weapons.name: Burnt Sienna
weapons.source: Dropped by Tomb Crawlers
weapons.why: strong early ranged melee whip option
weapons.effect: Causes enemies to erupt into healing projectiles on death
weapons.desc: The Burnt Sienna is a Pre-Hardmode broadsword that drops from Tomb Crawlers. When swung, it emits visual light particles. Enemies killed using the weapon will drop three small orbs that each heal the player for 2 HP when picked up.

weapons.name: Enchanted Boomerang
weapons.source: Crafted at By Hand
weapons.why: Upgraded boomerang that returns faster and hits harder.
weapons.desc: The Enchanted Boomerang is a pre-Hardmode boomerang. It is a direct upgrade to the Wooden Boomerang.

weapons.name: Monstrous Knives
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws a spread of short-range knives that heal the user
weapons.desc: The Monstrous Knives are a Pre-Hardmode melee weapon that act similarly to the Vampire Knives. When used, the player throws a spread of 3-4 gravity-affected knives that heal the player for 5% to 10% of the damage dealt. The knives fade away after a short amount of time, losing 10% of its damage and knockback every 0.5 seconds, then disappear into cosmetic red dust when fully transparent.

weapons.name: Starfury
weapons.source: Found in Skyware Chests (Floating Islands)
weapons.why: Calls a falling star from the sky on each swing.
weapons.effect: Causes stars to rain from the sky · 'Forged with the fury of heaven'
weapons.desc: The Starfury is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being found inside Skyware Chests on Floating Islands, as well as a 1/4 (25%) chance of being obtained from Sky Crates (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) and Azure Crates (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions). When swung, it occasionally summons a star projectile that falls from the sky to the cursor. The star deals ×1.5 the weapon's damage (37 base damage) but no knockback, and pierces once. [ 1 ] The star will pass through all blocks until it reaches the lowest empty space at or above the cursor, after which it will break on the next block it hits.

weapons.name: Terragrim
weapons.source: Rare drop from Enchanted Sword Shrine swords
weapons.why: Rapidly releases a flurry of slash projectiles toward the cursor when used.
weapons.effect: Unleashes a dicing flurry
weapons.desc: The Terragrim is a pre-Hardmode melee weapon. When used, it rapidly releases slashes aimed towards the cursor. Anything within this area takes constant damage at a rate exceeding the weapon's stated use time.

armor.name: Gold armor
armor.why: Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +3 defense · Enemies have a 2% chance to drop 1 gold coin, and bosses always drop an extra 3 gold coin · +1% critical strike chance per 5 gold coin in inventory, capped at +5%
armor.desc: Gold armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Gold Helmet, Gold Chainmail, and Gold Greaves. The full set grants 16 defense while equipped.

armor.name: Platinum armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +4 defense · +10% damage reduction
armor.desc: Platinum armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Platinum Helmet, Platinum Chainmail, and Platinum Greaves. The full set grants 20 defense while equipped.

armor.name: Silver armor
armor.why: Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +3 defense · 2 seconds after being hit for ≥20 damage, heal for 10 health; getting hit again during this time will reset the timer
armor.desc: Silver armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Silver Helmet, Silver Chainmail, and Silver Greaves. The full set grants 13 defense while equipped.

accessories.name: Wulfrum Controller
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Summons a wulfrum droid to fight for you · Hold ⚷ Open / Activate while holding the remote to switch all of your drones between regular and supercharge mode · Supercharged droids will stop attacking and focus wulfrum energy onto you · Supercharged droids provide +0.25 HP/s life regen and 2 defense per droid · Can also be used to heal other players by keeping your mouse cursor close enough to them
accessories.desc: The Wulfrum Controller is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. When used with its primary function (left-click), it summons a Wulfrum Droid minion that floats by the player and attacks nearby enemies by firing green energy bolts that cannot pierce but can curve towards nearby enemies. The droid waits a random time from 0.49-1.83 seconds between shots, and recoils in the opposite direction of its shot while shooting.

accessories.name: Any Double Jump
accessories.source: Any double-jump bottle: Cloud, Blizzard, Sandstorm, Tsunami or Fart in a Jar

accessories.name: Frog Leg
accessories.source: Fished in any viable body of water
accessories.why: extra jump and fall speed mobility
accessories.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
accessories.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

accessories.name: Hermes Boots
accessories.source: Found in Underground and Cavern Chests
accessories.why: Movement is survival in early Terraria, and Hermes Boots give you the speed to dodge, kite, and position better.
accessories.effect: The wearer can run super fast
accessories.desc: The Hermes Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Chests in the Underground and Cavern layers. While equipped, they grant the ability to sprint, allowing the player to reach maximum running speed faster, and they increase the player's maximum movement speed to 31 mph (22.73 tiles/second). The player will leave behind a visual trail of dust clouds as they sprint.

accessories.name: Magiluminescence
accessories.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.why: Increases the player's movement speed by 15%, and their acceleration (and deceleration) by 75%. This movement speed buff no longer applies if the player is not grounded.
accessories.effect: Increases movement speed and acceleration · Provides light when worn · 'A brief light in my dark life.'
accessories.desc: The Magiluminescence is a pre-Hardmode accessory that increases the player's maximum movement speed by 15% and their acceleration and deceleration by 75%. This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

accessories.name: Black Glass Band
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Enemy hits create an obsidian flash that always critically strikes · This effect has a 5 second cooldown, but is halved if the flash kills an enemy · Visual and audio effects are reduced if visibility is disabled · 'A shining band with boundless potential'
accessories.desc: The Black Glass Band is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it releases an obsidian strike upon enemy hits that deals 20 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 5 second cooldown that is halved if the enemy is killed with the strike. The strike's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

accessories.name: Craw Carapace
accessories.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
accessories.effect: 7% increased damage · Attackers take damage and are inflicted with Crumbling
accessories.desc: The Craw Carapace is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12. While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

accessories.name: Feral Claws
accessories.source: Found in Jungle Chests, Ivy Chests and Jungle Crates
accessories.why: The melee speed and autoswing boost noticeably improves several early melee weapons.
accessories.effect: 12% increased melee speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons
accessories.desc: Feral Claws are a pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Jungle Crates, Bramble Crates, and Ivy Chests located in Jungle Shrines and at the base of a Living Mahogany Tree in the Underground Jungle. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

accessories.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
accessories.source: Dropped by Blood Feeders, Crimeras and Face Monsters in the Crimson
accessories.why: Provides all weapons with 5 unconditional armor penetration. Can be stacked with or upgraded into the Stinger Necklace.
accessories.effect: Increases armor penetration by 5
accessories.desc: The Shark Tooth Necklace is an accessory which has a 1/150 (0.67%) / 1/75 (1.33%) chance to drop from Blood Zombies and Dripplers found during a Blood Moon. It increases the player's armor penetration by 5 when equipped.

accessories.name: Gladiator's Locket
accessories.source: Purchased from Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found
accessories.effect: Enemies drop a healing orb on kill · Gain an increase to your damage and movement speed the lower your health is, up to 20% at 50% life or below
accessories.desc: The Gladiator's Locket is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is found in the Marble Cave shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found. When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

accessories.name: Ilmeris' Spark
accessories.effect: Taking damage releases a blast of sparks
accessories.desc: Ilmeris' Spark is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Cnidrions. When equipped, it causes the player to release 8 gravity-affected sparks around them when harmed by any source of damage. These sparks linger for 2 seconds, partially ignore immunity frames, and deal 6 base damage, which is boosted by the player's highest class' damage.

accessories.name: Rover Drive
accessories.effect: Gain a barrier with 20 health · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · The barrier will regenerate 10 seconds after being hit, taking 5 seconds to completely regenerate · Getting hit resets the timer · Can also be scrapped at an extractinator
accessories.desc: The Rover Drive is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Wulfrum Rovers. When equipped for 10 seconds without taking damage, a protective matrix covers its user, which grants 20 matrix durability. If the player gets hit, durability is lost instead of health by the amount of damage taken.

buffs.name: Lesser Healing Potions
buffs.source: Crafted

buffs.name: Eggnog
buffs.source: Dropped by Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event
buffs.desc: Eggnog is a pre-Hardmode recovery potion that can be dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event, with a chance of 8.101% in pre-Hardmode and 7.561% in Hardmode. When used, it restores 80 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 40 seconds. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Well Fed
buffs.source: Any cooked food buff
buffs.why: A food buff is easy value and should be active almost all the time once you can maintain it.
buffs.desc: Well Fed, Plenty Satisfied, and Exquisitely Stuffed are buffs granted to the player when they consume food, which provide general stat bonuses that vary in potency and duration depending on the food item consumed. In Expert Mode, health regeneration will only be fully effective while the player is under the effects of one of these buffs. While one of these buffs is active in a The Constant or Zenith special world seed, the player will also be temporarily immune to hunger for the buff's duration.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Sharpened
buffs.source: Purchased from Merchant for 10 GC
buffs.desc: The Sharpening Station is a furniture item found naturally generated in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle. In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Merchant for 10 GC.

buffs.name: Thorns Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Thorns Potion is a buff potion which grants the Thorns buff when consumed. The buff inflicts a knockback of 10 (Extremely strong) on enemies that come into contact with the player, and deals 100% of their damage to them. [ 1 ] This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Extra jump
items.desc: Extra jumps allow the player to perform one or more extra mid-air jumps and are granted by five different accessories and four different mounts.

items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance

items.desc: The Shark Tooth Necklace is an accessory which has a 1/150 (0.67%) / 1/75 (1.33%) chance to drop from Blood Zombies and Dripplers found during a Blood Moon. It increases the player's armor penetration by 5 when equipped.

weapons.name: Demon Bow
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Corruption bow requiring Shadow Scales dropped by the Eater of Worlds.
weapons.desc: It is the Corruption counterpart to The Crimson 's Tendon Bow.

weapons.name: Tendon Bow
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Crimson counterpart to the Demon Bow.
weapons.desc: It is the Crimson counterpart to The Corruption 's Demon Bow.

weapons.name: Flintlock Pistol
weapons.source: Purchased from the Arms Dealer (5 GC)
weapons.why: Basic pistol sold by the Arms Dealer before any boss.
weapons.desc: The Flintlock Pistol is a pre-Hardmode gun that can be bought from the Arms Dealer for 5 GC.

weapons.name: Molotov Cocktail
weapons.source: Crafted at a By Hand
weapons.effect: A small explosion that puts enemies on fire · Lights nearby area on fire for a while
weapons.desc: The Molotov Cocktail is a consumable ranged weapon with a relatively short throwing arc. Upon hitting a solid object or enemy, it will explode and release 6 Molotov Fire light emitting projectiles, which can hit up to 3 targets. These smaller projectiles deal 50% damage (11 base damage), apply no knockback and inflict the On Fire! debuff on enemies for 3–6 seconds.

weapons.name: Paintball Gun
weapons.source: Purchased from the Painter
weapons.why: Fires a three-shot burst of arcing paintballs and uses no ammunition.
weapons.desc: The Paintball Gun is a pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that fires a three-shot burst of slow-moving, arcing multicolored Paintball projectiles which consume no mana or ammunition, dissipating upon contact with an enemy or surface. The Paintball Gun has a 11% critical strike chance, as opposed to the usual 4%. It has a 1/10 (10%) chance of being dropped by the Painter.

weapons.name: Spark Spreader
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Ignites your foe with flaming sparks · Uses gel for ammo
weapons.desc: The Spark Spreader is a Pre-Hardmode flamethrower that uses Gel for ammunition. When used, it fires bursts of 4 short-ranged orange sparks with a 0.2 second delay in between. The sparks inflict the On Fire! debuff and pierce three enemies.

weapons.name: Wulfrum Controller
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons a wulfrum droid to fight for you · Hold ⚷ Open / Activate while holding the remote to switch all of your drones between regular and supercharge mode · Supercharged droids will stop attacking and focus wulfrum energy onto you · Supercharged droids provide +0.25 HP/s life regen and 2 defense per droid · Can also be used to heal other players by keeping your mouse cursor close enough to them

armor.effect: 20% chance to save ammo
armor.desc: Fossil armor is a pre-Hardmode ranged armor set consisting of the Fossil Helmet, Fossil Plate, and Fossil Greaves.

armor.name: Snow Ruffian armor
armor.effect: You can glide to negate fall damage · Ranged critical strikes inflict Frostburn for 2 seconds
armor.desc: Snow Ruffian armor is a Pre-Hardmode ranged armor set.

accessories.desc: The Scions Curio is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Rusty Chests. When equipped, it makes killing an enemy or getting hit create a blast that inflicts Irradiated for 5 seconds. Also, hitting enemies with ranged weapons boost the effects of the Irradiated debuff in the following ways:

accessories.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
accessories.source: Dropped by Blood Feeders, Crimeras and Face Monsters in the Crimson
accessories.why: Provides all weapons with 5 unconditional armor penetration. Can be stacked with or upgraded into the Stinger Necklace.
accessories.effect: Increases armor penetration by 5
accessories.desc: The Shark Tooth Necklace is an accessory which has a 1/150 (0.67%) / 1/75 (1.33%) chance to drop from Blood Zombies and Dripplers found during a Blood Moon. It increases the player's armor penetration by 5 when equipped.

accessories.name: Gladiator's Locket
accessories.source: Purchased from Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found
accessories.effect: Enemies drop a healing orb on kill · Gain an increase to your damage and movement speed the lower your health is, up to 20% at 50% life or below
accessories.desc: The Gladiator's Locket is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is found in the Marble Cave shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found. When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

accessories.name: Ilmeris' Spark
accessories.effect: Taking damage releases a blast of sparks
accessories.desc: Ilmeris' Spark is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Cnidrions. When equipped, it causes the player to release 8 gravity-affected sparks around them when harmed by any source of damage. These sparks linger for 2 seconds, partially ignore immunity frames, and deal 6 base damage, which is boosted by the player's highest class' damage.

accessories.name: Rover Drive
accessories.effect: Gain a barrier with 20 health · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · The barrier will regenerate 10 seconds after being hit, taking 5 seconds to completely regenerate · Getting hit resets the timer · Can also be scrapped at an extractinator
accessories.desc: The Rover Drive is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Wulfrum Rovers. When equipped for 10 seconds without taking damage, a protective matrix covers its user, which grants 20 matrix durability. If the player gets hit, durability is lost instead of health by the amount of damage taken.

buffs.name: Lesser Healing Potions
buffs.source: Crafted

buffs.name: Eggnog
buffs.source: Dropped by Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event
buffs.desc: Eggnog is a pre-Hardmode recovery potion that can be dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event, with a chance of 8.101% in pre-Hardmode and 7.561% in Hardmode. When used, it restores 80 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 40 seconds. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Well Fed
buffs.source: Any cooked food buff
buffs.why: It is a free all-purpose bump to damage, survivability, and movement.
buffs.desc: Well Fed, Plenty Satisfied, and Exquisitely Stuffed are buffs granted to the player when they consume food, which provide general stat bonuses that vary in potency and duration depending on the food item consumed. In Expert Mode, health regeneration will only be fully effective while the player is under the effects of one of these buffs. While one of these buffs is active in a The Constant or Zenith special world seed, the player will also be temporarily immune to hunger for the buff's duration.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Survival matters a lot once the phase is dominated by hard optional content and fast fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Even ranged classes need extra defense when bosses or cave enemies close the gap.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Ammo consumption adds up quickly, so this makes a stack last longer.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ammo Reservation Potion is a buff potion which grants the Ammo Reservation buff when consumed. The buff reduces the chance of consuming any ammunition by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Archery Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Raises arrow damage by 10% and arrow speed by 20%. Bows only.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Archery Potion is a buff potion which grants the Archery buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage of arrow -firing weapons by 10%, as well as the velocity of arrows by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Thorns Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Thorns Potion is a buff potion which grants the Thorns buff when consumed. The buff inflicts a knockback of 10 (Extremely strong) on enemies that come into contact with the player, and deals 100% of their damage to them. [ 1 ] This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Flash Rounds
buffs.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
buffs.station: Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil

ammo.name: Jester's Arrows
ammo.desc: The Jester's Arrow is a pre-Hardmode arrow. It is unaffected by gravity and can pierce an infinite number of enemies, and its damage decreases by 10% per each enemy pierced.

ammo.name: Silver Bullets
ammo.desc: The Silver Bullet is a pre-Hardmode bullet. It deals 2 more damage and is slightly faster than Musket Balls. It also deals 300% damage to Werewolves. [ 1 ]

ammo.name: Unholy Arrows
ammo.desc: The Unholy Arrow is a pre-Hardmode arrow. It can pierce 4 enemies, and its damage decreases by 5% per enemy pierced.

items.name: Extra jump
items.desc: Extra jumps allow the player to perform one or more extra mid-air jumps and are granted by five different accessories and four different mounts.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.why: Upgrades of this are also viable.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
items.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

items.name: Hermes Boots
items.why: Upgrades of this are also viable.
items.effect: The wearer can run super fast
items.desc: The Hermes Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Chests in the Underground and Cavern layers. While equipped, they grant the ability to sprint, allowing the player to reach maximum running speed faster, and they increase the player's maximum movement speed to 31 mph (22.73 tiles/second). The player will leave behind a visual trail of dust clouds as they sprint.

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.effect: Increases movement speed and acceleration · Provides light when worn · 'A brief light in my dark life.'
items.desc: The Magiluminescence is a pre-Hardmode accessory that increases the player's maximum movement speed by 15% and their acceleration and deceleration by 75%. This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

items.name: Gladiator's Locket
items.why: This is difficult to obtain, and only one can be obtained per world.
items.effect: Enemies drop a healing orb on kill · Gain an increase to your damage and movement speed the lower your health is, up to 20% at 50% life or below
items.desc: The Gladiator's Locket is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is found in the Marble Cave shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found. When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

items.name: Ilmeris' Spark
items.why: This is best on worms and other multi-hit scenarios.
items.effect: Taking damage releases a blast of sparks

items.name: Rover Drive

items.name: Black Glass Band
items.effect: Enemy hits create an obsidian flash that always critically strikes · This effect has a 5 second cooldown, but is halved if the flash kills an enemy · Visual and audio effects are reduced if visibility is disabled · 'A shining band with boundless potential'
items.desc: The Black Glass Band is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it releases an obsidian strike upon enemy hits that deals 20 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 5 second cooldown that is halved if the enemy is killed with the strike. The strike's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

items.name: Craw Carapace
items.effect: 7% increased damage · Attackers take damage and are inflicted with Crumbling
items.desc: The Craw Carapace is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12. While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

items.name: Scions Curio
items.why: This is difficult to obtain.
items.effect: Ranged hits increase the effectiveness of Irradiated · Irradiated damage over time scales off of your ranged damage and crit chance · On kill, enemies burst, spreading Irradiated · Taking damage causes the curio to explode in retaliation · Current Irradiated damage: [DAMAGE]
items.desc: The Scions Curio is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Rusty Chests. When equipped, it makes killing an enemy or getting hit create a blast that inflicts Irradiated for 5 seconds. items.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
items.effect: Increases armor penetration by 5
items.desc: The Shark Tooth Necklace is an accessory which has a 1/150 (0.67%) / 1/75 (1.33%) chance to drop from Blood Zombies and Dripplers found during a Blood Moon. It increases the player's armor penetration by 5 when equipped.

weapons.name: Amber Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Gem staff whose amber bolt travels faster than other gem staves.
weapons.desc: The Amber Staff is a pre-Hardmode wand that fires an orange bolt that can pierce one enemy. It is the fifth tier of gem staff, along with the Ruby Staff, which has identical stats.

weapons.name: Crimson Rod
weapons.source: Destroyed from Crimson Hearts, or fished in Crimson/Hematic Crates
weapons.why: Places a lingering blood cloud that rains piercing droplets downward onto enemies below.
weapons.effect: Summons a cloud to rain blood on your foes
weapons.desc: The Crimson Rod is a pre-Hardmode magic weapon that launches a reddish rain cloud towards the cursor, where it rains damaging blood droplets downward onto enemies below. One cloud projectile can be placed at a time and it does not pass through terrain, instead stopping if it hits a surface before it reaches its target location. Once placed, the cloud will remain for five minutes, similarly to the Nimbus Rod 's cloud.

weapons.name: Thunder Zapper
weapons.source: Found in Sandstone Chests and Oasis/Mirage Crates (Desert)
weapons.why: Fires an electric bolt that pierces one enemy, found in the Desert.
weapons.desc: The Thunder Zapper is a pre-Hardmode wand that can be found in Sandstone Chests in the lower 3/7ths of the Underground Desert and in Oasis Crates and Mirage Crates obtained from fishing in the Oasis. When used, it fires a lightning bolt that travels in a zigzag pattern horizontally (but traveling straight when shooting directly up or down). The bolt dissipates with a visual explosion after traveling for about one second or upon hitting an enemy or a block.

weapons.name: Veering Wind
weapons.source: Crafted at a Bookcase
weapons.effect: Casts a circular spread of wind waves with high knockback · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to cast a circular spread of frost waves
weapons.desc: The Veering Wind is a Pre-Hardmode spell tome. When used with its primary fire (⚒ Use / Attack), it fires an even ring of 12 fast air waves which travel outwards from the player and deal heavy knockback. When used with its secondary fire (⚷ Open / Activate), it instead fires frost waves that inflict the Frostburn and Frozen debuffs, with 20% knockback, 25% velocity, and 50% attack speed compared to the air waves.

weapons.name: Vilethorn
weapons.source: Dropped by Shadow Orbs (Corruption); found in Corrupt Crates
weapons.why: Projects a piercing line of thorns through blocks and enemies.
weapons.effect: Summons a vile thorn
weapons.desc: The Vilethorn is a pre-Hardmode wand. It has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being obtained from destroying Shadow Orbs found in the Corruption or a 1/5 (20%) chance from Corrupt Crates (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) and Defiled Crates (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions), which are fished in the Corruption. When used, it extends a 15-tile-long thorn from the player's position, which passes through blocks, pierces infinite enemies, and hits rapidly for up to six times per enemy.

armor.name: Gold armor
armor.why: Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +3 defense · Enemies have a 2% chance to drop 1 gold coin, and bosses always drop an extra 3 gold coin · +1% critical strike chance per 5 gold coin in inventory, capped at +5%
armor.desc: Gold armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Gold Helmet, Gold Chainmail, and Gold Greaves. The full set grants 16 defense while equipped.

armor.name: Platinum armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +4 defense · +10% damage reduction
armor.desc: Platinum armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Platinum Helmet, Platinum Chainmail, and Platinum Greaves. The full set grants 20 defense while equipped.

armor.name: Silver armor
armor.why: Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +3 defense · 2 seconds after being hit for ≥20 damage, heal for 10 health; getting hit again during this time will reset the timer
armor.desc: Silver armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Silver Helmet, Silver Chainmail, and Silver Greaves. The full set grants 13 defense while equipped.

buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Extra jump
items.desc: Extra jumps allow the player to perform one or more extra mid-air jumps and are granted by five different accessories and four different mounts.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.why: Upgrades of this are also viable.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
items.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

items.name: Hermes Boots
items.why: Upgrades of this are also viable.
items.effect: The wearer can run super fast
items.desc: The Hermes Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Chests in the Underground and Cavern layers. While equipped, they grant the ability to sprint, allowing the player to reach maximum running speed faster, and they increase the player's maximum movement speed to 31 mph (22.73 tiles/second). The player will leave behind a visual trail of dust clouds as they sprint.

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.effect: Increases movement speed and acceleration · Provides light when worn · 'A brief light in my dark life.'
items.desc: The Magiluminescence is a pre-Hardmode accessory that increases the player's maximum movement speed by 15% and their acceleration and deceleration by 75%. This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

items.name: Gladiator's Locket
items.why: This is difficult to obtain, and only one can be obtained per world.
items.effect: Enemies drop a healing orb on kill · Gain an increase to your damage and movement speed the lower your health is, up to 20% at 50% life or below
items.desc: The Gladiator's Locket is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is found in the Marble Cave shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found. When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

items.name: Ilmeris' Spark
items.why: This is best on worms and other multi-hit scenarios.
items.effect: Taking damage releases a blast of sparks
items.desc: Ilmeris' Spark is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Cnidrions. When equipped, it causes the player to release 8 gravity-affected sparks around them when harmed by any source of damage. These sparks linger for 2 seconds, partially ignore immunity frames, and deal 6 base damage, which is boosted by the player's highest class' damage.

items.name: Rover Drive
items.effect: Gain a barrier with 20 health · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · The barrier will regenerate 10 seconds after being hit, taking 5 seconds to completely regenerate · Getting hit resets the timer · Can also be scrapped at an extractinator
items.desc: The Rover Drive is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Wulfrum Rovers. When equipped for 10 seconds without taking damage, a protective matrix covers its user, which grants 20 matrix durability. If the player gets hit, durability is lost instead of health by the amount of damage taken.

items.name: Band of Starpower
items.why: Upgrades of this are also viable.
items.effect: Increases maximum mana by 20
items.desc: The Band of Starpower is an accessory that increases the player's maximum mana by 20. The Band of Starpower has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being obtained from destroying Shadow Orbs found in the Corruption or a 1/5 (20%) chance from Corrupt Crates and Defiled Crates, which are fished in the Corruption. It can furthermore be crafted.

items.name: Black Glass Band
items.effect: Enemy hits create an obsidian flash that always critically strikes · This effect has a 5 second cooldown, but is halved if the flash kills an enemy · Visual and audio effects are reduced if visibility is disabled · 'A shining band with boundless potential'
items.desc: The Black Glass Band is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it releases an obsidian strike upon enemy hits that deals 20 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 5 second cooldown that is halved if the enemy is killed with the strike. The strike's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

items.name: Craw Carapace
items.effect: 7% increased damage · Attackers take damage and are inflicted with Crumbling
items.desc: The Craw Carapace is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12. While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

items.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
items.effect: Increases armor penetration by 5
items.desc: The Shark Tooth Necklace is an accessory which has a 1/150 (0.67%) / 1/75 (1.33%) chance to drop from Blood Zombies and Dripplers found during a Blood Moon. It increases the player's armor penetration by 5 when equipped.

weapons.name: Enchanted Knife Staff
weapons.source: Found in underground Gold Chests or from Golden or Titanium Crates
weapons.why: primary minion, strong ranged summon damage
weapons.effect: Summons an Enchanted Knife to fight for you
weapons.desc: The Enchanted Knife Staff is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that can be found in underground Gold Chests or from Golden or Titanium Crates. When used, it summons a floating knife that float over the player's head. While an enemy is nearby, it swings itself back and forth at a close distance from the enemy, shooting a knife beam that is unaffected by gravity and can pass through tiles.

weapons.name: Stormjaw Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Stormlions
weapons.effect: Summons a baby stormlion to fight for you
weapons.desc: The Stormjaw Staff is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by Stormlions. When used, it summons a miniature Stormlion minion. It runs on the ground and aggressively rams enemies back and forth, does not deal contact damage but creates damaging sparks in contact with enemies.

weapons.name: Sun Spirit Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons a solar spirit to protect you · Repeated summons increase its power
weapons.desc: The Sun Spirit Staff is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons a Solar Spirit minion above the player's head that fires non-piercing yellow energy beams at nearby enemies once every 0.83 seconds. Unlike most minions, only one Solar Spirit can be summoned at a time.

weapons.name: Rusty Beacon Prototype
weapons.source: Found in Rusty Chests
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons a long-abandoned drone that passively emits Irradiated waves
weapons.desc: The Rusty Beacon Prototype is a Pre-Hardmode sentry that can be found in Rusty Chests. When used, it summons a stationary Rusty drone that bobs up and down. Every 2 seconds, starting 1 second after it is summoned, it fires a toxic wave pulse that inflicts the Irradiated debuff.

weapons.name: Squirrel Squire Staff
weapons.source: Obtained from the Starter Bag
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons a squirrel to throw acorns at your enemies
weapons.desc: The Squirrel Squire Staff is a Pre-Hardmode sentry that is also obtained from the Starter Bag. When used, it summons a stationary squirrel sentry at the nearest block to the player's location. If there are no blocks directly underneath it, it will start falling.

weapons.name: Leather Whip
weapons.source: Purchased from the Zoologist (10 Gold)
weapons.why: Bought from the Zoologist and directs minions onto the struck target.
weapons.effect: 4 summon tag damage · Your summons will focus struck enemies · 'Die monster!'
weapons.desc: The Leather Whip is a pre-Hardmode whip that is normally always available to be purchased from the Zoologist for 10 GC (except in certain scenarios). It has a 50% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:

armor.name: Wulfrum armor
armor.effect: Wulfrum Bastion - Armor Set Bonus to equip a power armor, costing one Wulfrum Metal Scrap · While active, you can only use the integrated fusion cannon, but your defensive stats are increased · The armor lasts up to 30 seconds, but each hit loses 2 seconds of duration · Hold Shift to see the stats of the fusion cannon
armor.desc: Wulfrum armor is a Pre-Hardmode summoner armor set.

armor.name: Gold armor
armor.why: Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +3 defense · Enemies have a 2% chance to drop 1 gold coin, and bosses always drop an extra 3 gold coin · +1% critical strike chance per 5 gold coin in inventory, capped at +5%
armor.desc: Gold armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Gold Helmet, Gold Chainmail, and Gold Greaves. The full set grants 16 defense while equipped.

armor.name: Platinum armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +4 defense · +10% damage reduction
armor.desc: Platinum armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Platinum Helmet, Platinum Chainmail, and Platinum Greaves. The full set grants 20 defense while equipped.

armor.name: Silver armor
armor.why: Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +3 defense · 2 seconds after being hit for ≥20 damage, heal for 10 health; getting hit again during this time will reset the timer
armor.desc: Silver armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Silver Helmet, Silver Chainmail, and Silver Greaves. The full set grants 13 defense while equipped.

accessories.name: Any Double Jump
accessories.source: Any double-jump bottle: Cloud, Blizzard, Sandstorm, Tsunami or Fart in a Jar

accessories.name: Spirit Glyph
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Minion attacks provide various buffs · Hold Shift for more Spirit Power grants 10% increased summon damage · Spirit Defense grants 2 defense · Spirit Regen grants 0.5 HP/s life regeneration
accessories.desc: The Spirit Glyph is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, whenever a minion hits an enemy, the player is granted one of the following buffs:

accessories.source: Fished in any viable body of water
accessories.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
accessories.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

accessories.why: Movement is survival in early Terraria, and Hermes Boots give you the speed to dodge, kite, and position better.

accessories.why: Provides all weapons with 5 unconditional armor penetration. Can be stacked with or upgraded into the Stinger Necklace.
accessories.effect: Increases armor penetration by 5
accessories.desc: The Shark Tooth Necklace is an accessory which has a 1/150 (0.67%) / 1/75 (1.33%) chance to drop from Blood Zombies and Dripplers found during a Blood Moon. It increases the player's armor penetration by 5 when equipped.

accessories.desc: The Wulfrum Battery is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Wulfrum enemies. It grants the following effects while equipped:

buffs.name: Lesser Healing Potions
buffs.source: Crafted

buffs.name: Eggnog
buffs.source: Dropped by Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event
buffs.desc: Eggnog is a pre-Hardmode recovery potion that can be dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event, with a chance of 8.101% in pre-Hardmode and 7.561% in Hardmode. When used, it restores 80 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 40 seconds. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Well Fed
buffs.source: Any cooked food buff
buffs.why: It is a painless always-on stat boost for a class that wants every slot and every edge.
buffs.desc: Well Fed, Plenty Satisfied, and Exquisitely Stuffed are buffs granted to the player when they consume food, which provide general stat bonuses that vary in potency and duration depending on the food item consumed. In Expert Mode, health regeneration will only be fully effective while the player is under the effects of one of these buffs. While one of these buffs is active in a The Constant or Zenith special world seed, the player will also be temporarily immune to hunger for the buff's duration.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: The damage reduction is especially welcome in a phase full of punishing optional content.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: You are still fragile even with summons doing the work, so extra defense is welcome.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Thorns Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Thorns Potion is a buff potion which grants the Thorns buff when consumed. The buff inflicts a knockback of 10 (Extremely strong) on enemies that come into contact with the player, and deals 100% of their damage to them. [ 1 ] This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

weapons.name: Antlion Skewer
weapons.source: Dropped by Antlions
weapons.why: first-listed spam rogue weapon, strong sustained DPS
weapons.effect: Throws living, skewered Antlions that shoot sand blasts · Stealth strikes spew a mass of sand balls and gust · Sand clouds temporarily lower enemy contact damage
weapons.desc: The Antlion Skewer is a Pre-Hardmode javelin dropped by Antlions. When used, it throws a skewered Antlion javelin that is unaffected by gravity. After 0.25 seconds, the Antlion spits a sand ball in its direction which deals 50% damage, then accelerates for the next 0.5 seconds.

weapons.name: Contaminated Bile
weapons.source: Dropped by Gnashers
weapons.why: solid area-denial spam option; first-listed stealth strike option
weapons.effect: Throws a flask of Irradiated bile which shatters and lingers in a lcoud · Stealth strikes cause sulphuric bubbles to quickly rise from the cloud
weapons.desc: The Contaminated Bile is a Pre-Hardmode bomb dropped by Gnashers. It throws a bile flask that shatters into a lingering irradiated cloud on hit.

weapons.name: Gilded Dagger / Gleaming Dagger
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: reliable rapid-throw dagger; strong stealth-strike dagger

weapons.name: Urchin Stinger
weapons.source: Dropped by Aquatic Urchins
weapons.effect: Sticks into enemies and injects an extremely potent poison · Stealth strikes stick into and make enemies Poisoned for longer · Sticking seven stingers in an enemy with a stealth strike stuck in it spawns an irradiated blast
weapons.desc: Urchin Stingers are Pre-Hardmode rogue weapons dropped by Aquatic Urchins. When used, they fire an urchin stinger that travels a short distance before being affected by gravity. The urchin stinger pierces once and inflicts the Poisoned debuff on hit.

weapons.name: Wulfrum Knife
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires wulfrum knives in bursts of 3 that stick in enemies · Stealth strikes make the knife fly further and hit several times at once · ⚷ Open / Activate to magnetize all stuck knives back to you, restoring stealth · Returning knives also temporarily allows using stealth strikes without rogue armor
weapons.desc: The Wulfrum Knife is a Pre-Hardmode dagger. When used with its primary fire (⚒ Use / Attack), it throws a set of three knives in quick succession. The knives are affected by gravity and do not pierce.

weapons.name: Iron Francisca / Lead Tomahawk
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil

weapons.name: Wulfrum Controller
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons a wulfrum droid to fight for you · Hold ⚷ Open / Activate while holding the remote to switch all of your drones between regular and supercharge mode · Supercharged droids will stop attacking and focus wulfrum energy onto you · Supercharged droids provide +0.25 HP/s life regen and 2 defense per droid · Can also be used to heal other players by keeping your mouse cursor close enough to them
weapons.desc: The Wulfrum Controller is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. When used with its primary function (left-click), it summons a Wulfrum Droid minion that floats by the player and attacks nearby enemies by firing green energy bolts that cannot pierce but can curve towards nearby enemies. The droid waits a random time from 0.49-1.83 seconds between shots, and recoils in the opposite direction of its shot while shooting.

armor.name: Desert Prowler armor
armor.why: first-listed rogue armor at this tier
armor.effect: +50 maximum stealth · Sandsmoke Bomb - Armor Set Bonus to shroud yourself in a small cloud of sand · While the sand cloud is active, gain increased mobility but heavily reduced defense · Using a rogue weapon instantly dispels the sand cloak, but guarantees a supercrit for 200% damage · The supercrit applies only as long as the resulting hit wouldn't exceed 200 damage · Landing the killing blow on an enemy with this shot shortens the ability's cooldown to 2 seconds
armor.desc: Desert Prowler armor is a Pre-Hardmode rogue armor set.

armor.name: Gladiator armor
armor.effect: Grants immunity to knockback
armor.desc: Gladiator armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Gladiator Helmet, Gladiator Breastplate, and Gladiator Leggings. Each piece has a 1/21 (4.76%) chance of being dropped by Hoplites.

armor.name: Gold armor
armor.why: Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +3 defense · Enemies have a 2% chance to drop 1 gold coin, and bosses always drop an extra 3 gold coin · +1% critical strike chance per 5 gold coin in inventory, capped at +5%
armor.desc: Gold armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Gold Helmet, Gold Chainmail, and Gold Greaves. The full set grants 16 defense while equipped.

armor.name: Platinum armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +4 defense · +10% damage reduction
armor.desc: Platinum armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Platinum Helmet, Platinum Chainmail, and Platinum Greaves. The full set grants 20 defense while equipped.

armor.name: Silver armor
armor.why: Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +3 defense · 2 seconds after being hit for ≥20 damage, heal for 10 health; getting hit again during this time will reset the timer
armor.desc: Silver armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Silver Helmet, Silver Chainmail, and Silver Greaves. The full set grants 13 defense while equipped.

accessories.name: Any Double Jump
accessories.source: Any double-jump bottle: Cloud, Blizzard, Sandstorm, Tsunami or Fart in a Jar

accessories.name: Frog Leg
accessories.source: Fished in any viable body of water
accessories.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
accessories.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

accessories.name: Hermes Boots
accessories.source: Found in Underground and Cavern Chests
accessories.effect: The wearer can run super fast
accessories.desc: The Hermes Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Chests in the Underground and Cavern layers. While equipped, they grant the ability to sprint, allowing the player to reach maximum running speed faster, and they increase the player's maximum movement speed to 31 mph (22.73 tiles/second). The player will leave behind a visual trail of dust clouds as they sprint.

accessories.name: Magiluminescence
accessories.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Increases movement speed and acceleration · Provides light when worn · 'A brief light in my dark life.'
accessories.desc: The Magiluminescence is a pre-Hardmode accessory that increases the player's maximum movement speed by 15% and their acceleration and deceleration by 75%. This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

accessories.name: Black Glass Band
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Enemy hits create an obsidian flash that always critically strikes · This effect has a 5 second cooldown, but is halved if the flash kills an enemy · Visual and audio effects are reduced if visibility is disabled · 'A shining band with boundless potential'
accessories.desc: The Black Glass Band is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it releases an obsidian strike upon enemy hits that deals 20 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 5 second cooldown that is halved if the enemy is killed with the strike. The strike's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

accessories.name: Craw Carapace
accessories.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
accessories.effect: 7% increased damage · Attackers take damage and are inflicted with Crumbling
accessories.desc: The Craw Carapace is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12. While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

accessories.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
accessories.source: Dropped by Blood Feeders, Crimeras and Face Monsters in the Crimson
accessories.effect: Increases armor penetration by 5
accessories.desc: The Shark Tooth Necklace is an accessory which has a 1/150 (0.67%) / 1/75 (1.33%) chance to drop from Blood Zombies and Dripplers found during a Blood Moon. It increases the player's armor penetration by 5 when equipped.

accessories.name: Coin of Deceit
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Stealth strikes only expend 90% of your max stealth · 6% increased rogue crit chance
accessories.desc: The Coin of Deceit is a Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory. When equipped, it increases rogue critical strike chance by 6% and makes stealth strikes only require 90% of the player's maximum stealth to perform and consume 90% of the player's maximum stealth when performed.

accessories.name: Scuttler's Jewel
accessories.effect: Stealth strike projectiles spawn a jewel spike on hit or when destroyed · Can also be broken down at an extractinator
accessories.desc: The Scuttler's Jewel is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Crawlers. When equipped, it causes rogue projectiles to spawn a stationary floating jewel spike on the first hit of a stealth strike that deals 16 rogue damage. It can also be used at an Extractinator to obtain gems.

accessories.name: Gladiator's Locket
accessories.source: Purchased from Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found
accessories.effect: Enemies drop a healing orb on kill · Gain an increase to your damage and movement speed the lower your health is, up to 20% at 50% life or below
accessories.desc: The Gladiator's Locket is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is found in the Marble Cave shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found. When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

accessories.name: Ilmeris' Spark
accessories.effect: Taking damage releases a blast of sparks
accessories.desc: Ilmeris' Spark is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Cnidrions. When equipped, it causes the player to release 8 gravity-affected sparks around them when harmed by any source of damage. These sparks linger for 2 seconds, partially ignore immunity frames, and deal 6 base damage, which is boosted by the player's highest class' damage.

accessories.name: Rover Drive
accessories.effect: Gain a barrier with 20 health · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · The barrier will regenerate 10 seconds after being hit, taking 5 seconds to completely regenerate · Getting hit resets the timer · Can also be scrapped at an extractinator
accessories.desc: The Rover Drive is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Wulfrum Rovers. When equipped for 10 seconds without taking damage, a protective matrix covers its user, which grants 20 matrix durability. If the player gets hit, durability is lost instead of health by the amount of damage taken.

buffs.name: Purple Haze
buffs.source: Crafted at a Keg
buffs.station: Keg
buffs.desc: Purple Haze is a Pre-Hardmode alcohol. Upon consumption, it inflicts the Purple Haze debuff which, for 5 seconds after performing a stealth strike, increases non- stealth strike rogue damage by 25% but reduces stealth strike damage by 25%.

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Shadow Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Shadow Potion is a Pre-Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Shadow buff, which provides the following effects:

buffs.name: Thorns Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Thorns Potion is a buff potion which grants the Thorns buff when consumed. The buff inflicts a knockback of 10 (Extremely strong) on enemies that come into contact with the player, and deals 100% of their damage to them. [ 1 ] This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Well Fed
buffs.source: Any cooked food buff
buffs.desc: Well Fed, Plenty Satisfied, and Exquisitely Stuffed are buffs granted to the player when they consume food, which provide general stat bonuses that vary in potency and duration depending on the food item consumed. In Expert Mode, health regeneration will only be fully effective while the player is under the effects of one of these buffs. While one of these buffs is active in a The Constant or Zenith special world seed, the player will also be temporarily immune to hunger for the buff's duration.

items.name: Extra jump
items.desc: Extra jumps allow the player to perform one or more extra mid-air jumps and are granted by five different accessories and four different mounts.
