items.desc: The Worm Scarf is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Eater of Worlds ' Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While equipped, it grants +17% damage reduction.

items.name: Fungal Clump
items.effect: Summons a fungal clump to fight for you · The clump latches onto enemies and steals their life for you
items.desc: The Fungal Clump is an Expert Mode Pre-Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Crabulon. When equipped, it summons a Fungal Clump minion that attaches to enemies, damaging them and spawning blue healing orbs that home in on the player and heal them for 25% of the damage the minion deals.

items.name: Batholith Bangle
items.effect: Magic enemy hits create a powerful granite flash that always critically strikes · This effect has a 10 second cooldown · Visual and audio effects are reduced if visibility is disabled · 'The solid granite radiates energy throughout your body'
items.desc: The Batholith Bangle is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it releases a granite flash upon enemy hits with magic weapons that deals 50 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 10 second cooldown. The strike's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

items.name: Craw Carapace
items.effect: 7% increased damage · Attackers take damage and are inflicted with Crumbling
items.desc: The Craw Carapace is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12. While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

items.name: Mana Flower
items.effect: 8% reduced mana cost · Automatically use mana potions when needed
items.desc: The Mana Flower is a pre-Hardmode accessory that reduces mana usage by 8%, and enables auto-consumption of any mana-restoring potions in the player's inventory when mana is depleted. The Mana Flower stacks with other mana cost-reduction items, including Nature's Gift. It is.

items.name: Magic Cuffs
items.effect: Increases maximum mana by 20 · Restores mana when damaged
items.desc: The Magic Cuffs are a pre-Hardmode accessory which increases maximum mana by 20 and restores mana when the wearer is damaged.

weapons.name: Brittle Star Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by the Desert Scourge
weapons.why: primary minion staff at this tier
weapons.effect: Summons a small brittle starfish that will dash through enemies until it shatters · Starfish will quickly regenerate after shattering · Holding ⚷ Open / Activate will swap starfish between dashing and circling you · When the starfish are circling, each one provides you with 3 defense
weapons.desc: The Brittle Star Staff is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by the Desert Scourge. When used, it summons a Brittle Star minion, which follows the player and attacks enemies by dashing at them to deal damage. Brittle stars hit up to 4 enemies before shattering, quickly regenerating afterwards.

weapons.name: Deathstare Rod
weapons.source: Dropped by the Eye of Cthulhu
weapons.effect: Summons an eye above your head that watches you and shoots at enemies · There can only be one eye at a time
weapons.desc: The Deathstare Rod is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by the Eye of Cthulhu. When used, it summons a tiny floating eyeball above the player's head that fires lasers at nearby enemies once every second. On hit, the laser deals damage in a tiny area of effect.

weapons.name: Enchanted Conch
weapons.source: Purchased from Sea King for 2 gold
weapons.effect: Summons a hermit crab to fight for you
weapons.desc: The Enchanted Conch is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that is sold by the Sea King for 2. When used, it summons a Hermit Crab minion that runs on the ground or jumps around, dealing contact damage to enemies. If the player is far away, it will twirl around within its shell to catch up with them but will not be able to attack enemies while in this form.

weapons.name: Stormjaw Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Stormlions
weapons.effect: Summons a baby stormlion to fight for you
weapons.desc: The Stormjaw Staff is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by Stormlions. When used, it summons a miniature Stormlion minion. It runs on the ground and aggressively rams enemies back and forth, does not deal contact damage but creates damaging sparks in contact with enemies.

weapons.name: Polyp Launcher
weapons.source: Purchased from Sea King for 2 gold
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons a polyp bunch that launches coral chunks at nearby enemies
weapons.desc: Polyp Launcher is a Pre-Hardmode sentry that is sold by the Sea King for 2. When used, it summons a grounded polyp sentry which inaccurately fires gravity-affected balls of coral at nearby enemies. On hit, the coral chunk bursts into 1-4 fragments which deals half as much damage and knockback.

weapons.name: Rusty Beacon Prototype
weapons.source: Found in Rusty Chests
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons a long-abandoned drone that passively emits Irradiated waves
weapons.desc: The Rusty Beacon Prototype is a Pre-Hardmode sentry that can be found in Rusty Chests. When used, it summons a stationary Rusty drone that bobs up and down. Every 2 seconds, starting 1 second after it is summoned, it fires a toxic wave pulse that inflicts the Irradiated debuff.

weapons.name: Snapthorn
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Jungle-material whip that inflicts Acid Venom and grants summon tag damage.
weapons.effect: 6 summon tag damage · Your summons will focus struck enemies · Strike enemies to gain whip attack speed
weapons.desc: The Snapthorn is a pre-Hardmode whip. It has a 40% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:

armor.name: Obsidian armor
armor.why: Whip range +30%, whip speed +15%, summon damage +15%.
armor.effect: Increases whip range by 30% and speed by 15% · Increases summon damage by 15%
armor.desc: Obsidian armor is a pre-Hardmode summoner armor set consisting of the Obsidian Outlaw Hat, Obsidian Longcoat, and Obsidian Pants.

armor.name: Crimson armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.effect: Greatly increased life regeneration · This is increased the longer you are not damaged · Standing still also greatly increases life regeneration
armor.desc: Crimson armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Crimson Helmet, Crimson Scalemail, and Crimson Greaves.

armor.name: Shadow armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.effect: Increased movement speed and acceleration
armor.desc: Shadow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Shadow Helmet, Shadow Scalemail, and Shadow Greaves.

accessories.name: Any Balloon
accessories.source: Any jump balloon: Shiny Red Balloon, Cloud in a Balloon or a Bundle variant
accessories.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. These alternatives are grouped as " Any <groupname> ". For instance, items that use Any Wood as an ingredient can be.

accessories.name: Fledgling Wings
accessories.source: Found in Skyware Chests on Floating Islands
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: The Fledgling Wings are the only pre-Hardmode wings. Like all wings, they grant the player the ability to fly and glide when equipped, as well as not take fall damage. At top speed, they allow traveling at 15 mph horizontally and 22 mph vertically.

accessories.name: Fungal Clump
accessories.effect: Summons a fungal clump to fight for you · The clump latches onto enemies and steals their life for you
accessories.desc: The Fungal Clump is an Expert Mode Pre-Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Crabulon. When equipped, it summons a Fungal Clump minion that attaches to enemies, damaging them and spawning blue healing orbs that home in on the player and heal them for 25% of the damage the minion deals.

accessories.name: Spirit Glyph
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Minion attacks provide various buffs · Hold Shift for more Spirit Power grants 10% increased summon damage · Spirit Defense grants 2 defense · Spirit Regen grants 0.5 HP/s life regeneration
accessories.desc: The Spirit Glyph is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, whenever a minion hits an enemy, the player is granted one of the following buffs:

accessories.name: Frog Leg
accessories.source: Fished in any viable body of water
accessories.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
accessories.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

accessories.name: Lightning Boots
accessories.why: Sprint and flight movement in one slot, accelerating faster and reaching a higher top speed than Spectre Boots.
accessories.effect: Allows flight, super fast running · 8% increased movement speed
accessories.desc: The Lightning Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Spectre Boots. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Magiluminescence
accessories.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.why: Increases the player's movement speed by 15%, and their acceleration (and deceleration) by 75%. This movement speed buff no longer applies if the player is not grounded.
accessories.effect: Increases movement speed and acceleration · Provides light when worn · 'A brief light in my dark life.'
accessories.desc: The Magiluminescence is a pre-Hardmode accessory that increases the player's maximum movement speed by 15% and their acceleration and deceleration by 75%. This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

accessories.name: Shield of Cthulhu
accessories.source: Dropped by the Eye of Cthulhu treasure bag
accessories.why: Expert Mode only. Gives a dash that also damages enemies and grants brief invulnerability.
accessories.effect: Allows the player to dash into the enemy · Double tap a direction
accessories.desc: The Shield of Cthulhu is a pre-Hardmode shield accessory that is always dropped from the Eye of Cthulhu 's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While equipped, it grants 2 defense and allows the player to perform a dash attack by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right button, or the Dash button once. Dashing into an enemy deals damage to it, causes the player to bounce backward, and grants 0.07 seconds of invincibility frames and 0.17 seconds of immunity to contact damage from the hit enemy. [ 1 ] The cooldown between dashes is 0.5 seconds. [ 2 ]

accessories.name: Craw Carapace
accessories.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
accessories.effect: 7% increased damage · Attackers take damage and are inflicted with Crumbling
accessories.desc: The Craw Carapace is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12. While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

accessories.name: Voltaic Jelly
accessories.source: Dropped by Ghost Bells after Desert Scourge has been defeated
accessories.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Minion attacks inflict Static Discharge
accessories.desc: The Voltaic Jelly is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Ghost Bells after Desert Scourge has been defeated. When equipped, it grants +1 minion slot and a 20% chance for minions to inflict the Static Discharge debuff. It does not stack with the Jelly-Charged Battery or its upgrades.

accessories.name: Crown Jewel
accessories.effect: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s
accessories.desc: The Crown Jewel is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by King Slime. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Gladiator's Locket
accessories.source: Purchased from Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found
accessories.effect: Enemies drop a healing orb on kill · Gain an increase to your damage and movement speed the lower your health is, up to 20% at 50% life or below
accessories.desc: The Gladiator's Locket is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is found in the Marble Cave shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found. When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

accessories.name: Rover Drive
accessories.effect: Gain a barrier with 20 health · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · The barrier will regenerate 10 seconds after being hit, taking 5 seconds to completely regenerate · Getting hit resets the timer · Can also be scrapped at an extractinator
accessories.desc: The Rover Drive is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Wulfrum Rovers. When equipped for 10 seconds without taking damage, a protective matrix covers its user, which grants 20 matrix durability. If the player gets hit, durability is lost instead of health by the amount of damage taken.

accessories.name: Unholy/Vicious Tonic
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil

buffs.name: Healing Potions / Strange Brew
buffs.source: Crafted

buffs.name: Plenty Satisfied
buffs.desc: Well Fed, Plenty Satisfied, and Exquisitely Stuffed are buffs granted to the player when they consume food, which provide general stat bonuses that vary in potency and duration depending on the food item consumed. In Expert Mode, health regeneration will only be fully effective while the player is under the effects of one of these buffs. While one of these buffs is active in a The Constant or Zenith special world seed, the player will also be temporarily immune to hunger for the buff's duration.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: The damage reduction is especially welcome in a phase full of punishing optional content.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: You are still fragile even with summons doing the work, so extra defense is welcome.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Summoning Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: The extra minion slot is too valuable to skip, even in the earliest summoner boss prep.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Summoning Potion is a buff potion which grants the Summoning buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum number of minions by 1. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Thorns Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Thorns Potion is a buff potion which grants the Thorns buff when consumed. The buff inflicts a knockback of 10 (Extremely strong) on enemies that come into contact with the player, and deals 100% of their damage to them. [ 1 ] This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Bounding Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Bounding Potion is a Pre-Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Bounding buff, which increases jump speed by 5% and jump height by 20%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Extra jump
items.desc: Extra jumps allow the player to perform one or more extra mid-air jumps and are granted by five different accessories and four different mounts.

items.desc: The Brain of Confusion is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Brain of Cthulhu 's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. It grants the following effects while equipped:

When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

items.name: Unholy Tonic
items.why: Use which matches your world evil.
items.effect: Increases defense by 3 while in the corruption · Grants immunity to Brain Rot
items.desc: The Unholy Tonic is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. When equipped, it grants +3 defense while in The Corruption. It also grants immunity to the Brain Rot debuff.

items.name: Vicious Tonic
items.why: Use which matches your world evil.
items.effect: Increases defense by 3 while in the crimson · Grants immunity to Burning Blood
items.desc: The Vicious Tonic is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. When equipped, it grants +3 defense while in The Crimson. It also grants immunity to the Burning Blood debuff.

weapons.name: Pumpkaboom
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws a pumpkin which sticks to enemies and explodes after a delay · Stealth strikes throw larger pumpkins which pull enemies in before releasing a larger explosion
weapons.desc: The Pumpkaboom is a Pre-Hardmode bomb. When used, it throws a pumpkin bomb that sticks to enemies on hit. Upon sticking to enemies for 1.83 seconds, it explodes in a 10.625 tile radius for 200% damage.

weapons.name: Sand Dollar
weapons.source: Purchased from Sea King for 2 gold
weapons.effect: Throws up to 2 returning sand dollars · Stealth strikes throw 2 long ranged sand dollars that explode into coral shards on enemy hits
weapons.desc: The Sand Dollar is a Pre-Hardmode rogue boomerang that is sold by the Sea King for 2. When used, it throws up to 2 sand dollars that return to the player after traveling a moderate distance or hitting an enemy.

weapons.name: Seafoam Bomb
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws a bomb that explodes into a bubble which deals extra damage to enemies · Stealth strikes are faster and explode into 5 bubbles
weapons.desc: The Seafoam Bomb is a Pre-Hardmode non-consumable bomb. When used, it throws a small bomb that travels a short distance before being affected by gravity. Upon collision with a tile or enemy, the bomb explodes into a bubble that ignores enemy immunity frames.

weapons.name: Spore Knife
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: listed under both spam and stealth
weapons.effect: Throws an overgrown dagger that bursts into a cloud of poisonous spores · Stealth strikes erupt into hungry homing buds that stick to enemies and gnaw them
weapons.desc: The Spore Knife is a Pre-Hardmode dagger. It releases damaging spore clouds upon contact with a surface or enemy.

weapons.name: Contaminated Bile
weapons.source: Dropped by Gnashers
weapons.effect: Throws a flask of Irradiated bile which shatters and lingers in a lcoud · Stealth strikes cause sulphuric bubbles to quickly rise from the cloud
weapons.desc: The Contaminated Bile is a Pre-Hardmode bomb dropped by Gnashers. It throws a bile flask that shatters into a lingering irradiated cloud on hit.

weapons.name: Scourge of the Desert
weapons.source: Dropped by the Desert Scourge
weapons.effect: A javelin that will burrow through the ground and launch itself at enemies · Stealth strikes throw three javelins that will burrow multiple times
weapons.desc: The Scourge of the Desert is a javelin dropped by the Desert Scourge. When used, it throws a javelin that burrows into tiles and launches itself towards the closest enemy when burrowing through tiles. Thrown javelins are slightly affected by gravity and pierce twice.

weapons.name: Brittle Star Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by the Desert Scourge
weapons.effect: Summons a small brittle starfish that will dash through enemies until it shatters · Starfish will quickly regenerate after shattering · Holding ⚷ Open / Activate will swap starfish between dashing and circling you · When the starfish are circling, each one provides you with 3 defense
weapons.desc: The Brittle Star Staff is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by the Desert Scourge. When used, it summons a Brittle Star minion, which follows the player and attacks enemies by dashing at them to deal damage. Brittle stars hit up to 4 enemies before shattering, quickly regenerating afterwards.

weapons.name: Wulfrum Controller
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons a wulfrum droid to fight for you · Hold ⚷ Open / Activate while holding the remote to switch all of your drones between regular and supercharge mode · Supercharged droids will stop attacking and focus wulfrum energy onto you · Supercharged droids provide +0.25 HP/s life regen and 2 defense per droid · Can also be used to heal other players by keeping your mouse cursor close enough to them
weapons.desc: The Wulfrum Controller is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. When used with its primary function (left-click), it summons a Wulfrum Droid minion that floats by the player and attacks nearby enemies by firing green energy bolts that cannot pierce but can curve towards nearby enemies. The droid waits a random time from 0.49-1.83 seconds between shots, and recoils in the opposite direction of its shot while shooting.

armor.name: Sulphurous armor
armor.effect: +65 maximum stealth · Attacking and being attacked by enemies inflicts Poisoned for 1 second · Grants an additional jump that summons a sulphurous bubble · Reduces the severity of the sulphuric waters
armor.desc: Sulphurous armor is a Pre-Hardmode rogue armor set.

armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Crimson worlds only. Greatly increased life regeneration.

armor.desc: Shadow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Shadow Helmet, Shadow Scalemail, and Shadow Greaves.

accessories.name: Any Balloon
accessories.source: Any jump balloon: Shiny Red Balloon, Cloud in a Balloon or a Bundle variant
accessories.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. These alternatives are grouped as " Any <groupname> ". For instance, items that use Any Wood as an ingredient can be.

accessories.name: Fledgling Wings
accessories.source: Found in Skyware Chests on Floating Islands
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: The Fledgling Wings are the only pre-Hardmode wings. Like all wings, they grant the player the ability to fly and glide when equipped, as well as not take fall damage. At top speed, they allow traveling at 15 mph horizontally and 22 mph vertically.

accessories.name: Fungal Clump
accessories.effect: Summons a fungal clump to fight for you · The clump latches onto enemies and steals their life for you
accessories.desc: The Fungal Clump is an Expert Mode Pre-Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Crabulon. When equipped, it summons a Fungal Clump minion that attaches to enemies, damaging them and spawning blue healing orbs that home in on the player and heal them for 25% of the damage the minion deals.

accessories.name: Frog Leg
accessories.source: Fished in any viable body of water
accessories.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
accessories.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

accessories.name: Lightning Boots
accessories.effect: Allows flight, super fast running · 8% increased movement speed
accessories.desc: The Lightning Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Spectre Boots. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Magiluminescence
accessories.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Increases movement speed and acceleration · Provides light when worn · 'A brief light in my dark life.'
accessories.desc: The Magiluminescence is a pre-Hardmode accessory that increases the player's maximum movement speed by 15% and their acceleration and deceleration by 75%. This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

accessories.name: Shield of Cthulhu
accessories.source: Dropped by the Eye of Cthulhu treasure bag
accessories.effect: Allows the player to dash into the enemy · Double tap a direction
accessories.desc: The Shield of Cthulhu is a pre-Hardmode shield accessory that is always dropped from the Eye of Cthulhu 's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While equipped, it grants 2 defense and allows the player to perform a dash attack by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right button, or the Dash button once. Dashing into an enemy deals damage to it, causes the player to bounce backward, and grants 0.07 seconds of invincibility frames and 0.17 seconds of immunity to contact damage from the hit enemy. [ 1 ] The cooldown between dashes is 0.5 seconds. [ 2 ]

accessories.name: Crown Jewel
accessories.effect: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s
accessories.desc: The Crown Jewel is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by King Slime. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Gladiator's Locket
accessories.source: Purchased from Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found
accessories.effect: Enemies drop a healing orb on kill · Gain an increase to your damage and movement speed the lower your health is, up to 20% at 50% life or below
accessories.desc: The Gladiator's Locket is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is found in the Marble Cave shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found. When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

accessories.name: Rover Drive
accessories.effect: Gain a barrier with 20 health · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · The barrier will regenerate 10 seconds after being hit, taking 5 seconds to completely regenerate · Getting hit resets the timer · Can also be scrapped at an extractinator
accessories.desc: The Rover Drive is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Wulfrum Rovers. When equipped for 10 seconds without taking damage, a protective matrix covers its user, which grants 20 matrix durability. If the player gets hit, durability is lost instead of health by the amount of damage taken.

accessories.name: Unholy Tonic / Vicious Tonic
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil

accessories.name: Amidias' Pendant
accessories.effect: Periodically rains down prism shards that can briefly stun enemies
accessories.desc: Amidias' Pendant is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by the Giant Clam. While equipped, it causes 3 homing prism shards to fall from the sky every 2 seconds. Each shard deals 30 base damage.

accessories.name: Black Glass Band
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Enemy hits create an obsidian flash that always critically strikes · This effect has a 5 second cooldown, but is halved if the flash kills an enemy · Visual and audio effects are reduced if visibility is disabled · 'A shining band with boundless potential'
accessories.desc: The Black Glass Band is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it releases an obsidian strike upon enemy hits that deals 20 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 5 second cooldown that is halved if the enemy is killed with the strike. The strike's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

accessories.name: Coin of Deceit
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Stealth strikes only expend 90% of your max stealth · 6% increased rogue crit chance
accessories.desc: The Coin of Deceit is a Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory. When equipped, it increases rogue critical strike chance by 6% and makes stealth strikes only require 90% of the player's maximum stealth to perform and consume 90% of the player's maximum stealth when performed.

accessories.name: Craw Carapace
accessories.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
accessories.effect: 7% increased damage · Attackers take damage and are inflicted with Crumbling
accessories.desc: The Craw Carapace is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12. While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

accessories.name: Scuttler's Jewel
accessories.effect: Stealth strike projectiles spawn a jewel spike on hit or when destroyed · Can also be broken down at an extractinator
accessories.desc: The Scuttler's Jewel is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Crawlers. When equipped, it causes rogue projectiles to spawn a stationary floating jewel spike on the first hit of a stealth strike that deals 16 rogue damage. It can also be used at an Extractinator to obtain gems.

buffs.name: Plenty Satisfied
buffs.desc: Well Fed, Plenty Satisfied, and Exquisitely Stuffed are buffs granted to the player when they consume food, which provide general stat bonuses that vary in potency and duration depending on the food item consumed. In Expert Mode, health regeneration will only be fully effective while the player is under the effects of one of these buffs. While one of these buffs is active in a The Constant or Zenith special world seed, the player will also be temporarily immune to hunger for the buff's duration.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Shadow Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Shadow Potion is a Pre-Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Shadow buff, which provides the following effects:

buffs.name: Thorns Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Thorns Potion is a buff potion which grants the Thorns buff when consumed. The buff inflicts a knockback of 10 (Extremely strong) on enemies that come into contact with the player, and deals 100% of their damage to them. [ 1 ] This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Bounding Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Bounding Potion is a Pre-Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Bounding buff, which increases jump speed by 5% and jump height by 20%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
items.effect: Increases armor penetration by 5
items.desc: The Shark Tooth Necklace is an accessory which has a 1/150 (0.67%) / 1/75 (1.33%) chance to drop from Blood Zombies and Dripplers found during a Blood Moon. It increases the player's armor penetration by 5 when equipped.

items.effect: Stealth strike projectiles spawn a jewel spike on hit or when destroyed · Can also be broken down at an extractinator

items.name: Silencing Sheath
items.effect: +10 maximum stealth, and stealth generates 4% faster
items.desc: The Silencing Sheath is a Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory. When equipped, it increases maximum rogue stealth by 10 and increases rogue stealth generation by 4%.

weapons.name: Falcon Blade
weapons.source: From Iron/Mythril Crates (fishing)
weapons.why: Obtained from Iron and Mythril fishing crates.
weapons.effect: Rapid attacks deal more damage
weapons.desc: The Falcon Blade is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 38/625 (6.08%) chance of being obtained from Iron Crates and a 299/5000 (5.98%) chance from Mythril Crates. Striking enemies with the weapon increases its damage by 12% per hit, up to a maximum of 50%. This damage bonus decays at a rate of 0.5% per tick [ 1 ] or 30% per second. [ 2 ]

weapons.name: Muramasa
weapons.source: Found in Dungeon Locked Gold Chests
weapons.why: Fast broadsword found in the Dungeon after Skeletron.
weapons.desc: The Muramasa is a pre-Hardmode, post- Skeletron broadsword that has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being obtained from the Locked Gold Chests found in the Dungeon, as well as a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being obtained from Golden Lock Boxes. When swung, it creates a blue slash upon enemy hits. The slashes deal 50% of the weapon's damage (12 base damage) [ 1 ], inflict no knockback, do not pierce, and have 5 armor penetration. [ 2 ]

weapons.name: Night's Edge
weapons.source: Crafted at Demon Altar or Crimson Altar
weapons.why: Wide-arc broadsword with the highest pre-Hardmode melee damage.
weapons.desc: The Night's Edge is a pre-Hardmode, post- Skeletron broadsword. When swung, a circular purple aura follows the swing, reaching slightly farther than the sword itself. Another aura swings towards the cursor, further increasing range.

armor.name: Aerospec armor
armor.effect: Taking over 25 damage in one hit will cause a spread of homing feathers to fall · Allows you to fall more quickly and disables fall damage · Helm: 5% increased movement speed and melee critical strike chance · Enemies are more likely to target you · Hood: 5% increased movement speed and ranged critical strike chance · Hat: 8% reduced mana cost · 5% increased movement speed and magic critical strike chance · Helmet: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · 11% increased summon damage · Summons a valkyrie to protect you · Headgear: +80 maximum stealth · 5% increased movement speed and rogue critical strike chance
armor.desc: Aerospec armor is a Pre-Hardmode armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit afterimages.

armor.name: Molten armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: 10% extra melee damage, immunity to fire blocks, and you cannot be set on fire.
armor.effect: 10% extra melee damage · Grants immunity to fire blocks · Cannot be set on fire
armor.desc: Molten armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Molten Helmet, Molten Breastplate, and Molten Greaves.

armor.name: Crimson armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Crimson worlds only. Greatly increased life regeneration.
armor.effect: Greatly increased life regeneration · This is increased the longer you are not damaged · Standing still also greatly increases life regeneration
armor.desc: Crimson armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Crimson Helmet, Crimson Scalemail, and Crimson Greaves.

accessories.desc: The Worm Scarf is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Eater of Worlds ' Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While equipped, it grants +17% damage reduction.

buffs.name: Healing Potions
buffs.source: Crafted

buffs.name: Strange Brew
buffs.source: Purchased from Skeleton Merchant during certain moon phases for 5 SC
buffs.desc: The Strange Brew is a pre-Hardmode recovery potion that can be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant during certain moon phases for 5 SC. When used, it restores 70–120 health, inflicts 40–70 seconds of Potion Sickness, and has a 3/5 (60%) chance to grant up to 4 seconds of invincibility. The duration of Potion Sickness can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Plenty Satisfied
buffs.why: well-fed food buff to all stats
buffs.desc: Well Fed, Plenty Satisfied, and Exquisitely Stuffed are buffs granted to the player when they consume food, which provide general stat bonuses that vary in potency and duration depending on the food item consumed. In Expert Mode, health regeneration will only be fully effective while the player is under the effects of one of these buffs. While one of these buffs is active in a The Constant or Zenith special world seed, the player will also be temporarily immune to hunger for the buff's duration.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Sharpening Station
buffs.source: Found in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle
buffs.why: Grants armor penetration to melee weapons while standing near it.
buffs.desc: The Sharpening Station is a furniture item found naturally generated in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle. In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Merchant for 10 GC.

buffs.name: Thorns Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Thorns Potion is a buff potion which grants the Thorns buff when consumed. The buff inflicts a knockback of 10 (Extremely strong) on enemies that come into contact with the player, and deals 100% of their damage to them. [ 1 ] This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons
items.effect: Allows the holder to quadruple jump · Increases jump height and negates fall damage
items.desc: The Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons is an accessory which combines the functionalities of the Bundle of Balloons and the Lucky Horseshoe.

items.name: Skyline Wings
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 1.33 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Average · Max vertical speed: Average · Horizontal acceleration: Average · Vertical acceleration: Average
items.desc: Skyline Wings are a Pre-Hardmode wing -type accessory. When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide at a low height.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.why: Upgrades of this are also viable.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
items.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

items.name: Lightning Boots
items.why: Upgrades of this are also viable.
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running · 8% increased movement speed
items.desc: The Lightning Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Spectre Boots. They grant the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.effect: Increases movement speed and acceleration · Provides light when worn · 'A brief light in my dark life.'
items.desc: The Magiluminescence is a pre-Hardmode accessory that increases the player's maximum movement speed by 15% and their acceleration and deceleration by 75%. This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

items.name: Brain of Confusion
items.why: Dodges in Calamity are guaranteed on a cooldown.
items.effect: Has a chance to create illusions and dodge an attack · Temporarily increase critical chance and minion damage after dodge · May confuse nearby enemies after being struck
items.desc: The Brain of Confusion is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Brain of Cthulhu 's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Crown Jewel
items.effect: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s
items.desc: The Crown Jewel is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by King Slime. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Honey Dew
items.effect: Natural life regen is 50% more potent
items.desc: The Honey Dew is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.

items.name: Gladiator's Locket
items.why: This is difficult to obtain, and only one can be obtained per world.
items.effect: Enemies drop a healing orb on kill · Gain an increase to your damage and movement speed the lower your health is, up to 20% at 50% life or below
items.desc: The Gladiator's Locket is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is found in the Marble Cave shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found. When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

items.name: Worm Scarf
items.effect: Reduces damage taken by 17%
items.desc: The Worm Scarf is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Eater of Worlds ' Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While equipped, it grants +17% damage reduction.

items.name: Bloody Worm Tooth
items.effect: 10% increased melee damage
items.desc: The Bloody Worm Tooth is an Expert Mode Pre-Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by The Perforators. When equipped, it grants 2 defense and increases melee damage by 10%.

items.name: Craw Carapace
items.effect: 7% increased damage · Attackers take damage and are inflicted with Crumbling
items.desc: The Craw Carapace is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12. While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

items.name: Feral Claws
items.effect: 12% increased melee speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons
items.desc: Feral Claws are a pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Jungle Crates, Bramble Crates, and Ivy Chests located in Jungle Shrines and at the base of a Living Mahogany Tree in the Underground Jungle. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

weapons.name: Blood Rain Bow
weapons.source: Dropped by Wandering Eye Fish and Zombie Merman (Blood Moon fishing)
weapons.why: Fires arrows in an arc that rain down from above.
weapons.effect: Rains blood from the sky · 'Reign in Blood'
weapons.desc: The Blood Rain Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow that has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped by Wandering Eye Fish and Zombie Mermen. When used, it converts any type of arrow into a spread of 1–3 streams of blood (average of 1.83 streams) [ 1 ] to rain from the sky, directed towards the cursor. Each use only consumes one arrow.

weapons.name: Boomstick
weapons.source: Found in Ivy Chests and Jungle/Bramble Crates
weapons.why: Pre-Hardmode shotgun that fires a spread of bullets, found in the Jungle.
weapons.effect: Fires a spread of bullets
weapons.desc: The Boomstick is a pre-Hardmode gun. It can be found in Ivy Chests (21.72% chance) in the Underground Jungle, and also in Jungle Crates (19/100 (19%) chance). When used, it fires a spread of 3–4 bullets, consuming one piece of ammunition.

weapons.name: Fungicide
weapons.source: Dropped by Crabulon
weapons.effect: Converts musket balls into fungal rounds that split upon impact
weapons.desc: The Fungicide is a Pre-Hardmode gun that is dropped by Crabulon. When Musket Balls are used as ammo, it fires a fungus bullet that, upon impact with an enemy or tile, splits into smaller spores which are affected by gravity. These spores quickly home in on nearby enemies and are not affected by gravity while doing so.

weapons.name: Spark Spreader
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Ignites your foe with flaming sparks · Uses gel for ammo
weapons.desc: The Spark Spreader is a Pre-Hardmode flamethrower that uses Gel for ammunition. When used, it fires bursts of 4 short-ranged orange sparks with a 0.2 second delay in between. The sparks inflict the On Fire! debuff and pierce three enemies.

weapons.name: Spiky Balls
weapons.desc: The Spiky Ball is a consumable ranged weapon that is primarily used as a passive trap by tossing them to the ground, where enemies who pass over them will take damage up to 7 times (after which the Spiky Balls vanish). If not destroyed, they will automatically vanish after 1 minute and 20 seconds. [ 1 ] They can also be directly thrown at enemies, but they have a very short arc and quickly fall to the ground. Spiky Balls have a 199/400 (49.75%) chance of being dropped by all goblins during the Goblin Army event (except for the Goblin Warlock), and can be purchased from the Goblin Tinkerer for 80 CC each.

armor.name: Aerospec armor
armor.effect: Taking over 25 damage in one hit will cause a spread of homing feathers to fall · Allows you to fall more quickly and disables fall damage · Helm: 5% increased movement speed and melee critical strike chance · Enemies are more likely to target you · Hood: 5% increased movement speed and ranged critical strike chance · Hat: 8% reduced mana cost · 5% increased movement speed and magic critical strike chance · Helmet: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · 11% increased summon damage · Summons a valkyrie to protect you · Headgear: +80 maximum stealth · 5% increased movement speed and rogue critical strike chance
armor.desc: Aerospec armor is a Pre-Hardmode armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit afterimages.

armor.name: Crimson armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Crimson worlds only. Greatly increased life regeneration.
armor.effect: Greatly increased life regeneration · This is increased the longer you are not damaged · Standing still also greatly increases life regeneration
armor.desc: Crimson armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Crimson Helmet, Crimson Scalemail, and Crimson Greaves.

armor.name: Shadow armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Corruption worlds only. Increased movement speed and acceleration.
armor.effect: Increased movement speed and acceleration
armor.desc: Shadow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Shadow Helmet, Shadow Scalemail, and Shadow Greaves.

accessories.name: Any Balloon
accessories.source: Any jump balloon: Shiny Red Balloon, Cloud in a Balloon or a Bundle variant
accessories.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. These alternatives are grouped as " Any <groupname> ". For instance, items that use Any Wood as an ingredient can be.

accessories.name: Fledgling Wings
accessories.source: Found in Skyware Chests on Floating Islands
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: The Fledgling Wings are the only pre-Hardmode wings. Like all wings, they grant the player the ability to fly and glide when equipped, as well as not take fall damage. At top speed, they allow traveling at 15 mph horizontally and 22 mph vertically.

accessories.name: Fungal Clump
accessories.effect: Summons a fungal clump to fight for you · The clump latches onto enemies and steals their life for you
accessories.desc: The Fungal Clump is an Expert Mode Pre-Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Crabulon. When equipped, it summons a Fungal Clump minion that attaches to enemies, damaging them and spawning blue healing orbs that home in on the player and heal them for 25% of the damage the minion deals.

accessories.name: Frog Leg
accessories.source: Fished in any viable body of water
accessories.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
accessories.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

accessories.name: Lightning Boots
accessories.why: You still need strong horizontal movement to keep distance and reposition between volley windows.
accessories.effect: Allows flight, super fast running · 8% increased movement speed
accessories.desc: The Lightning Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Spectre Boots. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Magiluminescence
accessories.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.why: Increases the player's movement speed by 15%, and their acceleration (and deceleration) by 75%. This movement speed buff no longer applies if the player is not grounded.
accessories.effect: Increases movement speed and acceleration · Provides light when worn · 'A brief light in my dark life.'
accessories.desc: The Magiluminescence is a pre-Hardmode accessory that increases the player's maximum movement speed by 15% and their acceleration and deceleration by 75%. This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

accessories.name: Shield of Cthulhu
accessories.source: Dropped by the Eye of Cthulhu treasure bag
accessories.why: Expert Mode only. Gives a dash that also damages enemies and grants brief invulnerability.
accessories.effect: Allows the player to dash into the enemy · Double tap a direction
accessories.desc: The Shield of Cthulhu is a pre-Hardmode shield accessory that is always dropped from the Eye of Cthulhu 's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While equipped, it grants 2 defense and allows the player to perform a dash attack by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right button, or the Dash button once. Dashing into an enemy deals damage to it, causes the player to bounce backward, and grants 0.07 seconds of invincibility frames and 0.17 seconds of immunity to contact damage from the hit enemy. [ 1 ] The cooldown between dashes is 0.5 seconds. [ 2 ]

accessories.name: Amidias' Pendant
accessories.effect: Periodically rains down prism shards that can briefly stun enemies
accessories.desc: Amidias' Pendant is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by the Giant Clam. While equipped, it causes 3 homing prism shards to fall from the sky every 2 seconds. Each shard deals 30 base damage.

accessories.name: Black Glass Band
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Enemy hits create an obsidian flash that always critically strikes · This effect has a 5 second cooldown, but is halved if the flash kills an enemy · Visual and audio effects are reduced if visibility is disabled · 'A shining band with boundless potential'
accessories.desc: The Black Glass Band is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it releases an obsidian strike upon enemy hits that deals 20 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 5 second cooldown that is halved if the enemy is killed with the strike. The strike's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

accessories.name: Craw Carapace
accessories.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
accessories.effect: 7% increased damage · Attackers take damage and are inflicted with Crumbling
accessories.desc: The Craw Carapace is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12. While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

accessories.name: Scions Curio
accessories.effect: Ranged hits increase the effectiveness of Irradiated · Irradiated damage over time scales off of your ranged damage and crit chance · On kill, enemies burst, spreading Irradiated · Taking damage causes the curio to explode in retaliation · Current Irradiated damage: [DAMAGE]
accessories.desc: The Scions Curio is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Rusty Chests. When equipped, it makes killing an enemy or getting hit create a blast that inflicts Irradiated for 5 seconds. Also, hitting enemies with ranged weapons boost the effects of the Irradiated debuff in the following ways:

accessories.name: Crown Jewel
accessories.effect: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s
accessories.desc: The Crown Jewel is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by King Slime. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Gladiator's Locket
accessories.source: Purchased from Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found
accessories.effect: Enemies drop a healing orb on kill · Gain an increase to your damage and movement speed the lower your health is, up to 20% at 50% life or below
accessories.desc: The Gladiator's Locket is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is found in the Marble Cave shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found. When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

accessories.name: Rover Drive
accessories.effect: Gain a barrier with 20 health · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · The barrier will regenerate 10 seconds after being hit, taking 5 seconds to completely regenerate · Getting hit resets the timer · Can also be scrapped at an extractinator
accessories.desc: The Rover Drive is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Wulfrum Rovers. When equipped for 10 seconds without taking damage, a protective matrix covers its user, which grants 20 matrix durability. If the player gets hit, durability is lost instead of health by the amount of damage taken.

accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
