ammo.source: Obtained from throwing a Wooden or Hellfire Arrow into Shimmer

items.name: Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons
items.effect: Allows the holder to quadruple jump · Increases jump height and negates fall damage
items.desc: The Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons is an accessory which combines the functionalities of the Bundle of Balloons and the Lucky Horseshoe.

items.name: Skyline Wings
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 1.33 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Average · Max vertical speed: Average · Horizontal acceleration: Average · Vertical acceleration: Average
items.desc: Skyline Wings are a Pre-Hardmode wing -type accessory. When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide at a low height.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.why: Upgrades of this are also viable.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
items.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

items.name: Lightning Boots
items.why: Upgrades of this are also viable.
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running · 8% increased movement speed
items.desc: The Lightning Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Spectre Boots. They grant the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.effect: Increases movement speed and acceleration · Provides light when worn · 'A brief light in my dark life.'
items.desc: The Magiluminescence is a pre-Hardmode accessory that increases the player's maximum movement speed by 15% and their acceleration and deceleration by 75%. This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

items.name: Brain of Confusion
items.why: Dodges in Calamity are guaranteed on a cooldown.
items.effect: Has a chance to create illusions and dodge an attack · Temporarily increase critical chance and minion damage after dodge · May confuse nearby enemies after being struck
items.desc: The Brain of Confusion is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Brain of Cthulhu 's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Crown Jewel
items.effect: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s
items.desc: The Crown Jewel is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by King Slime. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Honey Dew
items.effect: Natural life regen is 50% more potent
items.desc: The Honey Dew is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.

items.name: Gladiator's Locket
items.why: This is difficult to obtain, and only one can be obtained per world.
items.effect: Enemies drop a healing orb on kill · Gain an increase to your damage and movement speed the lower your health is, up to 20% at 50% life or below
items.desc: The Gladiator's Locket is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is found in the Marble Cave shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found. When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

items.name: Worm Scarf
items.effect: Reduces damage taken by 17%
items.desc: The Worm Scarf is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Eater of Worlds ' Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While equipped, it grants +17% damage reduction.

items.name: Craw Carapace
items.effect: 7% increased damage · Attackers take damage and are inflicted with Crumbling
items.desc: The Craw Carapace is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12. While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

items.name: Protolith Bangle
items.effect: Ranged enemy hits create a marble flash that always critically strikes and can hit multiple enemies · This effect has a 7 second cooldown · Visual and audio effects are reduced if visibility is disabled · 'The cold marble against your wrist puts your mind at ease'
items.desc: The Protolith Bangle is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it releases a marble shatter upon enemy hits with ranged weapons that deals 30 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 7 second cooldown. The shatter's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

weapons.name: Amber Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Gem staff whose amber bolt travels faster than other gem staves.
weapons.desc: The Amber Staff is a pre-Hardmode wand that fires an orange bolt that can pierce one enemy. It is the fifth tier of gem staff, along with the Ruby Staff, which has identical stats.

weapons.name: Crimson Rod
weapons.source: Destroyed from Crimson Hearts, or fished in Crimson/Hematic Crates
weapons.why: Places a lingering blood cloud that rains piercing droplets downward onto enemies below.
weapons.effect: Summons a cloud to rain blood on your foes
weapons.desc: The Crimson Rod is a pre-Hardmode magic weapon that launches a reddish rain cloud towards the cursor, where it rains damaging blood droplets downward onto enemies below. One cloud projectile can be placed at a time and it does not pass through terrain, instead stopping if it hits a surface before it reaches its target location. Once placed, the cloud will remain for five minutes, similarly to the Nimbus Rod 's cloud.

weapons.name: Thunder Zapper
weapons.source: Found in Sandstone Chests and Oasis/Mirage Crates (Desert)
weapons.why: Fires an electric bolt that pierces one enemy, found in the Desert.
weapons.desc: The Thunder Zapper is a pre-Hardmode wand that can be found in Sandstone Chests in the lower 3/7ths of the Underground Desert and in Oasis Crates and Mirage Crates obtained from fishing in the Oasis. When used, it fires a lightning bolt that travels in a zigzag pattern horizontally (but traveling straight when shooting directly up or down). The bolt dissipates with a visual explosion after traveling for about one second or upon hitting an enemy or a block.

weapons.name: Veering Wind
weapons.source: Crafted at a Bookcase
weapons.effect: Casts a circular spread of wind waves with high knockback · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to cast a circular spread of frost waves
weapons.desc: The Veering Wind is a Pre-Hardmode spell tome. When used with its primary fire (⚒ Use / Attack), it fires an even ring of 12 fast air waves which travel outwards from the player and deal heavy knockback. When used with its secondary fire (⚷ Open / Activate), it instead fires frost waves that inflict the Frostburn and Frozen debuffs, with 20% knockback, 25% velocity, and 50% attack speed compared to the air waves.

weapons.name: Vilethorn
weapons.source: Dropped by Shadow Orbs (Corruption); found in Corrupt Crates
weapons.why: Projects a piercing line of thorns through blocks and enemies.
weapons.effect: Summons a vile thorn
weapons.desc: The Vilethorn is a pre-Hardmode wand. It has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being obtained from destroying Shadow Orbs found in the Corruption or a 1/5 (20%) chance from Corrupt Crates (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) and Defiled Crates (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions), which are fished in the Corruption. When used, it extends a 15-tile-long thorn from the player's position, which passes through blocks, pierces infinite enemies, and hits rapidly for up to six times per enemy.

weapons.name: Wulfrum Controller
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons a wulfrum droid to fight for you · Hold ⚷ Open / Activate while holding the remote to switch all of your drones between regular and supercharge mode · Supercharged droids will stop attacking and focus wulfrum energy onto you · Supercharged droids provide +0.25 HP/s life regen and 2 defense per droid · Can also be used to heal other players by keeping your mouse cursor close enough to them
weapons.desc: The Wulfrum Controller is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. When used with its primary function (left-click), it summons a Wulfrum Droid minion that floats by the player and attacks nearby enemies by firing green energy bolts that cannot pierce but can curve towards nearby enemies. The droid waits a random time from 0.49-1.83 seconds between shots, and recoils in the opposite direction of its shot while shooting.

armor.name: Meteor armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Space Gun costs 0 mana, so it pairs with that weapon specifically.
armor.effect: Space Gun costs 0 mana
armor.desc: Meteor armor is a pre-Hardmode mage armor set consisting of the Meteor Helmet, Meteor Suit, and Meteor Leggings.

armor.name: Aerospec armor
armor.effect: Taking over 25 damage in one hit will cause a spread of homing feathers to fall · Allows you to fall more quickly and disables fall damage · Helm: 5% increased movement speed and melee critical strike chance · Enemies are more likely to target you · Hood: 5% increased movement speed and ranged critical strike chance · Hat: 8% reduced mana cost · 5% increased movement speed and magic critical strike chance · Helmet: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · 11% increased summon damage · Summons a valkyrie to protect you · Headgear: +80 maximum stealth · 5% increased movement speed and rogue critical strike chance
armor.desc: Aerospec armor is a Pre-Hardmode armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit afterimages.

armor.name: Crimson armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.effect: Greatly increased life regeneration · This is increased the longer you are not damaged · Standing still also greatly increases life regeneration
armor.desc: Crimson armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Crimson Helmet, Crimson Scalemail, and Crimson Greaves.

armor.name: Shadow armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.effect: Increased movement speed and acceleration
armor.desc: Shadow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Shadow Helmet, Shadow Scalemail, and Shadow Greaves.

accessories.name: Any Double Jump
accessories.source: Any double-jump bottle: Cloud, Blizzard, Sandstorm, Tsunami or Fart in a Jar

accessories.name: Frog Leg
accessories.source: Fished in any viable body of water
accessories.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
accessories.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

accessories.name: Hermes Boots
accessories.source: Found in Underground and Cavern Chests
accessories.why: Movement is survival in early Terraria, and Hermes Boots give you the speed to dodge, kite, and position better.
accessories.effect: The wearer can run super fast
accessories.desc: The Hermes Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Chests in the Underground and Cavern layers. While equipped, they grant the ability to sprint, allowing the player to reach maximum running speed faster, and they increase the player's maximum movement speed to 31 mph (22.73 tiles/second). The player will leave behind a visual trail of dust clouds as they sprint.

accessories.name: Magiluminescence
accessories.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.why: Increases the player's movement speed by 15%, and their acceleration (and deceleration) by 75%. This movement speed buff no longer applies if the player is not grounded.
accessories.effect: Increases movement speed and acceleration · Provides light when worn · 'A brief light in my dark life.'
accessories.desc: The Magiluminescence is a pre-Hardmode accessory that increases the player's maximum movement speed by 15% and their acceleration and deceleration by 75%. This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

accessories.name: Shield of Cthulhu
accessories.source: Dropped by the Eye of Cthulhu treasure bag
accessories.why: Expert Mode only. Gives a dash that also damages enemies and grants brief invulnerability.
accessories.effect: Allows the player to dash into the enemy · Double tap a direction
accessories.desc: The Shield of Cthulhu is a pre-Hardmode shield accessory that is always dropped from the Eye of Cthulhu 's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While equipped, it grants 2 defense and allows the player to perform a dash attack by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right button, or the Dash button once. Dashing into an enemy deals damage to it, causes the player to bounce backward, and grants 0.07 seconds of invincibility frames and 0.17 seconds of immunity to contact damage from the hit enemy. [ 1 ] The cooldown between dashes is 0.5 seconds. [ 2 ]

accessories.name: Band of Starpower
accessories.source: Found in Shadow Orbs / Crimson Hearts
accessories.effect: Increases maximum mana by 20
accessories.desc: The Band of Starpower is an accessory that increases the player's maximum mana by 20. The Band of Starpower has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being obtained from destroying Shadow Orbs found in the Corruption or a 1/5 (20%) chance from Corrupt Crates and Defiled Crates, which are fished in the Corruption. It can furthermore be crafted.

accessories.name: Black Glass Band
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Enemy hits create an obsidian flash that always critically strikes · This effect has a 5 second cooldown, but is halved if the flash kills an enemy · Visual and audio effects are reduced if visibility is disabled · 'A shining band with boundless potential'
accessories.desc: The Black Glass Band is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it releases an obsidian strike upon enemy hits that deals 20 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 5 second cooldown that is halved if the enemy is killed with the strike. The strike's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

accessories.name: Craw Carapace
accessories.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
accessories.effect: 7% increased damage · Attackers take damage and are inflicted with Crumbling
accessories.desc: The Craw Carapace is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12. While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

accessories.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
accessories.source: Dropped by Blood Feeders, Crimeras and Face Monsters in the Crimson
accessories.why: Provides all weapons with 5 unconditional armor penetration. Can be stacked with or upgraded into the Stinger Necklace.
accessories.effect: Increases armor penetration by 5
accessories.desc: The Shark Tooth Necklace is an accessory which has a 1/150 (0.67%) / 1/75 (1.33%) chance to drop from Blood Zombies and Dripplers found during a Blood Moon. It increases the player's armor penetration by 5 when equipped.

accessories.name: Gladiator's Locket
accessories.source: Purchased from Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found
accessories.effect: Enemies drop a healing orb on kill · Gain an increase to your damage and movement speed the lower your health is, up to 20% at 50% life or below
accessories.desc: The Gladiator's Locket is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is found in the Marble Cave shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found. When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

accessories.name: Ilmeris' Spark
accessories.effect: Taking damage releases a blast of sparks
accessories.desc: Ilmeris' Spark is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Cnidrions. When equipped, it causes the player to release 8 gravity-affected sparks around them when harmed by any source of damage. These sparks linger for 2 seconds, partially ignore immunity frames, and deal 6 base damage, which is boosted by the player's highest class' damage.

accessories.name: Rover Drive
accessories.effect: Gain a barrier with 20 health · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · The barrier will regenerate 10 seconds after being hit, taking 5 seconds to completely regenerate · Getting hit resets the timer · Can also be scrapped at an extractinator
accessories.desc: The Rover Drive is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Wulfrum Rovers. When equipped for 10 seconds without taking damage, a protective matrix covers its user, which grants 20 matrix durability. If the player gets hit, durability is lost instead of health by the amount of damage taken.

buffs.name: Lesser Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Lesser Healing Potion is a pre-Hardmode recovery potion that restores 50 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 60 seconds when used. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths. It is the first tier of healing potion, preceding the Healing Potion, Greater Healing Potion, Jungle Juice and Super Healing Potion.

buffs.name: Eggnog
buffs.source: Dropped by Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event
buffs.desc: Eggnog is a pre-Hardmode recovery potion that can be dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event, with a chance of 8.101% in pre-Hardmode and 7.561% in Hardmode. When used, it restores 80 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 40 seconds. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Well Fed
buffs.source: Any cooked food buff
buffs.why: The global stat bump is easy to maintain and always worth it.
buffs.desc: Well Fed, Plenty Satisfied, and Exquisitely Stuffed are buffs granted to the player when they consume food, which provide general stat bonuses that vary in potency and duration depending on the food item consumed. In Expert Mode, health regeneration will only be fully effective while the player is under the effects of one of these buffs. While one of these buffs is active in a The Constant or Zenith special world seed, the player will also be temporarily immune to hunger for the buff's duration.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: The extra survivability helps offset how punishing late-Hardmode mistakes can be for mage.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Mage has less room for mistakes, so the bonus defense matters a lot.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Thorns Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Thorns Potion is a buff potion which grants the Thorns buff when consumed. The buff inflicts a knockback of 10 (Extremely strong) on enemies that come into contact with the player, and deals 100% of their damage to them. [ 1 ] This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Magic Power Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Magic Power Potion is a buff potion which grants the Magic Power buff when consumed. The buff increases magic damage by 20%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Mana Potion
buffs.source: Crafted, or found in most Crates
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Mana Potion is a recovery potion that restores 100 mana and inflicts the Mana Sickness debuff upon use. They are also sold by the Merchant in Hardmode for 2 SC 50 CC.

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Speeds up mana regeneration, so you stop to drink fewer mana potions.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Mana Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Mana Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff increases the rate at which the player's mana regenerates. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Magic Cuffs
items.effect: Increases maximum mana by 20 · Restores mana when damaged
items.desc: The Magic Cuffs are a pre-Hardmode accessory which increases maximum mana by 20 and restores mana when the wearer is damaged.

weapons.name: Dank Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by The Hive Mind
weapons.why: highest minion damage at this tier
weapons.effect: Summons a dank creeper to fight for you
weapons.desc: The Dank Staff is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by The Hive Mind. When used, it summons a miniature Dank Creeper that attempts to latch onto enemies to deal damage and inflicts the Brain Rot debuff upon contact.

weapons.name: Hornet Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Summons a Hornet minion that inflicts Poisoned; Bee Wax drops from Queen Bee.
weapons.effect: Summons a hornet to fight for you
weapons.desc: The Hornet Staff is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Hornet minion. It hovers above enemies, firing stingers that inflict the Poisoned debuff for 4–7 seconds and do not pierce.

weapons.name: Imp Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Summons an Imp minion that fires On Fire! bolts; needs Underworld Hellstone.
weapons.effect: Summons an imp to fight for you
weapons.desc: The Imp Staff is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Flying Imp minion. It hovers near enemies, shooting fireballs that inflict the On Fire! debuff for 3–6 seconds and can pierce up to 4 enemies.

weapons.name: P-PMA: Aqueous Hunter Drone
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons a shrimp drone that fires bursts of homing plasma missiles · ⚷ Open / Activate while holding any summon weapon to command the shrimp to launch a vertical missile barrage · Vertical missiles aim towards your cursor and leave a lingering blast if they hit solid ground · Each shrimp uses 4 minion slots · Ignores 15 points of enemy Defense · 'When pursuing the adherents of gods, Yharim believed no stone should be left unturned. · Weaponry for underwater contingencies was an unusually heavy focus, but no models ever saw deployment'
weapons.desc: The P-PMA: Aqueous Hunter Drone is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. It spends 4 minion slots to summon an arsenal shrimp minion that floats around the player. When an enemy is nearby, it will launch a burst of homing plasma missiles.

weapons.name: Houndius Shootius
weapons.source: Dropped by Deerclops
weapons.why: Pre-Hardmode sentry dropped by Deerclops that shoots piercing fireballs.
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons an arcane construct to shoot optic blasts at your enemies · 'Oh me oh my, look at that eye!'
weapons.desc: The Houndius Shootius is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons the Houndius Shootius sentry. It shoots fireballs towards enemies, which dissipate upon contact with enemies or blocks. The Houndius Shootius has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by Deerclops.

weapons.name: Polyp Launcher
weapons.source: Purchased from Sea King for 2 gold
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons a polyp bunch that launches coral chunks at nearby enemies
weapons.desc: Polyp Launcher is a Pre-Hardmode sentry that is sold by the Sea King for 2. When used, it summons a grounded polyp sentry which inaccurately fires gravity-affected balls of coral at nearby enemies. On hit, the coral chunk bursts into 1-4 fragments which deals half as much damage and knockback.

weapons.name: Snapthorn
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Jungle-material whip that inflicts Acid Venom and grants summon tag damage.
weapons.effect: 6 summon tag damage · Your summons will focus struck enemies · Strike enemies to gain whip attack speed
weapons.desc: The Snapthorn is a pre-Hardmode whip. It has a 40% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:

armor.name: Aerospec armor
armor.effect: Taking over 25 damage in one hit will cause a spread of homing feathers to fall · Allows you to fall more quickly and disables fall damage · Helm: 5% increased movement speed and melee critical strike chance · Enemies are more likely to target you · Hood: 5% increased movement speed and ranged critical strike chance · Hat: 8% reduced mana cost · 5% increased movement speed and magic critical strike chance · Helmet: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · 11% increased summon damage · Summons a valkyrie to protect you · Headgear: +80 maximum stealth · 5% increased movement speed and rogue critical strike chance
armor.desc: Aerospec armor is a Pre-Hardmode armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit afterimages.

armor.name: Bee armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Summon damage +10%. No whip bonus, so it suits minion-led builds.
armor.effect: Increases summon damage by 10%
armor.desc: Bee armor is a pre-Hardmode summoner armor set consisting of the Bee Headgear, Bee Breastplate, and Bee Greaves.

armor.name: Obsidian armor
armor.why: Whip range +30%, whip speed +15%, summon damage +15%.
armor.effect: Increases whip range by 30% and speed by 15% · Increases summon damage by 15%
armor.desc: Obsidian armor is a pre-Hardmode summoner armor set consisting of the Obsidian Outlaw Hat, Obsidian Longcoat, and Obsidian Pants.

armor.name: Crimson armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.effect: Greatly increased life regeneration · This is increased the longer you are not damaged · Standing still also greatly increases life regeneration
armor.desc: Crimson armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Crimson Helmet, Crimson Scalemail, and Crimson Greaves.

armor.name: Shadow armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.effect: Increased movement speed and acceleration
armor.desc: Shadow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Shadow Helmet, Shadow Scalemail, and Shadow Greaves.

accessories.name: Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons
accessories.why: primary mobility, jump and fall protection
accessories.effect: Allows the holder to quadruple jump · Increases jump height and negates fall damage
accessories.desc: The Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons is an accessory which combines the functionalities of the Bundle of Balloons and the Lucky Horseshoe.

accessories.name: Skyline Wings
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 1.33 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Average · Max vertical speed: Average · Horizontal acceleration: Average · Vertical acceleration: Average
accessories.desc: Skyline Wings are a Pre-Hardmode wing -type accessory. When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide at a low height.

accessories.name: Spirit Glyph
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Minion attacks provide various buffs · Hold Shift for more Spirit Power grants 10% increased summon damage · Spirit Defense grants 2 defense · Spirit Regen grants 0.5 HP/s life regeneration
accessories.desc: The Spirit Glyph is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, whenever a minion hits an enemy, the player is granted one of the following buffs:

accessories.name: Frog Leg
accessories.source: Fished in any viable body of water
accessories.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
accessories.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

accessories.name: Lightning Boots
accessories.why: Sprint and flight movement in one slot, accelerating faster and reaching a higher top speed than Spectre Boots.
accessories.effect: Allows flight, super fast running · 8% increased movement speed
accessories.desc: The Lightning Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Spectre Boots. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Magiluminescence
accessories.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.why: Increases the player's movement speed by 15%, and their acceleration (and deceleration) by 75%. This movement speed buff no longer applies if the player is not grounded.
accessories.effect: Increases movement speed and acceleration · Provides light when worn · 'A brief light in my dark life.'
accessories.desc: The Magiluminescence is a pre-Hardmode accessory that increases the player's maximum movement speed by 15% and their acceleration and deceleration by 75%. This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

accessories.name: Craw Carapace
accessories.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
accessories.effect: 7% increased damage · Attackers take damage and are inflicted with Crumbling
accessories.desc: The Craw Carapace is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12. While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

accessories.name: Hive Pack
accessories.source: Dropped by the Queen Bee's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode
accessories.effect: Increases the strength of friendly bees
accessories.desc: The Hive Pack is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Queen Bee 's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While equipped, it grants a 1/2 (50%) chance of replacing friendly Bee projectiles with stronger Giant Bees. [ 1 ]

accessories.name: Pygmy Necklace
accessories.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 1
accessories.desc: The Pygmy Necklace is a pre-Hardmode accessory that provides the player with one additional minion slot. It is purchased from the Witch Doctor for 20 GC at night.

accessories.name: Voltaic Jelly
accessories.source: Dropped by Ghost Bells after Desert Scourge has been defeated
accessories.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Minion attacks inflict Static Discharge
accessories.desc: The Voltaic Jelly is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Ghost Bells after Desert Scourge has been defeated. When equipped, it grants +1 minion slot and a 20% chance for minions to inflict the Static Discharge debuff. It does not stack with the Jelly-Charged Battery or its upgrades.

accessories.name: Brain of Confusion
accessories.source: Dropped by the Brain of Cthulhu's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode
accessories.effect: Has a chance to create illusions and dodge an attack · Temporarily increase critical chance and minion damage after dodge · May confuse nearby enemies after being struck
accessories.desc: The Brain of Confusion is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Brain of Cthulhu 's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Crown Jewel
accessories.effect: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s
accessories.desc: The Crown Jewel is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by King Slime. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Honey Dew
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Natural life regen is 50% more potent
accessories.desc: The Honey Dew is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.

accessories.name: Gladiator's Locket
accessories.source: Purchased from Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found
accessories.why: difficult to obtain, one per world
accessories.effect: Enemies drop a healing orb on kill · Gain an increase to your damage and movement speed the lower your health is, up to 20% at 50% life or below
accessories.desc: The Gladiator's Locket is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is found in the Marble Cave shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found. When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

accessories.name: Worm Scarf
accessories.source: Dropped by the Eater of Worlds' Treasure Bag in Expert Mode
accessories.effect: Reduces damage taken by 17%
accessories.desc: The Worm Scarf is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Eater of Worlds ' Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While equipped, it grants +17% damage reduction.

buffs.name: Healing Potions
buffs.source: Crafted

buffs.name: Honeyfins
buffs.source: Crafted

buffs.name: Plenty Satisfied
buffs.desc: Well Fed, Plenty Satisfied, and Exquisitely Stuffed are buffs granted to the player when they consume food, which provide general stat bonuses that vary in potency and duration depending on the food item consumed. In Expert Mode, health regeneration will only be fully effective while the player is under the effects of one of these buffs. While one of these buffs is active in a The Constant or Zenith special world seed, the player will also be temporarily immune to hunger for the buff's duration.

buffs.name: Flask of Fire
buffs.source: Crafted at an Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.desc: The Flask of Fire is a flask that causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the On Fire! debuff for 3–6 seconds on enemies hit. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.name: Flask of Poison
buffs.source: Brewed at Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.desc: The Flask of Poison is a flask that causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Poisoned debuff for 5–9 seconds on enemies hit. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.name: Summoning Potions
buffs.source: Crafted

buffs.name: Strategist
buffs.source: Dropped by the Dark Mage and the Ogre during the Old One's Army event
buffs.desc: The War Table is an animated furniture item which fulfills a house's table requirement that is dropped by the Dark Mage and the Ogre during the Old One's Army event, with a 1/2 (50%) / 1/1 (100%) chance during Tier 1, and a 1/8 (12.5%) / 1/4 (25%) chance during Tier 3.

buffs.name: Wrath Potions
buffs.source: Crafted

buffs.name: Bounding Potions
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table

buffs.name: Swiftness Potions
buffs.source: Crafted

weapons.name: Feather Knife
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: first-listed spam rogue weapon, steady rapid damage
weapons.effect: Throws a knife which summons homing feathers · Stealth strike throw a volley of knives
weapons.desc: The Feather Knife is a Pre-Hardmode dagger. When used, it throws a gravity affected knife that periodically releases homing explosive feathers. The feather and explosion deal 5% and 50% of the weapon's damage respectively.

weapons.name: Hardened Honeycomb
weapons.source: Dropped by the Queen Bee
weapons.effect: Fires a honeycomb that shatters into fragments · Stealth strikes grant the Honey buff on hit and spawn bees
weapons.desc: The Hardened Honeycomb is a Pre-Hardmode rogue weapon that is dropped by the Queen Bee. When used, it throws honeycomb projectiles that are slightly affected by gravity and shatter into 2 fragments upon collision with an enemy or tile. The honeycomb fragments fly in random directions and deal 100% of the weapon's base damage.

weapons.name: Meteor Fist
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a wired-guided rocket fist that seeks the cursor and accelerates over time · Stealth strikes immediately start accelerating and drop a meteorite on the struck enemy
weapons.desc: The Meteor Fist is a Pre-Hardmode bomb. When used, it releases a rocket fist which connects to the player via a wire. After 1 second, the fist begins to accelerate and home towards the cursor's position, leaving a fiery trail behind it.

weapons.name: Crystalline
weapons.why: primary power weapon, strong stealth-strike single-target hits
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Splits into several projectiles as it travels · Stealth strikes make the blade split more and create crystals when destroyed
weapons.desc: The Crystalline is a Pre-Hardmode dagger. When used, it throws a gemstone dagger that travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity. Shortly after being thrown, the dagger splits into 3 weaker copies of itself that are not affected by gravity and disappear shortly after spawning.

weapons.name: Shattered Sun
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws daggers that split into scorching homing daggers · Stealth strikes fire volleys of homing daggers from the player on dagger hits that suck enemies in
weapons.desc: The Shattered Dawn is a post- Moon Lord dagger that is a direct upgrade to the Radiant Star. When used, it throws a profaned dagger that is not affected by gravity and pierces infinitely. Upon hitting an enemy, it causes a small damaging explosion that deals 45% of the weapon's damage.

weapons.name: Brittle Star Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by the Desert Scourge
weapons.effect: Summons a small brittle starfish that will dash through enemies until it shatters · Starfish will quickly regenerate after shattering · Holding ⚷ Open / Activate will swap starfish between dashing and circling you · When the starfish are circling, each one provides you with 3 defense
weapons.desc: The Brittle Star Staff is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by the Desert Scourge. When used, it summons a Brittle Star minion, which follows the player and attacks enemies by dashing at them to deal damage. Brittle stars hit up to 4 enemies before shattering, quickly regenerating afterwards.

weapons.name: Wulfrum Controller
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons a wulfrum droid to fight for you · Hold ⚷ Open / Activate while holding the remote to switch all of your drones between regular and supercharge mode · Supercharged droids will stop attacking and focus wulfrum energy onto you · Supercharged droids provide +0.25 HP/s life regen and 2 defense per droid · Can also be used to heal other players by keeping your mouse cursor close enough to them
weapons.desc: The Wulfrum Controller is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. When used with its primary function (left-click), it summons a Wulfrum Droid minion that floats by the player and attacks nearby enemies by firing green energy bolts that cannot pierce but can curve towards nearby enemies. The droid waits a random time from 0.49-1.83 seconds between shots, and recoils in the opposite direction of its shot while shooting.

items.desc: The Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons is an accessory which combines the functionalities of the Bundle of Balloons and the Lucky Horseshoe.

items.desc: Skyline Wings are a Pre-Hardmode wing -type accessory. When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide at a low height.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.why: Upgrades of this are also viable.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
items.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

items.name: Lightning Boots
items.why: Upgrades of this are also viable.
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running · 8% increased movement speed
items.desc: The Lightning Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Spectre Boots. They grant the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.effect: Increases movement speed and acceleration · Provides light when worn · 'A brief light in my dark life.'
items.desc: The Magiluminescence is a pre-Hardmode accessory that increases the player's maximum movement speed by 15% and their acceleration and deceleration by 75%. This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

items.name: Brain of Confusion
items.why: Dodges in Calamity are guaranteed on a cooldown.
items.effect: Has a chance to create illusions and dodge an attack · Temporarily increase critical chance and minion damage after dodge · May confuse nearby enemies after being struck
items.desc: The Brain of Confusion is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Brain of Cthulhu 's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Crown Jewel
items.effect: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s
items.desc: The Crown Jewel is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by King Slime. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Honey Dew
items.effect: Natural life regen is 50% more potent
items.desc: The Honey Dew is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.

items.name: Gladiator's Locket
items.why: This is difficult to obtain, and only one can be obtained per world.
items.effect: Enemies drop a healing orb on kill · Gain an increase to your damage and movement speed the lower your health is, up to 20% at 50% life or below
items.desc: The Gladiator's Locket is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is found in the Marble Cave shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found. When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

items.name: Worm Scarf
items.effect: Reduces damage taken by 17%
items.desc: The Worm Scarf is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Eater of Worlds ' Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While equipped, it grants +17% damage reduction.

items.name: Bloodstained Glove
items.effect: Stealth strikes have +8 armor penetration and heal for 5 HP
items.desc: The Bloodstained Glove is a Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory that is dropped by The Perforators. When equipped, it makes stealth strikes have +8 armor penetration and heal the player for 5 health.

items.name: Coin of Deceit
items.effect: Stealth strikes only expend 90% of your max stealth · 6% increased rogue crit chance
items.desc: The Coin of Deceit is a Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory. When equipped, it increases rogue critical strike chance by 6% and makes stealth strikes only require 90% of the player's maximum stealth to perform and consume 90% of the player's maximum stealth when performed.

items.name: Craw Carapace
items.effect: 7% increased damage · Attackers take damage and are inflicted with Crumbling
items.desc: The Craw Carapace is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12. While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

items.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
items.effect: Increases armor penetration by 5
items.desc: The Shark Tooth Necklace is an accessory which has a 1/150 (0.67%) / 1/75 (1.33%) chance to drop from Blood Zombies and Dripplers found during a Blood Moon. It increases the player's armor penetration by 5 when equipped.

items.name: Filthy Glove
items.effect: Stealth strikes have +8 armor penetration and deal 8% more damage
items.desc: The Filthy Glove is a Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory that is dropped by The Hive Mind. When equipped, it makes stealth strikes deal 8% more damage and have +8 armor penetration.

items.name: Silencing Sheath
items.effect: +10 maximum stealth, and stealth generates 4% faster
items.desc: The Silencing Sheath is a Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory. When equipped, it increases maximum rogue stealth by 10 and increases rogue stealth generation by 4%.

weapons.name: Volcano
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Creates an explosion on hitting enemies.
weapons.effect: 'It's made out of fire!'
weapons.desc: The Volcano is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it creates an explosion upon enemy hits, dealing 75% of the weapon's damage (30 base damage) to the enemy and 2 other targets in an area around the enemy. [ 1 ] The Volcano has a 1/2 (50%) chance to inflict the On Fire! debuff for 3 seconds, while its explosion is guaranteed to inflict it for the same duration. [ 2 ]

weapons.name: Blade of Grass
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Fires a homing Leaf Blade projectile on each swing.
weapons.effect: Has a chance to poison enemies
weapons.desc: The Blade of Grass is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it fires a Leaf Blade projectile that travels upwards in a circle and homes in on enemies. The Leaf Blade projectile can pass through blocks, deals 25% of the weapon's damage (4 base damage), has 20 armor penetration, and can pierce two enemies. [ 1 ] The sword and its projectiles both have a 1/4 (25%) chance of inflicting the Poisoned debuff for 7 seconds upon hit. [ 2 ]

weapons.name: Enchanted Sword
weapons.source: From Enchanted Sword Shrine background object
weapons.why: Fires an Enchanted Beam projectile at high health.
weapons.effect: Shoots an enchanted sword beam
weapons.desc: The Enchanted Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it occasionally fires an Enchanted Beam projectile that cannot pierce enemies or pass through blocks. Both the sword and its projectile produce lingering particles that emit large amounts of light.

weapons.name: Muramasa
weapons.source: Found in Dungeon Locked Gold Chests
weapons.why: Fast broadsword found in the Dungeon after Skeletron.
weapons.desc: The Muramasa is a pre-Hardmode, post- Skeletron broadsword that has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being obtained from the Locked Gold Chests found in the Dungeon, as well as a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being obtained from Golden Lock Boxes. When swung, it creates a blue slash upon enemy hits. The slashes deal 50% of the weapon's damage (12 base damage) [ 1 ], inflict no knockback, do not pierce, and have 5 armor penetration. [ 2 ]

armor.name: Molten armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: 10% extra melee damage, immunity to fire blocks, and you cannot be set on fire.
armor.effect: 10% extra melee damage · Grants immunity to fire blocks · Cannot be set on fire
armor.desc: Molten armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Molten Helmet, Molten Breastplate, and Molten Greaves.

armor.name: Statigel armor
armor.effect: Grants an extra jump and increased jump height · 12% increased jump speed · Helm: Enemies are more likely to target you · Hood: 15% increased summon damage · Summons a mini paladin to fight for you, the type depends on what world evil you have · Mask: +90 maximum stealth
armor.desc: Statigel armor is a Pre-Hardmode armor set.

accessories.name: Any Balloon
accessories.source: Any jump balloon: Shiny Red Balloon, Cloud in a Balloon or a Bundle variant
accessories.desc: An alternative crafting ingredient is an item that can be used in place of another item in a crafting recipe. These alternatives are grouped as " Any <groupname> ". For instance, items that use Any Wood as an ingredient can be.

accessories.name: Fledgling Wings
accessories.source: Found in Skyware Chests on Floating Islands
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: The Fledgling Wings are the only pre-Hardmode wings. Like all wings, they grant the player the ability to fly and glide when equipped, as well as not take fall damage. At top speed, they allow traveling at 15 mph horizontally and 22 mph vertically.

accessories.name: Frog Leg
accessories.source: Fished in any viable body of water

accessories.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
accessories.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

accessories.why: Mech fights need consistent horizontal movement to hold spacing.
accessories.effect: Allows flight, super fast running · 8% increased movement speed
accessories.desc: The Lightning Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Spectre Boots. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Magiluminescence
accessories.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.why: Increases the player's movement speed by 15%, and their acceleration (and deceleration) by 75%. This movement speed buff no longer applies if the player is not grounded.
accessories.effect: Increases movement speed and acceleration · Provides light when worn · 'A brief light in my dark life.'

This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

accessories.name: Shield of Cthulhu
accessories.source: Dropped by the Eye of Cthulhu treasure bag
accessories.why: Expert Mode only. Gives a dash that also damages enemies and grants brief invulnerability.
accessories.effect: Allows the player to dash into the enemy · Double tap a direction
accessories.desc: The Shield of Cthulhu is a pre-Hardmode shield accessory that is always dropped from the Eye of Cthulhu 's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While equipped, it grants 2 defense and allows the player to perform a dash attack by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right button, or the Dash button once. Dashing into an enemy deals damage to it, causes the player to bounce backward, and grants 0.07 seconds of invincibility frames and 0.17 seconds of immunity to contact damage from the hit enemy. [ 1 ] The cooldown between dashes is 0.5 seconds. [ 2 ]

accessories.name: Cloud in a Bottle
accessories.source: Found in Underground and Cavern Chests
accessories.why: The double-jump makes cave traversal and emergency boss repositioning much easier.
accessories.effect: Allows the holder to double jump
accessories.desc: The Cloud in a Bottle is an accessory that can be found in Gold Chests in the Underground and Cavern layers. When equipped, it allows the player an extra jump. The extra jump has a 75% jump duration compared to a normal jump, increasing the maximum height the player can reach without other accessories by 5 tiles, for a total of 11 tiles.

accessories.name: Hermes Boots
accessories.source: Found in Underground and Cavern Chests
accessories.why: Movement is survival in early Terraria, and Hermes Boots give you the speed to dodge, kite, and position better.
accessories.effect: The wearer can run super fast
accessories.desc: The Hermes Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Chests in the Underground and Cavern layers. While equipped, they grant the ability to sprint, allowing the player to reach maximum running speed faster, and they increase the player's maximum movement speed to 31 mph (22.73 tiles/second). The player will leave behind a visual trail of dust clouds as they sprint.

accessories.name: Craw Carapace
accessories.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
accessories.effect: 7% increased damage · Attackers take damage and are inflicted with Crumbling
accessories.desc: The Craw Carapace is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12. accessories.name: Feral Claws
accessories.source: Found in Jungle Chests, Ivy Chests and Jungle Crates
accessories.why: The melee speed and autoswing boost noticeably improves several early melee weapons.
accessories.effect: 12% increased melee speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons
accessories.desc: Feral Claws are a pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Jungle Crates, Bramble Crates, and Ivy Chests located in Jungle Shrines and at the base of a Living Mahogany Tree in the Underground Jungle. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

accessories.name: Magma Stone
accessories.source: Dropped by Hellbats and Lava Bats
accessories.why: Adds fire damage to melee strikes.
accessories.effect: Melee attacks inflict fire damage
accessories.desc: The Magma Stone is an accessory that causes the wearer's melee attacks to inflict the Hellfire debuff for up to 6 seconds on enemies. [ 1 ] It also causes direct hits from melee weapons to inflict the Hellfire debuff, and melee projectiles to inflict the On Fire! debuff for up to 6 seconds against other players in PvP. [ 2 ] The Magma Stone also adds orange flame particle effects on the sprites of both the weapon and its projectiles that give off light. It has a 1/50 (2%) chance to be dropped by Lava Bats and a 1/150 (0.67%) chance to be dropped by Hellbats in The Underworld.

accessories.name: Brain of Confusion

accessories.effect: Has a chance to create illusions and dodge an attack · Temporarily increase critical chance and minion damage after dodge · May confuse nearby enemies after being struck
accessories.desc: The Brain of Confusion is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Brain of Cthulhu 's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. It grants the following effects while equipped:

buffs.name: Healing Potions
buffs.source: Crafted

buffs.name: Plenty Satisfied
buffs.desc: Well Fed, Plenty Satisfied, and Exquisitely Stuffed are buffs granted to the player when they consume food, which provide general stat bonuses that vary in potency and duration depending on the food item consumed. In Expert Mode, health regeneration will only be fully effective while the player is under the effects of one of these buffs. While one of these buffs is active in a The Constant or Zenith special world seed, the player will also be temporarily immune to hunger for the buff's duration.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Sharpening Station
buffs.source: Found in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle
buffs.why: Grants armor penetration to melee weapons while standing near it.
buffs.desc: The Sharpening Station is a furniture item found naturally generated in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle. In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Merchant for 10 GC.

buffs.name: Thorns Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Thorns Potion is a buff potion which grants the Thorns buff when consumed. The buff inflicts a knockback of 10 (Extremely strong) on enemies that come into contact with the player, and deals 100% of their damage to them. [ 1 ] This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

weapons.name: Phoenix Blaster
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Upgrade to the Handgun, with higher damage and fire rate.
weapons.desc: The Phoenix Blaster is a pre-Hardmode gun and the direct upgrade to the Handgun, with increased damage and velocity but slightly less knockback.

accessories.effect: Increases movement speed and acceleration · Provides light when worn · 'A brief light in my dark life.'
accessories.desc: The Magiluminescence is a pre-Hardmode accessory that increases the player's maximum movement speed by 15% and their acceleration and deceleration by 75%. This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

accessories.name: Shield of Cthulhu
accessories.source: Dropped by the Eye of Cthulhu treasure bag
accessories.why: Expert Mode only. Gives a dash that also damages enemies and grants brief invulnerability.
accessories.effect: Allows the player to dash into the enemy · Double tap a direction
accessories.desc: The Shield of Cthulhu is a pre-Hardmode shield accessory that is always dropped from the Eye of Cthulhu 's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While equipped, it grants 2 defense and allows the player to perform a dash attack by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right button, or the Dash button once. Dashing into an enemy deals damage to it, causes the player to bounce backward, and grants 0.07 seconds of invincibility frames and 0.17 seconds of immunity to contact damage from the hit enemy. [ 1 ] The cooldown between dashes is 0.5 seconds. [ 2 ]

accessories.name: Craw Carapace
accessories.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
accessories.effect: 7% increased damage · Attackers take damage and are inflicted with Crumbling
accessories.desc: The Craw Carapace is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12. While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

accessories.name: Magma Stone
accessories.source: Dropped by Hellbats and Lava Bats
accessories.effect: Melee attacks inflict fire damage
accessories.desc: The Magma Stone is an accessory that causes the wearer's melee attacks to inflict the Hellfire debuff for up to 6 seconds on enemies. [ 1 ] It also causes direct hits from melee weapons to inflict the Hellfire debuff, and melee projectiles to inflict the On Fire! debuff for up to 6 seconds against other players in PvP. [ 2 ] The Magma Stone also adds orange flame particle effects on the sprites of both the weapon and its projectiles that give off light. It has a 1/50 (2%) chance to be dropped by Lava Bats and a 1/150 (0.67%) chance to be dropped by Hellbats in The Underworld.

accessories.name: Brain of Confusion
accessories.source: Dropped by the Brain of Cthulhu's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode
accessories.effect: Has a chance to create illusions and dodge an attack · Temporarily increase critical chance and minion damage after dodge · May confuse nearby enemies after being struck
accessories.desc: The Brain of Confusion is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Brain of Cthulhu 's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Crown Jewel
accessories.effect: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s
accessories.desc: The Crown Jewel is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by King Slime. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Gladiator's Locket
accessories.source: Purchased from Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found
accessories.effect: Enemies drop a healing orb on kill · Gain an increase to your damage and movement speed the lower your health is, up to 20% at 50% life or below
accessories.desc: The Gladiator's Locket is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is found in the Marble Cave shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found. When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

accessories.name: Unholy Tonic / Vicious Tonic
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil

accessories.name: Worm Scarf
accessories.source: Dropped by the Eater of Worlds' Treasure Bag in Expert Mode
accessories.effect: Reduces damage taken by 17%
accessories.desc: The Worm Scarf is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Eater of Worlds ' Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While equipped, it grants +17% damage reduction.

buffs.name: Healing Potions / Strange Brew
buffs.source: Crafted

buffs.name: Plenty Satisfied
buffs.desc: Well Fed, Plenty Satisfied, and Exquisitely Stuffed are buffs granted to the player when they consume food, which provide general stat bonuses that vary in potency and duration depending on the food item consumed. In Expert Mode, health regeneration will only be fully effective while the player is under the effects of one of these buffs. While one of these buffs is active in a The Constant or Zenith special world seed, the player will also be temporarily immune to hunger for the buff's duration.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Survival matters a lot once the phase is dominated by hard optional content and fast fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Even ranged classes need extra defense when bosses or cave enemies close the gap.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Ammo consumption adds up quickly, so this makes a stack last longer.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ammo Reservation Potion is a buff potion which grants the Ammo Reservation buff when consumed. The buff reduces the chance of consuming any ammunition by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Archery Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Raises arrow damage by 10% and arrow speed by 20%. Bows only.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Archery Potion is a buff potion which grants the Archery buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage of arrow -firing weapons by 10%, as well as the velocity of arrows by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Thorns Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Thorns Potion is a buff potion which grants the Thorns buff when consumed. The buff inflicts a knockback of 10 (Extremely strong) on enemies that come into contact with the player, and deals 100% of their damage to them. [ 1 ] This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Bounding Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Bounding Potion is a Pre-Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Bounding buff, which increases jump speed by 5% and jump height by 20%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons
items.effect: Allows the holder to quadruple jump · Increases jump height and negates fall damage
items.desc: The Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons is an accessory which combines the functionalities of the Bundle of Balloons and the Lucky Horseshoe.

items.name: Skyline Wings

items.desc: Skyline Wings are a Pre-Hardmode wing -type accessory. When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide at a low height.

items.name: Counter Scarf

items.desc: The Counter Scarf is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is sold by the Clothier for 20. It grants the ability to dash by double-tapping the ◀ Left or ▶ Right keys, with a base distance of 14 blocks.

items.effect: Natural life regen is 50% more potent
items.desc: The Honey Dew is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.
