items.name: Obsidian Shield
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Grants immunity to fire blocks
items.desc: The Obsidian Shield is a pre-Hardmode shield and immunity accessory that grants +2 defense, immunity to knockback, and immunity to the Burning debuff.

items.name: Radiant Ooze
items.effect: +0.5 to +2.5 HP/s life regen based on missing health · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled · (Current regen: +[REGEN] HP/s)
items.desc: The Radiant Ooze is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it grants + 0.5 HP/s to + 2.5 HP/s; the lower the player's health, the stronger the effect. It also makes the player emit yellow light if visibility is enabled.

items.name: Bone Glove
items.effect: Shoots crossbones at enemies while you are attacking
items.desc: The Bone Glove is a pre-Hardmode accessory that throws ricocheting crossbones every time a weapon is used, at a maximum of once per second. The crossbones projectiles ricochet off walls three times or pierce two enemies before being destroyed, deal 25 classless damage, and additionally have 25 armor penetration. The Bone Glove is always dropped from Skeletron 's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.

items.name: Craw Carapace
items.effect: 7% increased damage · Attackers take damage and are inflicted with Crumbling
items.desc: The Craw Carapace is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12. While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

items.name: Protolith Bangle
items.effect: Ranged enemy hits create a marble flash that always critically strikes and can hit multiple enemies · This effect has a 7 second cooldown · Visual and audio effects are reduced if visibility is disabled · 'The cold marble against your wrist puts your mind at ease'
items.desc: The Protolith Bangle is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it releases a marble shatter upon enemy hits with ranged weapons that deals 30 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 7 second cooldown. The shatter's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

weapons.name: Abyssal Tome
weapons.source: Dropped by The Slime God
weapons.why: first-listed primary magic weapon at this tier
weapons.effect: Casts a slow-moving ball of dark energy
weapons.desc: The Abyssal Tome is a Pre-Hardmode spell tome that is dropped by The Slime God. When used, it fires a slow-moving purple glob that passes through tiles and is not affected by gravity and will slowly decelerate before stopping in place. After hitting an enemy twice or after 5 seconds from being shot, it will explode, dealing damage in a small radius.

weapons.name: Aqua Scepter
weapons.source: Found in Gold Chests / Golden Lock Boxes
weapons.why: Sprays a stream of water droplets that pierce enemies.
weapons.effect: Sprays out a shower of water
weapons.desc: The Aqua Scepter is a pre-Hardmode wand that fires arcing streams of water in quick succession, with each stream being able to hit up to 5 targets. The water streams bounce upwards upon colliding with lava. They pierce infinitely after a bounce, move slower, are less affected by gravity and can last for a significantly longer time. [ 1 ]

weapons.name: Blood Bath
weapons.source: Dropped by The Perforators
weapons.effect: Drenches your foes in blood
weapons.desc: The Blood Bath is a Pre-Hardmode wand that is dropped by The Perforators. When used, it spawns 2-3 blood raindrops from the sky that pierce once but cannot pass through tiles. The raindrops inflict the Burning Blood debuff.

weapons.name: Demon Scythe
weapons.source: Dropped by Demons and Voodoo Demons in the Underworld
weapons.why: Fires accelerating sickle projectiles that pierce up to five enemies.
weapons.effect: Casts a demon scythe
weapons.desc: The Demon Scythe is a pre-Hardmode spell book that has a 1/35 (2.86%) chance of being dropped by Demons and Voodoo Demons. When used, it fires a sickle projectile that is initially static before gradually accelerating. The sickles can hit up to five times before dissipating, and they cannot pass through blocks.

weapons.name: Eldritch Tome
weapons.source: Dropped by The Slime God
weapons.effect: Casts eldritch tentacles to spear your enemies
weapons.desc: The Eldritch Tome is a Pre-Hardmode spell tome that is dropped by The Slime God. When used, it releases red tendrils which bend in random directions, similarly to the Shadowflame Hex Doll.

weapons.name: Night's Ray
weapons.source: Crafted at a Demon Altar or Crimson Altar
weapons.why: multi-star magic weapon with high DPS
weapons.effect: Fires a ray of pure, concentrated darkness · When hitting enemies, they are hit by several new beams from their sides
weapons.desc: The Night's Ray is a Pre-Hardmode wand. When used, it fires a purple beam that pierces ten times. When the beam hits an enemy, it spawns 4 four short-range particle beams to damage nearby enemies.

weapons.name: Brittle Star Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by the Desert Scourge
weapons.effect: Summons a small brittle starfish that will dash through enemies until it shatters · Starfish will quickly regenerate after shattering · Holding ⚷ Open / Activate will swap starfish between dashing and circling you · When the starfish are circling, each one provides you with 3 defense
weapons.desc: The Brittle Star Staff is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by the Desert Scourge. When used, it summons a Brittle Star minion, which follows the player and attacks enemies by dashing at them to deal damage. Brittle stars hit up to 4 enemies before shattering, quickly regenerating afterwards.

weapons.name: Wulfrum Controller
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons a wulfrum droid to fight for you · Hold ⚷ Open / Activate while holding the remote to switch all of your drones between regular and supercharge mode · Supercharged droids will stop attacking and focus wulfrum energy onto you · Supercharged droids provide +0.25 HP/s life regen and 2 defense per droid · Can also be used to heal other players by keeping your mouse cursor close enough to them
weapons.desc: The Wulfrum Controller is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. When used with its primary function (left-click), it summons a Wulfrum Droid minion that floats by the player and attacks nearby enemies by firing green energy bolts that cannot pierce but can curve towards nearby enemies. The droid waits a random time from 0.49-1.83 seconds between shots, and recoils in the opposite direction of its shot while shooting.

armor.name: Aerospec armor
armor.effect: Taking over 25 damage in one hit will cause a spread of homing feathers to fall · Allows you to fall more quickly and disables fall damage · Helm: 5% increased movement speed and melee critical strike chance · Enemies are more likely to target you · Hood: 5% increased movement speed and ranged critical strike chance · Hat: 8% reduced mana cost · 5% increased movement speed and magic critical strike chance · Helmet: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · 11% increased summon damage · Summons a valkyrie to protect you · Headgear: +80 maximum stealth · 5% increased movement speed and rogue critical strike chance
armor.desc: Aerospec armor is a Pre-Hardmode armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit afterimages.

armor.name: Meteor armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Space Gun costs 0 mana, so it pairs with that weapon specifically.
armor.effect: Space Gun costs 0 mana
armor.desc: Meteor armor is a pre-Hardmode mage armor set consisting of the Meteor Helmet, Meteor Suit, and Meteor Leggings.

armor.name: Statigel armor
armor.effect: Grants an extra jump and increased jump height · 12% increased jump speed · Helm: Enemies are more likely to target you · Hood: 15% increased summon damage · Summons a mini paladin to fight for you, the type depends on what world evil you have · Mask: +90 maximum stealth
armor.desc: Statigel armor is a Pre-Hardmode armor set.

buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Inferno Potion is a buff potion that grants the Inferno buff when consumed. The buff casts a spinning ring of fire around the player that deals 20 damage per second and inflicts the Hellfire debuff for 2 seconds to all enemies inside of it while also giving off light. Critters and other passive NPCs are unaffected.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.desc: The Seafood Dinner is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: The extra survivability helps offset how punishing late-Hardmode mistakes can be for mage.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Mage has less room for mistakes, so the bonus defense matters a lot.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Lifeforce Potion is a buff potion that grants the Lifeforce buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Magic Power Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Magic Power Potion is a buff potion which grants the Magic Power buff when consumed. The buff increases magic damage by 20%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Speeds up mana regeneration, so you stop to drink fewer mana potions.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Mana Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Mana Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff increases the rate at which the player's mana regenerates. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Bounding Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Bounding Potion is a Pre-Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Bounding buff, which increases jump speed by 5% and jump height by 20%.

buffs.name: Slice of Cake
buffs.source: Obtained by being the first player to talk to the Party Girl during a randomly occurring Party
buffs.desc: The Slice of Cake is a furniture item acquired by being the first player to talk to the Party Girl during a randomly occurring Party. Player-initiated Parties (caused by a Party Center), or the Party initiated at the creation of Celebration Mk 10 or Zenith worlds will not cause her to give players the Slice of Cake.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons
items.effect: Allows the holder to quadruple jump · Increases jump height and negates fall damage
items.desc: The Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons is an accessory which combines the functionalities of the Bundle of Balloons and the Lucky Horseshoe.

items.name: Skyline Wings
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 1.33 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Average · Max vertical speed: Average · Horizontal acceleration: Average · Vertical acceleration: Average
items.desc: Skyline Wings are a Pre-Hardmode wing -type accessory. When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide at a low height.

items.name: Counter Scarf
items.effect: Grants the ability to dash; dashing into an attack will cause you to dodge it · After a successful dodge you must wait 30 seconds before you can dodge again
items.desc: The Counter Scarf is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is sold by the Clothier for 20. It grants the ability to dash by double-tapping the ◀ Left or ▶ Right keys, with a base distance of 14 blocks.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.why: Upgrades of this are also viable.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
items.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.effect: Increases movement speed and acceleration · Provides light when worn · 'A brief light in my dark life.'
items.desc: The Magiluminescence is a pre-Hardmode accessory that increases the player's maximum movement speed by 15% and their acceleration and deceleration by 75%. This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

items.name: Terraspark Boots
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 8% increased movement speed · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava
items.desc: The Terraspark Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory. They grant the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Brain of Confusion
items.why: Dodges in Calamity are guaranteed on a cooldown.
items.effect: Has a chance to create illusions and dodge an attack · Temporarily increase critical chance and minion damage after dodge · May confuse nearby enemies after being struck
items.desc: The Brain of Confusion is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Brain of Cthulhu 's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Crown Jewel
items.effect: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s
items.desc: The Crown Jewel is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by King Slime. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Honey Dew
items.effect: Natural life regen is 50% more potent
items.desc: The Honey Dew is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.

items.name: Gladiator's Locket
items.why: This is difficult to obtain, and only one can be obtained per world.
items.effect: Enemies drop a healing orb on kill · Gain an increase to your damage and movement speed the lower your health is, up to 20% at 50% life or below
items.desc: The Gladiator's Locket is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is found in the Marble Cave shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found. When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

items.name: Obsidian Shield
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Grants immunity to fire blocks
items.desc: The Obsidian Shield is a pre-Hardmode shield and immunity accessory that grants +2 defense, immunity to knockback, and immunity to the Burning debuff.

items.name: Radiant Ooze
items.effect: +0.5 to +2.5 HP/s life regen based on missing health · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled · (Current regen: +[REGEN] HP/s)
items.desc: The Radiant Ooze is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it grants + 0.5 HP/s to + 2.5 HP/s; the lower the player's health, the stronger the effect. It also makes the player emit yellow light if visibility is enabled.

items.name: Batholith Bangle
items.effect: Magic enemy hits create a powerful granite flash that always critically strikes · This effect has a 10 second cooldown · Visual and audio effects are reduced if visibility is disabled · 'The solid granite radiates energy throughout your body'
items.desc: The Batholith Bangle is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it releases a granite flash upon enemy hits with magic weapons that deals 50 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 10 second cooldown. The strike's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

items.name: Bone Glove
items.effect: Shoots crossbones at enemies while you are attacking
items.desc: The Bone Glove is a pre-Hardmode accessory that throws ricocheting crossbones every time a weapon is used, at a maximum of once per second. The crossbones projectiles ricochet off walls three times or pierce two enemies before being destroyed, deal 25 classless damage, and additionally have 25 armor penetration. The Bone Glove is always dropped from Skeletron 's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.

items.name: Mana Flower
items.effect: 8% reduced mana cost · Automatically use mana potions when needed
items.desc: The Mana Flower is a pre-Hardmode accessory that reduces mana usage by 8%, and enables auto-consumption of any mana-restoring potions in the player's inventory when mana is depleted. The Mana Flower stacks with other mana cost-reduction items, including Nature's Gift. It is.

items.name: Magic Cuffs
items.effect: Increases maximum mana by 20 · Restores mana when damaged
items.desc: The Magic Cuffs are a pre-Hardmode accessory which increases maximum mana by 20 and restores mana when the wearer is damaged.

items.name: Mana Polarizer
items.effect: Increases maximum mana by 40 · Provides life regeneration and magic damage that scales based on how much mana you have · Lower mana means more life regeneration, but less magic damage · These scale from -2 to +2 HP/s, and 15% to 5% damage · The provided regeneration is halved when under Mana Sickness · Magic projectiles steal enemy life
items.desc: The Mana Polarizer is an Expert Mode Pre-Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by The Slime God. It grants the following effects while equipped:

weapons.name: Enchanted Knife Staff
weapons.source: Found in underground Gold Chests or from Golden or Titanium Crates
weapons.why: primary minion weapon at this tier
weapons.effect: Summons an Enchanted Knife to fight for you
weapons.desc: The Enchanted Knife Staff is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that can be found in underground Gold Chests or from Golden or Titanium Crates. When used, it summons a floating knife that float over the player's head. While an enemy is nearby, it swings itself back and forth at a close distance from the enemy, shooting a knife beam that is unaffected by gravity and can pass through tiles.

weapons.name: Stormjaw Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Stormlions
weapons.effect: Summons a baby stormlion to fight for you
weapons.desc: The Stormjaw Staff is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by Stormlions. When used, it summons a miniature Stormlion minion. It runs on the ground and aggressively rams enemies back and forth, does not deal contact damage but creates damaging sparks in contact with enemies.

weapons.name: Sun Spirit Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons a solar spirit to protect you · Repeated summons increase its power
weapons.desc: The Sun Spirit Staff is a Pre-Hardmode summon weapon. When used, it summons a Solar Spirit minion above the player's head that fires non-piercing yellow energy beams at nearby enemies once every 0.83 seconds. Unlike most minions, only one Solar Spirit can be summoned at a time.

weapons.name: Rusty Beacon Prototype
weapons.source: Found in Rusty Chests
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons a long-abandoned drone that passively emits Irradiated waves
weapons.desc: The Rusty Beacon Prototype is a Pre-Hardmode sentry that can be found in Rusty Chests. When used, it summons a stationary Rusty drone that bobs up and down. Every 2 seconds, starting 1 second after it is summoned, it fires a toxic wave pulse that inflicts the Irradiated debuff.

weapons.name: Squirrel Squire Staff
weapons.source: Obtained from the Starter Bag
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons a squirrel to throw acorns at your enemies
weapons.desc: The Squirrel Squire Staff is a Pre-Hardmode sentry that is also obtained from the Starter Bag. When used, it summons a stationary squirrel sentry at the nearest block to the player's location. If there are no blocks directly underneath it, it will start falling.

weapons.name: Leather Whip
weapons.source: Purchased from the Zoologist (10 Gold)
weapons.why: Bought from the Zoologist and directs minions onto the struck target.
weapons.effect: 4 summon tag damage · Your summons will focus struck enemies · 'Die monster!'
weapons.desc: The Leather Whip is a pre-Hardmode whip that is normally always available to be purchased from the Zoologist for 10 GC (except in certain scenarios). It has a 50% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:

armor.name: Bee armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Summon damage +10%. No whip bonus, so it suits minion-led builds.
armor.effect: Increases summon damage by 10%
armor.desc: Bee armor is a pre-Hardmode summoner armor set consisting of the Bee Headgear, Bee Breastplate, and Bee Greaves.

armor.name: Obsidian armor
armor.why: Whip range +30%, whip speed +15%, summon damage +15%.
armor.effect: Increases whip range by 30% and speed by 15% · Increases summon damage by 15%
armor.desc: Obsidian armor is a pre-Hardmode summoner armor set consisting of the Obsidian Outlaw Hat, Obsidian Longcoat, and Obsidian Pants.

armor.name: Statigel armor
armor.effect: Grants an extra jump and increased jump height · 12% increased jump speed · Helm: Enemies are more likely to target you · Hood: 15% increased summon damage · Summons a mini paladin to fight for you, the type depends on what world evil you have · Mask: +90 maximum stealth
armor.desc: Statigel armor is a Pre-Hardmode armor set.

accessories.name: Fledgling Wings
accessories.source: Found in Skyware Chests on Floating Islands
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: The Fledgling Wings are the only pre-Hardmode wings. Like all wings, they grant the player the ability to fly and glide when equipped, as well as not take fall damage. At top speed, they allow traveling at 15 mph horizontally and 22 mph vertically.

accessories.name: Spirit Glyph
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Minion attacks provide various buffs · Hold Shift for more Spirit Power grants 10% increased summon damage · Spirit Defense grants 2 defense · Spirit Regen grants 0.5 HP/s life regeneration
accessories.desc: The Spirit Glyph is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, whenever a minion hits an enemy, the player is granted one of the following buffs:

accessories.name: Frog Leg
accessories.source: Fished in any viable body of water
accessories.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
accessories.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

accessories.name: Hermes Boots
accessories.source: Found in Underground and Cavern Chests
accessories.why: Movement is survival in early Terraria, and Hermes Boots give you the speed to dodge, kite, and position better.
accessories.effect: The wearer can run super fast
accessories.desc: The Hermes Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Chests in the Underground and Cavern layers. While equipped, they grant the ability to sprint, allowing the player to reach maximum running speed faster, and they increase the player's maximum movement speed to 31 mph (22.73 tiles/second). The player will leave behind a visual trail of dust clouds as they sprint.

accessories.name: Magiluminescence
accessories.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.why: Increases the player's movement speed by 15%, and their acceleration (and deceleration) by 75%. This movement speed buff no longer applies if the player is not grounded.
accessories.effect: Increases movement speed and acceleration · Provides light when worn · 'A brief light in my dark life.'
accessories.desc: The Magiluminescence is a pre-Hardmode accessory that increases the player's maximum movement speed by 15% and their acceleration and deceleration by 75%. This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

accessories.name: Black Glass Band
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Enemy hits create an obsidian flash that always critically strikes · This effect has a 5 second cooldown, but is halved if the flash kills an enemy · Visual and audio effects are reduced if visibility is disabled · 'A shining band with boundless potential'
accessories.desc: The Black Glass Band is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it releases an obsidian strike upon enemy hits that deals 20 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 5 second cooldown that is halved if the enemy is killed with the strike. The strike's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

accessories.name: Craw Carapace
accessories.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
accessories.effect: 7% increased damage · Attackers take damage and are inflicted with Crumbling
accessories.desc: The Craw Carapace is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12. While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

accessories.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
accessories.source: Dropped by Blood Feeders, Crimeras and Face Monsters in the Crimson
accessories.why: Provides all weapons with 5 unconditional armor penetration. Can be stacked with or upgraded into the Stinger Necklace.
accessories.effect: Increases armor penetration by 5
accessories.desc: The Shark Tooth Necklace is an accessory which has a 1/150 (0.67%) / 1/75 (1.33%) chance to drop from Blood Zombies and Dripplers found during a Blood Moon. It increases the player's armor penetration by 5 when equipped.

accessories.name: Wulfrum Battery
accessories.effect: Your summons emit light if visibility is on · 7% increased summon damage · Wulfrum enemies drop additional scrap · Can also be scrapped at an extractinator
accessories.desc: The Wulfrum Battery is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Wulfrum enemies. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Gladiator's Locket
accessories.source: Purchased from Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found
accessories.effect: Enemies drop a healing orb on kill · Gain an increase to your damage and movement speed the lower your health is, up to 20% at 50% life or below
accessories.desc: The Gladiator's Locket is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is found in the Marble Cave shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found. When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

accessories.name: Ilmeris' Spark
accessories.effect: Taking damage releases a blast of sparks
accessories.desc: Ilmeris' Spark is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Cnidrions. When equipped, it causes the player to release 8 gravity-affected sparks around them when harmed by any source of damage. These sparks linger for 2 seconds, partially ignore immunity frames, and deal 6 base damage, which is boosted by the player's highest class' damage.

accessories.name: Rover Drive
accessories.effect: Gain a barrier with 20 health · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · The barrier will regenerate 10 seconds after being hit, taking 5 seconds to completely regenerate · Getting hit resets the timer · Can also be scrapped at an extractinator
accessories.desc: The Rover Drive is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Wulfrum Rovers. When equipped for 10 seconds without taking damage, a protective matrix covers its user, which grants 20 matrix durability. If the player gets hit, durability is lost instead of health by the amount of damage taken.

buffs.name: Lesser Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Lesser Healing Potion is a pre-Hardmode recovery potion that restores 50 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 60 seconds when used. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths. It is the first tier of healing potion, preceding the Healing Potion, Greater Healing Potion, Jungle Juice and Super Healing Potion.

buffs.name: Eggnog
buffs.source: Dropped by Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event
buffs.desc: Eggnog is a pre-Hardmode recovery potion that can be dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event, with a chance of 8.101% in pre-Hardmode and 7.561% in Hardmode. When used, it restores 80 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 40 seconds. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Well Fed
buffs.source: Any cooked food buff
buffs.why: It is a painless always-on stat boost for a class that wants every slot and every edge.
buffs.desc: Well Fed, Plenty Satisfied, and Exquisitely Stuffed are buffs granted to the player when they consume food, which provide general stat bonuses that vary in potency and duration depending on the food item consumed. In Expert Mode, health regeneration will only be fully effective while the player is under the effects of one of these buffs. While one of these buffs is active in a The Constant or Zenith special world seed, the player will also be temporarily immune to hunger for the buff's duration.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: The damage reduction is especially welcome in a phase full of punishing optional content.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: You are still fragile even with summons doing the work, so extra defense is welcome.

buffs.name: Thorns Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Thorns Potion is a buff potion which grants the Thorns buff when consumed. The buff inflicts a knockback of 10 (Extremely strong) on enemies that come into contact with the player, and deals 100% of their damage to them. [ 1 ] This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.desc: The Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons is an accessory which combines the functionalities of the Bundle of Balloons and the Lucky Horseshoe.

items.name: Skyline Wings
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 1.33 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Average · Max vertical speed: Average · Horizontal acceleration: Average · Vertical acceleration: Average
items.desc: Skyline Wings are a Pre-Hardmode wing -type accessory. When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide at a low height.

items.name: Counter Scarf
items.effect: Grants the ability to dash; dashing into an attack will cause you to dodge it · After a successful dodge you must wait 30 seconds before you can dodge again
items.desc: The Counter Scarf is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is sold by the Clothier for 20. It grants the ability to dash by double-tapping the ◀ Left or ▶ Right keys, with a base distance of 14 blocks.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.why: Upgrades of this are also viable.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
items.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.effect: Increases movement speed and acceleration · Provides light when worn · 'A brief light in my dark life.'
items.desc: The Magiluminescence is a pre-Hardmode accessory that increases the player's maximum movement speed by 15% and their acceleration and deceleration by 75%. This increase stacks with the bonus of the Hermes Boots and their variants. [ 1 ] It also creates an aura of light around the player, which can be useful when exploring underground. The Magiluminescence's movement speed buffs are disabled when the player is not grounded. [ 2 ]

items.name: Terraspark Boots
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 8% increased movement speed · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava
items.desc: The Terraspark Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory. They grant the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Brain of Confusion
items.why: Dodges in Calamity are guaranteed on a cooldown.
items.effect: Has a chance to create illusions and dodge an attack · Temporarily increase critical chance and minion damage after dodge · May confuse nearby enemies after being struck
items.desc: The Brain of Confusion is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Brain of Cthulhu 's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Crown Jewel
items.effect: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s
items.desc: The Crown Jewel is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by King Slime. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Honey Dew
items.effect: Natural life regen is 50% more potent
items.desc: The Honey Dew is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.

items.name: Gladiator's Locket
items.why: This is difficult to obtain, and only one can be obtained per world.
items.effect: Enemies drop a healing orb on kill · Gain an increase to your damage and movement speed the lower your health is, up to 20% at 50% life or below
items.desc: The Gladiator's Locket is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is found in the Marble Cave shrine or sold by the Shady Salesman for 25 during a Full Moon after the item has been found. When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

items.name: Obsidian Shield
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Grants immunity to fire blocks
items.desc: The Obsidian Shield is a pre-Hardmode shield and immunity accessory that grants +2 defense, immunity to knockback, and immunity to the Burning debuff.

items.name: Radiant Ooze
items.effect: +0.5 to +2.5 HP/s life regen based on missing health · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled · (Current regen: +[REGEN] HP/s)
items.desc: The Radiant Ooze is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it grants + 0.5 HP/s to + 2.5 HP/s; the lower the player's health, the stronger the effect. It also makes the player emit yellow light if visibility is enabled.

items.name: Bone Glove
items.effect: Shoots crossbones at enemies while you are attacking
items.desc: The Bone Glove is a pre-Hardmode accessory that throws ricocheting crossbones every time a weapon is used, at a maximum of once per second. The crossbones projectiles ricochet off walls three times or pierce two enemies before being destroyed, deal 25 classless damage, and additionally have 25 armor penetration. The Bone Glove is always dropped from Skeletron 's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.

items.name: Jelly-Charged Battery
items.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 1, and summon damage by 7% · Minion attacks create charged orbs
items.desc: The Jelly-Charged Battery is a Pre-Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Voltaic Jelly and Wulfrum Battery. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Pygmy Necklace
items.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 1
items.desc: The Pygmy Necklace is a pre-Hardmode accessory that provides the player with one additional minion slot. It is purchased from the Witch Doctor for 20 GC at night.

weapons.name: Feather Knife
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: homing thrown knives with strong spam DPS
weapons.effect: Throws a knife which summons homing feathers · Stealth strike throw a volley of knives
weapons.desc: The Feather Knife is a Pre-Hardmode dagger. When used, it throws a gravity affected knife that periodically releases homing explosive feathers. The feather and explosion deal 5% and 50% of the weapon's damage respectively.

weapons.name: Gel Dart
weapons.source: Crafted at a Solidifier
weapons.why: rapid piercing thrown darts; strong stealth-strike burst
weapons.effect: Throws bouncing gel darts that cover enemies in Slime · Stealth strikes ignore gravity, bounce more vigorously, and constantly leak slime
weapons.desc: The Gel Dart is a Pre-Hardmode dagger. When used, it throws a gel dagger that travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity and inflicts the Slime debuff. They pierce and bounce off tiles 3 times before breaking on the fourth impact.

weapons.name: Glaive
weapons.source: Purchased from Bandit for 10 gold
weapons.why: returning thrown polearm; stealth strike splits into projectiles
weapons.effect: Tosses a ricocheting glaive · Stealth strikes shred the first enemy they hit and provide a ring of high-knockback orbiting glaives
weapons.desc: The Glaive is a Pre-Hardmode rogue boomerang that is sold by the Bandit for 10. When used, it throws a glaive that ricochets towards nearby enemies upon contact with tiles or enemies, and pierces three times. Each struck enemy will reduce the damage of the glaive by 10%.

weapons.name: Lionfish
weapons.source: Obtained from Ancient Treasure Chests in the Abyss
weapons.why: inflicts venom on hit; venom-inflicting stealth strike
weapons.effect: Sticks to enemies and injects a potent Acid Venom · The Acid Venom can stack when more lionfish are stuck in an enemy · Stealth strikes spawn homing urchin spikes as they travel
weapons.desc: The Lionfish is a Pre-Hardmode rogue weapon that is obtained from Ancient Treasure Chests in the Abyss. When used, it hurls a Lionfish which travels in a straight line for a long distance before being affected by gravity. Lionfish projectiles will explode upon hitting a tile or after being stuck to an enemy for several seconds.

weapons.name: Slick Cane
weapons.source: Purchased from Bandit for 35 gold
weapons.effect: Swipes a cane that steals money from enemies · Stealth strikes gives a 1 in 20 chance for enemies to drop 1-2 gold coins when hit · Stealth strikes boost damage in proportion to money in the inventory, up to 1 platinum · 'Economy at its finest'
weapons.desc: The Slick Cane is a Pre-Hardmode rogue weapon that is sold by the Bandit for 35. When used, it thrusts out a short-ranged cane in front of the player which ignores enemy immunity frames. Each time it hits an enemy while being swung, that enemy will drop a small amount of coins proportional to the amount the enemy drops upon death.

weapons.name: Shinobi Blade
weapons.source: Dropped by Dark Casters
weapons.effect: Throws a fast blade that spawns healing orbs when it kills an enemy · Stealth strikes repeatedly stab the struck enemy from random directions
weapons.desc: The Shinobi Blade is a Pre-Hardmode dagger that is dropped by Dark Casters. When used, it throws a fast dagger that is unaffected by gravity and does not pierce or pass through tiles. Enemies killed by the dagger spawn homing blue orbs that heal the player for 5 health.

armor.name: Statigel armor
armor.effect: Grants an extra jump and increased jump height · 12% increased jump speed · Helm: Enemies are more likely to target you · Hood: 15% increased summon damage · Summons a mini paladin to fight for you, the type depends on what world evil you have · Mask: +90 maximum stealth
armor.desc: Statigel armor is a Pre-Hardmode armor set.

accessories.name: Bloodstained Glove
accessories.why: general rogue damage and stealth boost
accessories.effect: Stealth strikes have +8 armor penetration and heal for 5 HP
accessories.desc: The Bloodstained Glove is a Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory that is dropped by The Perforators. When equipped, it makes stealth strikes have +8 armor penetration and heal the player for 5 health.

accessories.name: Craw Carapace
accessories.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
accessories.effect: 7% increased damage · Attackers take damage and are inflicted with Crumbling
accessories.desc: The Craw Carapace is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12. While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

accessories.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
accessories.source: Dropped by Blood Feeders, Crimeras and Face Monsters in the Crimson
accessories.effect: Increases armor penetration by 5
accessories.desc: The Shark Tooth Necklace is an accessory which has a 1/150 (0.67%) / 1/75 (1.33%) chance to drop from Blood Zombies and Dripplers found during a Blood Moon. It increases the player's armor penetration by 5 when equipped.

accessories.name: Coin of Deceit
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Stealth strikes only expend 90% of your max stealth · 6% increased rogue crit chance
accessories.desc: The Coin of Deceit is a Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory. When equipped, it increases rogue critical strike chance by 6% and makes stealth strikes only require 90% of the player's maximum stealth to perform and consume 90% of the player's maximum stealth when performed.

accessories.name: Filthy Glove
accessories.effect: Stealth strikes have +8 armor penetration and deal 8% more damage
accessories.desc: The Filthy Glove is a Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory that is dropped by The Hive Mind. When equipped, it makes stealth strikes deal 8% more damage and have +8 armor penetration.

accessories.name: Mirage Mirror
accessories.effect: Reduces enemy aggression outside of the abyss · Stealth generates 25% faster when standing still and 12% faster while moving · 'Bend light around you'
accessories.desc: The Mirage Mirror is a Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory. When equipped, the player builds rogue stealth 25% faster while standing still and 12% faster while moving. It also reduces enemy aggro by 200, however it will not reduce aggro while in the Abyss.

buffs.name: Flask of Fire
buffs.source: Crafted at an Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.desc: The Flask of Fire is a flask that causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the On Fire! debuff for 3–6 seconds on enemies hit. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.name: Flask of Poison
buffs.source: Brewed at Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.desc: The Flask of Poison is a flask that causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Poisoned debuff for 5–9 seconds on enemies hit. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.name: Shadow Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Shadow Potion is a Pre-Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Shadow buff, which provides the following effects:

items.name: Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons
items.effect: Allows the holder to quadruple jump · Increases jump height and negates fall damage
items.desc: The Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons is an accessory which combines the functionalities of the Bundle of Balloons and the Lucky Horseshoe.

weapons.name: Bananarang
weapons.source: Dropped by Clowns during a Hardmode Blood Moon
weapons.why: Multiple can be thrown at once; dropped by Hardmode Clowns.
weapons.desc: The Bananarang is a Hardmode boomerang that is dropped by the Clown during Blood Moon with a 1/10 (10%) chance. Unlike most boomerangs, it does not have to return to the player before being fired, with a maximum of ten Bananarangs that can be thrown out at one time.

weapons.name: Chain Guillotines
weapons.source: Dropped by Corrupt Mimics (Hardmode)
weapons.why: Launched flail dropped by Corrupt Mimics in Hardmode.
weapons.desc: The Chain Guillotines are a Hardmode flail that have a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by Corrupt Mimics. When used, they fire two blades attached to chains in rapid succession, with a maximum range of 32 tiles. They can pierce enemies that are very close by.

weapons.name: Comet Quasher
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons a swarm of meteors from the sky on enemy hits
weapons.desc: The Comet Quasher is a Hardmode special sword that autoswings. On use, it swings in a full circle around the player. Hitting an enemy launches them away from the player and rains a barrage of 4 meteors on them that deals 150% base damage.

weapons.name: Shadowflame Knife
weapons.source: Dropped by Goblin Warlocks during a Hardmode Goblin Army
weapons.why: Throws ricocheting knives that inflict the Shadowflame debuff.
weapons.effect: Inflicts Shadowflame on hit
weapons.desc: The Shadowflame Knife is a Hardmode melee weapon that has a 1/6 (16.67%) / 1/3 (33.33%) chance to drop from Goblin Warlocks during the Goblin Army event. When used, it fires a small gravity-affected knife projectile that can bounce off enemies up to two times, but dissipates upon contact with blocks. It inflicts the Shadowflame debuff for 1–3 seconds on hit.

weapons.name: Storm Saber
weapons.source: Dropped by Cloud Elementals
weapons.effect: Fires two homing storm beams · One from blade and one from the sky
weapons.desc: The Storm Saber is a Hardmode broadsword that autoswings. It has a chance to be dropped from Cloud Elementals. When swung, it fires a slow and homing glowing sword-like projectile from the blade, and another from the sky towards the cursor.

armor.name: Cobalt armor
armor.effect: : 14% reduced mana costs · : 15% increased melee speed · : 20% chance to save ammo
armor.desc: Cobalt armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Cobalt Breastplate and Cobalt Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Cobalt Helmet, Cobalt Mask, and Cobalt Hat, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.

armor.name: Palladium armor
armor.effect: Greatly increases life regeneration after striking an enemy
armor.desc: Palladium armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Palladium Breastplate and Palladium Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Palladium Mask, Palladium Helmet, and Palladium Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.

accessories.name: Lunic Eye
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Fires seeking energy bolts that cause enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
accessories.desc: The Lunic Eye is a Hardmode classless weapon. When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

accessories.name: Rod of Discord
accessories.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
accessories.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

accessories.name: Angel Wings
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons
accessories.effect: Allows the holder to quadruple jump · Increases jump height and negates fall damage
accessories.desc: The Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons is an accessory which combines the functionalities of the Bundle of Balloons and the Lucky Horseshoe.

accessories.name: Demon Wings
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Amalgamated Brain
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10%
accessories.desc: The Amalgamated Brain is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Rotten Brain and Brain of Confusion. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Bloody Worm Scarf
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: 10% increased damage reduction and melee damage
accessories.desc: The Bloody Worm Scarf is a Hardmode accessory. When equipped, it provides 2 defense, and increases damage reduction and melee damage by 10%.

accessories.name: Frost Flare
accessories.effect: All attacks and projectiles inflict Frostbite · Being above 50% life grants 10% increased damage · Being below 50% life grants 10 defense and 15% increased max movement speed and acceleration · Grants resistance against cold attacks, Frostburn , Chilled and Frozen
accessories.desc: The Frost Flare is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Cryogen. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Grand Gelatin
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: 12% increased movement speed and jump speed · Using a healing potion creates a cleansing aura which lasts for 30 seconds · Entering the aura removes all debuffs one time and grants +2 HP/s life regen
accessories.desc: The Grand Gelatin is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Cleansing Jelly, Life Jelly and Vital Jelly. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Frog Leg
accessories.source: Fished in any viable body of water
accessories.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
accessories.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

accessories.name: Power Glove
accessories.effect: Increases melee knockback · 12% increased melee speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons · Increases the size of melee weapons
accessories.desc: The Power Glove is a Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

accessories.name: Putrid Scent
accessories.effect: Enemies are less likely to target you · 5% increased damage and critical strike chance
accessories.desc: The Putrid Scent is a Hardmode accessory that has a 1/5 (20%) chance to be dropped by Corrupt Mimics. While equipped, it increases the player's damage and critical strike chance by 5% and decreases aggro by 400.

accessories.name: Warrior Emblem
accessories.source: Dropped by the Wall of Flesh
accessories.why: The raw melee damage bonus is immediate and efficient, which makes it the easiest offensive slot to justify in this phase.
accessories.effect: 15% increased melee damage
accessories.desc: The Warrior Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that increases melee damage by 15%. It has a 1/4 (25%) chance to drop from the Wall of Flesh.

accessories.name: Charm of Myths
accessories.why: Steady life regen and a shorter healing-potion cooldown keep you topped up.
accessories.effect: Provides life regeneration and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25%
accessories.desc: The Charm of Myths is a Hardmode accessory which combines the effects of the Band of Regeneration and the Philosopher's Stone. When equipped, it regenerates 1 health every second and decreases the Potion Sickness debuff duration by 25%. This debuff normally imposes a 60-second cooldown after consuming a recovery potion; the Charm of Myths reduces it to 45 seconds.

accessories.name: Frost Barrier
accessories.effect: You will freeze nearby enemies when you are struck · Grants immunity to Chilled and Frostburn
accessories.desc: The Frost Barrier is a Hardmode shield accessory that is dropped by Ice Claspers. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Giant Tortoise Shell
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 10% increased damage reduction and 10% reduced dash velocity · Taking a hit restores dash velocity and reduces defense and damage reduction for 3 seconds
accessories.desc: The Giant Tortoise Shell is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Giant Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Honey Dew / Radiant Ooze
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil

accessories.name: Star Veil
accessories.why: Longer invincibility after a hit, plus retaliating falling stars.
accessories.effect: Causes stars to fall and increases length of invincibility after taking damage
accessories.desc: The Star Veil is a Hardmode accessory that combines the functions of the Star Cloak and the Cross Necklace, spawning falling star projectiles and increasing the length of the invincibility frames granted when the player is hurt.

buffs.name: Greater Healing Potions
buffs.source: Crafted

buffs.name: Plenty Satisfied
buffs.desc: Well Fed, Plenty Satisfied, and Exquisitely Stuffed are buffs granted to the player when they consume food, which provide general stat bonuses that vary in potency and duration depending on the food item consumed. In Expert Mode, health regeneration will only be fully effective while the player is under the effects of one of these buffs. While one of these buffs is active in a The Constant or Zenith special world seed, the player will also be temporarily immune to hunger for the buff's duration.

buffs.source: Crafted

items.name: Angel Wings
items.why: This has increased vertical speed.
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
items.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons
items.effect: Allows the holder to quadruple jump · Increases jump height and negates fall damage
items.desc: The Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons is an accessory which combines the functionalities of the Bundle of Balloons and the Lucky Horseshoe.

items.name: Demon Wings
items.why: This has increased fall speed.
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
items.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Counter Scarf
items.effect: Grants the ability to dash; dashing into an attack will cause you to dodge it · After a successful dodge you must wait 30 seconds before you can dodge again
items.desc: The Counter Scarf is a Pre-Hardmode accessory that is sold by the Clothier for 20. It grants the ability to dash by double-tapping the ◀ Left or ▶ Right keys, with a base distance of 14 blocks.

items.name: Deep Diver
items.effect: Allows the ability to dash with a shorter cooldown · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage · Provides greatly improved water mobility
items.desc: The Deep Diver is a Hardmode accessory. When equipped, it negates the slow movement speed while submerged in water. It also allows the player to double-tap the ◀ Left or ▶ Right keys to perform a short dash with a base distance of 9 blocks, which can be used in rapid succession.

items.name: Fairy Boots
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Flower grow on the grass you walk on · Fairies can spawn at any time on the surface and spawn far more frequently · Nearby fairies grant +1 HP/s life regen, 4 defense and 10% movement speed · Fairies are immune to damage and will no longer flee
items.desc: The Fairy Boots are a Hardmode accessory. They grant the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Terraspark Boots
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 8% increased movement speed · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava
items.desc: The Terraspark Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory. They grant the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Frog Leg
items.why: Upgrades of this are also viable.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
items.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

items.name: Charm of Myths
items.effect: Provides life regeneration and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25%
items.desc: The Charm of Myths is a Hardmode accessory which combines the effects of the Band of Regeneration and the Philosopher's Stone. When equipped, it regenerates 1 health every second and decreases the Potion Sickness debuff duration by 25%. This debuff normally imposes a 60-second cooldown after consuming a recovery potion; the Charm of Myths reduces it to 45 seconds.

items.name: Frost Barrier
items.why: This should be used for Cryogen.
items.effect: You will freeze nearby enemies when you are struck · Grants immunity to Chilled and Frostburn
items.desc: The Frost Barrier is a Hardmode shield accessory that is dropped by Ice Claspers. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Giant Tortoise Shell
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 10% increased damage reduction and 10% reduced dash velocity · Taking a hit restores dash velocity and reduces defense and damage reduction for 3 seconds
items.desc: The Giant Tortoise Shell is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Giant Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Honey Dew
items.effect: Natural life regen is 50% more potent
items.desc: The Honey Dew is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.

items.name: Radiant Ooze
items.effect: +0.5 to +2.5 HP/s life regen based on missing health · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled · (Current regen: +[REGEN] HP/s)
items.desc: The Radiant Ooze is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it grants + 0.5 HP/s to + 2.5 HP/s; the lower the player's health, the stronger the effect. It also makes the player emit yellow light if visibility is enabled.

items.name: Star Veil
items.effect: Causes stars to fall and increases length of invincibility after taking damage
items.desc: The Star Veil is a Hardmode accessory that combines the functions of the Star Cloak and the Cross Necklace, spawning falling star projectiles and increasing the length of the invincibility frames granted when the player is hurt.

items.name: Amalgamated Brain
items.effect: Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10%
items.desc: The Amalgamated Brain is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Rotten Brain and Brain of Confusion. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Bloody Worm Scarf
items.effect: 10% increased damage reduction and melee damage
items.desc: The Bloody Worm Scarf is a Hardmode accessory. When equipped, it provides 2 defense, and increases damage reduction and melee damage by 10%.

items.name: Frost Flare
items.effect: All attacks and projectiles inflict Frostbite · Being above 50% life grants 10% increased damage · Being below 50% life grants 10 defense and 15% increased max movement speed and acceleration · Grants resistance against cold attacks, Frostburn , Chilled and Frozen
items.desc: The Frost Flare is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Cryogen. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Grand Gelatin
items.effect: 12% increased movement speed and jump speed · Using a healing potion creates a cleansing aura which lasts for 30 seconds · Entering the aura removes all debuffs one time and grants +2 HP/s life regen
items.desc: The Grand Gelatin is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Cleansing Jelly, Life Jelly and Vital Jelly. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Power Glove
items.effect: Increases melee knockback · 12% increased melee speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons · Increases the size of melee weapons
items.desc: The Power Glove is a Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

items.name: Putrid Scent
items.effect: Enemies are less likely to target you · 5% increased damage and critical strike chance
items.desc: The Putrid Scent is a Hardmode accessory that has a 1/5 (20%) chance to be dropped by Corrupt Mimics. While equipped, it increases the player's damage and critical strike chance by 5% and decreases aggro by 400.

items.name: Warrior Emblem
items.effect: 15% increased melee damage
items.desc: The Warrior Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that increases melee damage by 15%. It has a 1/4 (25%) chance to drop from the Wall of Flesh.

weapons.name: Daedalus Stormbow
weapons.source: Dropped by Hallowed Mimics
weapons.why: Fires arrows that rain down from the sky.
weapons.effect: Shoots arrows from the sky
weapons.desc: The Daedalus Stormbow is a Hardmode bow that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by Hallowed Mimics. When used, it causes a wide spread of arrows to rain from the sky, directed towards the cursor. It fires two to four arrows per use, while only consuming a single arrow from the player's inventory.

weapons.name: Dart Pistol
weapons.source: Dropped by Crimson Mimics
weapons.why: Crimson counterpart of the Dart Rifle.
weapons.desc: The Dart Pistol is a Hardmode ranged weapon that autofires darts as ammunition, and is the Crimson counterpart to the Corruption 's Dart Rifle, with a higher rate of fire but lower damage. It has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by Crimson Mimics.

weapons.name: Dart Rifle
weapons.source: Dropped by Corrupt Mimics
weapons.why: Corruption dart weapon; pairs with Crystal or Cursed Darts.
weapons.desc: The Dart Rifle is a Hardmode ranged weapon that autofires darts as ammunition, and is the Corruption counterpart to the Crimson 's Dart Pistol, with higher damage but a lower rate of fire. It has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by Corrupt Mimics.

weapons.name: Needler
weapons.source: Dropped by Moss Hornets
weapons.effect: Converts musket balls into Acid Venom infused needles that stick to enemies and explode
weapons.desc: The Needler is a Hardmode gun that is dropped by Moss Hornets. If Musket Balls are used as ammo, bullets are converted into needles that stick to enemies and tiles which explode after a delay and inflict the Acid Venom debuff.

weapons.name: Polaris Parrotfish
weapons.source: Fished in the Astral Infection
weapons.effect: Rapidly fires an array of colorful star shots · Firing speed increases the closer you are to an enemy · Ignores 15 points of enemy Defense · 'It carries the mark of the Northern Star'
weapons.desc: The Polaris Parrotfish is a Hardmode ranged weapon that can be fished up in the Astral Infection. When used, it rapidly fires pink and blue lasers that vanish in a star-shaped flash after traveling a fixed distance or upon hitting enemies or tiles. It will also gain firing speed depending on how close the player is to an enemy, with the maximum modifier being 2x its standard firing speed.

weapons.name: Uzi
weapons.source: Dropped by Angry Trappers in the Hardmode Underground Jungle
weapons.why: Rapid-fire gun dropped by Angry Trappers, which spawn in the Hardmode Jungle.
weapons.effect: Shoots a powerful, high velocity bullet
weapons.desc: The Uzi is a Hardmode gun that has a 1/100 (1%) chance of being dropped by Angry Trappers. When used, it rapidly fires bullets at a high velocity. It also converts Musket Balls and Tungsten Bullets (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) into High Velocity Bullets, giving them the special effects but not affecting their damage.

armor.name: Cobalt armor
armor.effect: : 14% reduced mana costs · : 15% increased melee speed · : 20% chance to save ammo
armor.desc: Cobalt armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Cobalt Breastplate and Cobalt Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Cobalt Helmet, Cobalt Mask, and Cobalt Hat, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.

armor.name: Palladium armor
armor.effect: Greatly increases life regeneration after striking an enemy
armor.desc: Palladium armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Palladium Breastplate and Palladium Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Palladium Mask, Palladium Helmet, and Palladium Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.

accessories.name: Lunic Eye
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Fires seeking energy bolts that cause enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
accessories.desc: The Lunic Eye is a Hardmode classless weapon. When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

accessories.name: Rod of Discord
accessories.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
accessories.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

buffs.name: Greater Healing Potions
buffs.source: Crafted

buffs.name: Plenty Satisfied
buffs.desc: Well Fed, Plenty Satisfied, and Exquisitely Stuffed are buffs granted to the player when they consume food, which provide general stat bonuses that vary in potency and duration depending on the food item consumed. In Expert Mode, health regeneration will only be fully effective while the player is under the effects of one of these buffs. While one of these buffs is active in a The Constant or Zenith special world seed, the player will also be temporarily immune to hunger for the buff's duration.

buffs.station: Crystal Ball
buffs.desc: The Endless Musket Pouch is a Hardmode ammunition item. While in the inventory, it acts as an infinite source of Musket Balls.

ammo.name: Unholy Arrows
ammo.desc: The Unholy Arrow is a pre-Hardmode arrow. It can pierce 4 enemies, and its damage decreases by 5% per enemy pierced.
