This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Soaring Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Butterfly Wings
items.why: This has increased acceleration.
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
items.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Flame Wings
items.why: This has increased vertical mobility.
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
items.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Evasion Scarf
items.effect: Grants the ability to dash; dashing into an attack will cause you to dodge it · After a successful dodge you must wait 30 seconds before you can dodge again · Has a shorter dash cooldown than most dashes
items.desc: The Evasion Scarf is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Counter Scarf. It grants the ability to dash by double-tapping the ◀ Left or ▶ Right keys, with a base distance of 24 blocks.

items.name: Deep Diver
items.effect: Allows the ability to dash with a shorter cooldown · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage · Provides greatly improved water mobility
items.desc: The Deep Diver is a Hardmode accessory. When equipped, it negates the slow movement speed while submerged in water. It also allows the player to double-tap the ◀ Left or ▶ Right keys to perform a short dash with a base distance of 9 blocks, which can be used in rapid succession.

items.name: Fairy Boots
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Flower grow on the grass you walk on · Fairies can spawn at any time on the surface and spawn far more frequently · Nearby fairies grant +1 HP/s life regen, 4 defense and 10% movement speed · Fairies are immune to damage and will no longer flee
items.desc: The Fairy Boots are a Hardmode accessory. They grant the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Terraspark Boots
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 8% increased movement speed · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava
items.desc: The Terraspark Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory. They grant the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Frog Leg
items.why: Upgrades of this are also viable.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
items.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

items.name: Giant Tortoise Shell
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 10% increased damage reduction and 10% reduced dash velocity · Taking a hit restores dash velocity and reduces defense and damage reduction for 3 seconds
items.desc: The Giant Tortoise Shell is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Giant Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Honey Dew
items.effect: Natural life regen is 50% more potent
items.desc: The Honey Dew is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.

items.name: Radiant Ooze
items.effect: +0.5 to +2.5 HP/s life regen based on missing health · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled · (Current regen: +[REGEN] HP/s)
items.desc: The Radiant Ooze is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it grants + 0.5 HP/s to + 2.5 HP/s; the lower the player's health, the stronger the effect. It also makes the player emit yellow light if visibility is enabled.

items.name: Mana Polarizer
items.effect: Increases maximum mana by 40 · Provides life regeneration and magic damage that scales based on how much mana you have · Lower mana means more life regeneration, but less magic damage · These scale from -2 to +2 HP/s, and 15% to 5% damage · The provided regeneration is halved when under Mana Sickness · Magic projectiles steal enemy life
items.desc: The Mana Polarizer is an Expert Mode Pre-Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by The Slime God. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Star Veil
items.effect: Causes stars to fall and increases length of invincibility after taking damage
items.desc: The Star Veil is a Hardmode accessory that combines the functions of the Star Cloak and the Cross Necklace, spawning falling star projectiles and increasing the length of the invincibility frames granted when the player is hurt.

items.name: Amalgamated Brain
items.effect: Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10%
items.desc: The Amalgamated Brain is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Rotten Brain and Brain of Confusion. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Frost Flare
items.effect: All attacks and projectiles inflict Frostbite · Being above 50% life grants 10% increased damage · Being below 50% life grants 10 defense and 15% increased max movement speed and acceleration · Grants resistance against cold attacks, Frostburn , Chilled and Frozen
items.desc: The Frost Flare is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Cryogen. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Moon Stone
items.why: This is difficult to obtain.
items.effect: During nighttime, grants minor increase to damage, · melee speed, critical strike chance, life regeneration, · defense, mining speed, and minion knockback
items.desc: The Moon Stone is a Hardmode accessory which has a 1/35 (2.86%) / 69/1225 (5.63%) chance to drop from Vampires during the Solar Eclipse event. It grants the same stat bonuses as the Sun Stone, but these bonuses will only activate during the night or during a Solar Eclipse.

items.name: Abaddon
items.effect: Critical strikes curse enemies with Bane that scales off of your critical strike chance · When critically hit, enemies spread all debuffs they are afflicted with that are weaker than your Bane to nearby enemies · Current Bane damage: [DAMAGE] DPS
items.desc: The Abaddon is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Red Devils. When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff. Bane deals a base of 20 damage per second, and its damage is increased by 3% for each point of critical strike chance the player has.

items.name: Arcane Flower
items.effect: 8% reduced mana cost · Automatically use mana potions when needed · Enemies are less likely to target you
items.desc: The Arcane Flower is a Hardmode accessory which combines the functionality of the Mana Flower and the aggro -reducing effect of the Putrid Scent.

items.name: Sorcerer Emblem
items.effect: 15% increased magic damage
items.desc: The Sorcerer Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that increases magic damage by 15%. It has a 1/4 (25%) chance to drop from the Wall of Flesh.

weapons.name: Deepsea Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by the Aquatic Scourge
weapons.why: strong homing minion, primary summon at this tier
weapons.effect: Summons an aquatic star to fight for you
weapons.desc: The Deepsea Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by the Aquatic Scourge. When used, it summons an aquatic starfish to follow the player around and attack enemies by rapidly dashing at them to deal damage.

weapons.name: Igneous Exaltation
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons an Igneous blade that orbits around you · When your minion slots are full, ⚒ Use / Attack again to launch all blades towards the cursor · This ability has a two-second cooldown that requires holding this item · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to change the rotation direction
weapons.desc: The Igneous Exaltation is a Hardmode summon weapon. When used with its primary fire (left-click), it summons an Igneous Blade that orbits around the player, damaging enemies that come into contact with it. When used with its secondary fire (right-click), it will force all blades orbiting the player to charge towards the position of the cursor and piercing up to three enemies in its path, causing three smaller blades to rain down per hit.

weapons.name: Spider Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: Summons Spider minions that inflict Acid Venom; Spider Fangs drop from Hardmode Black Recluses.
weapons.effect: Summons spiders to fight for you
weapons.desc: The Spider Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Spider minion. It runs towards enemies and latches onto them, repeatedly dealing damage while latched and inflicting the Acid Venom debuff for 2–4 seconds. It can climb background walls and jump high.

weapons.name: Orthocera Shell
weapons.source: Dropped by Orthoceras
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons a flying orthocera to spit Irradiated and Acid Venom streams at your enemies
weapons.desc: The Orthocera Shell is a Hardmode sentry that is dropped by Orthoceras. It summons a stationary flying Orthocera sentry that shoots streams of acid at nearby enemies. The acid streams pierce up to two enemies along with inflicting the Acid Venom and Irradiated debuffs.

weapons.name: Cool Whip
weapons.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: Summons a Frost Wave and applies Frostburn to struck enemies.
weapons.effect: 6 summon tag damage · Your summons will focus struck enemies · Strike enemies to summon a friendly snowflake · 'Let me have some of that cool whip'
weapons.desc: The Cool Whip is a Hardmode whip. It has a 30% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:

weapons.name: Firecracker
weapons.source: Dropped by the Wall of Flesh
weapons.why: Wall of Flesh drop whose tag detonates for a large burst of minion damage.
weapons.effect: Your summons will focus struck enemies · Strike enemies with blazing energy · Blazing energy explodes from enemies hit by summons
weapons.desc: The Firecracker is a Hardmode whip. It has a 34% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:

armor.name: Spider armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.effect: Increases summon damage by 12%
armor.desc: Spider armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Spider Mask, Spider Breastplate, and Spider Greaves.

armor.name: Squire armor
armor.source: Purchased from Tavernkeep for a total of 450000* 45 after defeating any mechanical boss
armor.effect: Increases your max number of sentries by 1 · Ballista pierces more targets and panics when you take damage
armor.desc: Squire armor is a Hardmode melee/summoner armor set consisting of the Squire's Great Helm, Squire's Plating, and Squire's Greaves. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of 450000* 45 after defeating any mechanical boss.

accessories.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 1, and summon damage by 7% · Minion attacks create charged orbs

accessories.desc: The Nuclear Fuel Rod is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by the Cragmaw Mire. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Lunic Eye
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Fires seeking energy bolts that cause enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
accessories.desc: The Lunic Eye is a Hardmode classless weapon. When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

accessories.name: Rod of Discord
accessories.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
accessories.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

buffs.name: Plenty Satisfied
buffs.desc: Well Fed, Plenty Satisfied, and Exquisitely Stuffed are buffs granted to the player when they consume food, which provide general stat bonuses that vary in potency and duration depending on the food item consumed. In Expert Mode, health regeneration will only be fully effective while the player is under the effects of one of these buffs. While one of these buffs is active in a The Constant or Zenith special world seed, the player will also be temporarily immune to hunger for the buff's duration.

buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: The damage reduction is especially welcome in a phase full of punishing optional content.

buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Greater Healing Potion is a Hardmode recovery potion that restores 150 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 60 seconds when used. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Bewitched
buffs.source: Fished in the Dungeon
buffs.desc: The Bewitching Table is a furniture item found naturally placed in the Dungeon and can be obtained by fishing in the Dungeon. In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Witch Doctor for 10 GC if the Wizard is present. It emits light when placed.

buffs.name: Flask of Cursed Flames
buffs.source: Brewed at Imbuing Station
buffs.why: Coats melee hits with Cursed Inferno.
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.desc: The Flask of Cursed Flames is a Hardmode flask that causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Cursed Inferno debuff on hit for 3–6 seconds, which deals 24 damage per second and increases knockback on targets. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.name: Flask of Ichor
buffs.source: Crafted at Imbuing Station
buffs.why: Reduces enemy defense, which applies to every melee hit for the duration.
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.desc: The Flask of Ichor is a Hardmode flask that causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Ichor debuff for 10–19 seconds on enemies hit. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.name: Summoning Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: The extra minion slot is too valuable to skip, even in the earliest summoner boss prep.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Summoning Potion is a buff potion which grants the Summoning buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum number of minions by 1. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Strategist
buffs.source: Dropped by the Dark Mage and the Ogre during the Old One's Army event
buffs.desc: The War Table is an animated furniture item which fulfills a house's table requirement that is dropped by the Dark Mage and the Ogre during the Old One's Army event, with a 1/2 (50%) / 1/1 (100%) chance during Tier 1, and a 1/8 (12.5%) / 1/4 (25%) chance during Tier 3.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Soaring Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Butterfly Wings
items.why: This has increased acceleration.
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
items.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Flame Wings
items.why: This has increased vertical mobility.
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
items.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Evasion Scarf
items.effect: Grants the ability to dash; dashing into an attack will cause you to dodge it · After a successful dodge you must wait 30 seconds before you can dodge again · Has a shorter dash cooldown than most dashes
items.desc: The Evasion Scarf is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Counter Scarf. It grants the ability to dash by double-tapping the ◀ Left or ▶ Right keys, with a base distance of 24 blocks.

items.name: Deep Diver
items.effect: Allows the ability to dash with a shorter cooldown · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage · Provides greatly improved water mobility
items.desc: The Deep Diver is a Hardmode accessory. When equipped, it negates the slow movement speed while submerged in water. It also allows the player to double-tap the ◀ Left or ▶ Right keys to perform a short dash with a base distance of 9 blocks, which can be used in rapid succession.

items.name: Fairy Boots
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Flower grow on the grass you walk on · Fairies can spawn at any time on the surface and spawn far more frequently · Nearby fairies grant +1 HP/s life regen, 4 defense and 10% movement speed · Fairies are immune to damage and will no longer flee
items.desc: The Fairy Boots are a Hardmode accessory. They grant the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Terraspark Boots
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 8% increased movement speed · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava
items.desc: The Terraspark Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory. They grant the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Frog Leg
items.why: Upgrades of this are also viable.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
items.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

items.name: Giant Tortoise Shell
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 10% increased damage reduction and 10% reduced dash velocity · Taking a hit restores dash velocity and reduces defense and damage reduction for 3 seconds
items.desc: The Giant Tortoise Shell is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Giant Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Honey Dew
items.effect: Natural life regen is 50% more potent
items.desc: The Honey Dew is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.

items.name: Radiant Ooze
items.effect: +0.5 to +2.5 HP/s life regen based on missing health · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled · (Current regen: +[REGEN] HP/s)
items.desc: The Radiant Ooze is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it grants + 0.5 HP/s to + 2.5 HP/s; the lower the player's health, the stronger the effect. It also makes the player emit yellow light if visibility is enabled.

items.name: Star Veil
items.effect: Causes stars to fall and increases length of invincibility after taking damage
items.desc: The Star Veil is a Hardmode accessory that combines the functions of the Star Cloak and the Cross Necklace, spawning falling star projectiles and increasing the length of the invincibility frames granted when the player is hurt.

items.name: Amalgamated Brain
items.effect: Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10%
items.desc: The Amalgamated Brain is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Rotten Brain and Brain of Confusion. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Frost Flare
items.effect: All attacks and projectiles inflict Frostbite · Being above 50% life grants 10% increased damage · Being below 50% life grants 10 defense and 15% increased max movement speed and acceleration · Grants resistance against cold attacks, Frostburn , Chilled and Frozen
items.desc: The Frost Flare is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Cryogen. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Moon Stone
items.why: This is difficult to obtain.
items.effect: During nighttime, grants minor increase to damage, · melee speed, critical strike chance, life regeneration, · defense, mining speed, and minion knockback
items.desc: The Moon Stone is a Hardmode accessory which has a 1/35 (2.86%) / 69/1225 (5.63%) chance to drop from Vampires during the Solar Eclipse event. It grants the same stat bonuses as the Sun Stone, but these bonuses will only activate during the night or during a Solar Eclipse.

items.name: Spirit Glyph
items.effect: Minion attacks provide various buffs · Hold Shift for more Spirit Power grants 10% increased summon damage · Spirit Defense grants 2 defense · Spirit Regen grants 0.5 HP/s life regeneration
items.desc: The Spirit Glyph is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, whenever a minion hits an enemy, the player is granted one of the following buffs:

items.name: Jelly-Charged Battery
items.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 1, and summon damage by 7% · Minion attacks create charged orbs
items.desc: The Jelly-Charged Battery is a Pre-Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Voltaic Jelly and Wulfrum Battery. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Nuclear Fuel Rod
items.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Minions release an Irradiated aura on enemy hits · Grants immunity to Irradiated
items.desc: The Nuclear Fuel Rod is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by the Cragmaw Mire. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: The First Shadowflame
items.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Minion attacks inflict Shadowflame , and grants immunity to Shadowflame
items.desc: The First Shadowflame is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by the Goblin Warlock. It grants the following effects while equipped:

weapons.name: Cobalt Kunai
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: rapid-fire spam weapon with strong sustained DPS
weapons.effect: Stealth strikes fire four homing cobalt energy bolts
weapons.desc: The Cobalt Kunai is a Hardmode dagger. When used, it throws a cobalt dagger that pierces twice and travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity.

weapons.name: Cursed Dagger / Ichor Spear
weapons.source: Dropped by Clingers

weapons.name: Ice Star
weapons.source: Purchased from Archmage NPC for 20 gold
weapons.why: ranged spam option; stealth ranged option
weapons.effect: Throws fast but brittle homing ice stars · Stealth strikes last longer and spawn smaller homing stars on first hits
weapons.desc: The Ice Star is a Hardmode rogue weapon sold by the Archmage NPC for 20. It is a large throwing star made of ice, which pierces 3 times and will fall after traveling a short distance. It also has slight homing abilities.

weapons.name: Palladium Javelin
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: piercing spam thrown weapon; stealth strike piercing
weapons.effect: Stealth strikes split into more javelins and boost natural life regeneration on hits
weapons.desc: The Palladium Javelin is a Hardmode javelin. It throws a javelin that pierces twice, travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity.

weapons.name: Prismalline
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws daggers that split after a while · Stealth strikes additionally explode into prism shards and briefly stun enemies
weapons.desc: The Prismalline is a Hardmode dagger that is a direct upgrade to the Crystalline. When used, it throws a prism dagger that is affected by gravity and pierces infinitely. Shortly after it is thrown, it splits into 3 copies of itself in a random spread.

weapons.name: Cursed Dagger
weapons.source: Dropped by Clingers
weapons.effect: Throws a fast cursed dagger and two inaccurate weaker daggers · Stealth strikes throw a single dagger that bursts into a Cursed Inferno vortex
weapons.desc: The Cursed Dagger is a Hardmode dagger that is dropped by Clingers. When used, it throws a set of three daggers with one always aimed at the cursor while the other two are inaccurate. The daggers pierce once, deal 80% damage on the second hit, and inflict the Cursed Inferno debuff.

weapons.name: Equanimity
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws a boomerang that ricochets between enemies and makes them Confused · Enemy hits alternate summoning homing light shards or piercing dark shards · Stealth strikes cause an alternating explosion of light or dark on every ricochet, empowering the opposite color of shard
weapons.desc: Equanimity is a Hardmode rogue boomerang. When used, it throws a boomerang that has a custom throw animation and can ricochet between enemies. On enemy hits, the boomerang alternates between spawning piercing dark shards and homing light shards.

weapons.name: Lunic Eye
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires seeking energy bolts that cause enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Lunic Eye is a Hardmode classless weapon. When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

armor.name: Titan Heart armor
armor.effect: +100 maximum stealth · Stealth strikes deal 2x knockback and cause an astral explosion · Grants immunity to knockback
armor.desc: Titan Heart armor is a Hardmode rogue armor set.

accessories.name: Rod of Discord
accessories.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
accessories.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

accessories.name: Angel Wings
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons
accessories.effect: Allows the holder to quadruple jump · Increases jump height and negates fall damage
accessories.desc: The Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons is an accessory which combines the functionalities of the Bundle of Balloons and the Lucky Horseshoe.

accessories.name: Demon Wings
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Amalgamated Brain
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10%

accessories.name: Grand Gelatin
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: 12% increased movement speed and jump speed · Using a healing potion creates a cleansing aura which lasts for 30 seconds · Entering the aura removes all debuffs one time and grants +2 HP/s life regen
accessories.desc: The Grand Gelatin is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Cleansing Jelly, Life Jelly and Vital Jelly. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Frog Leg
accessories.source: Fished in any viable body of water
accessories.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
accessories.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

accessories.name: Charm of Myths
accessories.effect: Provides life regeneration and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25%
accessories.desc: The Charm of Myths is a Hardmode accessory which combines the effects of the Band of Regeneration and the Philosopher's Stone. When equipped, it regenerates 1 health every second and decreases the Potion Sickness debuff duration by 25%. This debuff normally imposes a 60-second cooldown after consuming a recovery potion; the Charm of Myths reduces it to 45 seconds.

accessories.name: Frost Barrier
accessories.effect: You will freeze nearby enemies when you are struck · Grants immunity to Chilled and Frostburn
accessories.desc: The Frost Barrier is a Hardmode shield accessory that is dropped by Ice Claspers. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Giant Tortoise Shell
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 10% increased damage reduction and 10% reduced dash velocity · Taking a hit restores dash velocity and reduces defense and damage reduction for 3 seconds
accessories.desc: The Giant Tortoise Shell is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Giant Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Honey Dew / Radiant Ooze
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil

accessories.name: Star Veil
accessories.effect: Causes stars to fall and increases length of invincibility after taking damage
accessories.desc: The Star Veil is a Hardmode accessory that combines the functions of the Star Cloak and the Cross Necklace, spawning falling star projectiles and increasing the length of the invincibility frames granted when the player is hurt.

accessories.name: Putrid Scent
accessories.why: damage and crit for spam builds
accessories.effect: Enemies are less likely to target you · 5% increased damage and critical strike chance
accessories.desc: The Putrid Scent is a Hardmode accessory that has a 1/5 (20%) chance to be dropped by Corrupt Mimics. While equipped, it increases the player's damage and critical strike chance by 5% and decreases aggro by 400.

accessories.name: Rogue Emblem
accessories.source: Dropped by the Wall of Flesh
accessories.effect: 15% increased rogue damage
accessories.desc: The Rogue Emblem is a Hardmode rogue accessory that is dropped by the Wall of Flesh. When equipped, it increases rogue damage by 15%. It is the rogue-class equivalent of the vanilla class emblems.

accessories.name: Coin of Deceit
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Stealth strikes only expend 90% of your max stealth · 6% increased rogue crit chance
accessories.desc: The Coin of Deceit is a Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory. When equipped, it increases rogue critical strike chance by 6% and makes stealth strikes only require 90% of the player's maximum stealth to perform and consume 90% of the player's maximum stealth when performed.

accessories.name: Filthy Glove
accessories.effect: Stealth strikes have +8 armor penetration and deal 8% more damage
accessories.desc: The Filthy Glove is a Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory that is dropped by The Hive Mind. When equipped, it makes stealth strikes deal 8% more damage and have +8 armor penetration.

accessories.name: Mirage Mirror
accessories.effect: Reduces enemy aggression outside of the abyss · Stealth generates 25% faster when standing still and 12% faster while moving · 'Bend light around you'
accessories.desc: The Mirage Mirror is a Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory. When equipped, the player builds rogue stealth 25% faster while standing still and 12% faster while moving. It also reduces enemy aggro by 200, however it will not reduce aggro while in the Abyss.

buffs.name: Greater Healing Potions
buffs.source: Crafted

buffs.name: Plenty Satisfied
buffs.desc: Well Fed, Plenty Satisfied, and Exquisitely Stuffed are buffs granted to the player when they consume food, which provide general stat bonuses that vary in potency and duration depending on the food item consumed. In Expert Mode, health regeneration will only be fully effective while the player is under the effects of one of these buffs. While one of these buffs is active in a The Constant or Zenith special world seed, the player will also be temporarily immune to hunger for the buff's duration.

items.name: Abaddon
items.effect: Critical strikes curse enemies with Bane that scales off of your critical strike chance · When critically hit, enemies spread all debuffs they are afflicted with that are weaker than your Bane to nearby enemies · Current Bane damage: [DAMAGE] DPS
items.desc: The Abaddon is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Red Devils. When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff. Bane deals a base of 20 damage per second, and its damage is increased by 3% for each point of critical strike chance the player has.

items.name: Rogue Emblem
items.effect: 15% increased rogue damage
items.desc: The Rogue Emblem is a Hardmode rogue accessory that is dropped by the Wall of Flesh. When equipped, it increases rogue damage by 15%. It is the rogue-class equivalent of the vanilla class emblems.

items.name: Ruin Medallion
items.effect: Stealth strikes only expend 75% of your max stealth · 6% increased rogue damage and rogue crit chance
items.desc: The Ruin Medallion is a Hardmode rogue accessory and the direct upgrade to the Coin of Deceit. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Electrician's Glove
items.effect: Stealth strikes summon sparks on enemy hits and heal you for 10 HP · Stealth strikes also have +8 armor penetration and deal 8% more damage
items.desc: The Electrician's Glove is a Hardmode rogue accessory and a direct upgrade to the Bloodstained Glove and Filthy Glove. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Mirage Mirror
items.effect: Reduces enemy aggression outside of the abyss · Stealth generates 25% faster when standing still and 12% faster while moving · 'Bend light around you'
items.desc: The Mirage Mirror is a Pre-Hardmode rogue accessory. When equipped, the player builds rogue stealth 25% faster while standing still and 12% faster while moving. It also reduces enemy aggro by 200, however it will not reduce aggro while in the Abyss.

weapons.name: Chain Guillotines
weapons.source: Dropped by Corrupt Mimics (Hardmode)
weapons.why: Launched flail dropped by Corrupt Mimics in Hardmode.
weapons.desc: The Chain Guillotines are a Hardmode flail that have a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by Corrupt Mimics. When used, they fire two blades attached to chains in rapid succession, with a maximum range of 32 tiles. They can pierce enemies that are very close by.

weapons.name: Darklight Greatsword
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires darklight blades that slice through enemies, creating additional slashes
weapons.desc: The Darklight Greatsword is a Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it fires a blue or purple blade that starts off slow before accelerating at full speed but will lose velocity as it goes through tiles and fade out before disappearing. The blades pierce twice and function similarly to the Death Sickle 's scythes.

weapons.name: Inferna Cutter
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: hits repeatedly, so it suits worms and grouped enemies
weapons.effect: Critical hits with the blade cause small explosions · Generates a number of small sparks when swung
weapons.desc: The Inferna Cutter is a Hardmode axe that is the direct upgrade to the Axe of Purity. When swung, it emits light particles and releases several sparks similar to those fired by the Butcher's Chainsaw, which deal 50% of the weapon's damage. When performing critical hits, it will also cause a small explosion, dealing 50% of the weapon's damage and can only hit the same enemy.

weapons.name: Majestic Guard
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: difficult to use; suits multi-hit targets
weapons.effect: An intricate blade, heavy enough to crush anything it wouldn't cut · Strongly knocks back enemies and heals you slightly on hit
weapons.desc: The Majestic Guard is a Hardmode special sword. When used, the sword is swung back and forth in front of the player. Striking an enemy launches them away, and heals the player for 7 health; health gained has diminishing returns on consecutive hits.

weapons.name: Starnight Lance
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Shoots a frigid starnight beam
weapons.desc: The Starnight Lance is a Hardmode spear. When used, it fires a starlight beam that pierces twice and travels a moderate distance before dissipating. The spear and beams inflict the Frostbite debuff.

weapons.name: Lunic Eye
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires seeking energy bolts that cause enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Lunic Eye is a Hardmode classless weapon. When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
weapons.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

armor.name: Adamantite armor
armor.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
armor.headpieceBonus: +22% melee damage, +14% melee critical strike chance, +20% melee speed and +25% movement speed.
armor.effect: : 19% reduced mana costs · : 20% increased melee and movement speed · : 25% chance to save ammo
armor.desc: Adamantite armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Adamantite Breastplate and Adamantite Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Adamantite Helmet, Adamantite Mask, and Adamantite Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.

armor.name: Orichalcum armor
armor.effect: Flower petals will fall on your target for extra damage
armor.desc: Orichalcum armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Orichalcum Breastplate and Orichalcum Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Orichalcum Mask, Orichalcum Helmet, and Orichalcum Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.

accessories.name: Butterfly Wings
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Flame Wings
accessories.why: primary mobility with increased vertical mobility
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Amalgamated Brain
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10%
accessories.desc: The Amalgamated Brain is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Rotten Brain and Brain of Confusion. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Bloody Worm Scarf
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: 10% increased damage reduction and melee damage
accessories.desc: The Bloody Worm Scarf is a Hardmode accessory. When equipped, it provides 2 defense, and increases damage reduction and melee damage by 10%.

accessories.name: Frost Flare
accessories.effect: All attacks and projectiles inflict Frostbite · Being above 50% life grants 10% increased damage · Being below 50% life grants 10 defense and 15% increased max movement speed and acceleration · Grants resistance against cold attacks, Frostburn , Chilled and Frozen
accessories.desc: The Frost Flare is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Cryogen. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Moon Stone
accessories.source: Dropped by Vampires during a Solar Eclipse
accessories.why: Half of the eventual Celestial Stone, and the part you can actually have here: a night-time boost to damage, crit, regen and speed.
accessories.effect: During nighttime, grants minor increase to damage, · melee speed, critical strike chance, life regeneration, · defense, mining speed, and minion knockback
accessories.desc: The Moon Stone is a Hardmode accessory which has a 1/35 (2.86%) / 69/1225 (5.63%) chance to drop from Vampires during the Solar Eclipse event. It grants the same stat bonuses as the Sun Stone, but these bonuses will only activate during the night or during a Solar Eclipse.

accessories.name: Evasion Scarf
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Grants the ability to dash; dashing into an attack will cause you to dodge it · After a successful dodge you must wait 30 seconds before you can dodge again · Has a shorter dash cooldown than most dashes
accessories.desc: The Evasion Scarf is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Counter Scarf. It grants the ability to dash by double-tapping the ◀ Left or ▶ Right keys, with a base distance of 24 blocks.

accessories.name: Ornate Shield
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Allows the ability to dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage
accessories.desc: The Ornate Shield is a Hardmode shield accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Fairy Boots
accessories.effect: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Flower grow on the grass you walk on · Fairies can spawn at any time on the surface and spawn far more frequently · Nearby fairies grant +1 HP/s life regen, 4 defense and 10% movement speed · Fairies are immune to damage and will no longer flee
accessories.desc: The Fairy Boots are a Hardmode accessory. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Terraspark Boots
accessories.source: Combined through the full boots crafting chain
accessories.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 8% increased movement speed · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava
accessories.desc: The Terraspark Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Frog Leg
accessories.source: Fished in any viable body of water
accessories.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
accessories.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

accessories.name: Abaddon
accessories.effect: Critical strikes curse enemies with Bane that scales off of your critical strike chance · When critically hit, enemies spread all debuffs they are afflicted with that are weaker than your Bane to nearby enemies · Current Bane damage: [DAMAGE] DPS
accessories.desc: The Abaddon is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Red Devils. When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff. Bane deals a base of 20 damage per second, and its damage is increased by 3% for each point of critical strike chance the player has.

accessories.name: Warrior Emblem
accessories.source: Dropped by the Wall of Flesh
accessories.why: The raw melee damage bonus is immediate and efficient, which makes it the easiest offensive slot to justify in this phase.
accessories.effect: 15% increased melee damage
accessories.desc: The Warrior Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that increases melee damage by 15%. It has a 1/4 (25%) chance to drop from the Wall of Flesh.

accessories.name: Giant Tortoise Shell
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 10% increased damage reduction and 10% reduced dash velocity · Taking a hit restores dash velocity and reduces defense and damage reduction for 3 seconds
accessories.desc: The Giant Tortoise Shell is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Giant Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Honey Dew
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Natural life regen is 50% more potent
accessories.desc: The Honey Dew is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.

accessories.name: Radiant Ooze
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: +0.5 to +2.5 HP/s life regen based on missing health · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled · (Current regen: +[REGEN] HP/s)
accessories.desc: The Radiant Ooze is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it grants + 0.5 HP/s to + 2.5 HP/s; the lower the player's health, the stronger the effect. It also makes the player emit yellow light if visibility is enabled.

accessories.name: Star Veil
accessories.why: Longer invincibility after a hit, plus retaliating falling stars.
accessories.effect: Causes stars to fall and increases length of invincibility after taking damage
accessories.desc: The Star Veil is a Hardmode accessory that combines the functions of the Star Cloak and the Cross Necklace, spawning falling star projectiles and increasing the length of the invincibility frames granted when the player is hurt.

buffs.name: Greater Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Greater Healing Potion is a Hardmode recovery potion that restores 150 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 60 seconds when used. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Candles
buffs.desc: Candles are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty-five types of candles to the game, with nineteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture, two acting as upgrades to the Water Candle and Peace Candle, and the remaining four being purchasable from the Wizard.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.desc: The Seafood Dinner is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Lifeforce Potion is a buff potion that grants the Lifeforce buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Photosynthesis Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Photosynthesis Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Flask of Cursed Flames
buffs.source: Brewed at Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.desc: The Flask of Cursed Flames is a Hardmode flask that causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Cursed Inferno debuff on hit for 3–6 seconds, which deals 24 damage per second and increases knockback on targets. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.name: Flask of Ichor
buffs.source: Crafted at Imbuing Station
buffs.why: The defense reduction still adds meaningful value even when your raw damage is already enormous.
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.desc: The Flask of Ichor is a Hardmode flask that causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Ichor debuff for 10–19 seconds on enemies hit. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Sharpening Station
buffs.source: Found in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle
buffs.why: Grants armor penetration to melee weapons while standing near it.
buffs.desc: The Sharpening Station is a furniture item found naturally generated in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle. In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Merchant for 10 GC.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Soaring Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

weapons.name: Megashark
weapons.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: Post-Destroyer upgrade to the Minishark requiring Souls of Might from a mechanical boss.
weapons.effect: 50% chance to save ammo · 'Minishark's older brother'
weapons.desc: The Megashark is a Hardmode, post- The Destroyer gun and the direct upgrade to the Minishark. When used, it fires bullets very rapidly in a small spread. It also has a 50% chance not to consume ammunition.

weapons.name: Daedalus Stormbow
weapons.source: Dropped by Hallowed Mimics
weapons.why: Fires arrows that rain down from the sky.
weapons.effect: Shoots arrows from the sky
weapons.desc: The Daedalus Stormbow is a Hardmode bow that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by Hallowed Mimics. When used, it causes a wide spread of arrows to rain from the sky, directed towards the cursor. It fires two to four arrows per use, while only consuming a single arrow from the player's inventory.

weapons.source: Dropped by Crimson Mimics

accessories.desc: The Giant Tortoise Shell is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Giant Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Star Veil

accessories.effect: Causes stars to fall and increases length of invincibility after taking damage
accessories.desc: The Star Veil is a Hardmode accessory that combines the functions of the Star Cloak and the Cross Necklace, spawning falling star projectiles and increasing the length of the invincibility frames granted when the player is hurt.

buffs.name: Plenty Satisfied
buffs.desc: Well Fed, Plenty Satisfied, and Exquisitely Stuffed are buffs granted to the player when they consume food, which provide general stat bonuses that vary in potency and duration depending on the food item consumed. In Expert Mode, health regeneration will only be fully effective while the player is under the effects of one of these buffs. While one of these buffs is active in a The Constant or Zenith special world seed, the player will also be temporarily immune to hunger for the buff's duration.

ammo.name: Unholy Arrows
ammo.desc: The Unholy Arrow is a pre-Hardmode arrow. It can pierce 4 enemies, and its damage decreases by 5% per enemy pierced.

items.name: Butterfly Wings
items.why: This has increased acceleration.
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
items.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Flame Wings
items.why: This has increased vertical mobility.
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
items.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Evasion Scarf
items.effect: Grants the ability to dash; dashing into an attack will cause you to dodge it · After a successful dodge you must wait 30 seconds before you can dodge again · Has a shorter dash cooldown than most dashes
items.desc: The Evasion Scarf is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Counter Scarf. It grants the ability to dash by double-tapping the ◀ Left or ▶ Right keys, with a base distance of 24 blocks.

items.name: Ornate Shield
items.effect: Allows the ability to dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage
items.desc: The Ornate Shield is a Hardmode shield accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Fairy Boots
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Flower grow on the grass you walk on · Fairies can spawn at any time on the surface and spawn far more frequently · Nearby fairies grant +1 HP/s life regen, 4 defense and 10% movement speed · Fairies are immune to damage and will no longer flee
items.desc: The Fairy Boots are a Hardmode accessory. They grant the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Terraspark Boots
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 8% increased movement speed · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava
items.desc: The Terraspark Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory. They grant the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Frog Leg
items.why: Upgrades of this are also viable.
items.effect: Increases jump speed and allows auto-jump · Increases fall resistance
items.desc: The Frog Leg is an accessory that can be fished in any viable body of water. It aids jumping in the following ways:

items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 10% increased damage reduction and 10% reduced dash velocity · Taking a hit restores dash velocity and reduces defense and damage reduction for 3 seconds
items.desc: The Giant Tortoise Shell is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Giant Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Honey Dew
items.effect: Natural life regen is 50% more potent
items.desc: The Honey Dew is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.

items.name: Radiant Ooze
items.effect: +0.5 to +2.5 HP/s life regen based on missing health · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled · (Current regen: +[REGEN] HP/s)
items.desc: The Radiant Ooze is a Pre-Hardmode accessory. While equipped, it grants + 0.5 HP/s to + 2.5 HP/s; the lower the player's health, the stronger the effect. It also makes the player emit yellow light if visibility is enabled.

items.name: Star Veil
items.effect: Causes stars to fall and increases length of invincibility after taking damage
items.desc: The Star Veil is a Hardmode accessory that combines the functions of the Star Cloak and the Cross Necklace, spawning falling star projectiles and increasing the length of the invincibility frames granted when the player is hurt.

items.name: Amalgamated Brain
items.effect: Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10%
items.desc: The Amalgamated Brain is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Rotten Brain and Brain of Confusion. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Frost Flare
items.effect: All attacks and projectiles inflict Frostbite · Being above 50% life grants 10% increased damage · Being below 50% life grants 10 defense and 15% increased max movement speed and acceleration · Grants resistance against cold attacks, Frostburn , Chilled and Frozen
items.desc: The Frost Flare is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Cryogen. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Moon Stone
items.why: This is difficult to obtain.
items.effect: During nighttime, grants minor increase to damage, · melee speed, critical strike chance, life regeneration, · defense, mining speed, and minion knockback
items.desc: The Moon Stone is a Hardmode accessory which has a 1/35 (2.86%) / 69/1225 (5.63%) chance to drop from Vampires during the Solar Eclipse event. It grants the same stat bonuses as the Sun Stone, but these bonuses will only activate during the night or during a Solar Eclipse.

items.name: Abaddon
items.effect: Critical strikes curse enemies with Bane that scales off of your critical strike chance · When critically hit, enemies spread all debuffs they are afflicted with that are weaker than your Bane to nearby enemies · Current Bane damage: [DAMAGE] DPS
items.desc: The Abaddon is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Red Devils. When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff. Bane deals a base of 20 damage per second, and its damage is increased by 3% for each point of critical strike chance the player has.

items.name: Magic Quiver
items.why: Upgrades of this are also viable.
items.effect: Increases arrow damage by 10% and greatly increases arrow speed · 20% chance to not consume arrows
items.desc: The Magic Quiver is a Hardmode accessory that boosts arrow - and Stake -firing weapons.

items.name: Ranger Emblem
items.effect: 15% increased ranged damage
items.desc: The Ranger Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that increases ranged damage by 15%. It has a 1/4 (25%) chance to drop from the Wall of Flesh.

weapons.name: R-GSS: Vulcan
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: high sustained magic DPS at this tier
weapons.effect: A mana-fueled Gatling cannon that fires in bursts · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to launch a magnetic harpoon which attracts your shots · Launching a harpoon makes burst mode fire last longer · When a harpoon expires, all magnetized shots launch at nearby enemies with increased damage · 'Originally a ceiling mounted mining beam, the removal of its battery reduced its heft only marginally. · It saw little use and many complaints from the battlemage corps.'
weapons.desc: The R-GSS: Vulcan is a Hardmode magic gun. When used, it winds up to rapidly fire gauss blasts with a brief downtime in between. Right-clicking fires an extremely fast harpoon that deals 500% base damage on a 3 second cooldown.

weapons.name: Ion Blaster
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Rapidly fires ion blasts with heavy armor penetration that accelerate and explode · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to charge the blaster, restoring your mana until it reaches max · The more mana you restore, the stronger the burst is when you release it · Charging for 90% of your max mana or more will reach max power · Holding this weapon disables the pickup of stars
weapons.desc: The Ion Blaster is a Hardmode magic gun. When used, it fires continuously accelerating ion blasts that increase in damage with the player's current mana. The projectile damage is multiplied by 0.2 added to 1.4 times of the player's mana ratio, dealing 20% damage at 0 mana and 160% damage at full mana.

weapons.name: Brimrose Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a spread of splitting brimstone beams
weapons.desc: The Brimrose Staff is a Hardmode wand. When used, it fires a single short laser beam that instantly splits into two beams, with the resulting beams also splitting into two more beams. There are a total of four splits, resulting in an immediate flower of 16 beam-endings being created a short distance from the player in the direction fired.

weapons.name: Unholy Trident
weapons.source: Dropped by Red Devils (Underworld, Hardmode)
weapons.why: Fires a spectral trident that passes through blocks.
weapons.effect: Summons the Devil's trident
weapons.desc: The Unholy Trident is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss wand that has a 1/30 (3.33%) chance of being dropped by Red Devils. When used, it rapidly fires high-velocity purple tridents that pierce two enemies. A trident's damage is reduced by 10% each time it pierces an enemy.

weapons.name: Frigidflash Bolt
weapons.source: Crafted at a Bookcase
weapons.effect: Casts a fast ball of flash-freezing magma that bounces off tiles · When hitting a tile, a flarefrost burst is produced · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to cast an empowered ball that creates a collapsing flarefrost vortex which explodes
weapons.desc: The Frigidflash Bolt is a Hardmode spell tome that is a combination of the Frost Bolt and Flare Bolt. When used, it fires a slow-moving ball of flash-freezing magma that travels in a straight line, is unaffected by gravity, inflicts the Frostburn and Hellfire debuffs on hit, and can pierce and bounce off blocks four times before dissipating.

weapons.name: Nimbus Rod
weapons.source: Dropped by Angry Nimbus during rain in Hardmode
weapons.why: Spawns up to two lasting storm clouds that drop damaging rain projectiles below them.
weapons.effect: Summons a cloud to rain down on your foes
weapons.desc: The Nimbus Rod is a Hardmode magic weapon that creates storm clouds that drop damaging "rain" projectiles directly below themselves. When cast, a cloud projectile is fired from the Nimbus Rod and travels towards the cursor. Upon reaching its destination or colliding with a solid block, the cloud stops and starts sending damaging raindrop particles downward, each dealing the weapon's stated damage.

armor.name: Adamantite armor
armor.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
armor.why: class-specific armor with new set bonus
armor.effect: : 19% reduced mana costs · : 20% increased melee and movement speed · : 25% chance to save ammo
armor.desc: Adamantite armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Adamantite Breastplate and Adamantite Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Adamantite Helmet, Adamantite Mask, and Adamantite Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.

armor.name: Orichalcum armor
armor.effect: Flower petals will fall on your target for extra damage
armor.desc: Orichalcum armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Orichalcum Breastplate and Orichalcum Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Orichalcum Mask, Orichalcum Helmet, and Orichalcum Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively.

armor.name: Crystal Assassin armor
armor.effect: Allows the ability to dash · 10% increased damage and critical strike chance
armor.desc: Crystal Assassin armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Crystal Assassin Hood, Crystal Assassin Shirt, and Crystal Assassin Pants. Queen Slime always drops one piece / two pieces upon defeat.

accessories.name: Sorcerer Emblem
accessories.source: Dropped by the Wall of Flesh
accessories.why: The damage boost is immediate and efficient, which is exactly what mage wants from an early Hardmode accessory slot.
accessories.effect: 15% increased magic damage
accessories.desc: The Sorcerer Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that increases magic damage by 15%. It has a 1/4 (25%) chance to drop from the Wall of Flesh.

accessories.name: Arcane Flower
accessories.why: reduced mana cost, auto-uses mana potions
accessories.effect: 8% reduced mana cost · Automatically use mana potions when needed · Enemies are less likely to target you
accessories.desc: The Arcane Flower is a Hardmode accessory which combines the functionality of the Mana Flower and the aggro -reducing effect of the Putrid Scent.

accessories.name: Mana Polarizer
accessories.effect: Increases maximum mana by 40 · Provides life regeneration and magic damage that scales based on how much mana you have · Lower mana means more life regeneration, but less magic damage · These scale from -2 to +2 HP/s, and 15% to 5% damage · The provided regeneration is halved when under Mana Sickness · Magic projectiles steal enemy life
accessories.desc: The Mana Polarizer is an Expert Mode Pre-Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by The Slime God. It grants the following effects while equipped:

buffs.name: Magic Power Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Magic Power Potion is a buff potion which grants the Magic Power buff when consumed. The buff increases magic damage by 20%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Speeds up mana regeneration, so you stop to drink fewer mana potions.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Mana Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Mana Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff increases the rate at which the player's mana regenerates. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Super Mana Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Super Mana Potion is a recovery potion that restores 300 mana and inflicts the Mana Sickness debuff upon use. It is the most potent of all mana restoration items.

buffs.name: Crystal Ball
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Wizard
buffs.why: Free Clairvoyance remains a baseline endgame mage habit before any serious fight.
buffs.desc: The Crystal Ball is a Hardmode furniture item which functions as a crafting station. It is purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC. Pressing ⚷ Open / Activate on a placed Crystal Ball grants the Clairvoyance buff and opens its crafting menu.
