buffs.name: Greater Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Greater Healing Potion is a Hardmode recovery potion that restores 150 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 60 seconds when used. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Candles
buffs.desc: Candles are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty-five types of candles to the game, with nineteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture, two acting as upgrades to the Water Candle and Peace Candle, and the remaining four being purchasable from the Wizard.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.desc: The Seafood Dinner is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Survival matters a lot once the phase is dominated by hard optional content and fast fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Even ranged classes need extra defense when bosses or cave enemies close the gap.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Lifeforce Potion is a buff potion that grants the Lifeforce buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Photosynthesis Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Photosynthesis Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ammo Box
buffs.source: Placed station buff
buffs.why: Endgame ranger still wants free ammo efficiency before every serious fight.
buffs.desc: The Ammo Box is a furniture item. It can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for 10 GC in Hardmode.

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Ammo consumption adds up quickly, so this makes a stack last longer.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ammo Reservation Potion is a buff potion which grants the Ammo Reservation buff when consumed. The buff reduces the chance of consuming any ammunition by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Archery Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Raises arrow damage by 10% and arrow speed by 20%. Bows only.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Archery Potion is a buff potion which grants the Archery buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage of arrow -firing weapons by 10%, as well as the velocity of arrows by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Soaring Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Hadal Mantle
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 2.17 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Great · Max vertical speed: Good · Horizontal acceleration: Great · Vertical acceleration: Good · Fueled by the fury of the depths
items.desc: The Hadal Mantle is a Hardmode wing -type accessory. While equipped, it allows the player to fly and glide.

items.name: Spectre Wings
items.why: This has increased acceleration.
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
items.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Angel Treads
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 12% increased movement speed and 10% increased flight time · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava · 'Extreme speed!'
items.desc: The Angel Treads are a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Terraspark Boots and Harpy Ring. They grant the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Fairy Boots
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Flower grow on the grass you walk on · Fairies can spawn at any time on the surface and spawn far more frequently · Nearby fairies grant +1 HP/s life regen, 4 defense and 10% movement speed · Fairies are immune to damage and will no longer flee
items.desc: The Fairy Boots are a Hardmode accessory. They grant the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Asgard's Valor
items.why: Master Ninja Gear has a faster dash and a consistent dodge on a cooldown.
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage
items.desc: The Asgard's Valor is a Hardmode shield accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Master Ninja Gear
items.why: Master Ninja Gear has a faster dash and a consistent dodge on a cooldown.
items.effect: Allows the ability to climb walls and dash · Gives a chance to dodge attacks
items.desc: The Master Ninja Gear is a Hardmode, post- Plantera accessory that combines the abilities of the Black Belt, the Tabi, and the Tiger Climbing Gear. It allows the player to cling to and slide down vertical walls, quickly dash short distances by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right key, and offers a 1/10 (10%) chance to automatically dodge enemy attacks. There is a one-second cooldown period between dashes.

items.name: Shield of the High Ruler
items.why: Master Ninja Gear has a faster dash and a consistent dodge on a cooldown.
items.effect: +10 max life · Grants immunity to knockback and most debuffs · Grants an improved Shield of Cthulhu dash · Bonking an enemy halves dash cooldown time · Facing a projectile when it hits you reduces its damage by 15% · 'For the fate of the kingdom'
items.desc: The Shield of the High Ruler is a Hardmode shield accessory and the direct upgrade to the Shield of Cthulhu. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Interstellar Stompers
items.effect: 6% increased movement speed, 20% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Hold ▼ Down to increase your maximum fall speed · Pressing Interstellar Stompers Hotkey while midair charges up a superspeed slam over 0.33 seconds · While falling, you ram through enemies and don't take contact damage · Once you hit the ground, you create an explosion at your feet · The explosion scales in both damage and size the longer you slam for · Temporary 40% increased jump speed after slamming into the ground
items.desc: The Interstellar Stompers are an Expert Mode -exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Astrum Aureus. They grant the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Leviathan Ambergris
items.effect: 100% increased initial dash velocity, 33% faster dash cooldown, and greatly increased dash deceleration · Your dashes are empowered by water, knocking back and damaging enemies with vicious currents · Visual effects are reduced if visibility is disabled
items.desc: The Leviathan Ambergris is an Expert Mode -exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Bloom Stone
items.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'
items.desc: The Bloom Stone is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Plantera. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Frozen Shield
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Puts a shell around the owner when below 50% life that reduces damage by 25% · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when above 25% life
items.desc: The Frozen Shield is a Hardmode, post- Plantera shield that combines the functionalities of the Paladin's Shield and the Frozen Turtle Shell. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

items.name: Living Dew
items.effect: Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster
items.desc: The Living Dew is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade of the Honey Dew. It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x and makes it generate 100% faster while equipped.

items.name: Star Veil
items.effect: Causes stars to fall and increases length of invincibility after taking damage
items.desc: The Star Veil is a Hardmode accessory that combines the functions of the Star Cloak and the Cross Necklace, spawning falling star projectiles and increasing the length of the invincibility frames granted when the player is hurt.

items.name: Celestial Shell
items.effect: Turns the holder into a werewolf at night · Turns the holder into a merfolk when entering water · Minor increase to damage, melee speed, · critical strike chance, life regeneration, · defense, mining speed, and minion knockback
items.desc: The Celestial Shell is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory that combines the stat-boosting powers of the Celestial Stone with the transformation powers of the Moon Shell, allowing both of their effects to happen simultaneously while taking only one accessory slot.

items.name: Apollyon
items.effect: Critical strikes curse enemies with Bane that greatly scales off of your critical strike chance · When critically hit, enemies spread all debuffs they are afflicted with that are weaker than your Bane to nearby enemies · Critical strikes deal an additional 3% damage per debuff on the enemy · Current Bane damage: [DAMAGE] DPS
items.desc: Apollyon is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Abaddon. When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff. Additionally, critical strikes spread all debuffs inflicted on the hit enemy that are weaker than Bane to up to 10 enemies within an 87.5-tile range, and critical strikes deal 3% increased damage for every debuff inflicted on the enemy.

items.name: Deadshot Brooch
items.effect: 12% increased ranged damage, 7% increased ranged critical strike chance and 20% reduced ammo usage · Pressing Ammo Cycle Hotkey will automatically swap the order of ammos in your ammo slots · The ammo type swapped depends on the ammo of the weapon you are holding
items.desc: The Deadshot Brooch is a Hardmode accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Recon Scope
items.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance · Enemies are less likely to target you · 'Enemy spotted'
items.desc: The Recon Scope is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
items.effect: Increases armor penetration by 10 · 10% increased damage
items.desc: The Sand Shark Tooth Necklace is a Hardmode accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

items.name: Sniper Scope
items.why: This grants critical strike damage.
items.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance
items.desc: The Sniper Scope is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

weapons.name: Alula Australis
weapons.source: Dropped by Astrum Aureus
weapons.why: strong homing star magic weapon, listed first
weapons.effect: Fires a beautiful aurora that spreads the Astral Infection and is trailed by a star shower
weapons.desc: The Alula Australis is a Hardmode wand that is dropped by Astrum Aureus. When used, it fires an aurora beam which travels in a cosine pattern. As the beam travels, homing astral stars trail with the beam and rain down from the sky.

weapons.name: Bat Scepter
weapons.source: Dropped by Pumpking (Pumpkin Moon)
weapons.why: Fires a spread of homing bats at nearby enemies.
weapons.effect: Summons bats to attack your enemies
weapons.desc: The Bat Scepter is a Hardmode, post- Plantera wand that is dropped by the Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon event with a 2.5–12.5% (6.25–12.5%) chance depending on the current wave. [ 1 ] When used, it fires a burst of 2–3 homing bats, which do not pierce enemies or pass through blocks.

weapons.name: Charged Blaster Cannon
weapons.source: Dropped by Martian Madness enemies (post-Golem)
weapons.why: Charges up to fire a large piercing laser beam.
weapons.desc: The Charged Blaster Cannon is a Hardmode, post- Golem magic gun that has a 1/800 (0.13%) chance to drop from all basic enemies during the Martian Madness event. It possesses multiple firing modes with escalating speed, damage, and method of attack depending on how long the ⚒ Use / Attack key is held while firing it. [ 1 ]

weapons.name: Rainbow Gun
weapons.source: Found in Hallowed Chest in the Dungeon (opened with a Hallowed Key)
weapons.why: Launches a lasting rainbow that damages enemies along its arc.
weapons.effect: Shoots a rainbow that does continuous damage
weapons.desc: The Rainbow Gun is a Hardmode, post- Plantera magic gun that fires a curving rainbow that persists for 40 seconds or until another rainbow is fired. Enemies touching the rainbow take damage repeatedly, approximately five times per second. The Rainbow Gun is always found in the Dungeon 's Hallowed Chest, which can only be unlocked with a Hallowed Key after Plantera has been defeated.

weapons.name: Razorpine
weapons.source: Dropped by Everscream (Frost Moon)
weapons.desc: The Razorpine is a Hardmode, post- Plantera wand that is dropped by the Everscream during the Frost Moon event with a 3.46%–10.37% (6.22%–31.11%) chance depending on the current wave. [ 1 ] When used, it rapidly fires 2–4 high-velocity pine needles in a spread, which do not pierce enemies or pass through blocks. The needles become affected by gravity after traveling a medium distance.

weapons.name: Wingman
weapons.source: Dropped by Martian Engineers during the Martian Madness event
weapons.effect: Spawns two Wingmen which orbit you and fire lasers at your cursor · Press ⚷ Open / Activate while firing to order the Wingmen to launch grenades · Grenades have a cooldown which is shortened if the Wingmen are fully revved up
weapons.desc: The Wingman is a Hardmode magic gun that is dropped by Martian Engineers during the Martian Madness event. When used with its primary fire (left-click), it summons two Wingmen to the sides of the player perpendicular to the direction of the cursor, that each switch sides and fire lasers towards the cursor that travel through tiles and pierce once. The Wingmen gradually increase in firing rate and laser velocity the longer it is held for, reaching a full speed of 6 lasers per second after 6 shots.

weapons.name: Lunic Eye
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires seeking energy bolts that cause enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Lunic Eye is a Hardmode classless weapon. When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals
weapons.why: listed support item for teleport dodging
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
weapons.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

armor.name: Brimflame armor
armor.effect: 8% increased damage and magic critical strike chance · Brimflame Frenzy - Armor Set Bonus for 10 seconds of 40% increased magic damage · However, this inflicts rapid life loss and disables mana regeneration and mana potions · This effect can be toggled off and has a cooldown of 30 seconds
armor.desc: Brimflame armor is a Hardmode mage armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a tiny pulsating aura around them.

armor.name: Hydrothermic armor
armor.why: melee set with brimstone offensive bonuses
armor.effect: Inferno effect when below 50% life · You emit a blazing explosion when you are hit · Helm: Enemies are more likely to target you · Melee attacks and projectiles cause chaos flames to erupt on enemy hits · Headgear: You fire a homing chaos flare when using ranged weapons every 0.33 seconds · Mask: Magic attacks summon damaging and healing flare orbs on hit · Helmet: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · 25% increased summon damage · Summons a hydrothermic vent to protect you · Hood: +110 maximum stealth · Rogue weapons unleash a volley of homing chaos flames around the player every 2 seconds
armor.desc: Hydrothermic armor is a Hardmode armor set.

armor.name: Reaver armor
armor.effect: Helm: Enemies are more likely to target you · Reduces the life regen lost from damage over time debuffs by 20% · 30% decreased movement speed and flight time · Grants Reaver Rage for 5 seconds after taking damage · Visage: Grants immunity to fall damage and allows constant jumping · 10% increased flight time and horizontal wing speed · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 50% faster · Reduces the cooldown of dashes by 33% · Headgear: Emits light and shows the location of treasure and ore · Enemies are less likely to target you and grants underwater breathing · Greatly enhances visibility in the abyss · Increased block placement & tool range by 7 · Increases pickup range for items
armor.desc: Reaver armor is a Hardmode armor set.

buffs.name: Plenty Satisfied
buffs.desc: Well Fed, Plenty Satisfied, and Exquisitely Stuffed are buffs granted to the player when they consume food, which provide general stat bonuses that vary in potency and duration depending on the food item consumed. In Expert Mode, health regeneration will only be fully effective while the player is under the effects of one of these buffs. While one of these buffs is active in a The Constant or Zenith special world seed, the player will also be temporarily immune to hunger for the buff's duration.

items.desc: Apollyon is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Abaddon. When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff. Additionally, critical strikes spread all debuffs inflicted on the hit enemy that are weaker than Bane to up to 10 enemies within an 87.5-tile range, and critical strikes deal 3% increased damage for every debuff inflicted on the enemy.

items.name: Arcane Flower
items.effect: 8% reduced mana cost · Automatically use mana potions when needed · Enemies are less likely to target you
items.desc: The Arcane Flower is a Hardmode accessory which combines the functionality of the Mana Flower and the aggro -reducing effect of the Putrid Scent.

items.effect: 10% increased damage · 8% increased critical strike chance

items.effect: Increases armor penetration by 10 · 10% increased damage

weapons.name: Xeno Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by the Martian Saucer during Martian Madness
weapons.why: Summons UFO minions with instantaneous non-missing attacks; event is post-Golem.
weapons.effect: Summons a UFO to fight for you
weapons.desc: The Xeno Staff is a Hardmode, post- Golem summon weapon that summons a UFO minion. It hovers above enemies, firing blue lasers that hit the target instantaneously. If an enemy is 18.75 to 50 tiles away, it will instantly teleport above it.

weapons.name: Wither Blossoms Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons four decaying Plague flowers over your head
weapons.desc: The Wither Blossoms Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that is an upgrade to the Tundra Flame Blossoms Staff. When used, it summons up to four dark-colored flowers that orbit around the player, and fire homing bolts at nearby targets. The bolts travel through terrain, disappearing shortly after hitting an enemy and inflicting the Plague debuff.

weapons.name: Sand Sharknado Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons a sandnado to fight for you
weapons.desc: The Sand Sharknado Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Forgotten Apex Wand. When used, it summons a sandnado to attack nearby enemies by firing miniature high velocity Sand Sharks at them.

weapons.name: Resurrection Butterfly
weapons.source: Crafted at a Loom
weapons.effect: Summons a pair of butterflies to fight for you · 'Remembering the melancholy of human existence · Even ghosts stray from the path of righteousness'
weapons.desc: The Resurrection Butterfly is a Hardmode summon weapon. When used with 2 or more minion slots, it summons two butterflies of different colors. The purple butterfly will charge into enemies with a short delay between charges, while the pink butterfly will fire 2 bullets towards enemies every 2-4 seconds that deal 85% of the weapon's base damage and last for 3.5 seconds.

weapons.name: Raven Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by the Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon
weapons.why: Summons Raven minions; obtained from the post-Plantera Pumpkin Moon event.
weapons.effect: Summons a raven to fight for you
weapons.desc: The Raven Staff is a Hardmode, post- Plantera summon weapon that summons a Raven minion. It flies and charges through enemies. The Raven Staff is dropped by the Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon event with a 2.5–12.5% (6.25–12.5%) chance depending on the current wave. [ 1 ]

weapons.name: Staff of the Frost Hydra
weapons.source: Found in the Dungeon's Ice Chest, opened with a Frozen Key (post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Post-Plantera sentry summoning a Frost Hydra that fires piercing frost blasts.
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons a powerful frost hydra to spit ice at your enemies
weapons.desc: The Staff of the Frost Hydra is a Hardmode, post- Plantera summon weapon that summons the Frost Hydra sentry. It fires frost blasts towards enemies, which pierce twice and inflict the Frostbite debuff.

weapons.name: Hive Pod
weapons.source: Dropped by Astraglomerates after Astrum Aureus has been defeated
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons an astraglomerate to spawn glomerings at your enemies · Glomerings spread the Astral Infection on impact
weapons.desc: The Hive Pod is a Hardmode sentry that is dropped by Astraglomerates after Astrum Aureus has been defeated. The Astral Hive will spawn Hivelings if there are any enemies nearby, which will home onto the closest enemy to them, even through walls.

weapons.name: Dreadmine Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons a turret that swarms your enemies with sea mines
weapons.desc: The Dreadmine Staff is a Hardmode sentry. It summons a stationary mine base that summons mines on nearby tiles which home in on enemies. When an enemy comes in contact with a mine, it will blow up.

weapons.name: Stellar Knife
weapons.source: Dropped by Aries after Astrum Aureus is defeated
weapons.why: homing knives with high sustained single-target DPS; boosted stealth-strike knives
weapons.effect: Throws knives that stop midair and then home into enemies, inflicting Astral Infection · Stealth strikes throw a volley of 10 knives in a spread · 'ZA WARUDO'
weapons.desc: The Stellar Knife is a Hardmode dagger that is dropped by Aries after Astrum Aureus is defeated. When thrown, it moves and rapidly spins in the direction it was initially thrown, slowly decelerating and losing spin speed over time. Once the knife fully decelerates, it then remains still until an enemy is within its detection range for it to home in.

weapons.source: Dropped by the majority of enemies that spawn during the Martian Madness event
weapons.why: strong area explosive damage; large stealth-strike explosion
weapons.effect: Direct hits from the weapon grant stealth · Non-stealth strikes do not consume stealth when fully charged · Holding a stealth strike charge beyond its limit rapidly drains stealth · Stealth strikes ricochet between multiple enemies, ending in a strong impact · 'A high-tech explosive with devastating power... If only you could figure out how to arm it' · 'At least you can throw it really hard!'
weapons.desc: The Doomsday Device is a Hardmode rogue bomb that can drop from the majority of enemies that spawn during the Martian Madness event, with an increased drop chance from Martian Officers. While holding ⚒ Use / Attack the player will rapidly charge a throw of the Doomsday Device, throwing the device when released. The device bounces off of enemies that it hits.

weapons.name: Epidemic Shredder
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws an infected boomerang that releases Plague seekers when it hits tiles or enemies · Stealth strikes cause the boomerang to release Plague seekers constantly as it travels · Contrary to its name, it will probably cause an epidemic if used incorrectly
weapons.desc: The Epidemic Shredder is a Hardmode rogue boomerang. When used, it throws a plague disk that pierces five times and returns to the player after traveling a moderate distance. The disk can bounce on tiles indefinitely until it reaches the player or despawns.

weapons.name: Plaguenade
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: plague grenade with good crowd damage; plague stealth-strike area damage
weapons.effect: Releases a swarm of angry Plague bees · Stealth strikes spawn more bees and generate a larger explosion
weapons.desc: The Plaguenade is a Hardmode bomb. It is an explosive projectile that release 20 plague-infected bees upon explosion. Both the explosion and the bees inflict the Plague debuff on contact.

weapons.name: Samsara Slicer
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws a disk that has a chance to generate several disks if enemies are near it · Stealth strikes shred enemies and are rapidly orbited by the smaller disks
weapons.desc: The Samsara Slicer is a Hardmode rogue boomerang. When used, it throws a disk that quickly returns to the player after hitting an enemy or after traveling for a short distance. The disk can pass through blocks and pierce infinitely, and has a chance to fire 6 smaller disks outwards from it when an enemy is nearby, which linger for a short time before dissipating.

weapons.effect: Rapidly throws a spread of teeth that stick to enemies · After sticking to an enemy, the teeth will gouge through them and shoot out the other side · Stealth strikes create a clamping jaw of teeth to maul your foes
weapons.desc: The Leviathan Teeth are a Hardmode dagger that is dropped by Leviathan and Anahita. When used, they rapidly throw an inaccurate tight spread of 2 gravity-affected teeth that inflict the Heavy Bleeding debuff on contact with enemies and stick to them. After sticking for 2 seconds, teeth will launch out the other side of the enemy, dealing an additional burst of damage.

accessories.effect: Stealth strikes only expend 75% of your max stealth · 6% increased rogue damage and rogue crit chance
accessories.desc: The Ruin Medallion is a Hardmode rogue accessory and the direct upgrade to the Coin of Deceit. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.why: increases stealth generation and rogue damage

accessories.desc: The Abyssal Mirror is a Hardmode rogue accessory and the direct upgrade to the Mirage Mirror. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.effect: Decreases rogue attack speed by 15% · Increases rogue damage and critical strike chance by 10%, and velocity by 15%
accessories.desc: The Glove of Precision is a Hardmode rogue accessory that is sold by the Bandit for 48 after Plantera has been defeated. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

accessories.name: Vampiric Talisman
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Rogue critical strikes steal enemy life · Stealth strikes grant 15% critical strike chance and increased lifesteal to non-stealth strikes for 10 seconds · Stealth strikes inflict Heavy Bleeding and Armor Crunch , and deal 8% more damage · 'Possessing the talisman makes you yearn for blood'
accessories.desc: The Vampiric Talisman is a Hardmode rogue accessory. When equipped, it causes rogue critical hits to steal 1.5% of their damage (rounded down) in health. Additionally, it increases stealth strike damage by 8% and causes all stealth strikes to inflict Armor Crunch for 2.5 seconds and Heavy Bleeding for 5 seconds.

accessories.name: Bloom Stone
accessories.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'
accessories.desc: The Bloom Stone is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Plantera. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Frozen Shield
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Puts a shell around the owner when below 50% life that reduces damage by 25% · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when above 25% life
accessories.desc: The Frozen Shield is a Hardmode, post- Plantera shield that combines the functionalities of the Paladin's Shield and the Frozen Turtle Shell. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

accessories.name: Living Dew
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster
accessories.desc: The Living Dew is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade of the Honey Dew. It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x and makes it generate 100% faster while equipped.

accessories.name: Star Veil
accessories.effect: Causes stars to fall and increases length of invincibility after taking damage
accessories.desc: The Star Veil is a Hardmode accessory that combines the functions of the Star Cloak and the Cross Necklace, spawning falling star projectiles and increasing the length of the invincibility frames granted when the player is hurt.

accessories.name: Celestial Shell
accessories.effect: Turns the holder into a werewolf at night · Turns the holder into a merfolk when entering water · Minor increase to damage, melee speed, · critical strike chance, life regeneration, · defense, mining speed, and minion knockback
accessories.desc: The Celestial Shell is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory that combines the stat-boosting powers of the Celestial Stone with the transformation powers of the Moon Shell, allowing both of their effects to happen simultaneously while taking only one accessory slot.

accessories.name: Angel Treads
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 12% increased movement speed and 10% increased flight time · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava · 'Extreme speed!'
accessories.desc: The Angel Treads are a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Terraspark Boots and Harpy Ring. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Fairy Boots
accessories.effect: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Flower grow on the grass you walk on · Fairies can spawn at any time on the surface and spawn far more frequently · Nearby fairies grant +1 HP/s life regen, 4 defense and 10% movement speed · Fairies are immune to damage and will no longer flee
accessories.desc: The Fairy Boots are a Hardmode accessory. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Asgard's Valor
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage
accessories.desc: The Asgard's Valor is a Hardmode shield accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Master Ninja Gear
accessories.effect: Allows the ability to climb walls and dash · Gives a chance to dodge attacks
accessories.desc: The Master Ninja Gear is a Hardmode, post- Plantera accessory that combines the abilities of the Black Belt, the Tabi, and the Tiger Climbing Gear. It allows the player to cling to and slide down vertical walls, quickly dash short distances by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right key, and offers a 1/10 (10%) chance to automatically dodge enemy attacks. There is a one-second cooldown period between dashes.

accessories.name: Shield of the High Ruler
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: +10 max life · Grants immunity to knockback and most debuffs · Grants an improved Shield of Cthulhu dash · Bonking an enemy halves dash cooldown time · Facing a projectile when it hits you reduces its damage by 15% · 'For the fate of the kingdom'
accessories.desc: The Shield of the High Ruler is a Hardmode shield accessory and the direct upgrade to the Shield of Cthulhu. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Interstellar Stompers
accessories.effect: 6% increased movement speed, 20% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Hold ▼ Down to increase your maximum fall speed · Pressing Interstellar Stompers Hotkey while midair charges up a superspeed slam over 0.33 seconds · While falling, you ram through enemies and don't take contact damage · Once you hit the ground, you create an explosion at your feet · The explosion scales in both damage and size the longer you slam for · Temporary 40% increased jump speed after slamming into the ground
accessories.desc: The Interstellar Stompers are an Expert Mode -exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Astrum Aureus. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Leviathan Ambergris
accessories.source: Dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita
accessories.effect: 100% increased initial dash velocity, 33% faster dash cooldown, and greatly increased dash deceleration · Your dashes are empowered by water, knocking back and damaging enemies with vicious currents · Visual effects are reduced if visibility is disabled
accessories.desc: The Leviathan Ambergris is an Expert Mode -exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Hadal Mantle
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 2.17 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Great · Max vertical speed: Good · Horizontal acceleration: Great · Vertical acceleration: Good · Fueled by the fury of the depths
accessories.desc: The Hadal Mantle is a Hardmode wing -type accessory. While equipped, it allows the player to fly and glide.

accessories.name: Spectre Wings
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Lunic Eye
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Fires seeking energy bolts that cause enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
accessories.desc: The Lunic Eye is a Hardmode classless weapon. When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

accessories.name: Rod of Discord
accessories.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
accessories.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

buffs.name: Flask of Brimstone
buffs.source: Crafted at an Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.desc: The Flask of Brimstone is a Hardmode flask. Upon consumption, it grants the Weapon Imbue: Brimstone buff, which causes melee, whip, and rogue weapons to inflict the Brimstone Flames debuff.

buffs.name: Flask of Venom
buffs.source: Brewed at Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.desc: The Flask of Venom is a Hardmode, post- Plantera flask that causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Acid Venom debuff on hit for 5–9 seconds, which deals 30 damage per second to enemies and prevents health regeneration. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.name: Shadow Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Shadow Potion is a Pre-Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Shadow buff, which provides the following effects:

buffs.name: Greater Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: primary healing item at this tier
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Greater Healing Potion is a Hardmode recovery potion that restores 150 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 60 seconds when used. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Lifeforce Potion is a buff potion that grants the Lifeforce buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Photosynthesis Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Photosynthesis Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.desc: The Seafood Dinner is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Soaring Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.desc: Apollyon is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Abaddon. When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff. weapons.name: Briny Baron
weapons.source: Dropped by Duke Fishron
weapons.why: versatile sword with strong projectile damage
weapons.effect: Striking an enemy with the blade causes a briny typhoon to appear · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to fire a razorwind aqua blade
weapons.desc: The Briny Baron is a Hardmode broadsword that is dropped by Duke Fishron. When used with its primary fire (left-click), it will swing, and deal damage in a normal manner. Striking an enemy with the sword spawns a shortly lingering typhoon that deals 50% of the weapon's damage in rapid successions and only one typhoon can exist at a time.

weapons.name: Exalted Oathblade
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Throw a twisted blade that impales, immolates, and slows enemies · Up to four blades can impale an enemy at a time, with further hits launching the previous impaled blades · Press <right> to enter a stance where you can use <left> to perform a devastating slash · While in the stance, you gain life and flight time regeneration and your dashes have a shorter cooldown · The devastating slash must recharge after being used · Striking an impaled enemy with the devastating slash launches all blades and readies another slash · Hold Shift for more A sword fashioned from the legend of the Last Demon Lord. · Crowned through his overwhelming might, his sword bathed in the blood of Demons and the fires of hell. · Even long after his passing, none have dared to take the seat. · Demonkind has not known unity since.
weapons.desc: The Exalted Oathblade is a Hardmode special sword that autoswings and is the direct upgrade to the Forbidden Oathblade. When used with its primary function (left-click), it throws a sword that sticks into enemies and reduces their speed, with a max of 4 being able to be stuck into a single enemy. If another is stuck, the oldest one will be launched out.

weapons.name: Flying Dragon
weapons.source: Dropped by Betsy (Old One's Army Tier 3)
weapons.why: Fires a red crescent-shaped projectile on each swing.
weapons.effect: Unleashes the heart's energy forward
weapons.desc: The Flying Dragon is a Hardmode, post- Golem broadsword that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by Betsy during Tier 3 of the Old One's Army event. When swung, it fires red crescent-shaped projectiles every 20 ticks [ 1 ] [ 2 ], which pierce four enemies, pass through blocks, and dissipate after one second.

weapons.name: Galvanizing Glaive
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Swings a spear which envelops struck foes in an energy field · When finished, the spear discharges an extra pulse of energy · 'A tool which quickly and neatly cleaves one object into two. · Its efficiency and reliability as a weapon is unmistakable.'
weapons.desc: The Galvanizing Glaive is a Hardmode spear. When used, the player swings a spear around similarly to the Ghastly Glaive, and releases five gauss energy projectiles, each dealing 40% of the weapon's damage. If the target is struck by the spear itself, there is a 1/12 chance per hit for an energy flux to spawn on the enemy, which continuously deals the weapon's damage.

weapons.name: Lucrecia
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a spiraling darklight shard when swung · Hits with the blade itself build Darklight Energy · Darklight Energy is lost over time if it has not been gained for a few seconds · Press ⚷ Open / Activate with maximum energy to fire a double helix comet
weapons.desc: The Lucrecia is a Hardmode special sword that autoswings. When used, it swings back and forth in front of the player, firing a darklight shard that pierces infinitely but cannot pass through tiles with each swing. Hitting with the sword itself builds up Darklight Energy, a resource that dissipates slowly over time, but briefly stops anytime it is gained.

weapons.name: Betsy's Wrath
weapons.source: Dropped by Betsy (Old One's Army Tier 3, post-Golem)
weapons.effect: Splashes defense reducing miasma!
weapons.desc: Betsy's Wrath is a Hardmode, post- Golem wand that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by Betsy during Tier 3 of the Old One's Army event. When used, it fires three fireballs that travel in arcs. The fireballs explode upon impact with an enemy or a block and inflict the Betsy's Curse debuff, which adds 40 armor penetration against affected entities for 10 seconds.

weapons.name: Lunic Eye
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires seeking energy bolts that cause enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Lunic Eye is a Hardmode classless weapon. When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
weapons.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

armor.name: Beetle armor
armor.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
armor.why: Beetles either raise melee damage and speed or absorb damage, depending on the chestplate you wear.
armor.effect: : Beetles increase your melee damage and speed · : Beetles protect you from damage
armor.desc: Beetle armor is a Hardmode, post- Golem melee armor set consisting of the Beetle Helmet and Beetle Leggings, as well as two different chestpieces: the Beetle Scale Mail and Beetle Shell, providing offensive and defensive bonuses respectively.

armor.name: Hydrothermic armor
armor.why: melee set with brimstone offensive bonuses
armor.effect: Inferno effect when below 50% life · You emit a blazing explosion when you are hit · Helm: Enemies are more likely to target you · Melee attacks and projectiles cause chaos flames to erupt on enemy hits · Headgear: You fire a homing chaos flare when using ranged weapons every 0.33 seconds · Mask: Magic attacks summon damaging and healing flare orbs on hit · Helmet: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · 25% increased summon damage · Summons a hydrothermic vent to protect you · Hood: +110 maximum stealth · Rogue weapons unleash a volley of homing chaos flames around the player every 2 seconds
armor.desc: Hydrothermic armor is a Hardmode armor set.

armor.name: Valhalla Knight armor
armor.source: Dropped by the Old One's Army, tier 3
armor.effect: Increases your max number of sentries by 1 · Greatly enhances Ballista effectiveness
armor.desc: Valhalla Knight armor is a Hardmode, post- Golem melee/summoner armor set consisting of the Valhalla Knight's Helm, Valhalla Knight's Breastplate, and Valhalla Knight's Greaves. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of 1500000* 150.

armor.name: Reaver armor
armor.effect: Helm: Enemies are more likely to target you · Reduces the life regen lost from damage over time debuffs by 20% · 30% decreased movement speed and flight time · Grants Reaver Rage for 5 seconds after taking damage · Visage: Grants immunity to fall damage and allows constant jumping · 10% increased flight time and horizontal wing speed · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 50% faster · Reduces the cooldown of dashes by 33% · Headgear: Emits light and shows the location of treasure and ore · Enemies are less likely to target you and grants underwater breathing · Greatly enhances visibility in the abyss · Increased block placement & tool range by 7 · Increases pickup range for items
armor.desc: Reaver armor is a Hardmode armor set.

accessories.name: Betsy's Wings
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Empress Wings
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Fishron Wings
accessories.why: Flight, and faster movement in rain and water.
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Bloody Worm Scarf
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: 10% increased damage reduction and melee damage
accessories.desc: The Bloody Worm Scarf is a Hardmode accessory. When equipped, it provides 2 defense, and increases damage reduction and melee damage by 10%.

accessories.name: Celestial Shell
accessories.why: All-round stats, plus werewolf at night and merfolk in water.
accessories.effect: Turns the holder into a werewolf at night · Turns the holder into a merfolk when entering water · Minor increase to damage, melee speed, · critical strike chance, life regeneration, · defense, mining speed, and minion knockback
accessories.desc: The Celestial Shell is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory that combines the stat-boosting powers of the Celestial Stone with the transformation powers of the Moon Shell, allowing both of their effects to happen simultaneously while taking only one accessory slot.

accessories.name: Angel Treads
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 12% increased movement speed and 10% increased flight time · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava · 'Extreme speed!'
accessories.desc: The Angel Treads are a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Terraspark Boots and Harpy Ring. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Fairy Boots
accessories.effect: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Flower grow on the grass you walk on · Fairies can spawn at any time on the surface and spawn far more frequently · Nearby fairies grant +1 HP/s life regen, 4 defense and 10% movement speed · Fairies are immune to damage and will no longer flee
accessories.desc: The Fairy Boots are a Hardmode accessory. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Asgard's Valor
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage
accessories.desc: The Asgard's Valor is a Hardmode shield accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Master Ninja Gear
accessories.why: Dash, wall climbing, and a 10% chance to dodge an attack.
accessories.effect: Allows the ability to climb walls and dash · Gives a chance to dodge attacks
accessories.desc: The Master Ninja Gear is a Hardmode, post- Plantera accessory that combines the abilities of the Black Belt, the Tabi, and the Tiger Climbing Gear. It allows the player to cling to and slide down vertical walls, quickly dash short distances by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right key, and offers a 1/10 (10%) chance to automatically dodge enemy attacks. There is a one-second cooldown period between dashes.

accessories.name: Shield of the High Ruler
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: +10 max life · Grants immunity to knockback and most debuffs · Grants an improved Shield of Cthulhu dash · Bonking an enemy halves dash cooldown time · Facing a projectile when it hits you reduces its damage by 15% · 'For the fate of the kingdom'
accessories.desc: The Shield of the High Ruler is a Hardmode shield accessory and the direct upgrade to the Shield of Cthulhu. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Interstellar Stompers
accessories.effect: 6% increased movement speed, 20% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Hold ▼ Down to increase your maximum fall speed · Pressing Interstellar Stompers Hotkey while midair charges up a superspeed slam over 0.33 seconds · While falling, you ram through enemies and don't take contact damage · Once you hit the ground, you create an explosion at your feet · The explosion scales in both damage and size the longer you slam for · Temporary 40% increased jump speed after slamming into the ground
accessories.desc: The Interstellar Stompers are an Expert Mode -exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Astrum Aureus. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Soaring Insignia
accessories.source: Dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess
accessories.effect: Grants infinite wing and rocket boot flight · Increases flight and jump mobility
accessories.desc: The Soaring Insignia is a Hardmode, post- Plantera accessory that boosts the player's flight and movement abilities. It has the following effects:

accessories.name: Apollyon
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Critical strikes curse enemies with Bane that greatly scales off of your critical strike chance · When critically hit, enemies spread all debuffs they are afflicted with that are weaker than your Bane to nearby enemies · Critical strikes deal an additional 3% damage per debuff on the enemy · Current Bane damage: [DAMAGE] DPS
accessories.desc: Apollyon is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Abaddon. When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff. Additionally, critical strikes spread all debuffs inflicted on the hit enemy that are weaker than Bane to up to 10 enemies within an 87.5-tile range, and critical strikes deal 3% increased damage for every debuff inflicted on the enemy.

accessories.name: Eye of the Golem
accessories.effect: 10% increased critical strike chance
accessories.desc: The Eye of the Golem is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory that grants +10% critical strike chance. It has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being dropped by Golem.

accessories.name: Fire Gauntlet
accessories.why: Melee damage, speed and knockback, and sets enemies on fire. Upgrades from Mechanical Glove.
accessories.effect: Increases melee knockback and melee attacks inflict fire damage · 12% increased melee damage and speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons · Increases the size of melee weapons
accessories.desc: The Fire Gauntlet is a Hardmode, post- mechanical bosses accessory. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

accessories.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
accessories.effect: Increases armor penetration by 10 · 10% increased damage
accessories.desc: The Sand Shark Tooth Necklace is a Hardmode accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

accessories.name: Blood Pact
accessories.effect: Increases max HP by 25% · Healing Potions are 33% more effective · Grants immunity to Bleeding , Burning Blood and Heavy Bleeding
accessories.desc: The Blood Pact is an Expert Mode -exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by the Ravager. When equipped, it increases the player's maximum health by 25%, grants immunity to the Bleeding, Burning Blood & Heavy Bleeding debuffs, and increases the amount of health restored from drinking healing potions by 33%.

accessories.name: Bloom Stone
accessories.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'
accessories.desc: The Bloom Stone is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Plantera. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Frozen Shield
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Puts a shell around the owner when below 50% life that reduces damage by 25% · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when above 25% life
accessories.desc: The Frozen Shield is a Hardmode, post- Plantera shield that combines the functionalities of the Paladin's Shield and the Frozen Turtle Shell. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

accessories.name: Living Dew
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster
accessories.desc: The Living Dew is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade of the Honey Dew. It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x and makes it generate 100% faster while equipped.

accessories.name: Star Veil
accessories.why: Longer invincibility after a hit, plus retaliating falling stars.
accessories.effect: Causes stars to fall and increases length of invincibility after taking damage
accessories.desc: The Star Veil is a Hardmode accessory that combines the functions of the Star Cloak and the Cross Necklace, spawning falling star projectiles and increasing the length of the invincibility frames granted when the player is hurt.

buffs.name: Greater Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: the healing potion available at this tier
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Greater Healing Potion is a Hardmode recovery potion that restores 150 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 60 seconds when used. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Candles
buffs.desc: Candles are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty-five types of candles to the game, with nineteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture, two acting as upgrades to the Water Candle and Peace Candle, and the remaining four being purchasable from the Wizard.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.desc: The Seafood Dinner is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Lifeforce Potion is a buff potion that grants the Lifeforce buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Photosynthesis Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Photosynthesis Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Flask of Brimstone
buffs.source: Crafted at an Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.desc: The Flask of Brimstone is a Hardmode flask. Upon consumption, it grants the Weapon Imbue: Brimstone buff, which causes melee, whip, and rogue weapons to inflict the Brimstone Flames debuff.

buffs.name: Flask of Venom
buffs.source: Brewed at Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.desc: The Flask of Venom is a Hardmode, post- Plantera flask that causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Acid Venom debuff on hit for 5–9 seconds, which deals 30 damage per second to enemies and prevents health regeneration. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Sharpening Station
buffs.source: Found in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle
buffs.why: Grants armor penetration to melee weapons while standing near it.
buffs.desc: The Sharpening Station is a furniture item found naturally generated in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle. In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Merchant for 10 GC.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Soaring Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().
