items.effect: Minion attacks provide various buffs · Does not stack with downgrades · Hold Shift for more Hallowed Power grants 10% increased summon damage and rains stars on enemies · Hallowed Defense grants 5 defense · Hallowed Regen grants +1 HP/s life regen
items.desc: The Hallowed Rune is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Spirit Glyph. While equipped, whenever a minion hits an enemy, the player is granted one of the following buffs:

items.name: Papyrus Scarab
items.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Increases your summon damage by 15% and the knockback of your minions
items.desc: The Papyrus Scarab is a Hardmode, post- Plantera accessory that combines the bonuses of the Necromantic Scroll and the Hercules Beetle. When equipped, it increases the damage of summon weapons by 15%, increases their knockback by 2, and increases the player's maximum number of minions by one.

items.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
items.effect: Increases armor penetration by 10 · 10% increased damage
items.desc: The Sand Shark Tooth Necklace is a Hardmode accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

items.name: Star-Tainted Generator
items.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 2, and summon damage by 7% · Minion attacks spawn astral explosions and inflict several debuffs · Grants immunity to Irradiated · Does not stack with downgrades
items.desc: The Star-Tainted Generator is a Hardmode accessory that combines the effects of the Jelly-Charged Battery, Nuclear Fuel Rod, and Starbuster Core. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Statis' Blessing
items.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 2, and summon damage by 12% · Increased minion knockback
items.desc: The Statis' Blessing is a Hardmode accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

weapons.name: Corpus Avertor
weapons.source: Dropped by the Ravager
weapons.why: top spam-type rogue weapon, listed first with lifesteal; primary stealth-strike option, listed first
weapons.effect: Throws a spinning dagger that spawns a rebounding clone · Deals more damage the lower your health, and grants lifesteal · Stealth strikes throw a piercing rainbow dagger which spawns an extra slash in its wake, at a blood cost · This dagger grants players on your team 10% damage and +2 HP/s life regen on hit, and heals them for a portion of damage dealt · 'Seems like it has worn down over time'
weapons.desc: The Corpus Avertor is a Hardmode rogue weapon that is dropped by the Ravager. When used, it throws a black knife that spawns smaller homing red knives as it travels. The red knives pass through tiles, deal 40% of the weapon's damage, and heal the player for 5% of their damage dealt. 10% of the player's missing health is added to the weapon's base damage.

weapons.name: Cranium Smasher
weapons.source: Dropped by the Ravager
weapons.effect: Alternates between throwing piercing, rolling disks and explosive disks · Stealth strikes embed into the hit foe, exploding multiple times
weapons.desc: The Cranium Smasher is a Hardmode bomb that is dropped by the Ravager. When used, it alternates between throwing rolling disks and explosive disks. Rolling disks travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity, and will roll on the ground and pierce up to 4 times before dissipating on the fifth.

weapons.name: Plaguenade
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: AoE plague spam option; stealth AoE option
weapons.effect: Releases a swarm of angry Plague bees · Stealth strikes spawn more bees and generate a larger explosion
weapons.desc: The Plaguenade is a Hardmode bomb. It is an explosive projectile that release 20 plague-infected bees upon explosion. Both the explosion and the bees inflict the Plague debuff on contact.

weapons.name: Stellar Knife
weapons.source: Dropped by Aries after Astrum Aureus is defeated
weapons.effect: Throws knives that stop midair and then home into enemies, inflicting Astral Infection · Stealth strikes throw a volley of 10 knives in a spread · 'ZA WARUDO'
weapons.desc: The Stellar Knife is a Hardmode dagger that is dropped by Aries after Astrum Aureus is defeated. When thrown, it moves and rapidly spins in the direction it was initially thrown, slowly decelerating and losing spin speed over time. Once the knife fully decelerates, it then remains still until an enemy is within its detection range for it to home in.

weapons.name: The Syringe
weapons.source: Dropped by The Plaguebringer Goliath
weapons.effect: Throws a high velocity syringe that increases damage as it travels · Shatters into glass and cinders on impact · Stealth strikes also shatter into Plague bees · 'I'm pretty sure this isn't healthy'
weapons.desc: The Syringe is a Hardmode rogue weapon dropped by The Plaguebringer Goliath. It auto-fires a high velocity syringe that increases damage as it travels and inflicts the Plague debuff. On contact with an enemy or block, it will shatter into glass and plague cinders.

weapons.name: Duke's Decapitator
weapons.source: Dropped by Duke Fishron
weapons.effect: Throws a hydro axe which shreds enemies when it comes into contact with them · The faster the axe is spinning, the more times it hits before disappearing · Stealth strikes emit short-ranged bubbles
weapons.desc: Duke's Decapitator is a Hardmode rogue weapon that is dropped by Duke Fishron. When used, it throws a fast-spinning axe that slowly decelerates to a stop and breaks shortly after. It will stick onto an enemy upon contact, dealing damage.

weapons.name: Leviathan Teeth
weapons.source: Dropped by Leviathan and Anahita
weapons.effect: Rapidly throws a spread of teeth that stick to enemies · After sticking to an enemy, the teeth will gouge through them and shoot out the other side · Stealth strikes create a clamping jaw of teeth to maul your foes
weapons.desc: The Leviathan Teeth are a Hardmode dagger that is dropped by Leviathan and Anahita. When used, they rapidly throw an inaccurate tight spread of 2 gravity-affected teeth that inflict the Heavy Bleeding debuff on contact with enemies and stick to them. After sticking for 2 seconds, teeth will launch out the other side of the enemy, dealing an additional burst of damage.

weapons.name: System Bane
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Hurls an unstable device which sticks to the ground and shocks nearby enemies with lightning · Stealth strikes make the device emit a large, damaging electromagnetic field
weapons.desc: The System Bane is a Hardmode spiky ball. When used, the player throws a gravity-affected electric machine that continuously deals damage to targets that come into contact with it. Occasionally if there's a target nearby, the device releases lightning to triple-strike it.

weapons.name: Betsy's Wrath
weapons.source: Dropped by Betsy (Old One's Army Tier 3, post-Golem)
weapons.effect: Splashes defense reducing miasma!
weapons.desc: Betsy's Wrath is a Hardmode, post- Golem wand that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by Betsy during Tier 3 of the Old One's Army event. When used, it fires three fireballs that travel in arcs. The fireballs explode upon impact with an enemy or a block and inflict the Betsy's Curse debuff, which adds 40 armor penetration against affected entities for 10 seconds.

weapons.name: Lunic Eye
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires seeking energy bolts that cause enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Lunic Eye is a Hardmode classless weapon. When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
weapons.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

armor.name: Hydrothermic armor
armor.why: melee set with brimstone offensive bonuses

armor.desc: Reaver armor is a Hardmode armor set.

weapons.name: B-GSS: Nidhogg
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: first-listed primary ranged weapon at this tier
weapons.effect: Fires a devastating powerful high-velocity blast with absurd knockback
weapons.desc: The B-GSS: Nidhogg is a Hardmode ranged weapon. When used, it rapidly fires instant-traveling gauss shots with very slight inaccuracy. Gauss shots create a small lingering magnetic implosion which pulls in non-boss enemies, though only one can exist at a time.

weapons.name: Dead Sun's Wind
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires a concentrated blast of superheated cosmic plasma that explodes and can ricochet off blocks · Shots aggressively home in on enemies after being ricocheted · Consecutive hits cause larger explosions · Uses gel for ammo
weapons.desc: Dead Sun's Wind is a Hardmode flamethrower that uses Gel for ammunition. When used, it fires high-velocity blasts of cosmic plasma that cause explosions on enemy hits, each explosion dealing 150% of the weapon's damage and increasing in size with consecutive hits. The plasma blasts can also ricochet off tiles, after which they gain the ability to home in aggressively on nearby enemies.

weapons.name: Plague Tainted SMG
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Shoots Plague bullets that spawn drones on critical hits · Bullets deal more damage and knockback the closer the enemy is · Drones have a much higher crit chance upon hitting an enemy inflicted with Plague · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to fire a drone swarm
weapons.desc: The Plague Tainted SMG is a Hardmode gun. When used with its primary fire (⚒ Use / Attack), it converts all bullets into plague bullets that inflict the Plague debuff on hit, dealing 150% damage and knockback if the target is within 50 tiles of the player. Critical strikes from plague bullets fire a plague drone that homes in on enemies and explodes upon contact with an enemy or block, with a 75% chance to critically strike if the target is afflicted with the Plague debuff.

weapons.name: Vortexpopper
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires bubbles everywhere that pop into bullets
weapons.desc: The Vortexpopper is a Hardmode gun and the direct upgrade to the Xenopopper. When used, it fires a spread of bubbles from the gun, and extra bubbles off-screen from any direction. After a short delay, the bubbles will pop and fire a bullet towards the cursor.

weapons.name: Betsy's Wrath
weapons.source: Dropped by Betsy (Old One's Army Tier 3, post-Golem)
weapons.effect: Splashes defense reducing miasma!
weapons.desc: Betsy's Wrath is a Hardmode, post- Golem wand that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by Betsy during Tier 3 of the Old One's Army event. When used, it fires three fireballs that travel in arcs. The fireballs explode upon impact with an enemy or a block and inflict the Betsy's Curse debuff, which adds 40 armor penetration against affected entities for 10 seconds.

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Eye of Magnus is a Hardmode classless weapon that is an upgraded version of the Lunic Eye. When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
weapons.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Apoctosis Array
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Rapidly fires an array of ion blasts with heavy armor penetration that accelerate and explode · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to charge the blaster, restoring your mana until it reaches max · The more mana you restore, the stronger the arrow is when you release it · Charging for 90% of your max mana or more will reach max power · Holding this weapon disables the pickup of stars
weapons.desc: The Apoctosis Array is a Hardmode magic gun and the direct upgrade to the Ion Blaster. When used, it fires spreads of three blasts that have 40 armor penetration and explode on hit, dealing 30% base damage. Holding ⚷ Open / Activate causes the gun to charge up by restoring the player's mana at a rate of 2.5% every two frames.

weapons.name: Nebula Arcanum
weapons.source: Crafted at Ancient Manipulator
weapons.why: Fires slow homing orbs that spawn additional star projectiles.
weapons.effect: 'Conjure masses of astral energy to chase down your foes'
weapons.desc: The Nebula Arcanum is a Hardmode, post- Lunatic Cultist magic weapon that fires a swirling purple orb when used. The orb will slowly home in on enemies within a 50-tile range and bounce off blocks, hitting three times before exploding into 10–16 smaller shard projectiles that each deal 65% of the weapon's listed damage (45 base damage), inflict 80% of its knockback (base knockback of 4 (Weak)), and do not pierce. [ 1 ] All three hits do not have to be on the same target, as it will continue to home in on other enemies in range if its target dies before the third hit. If the projectile does not hit enemies three times, it will explode after 11 seconds.

weapons.name: Nebula Blaze
weapons.source: Crafted at Ancient Manipulator
weapons.why: Fires homing star projectiles with a chance to fire a stronger high-damage shot.
weapons.effect: 'From Orion's belt to the palm of your hand'
weapons.desc: The Nebula Blaze is a Hardmode, post- Lunatic Cultist magic weapon that inaccurately fires pink, high-velocity projectiles which home in on nearby enemies, with a 1/5 (20%) chance to fire a larger blue Nebula Blaze Ex projectile that deals 300% of the weapon's damage (390 base damage) and moves 60% faster.

weapons.name: Star Shower
weapons.source: Dropped by Astrum Deus
weapons.effect: Casts a spread of astral stars from the sky that converge at the cursor and spread the Astral Infection
weapons.desc: The Star Shower is a Hardmode spell tome that is dropped by Astrum Deus. When used, it summons a spread of 5 astral stars from the sky that quickly travel to meet at the cursor's location, then continue to fall in that direction. The stars do not pierce enemies but can go through tiles.

weapons.name: The Swarmer
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires a swarm of bees and wasps
weapons.desc: The Swarmer is a Hardmode magic gun and the direct upgrade to the Bee Gun and Wasp Gun. When used, it rapidly fires 2 homing bees and wasps per shot that dissipate upon contact with enemies or tiles.

weapons.name: Hive Pack
weapons.source: Dropped by the Queen Bee's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode
weapons.effect: Increases the strength of friendly bees
weapons.desc: The Hive Pack is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Queen Bee 's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While equipped, it grants a 1/2 (50%) chance of replacing friendly Bee projectiles with stronger Giant Bees. [ 1 ]

weapons.name: Betsy's Wrath
weapons.source: Dropped by Betsy (Old One's Army Tier 3, post-Golem)
weapons.why: Fires a projectile that reduces enemy defense and creates homing shards.
weapons.effect: Splashes defense reducing miasma!
weapons.desc: Betsy's Wrath is a Hardmode, post- Golem wand that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by Betsy during Tier 3 of the Old One's Army event. When used, it fires three fireballs that travel in arcs. The fireballs explode upon impact with an enemy or a block and inflict the Betsy's Curse debuff, which adds 40 armor penetration against affected entities for 10 seconds.

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Eye of Magnus is a Hardmode classless weapon that is an upgraded version of the Lunic Eye. When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
weapons.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

accessories.name: Soaring Insignia
accessories.source: Dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess
accessories.effect: Grants infinite wing and rocket boot flight · Increases flight and jump mobility

accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Critical strikes curse enemies with Bane that greatly scales off of your critical strike chance · When critically hit, enemies spread all debuffs they are afflicted with that are weaker than your Bane to nearby enemies · Critical strikes deal an additional 3% damage per debuff on the enemy · Current Bane damage: [DAMAGE] DPS
accessories.desc: Apollyon is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Abaddon. When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff. Additionally, critical strikes spread all debuffs inflicted on the hit enemy that are weaker than Bane to up to 10 enemies within an 87.5-tile range, and critical strikes deal 3% increased damage for every debuff inflicted on the enemy.

accessories.name: Arcane Flower
accessories.effect: 8% reduced mana cost · Automatically use mana potions when needed · Enemies are less likely to target you
accessories.desc: The Arcane Flower is a Hardmode accessory which combines the functionality of the Mana Flower and the aggro -reducing effect of the Putrid Scent.

accessories.name: Destroyer Emblem
accessories.effect: 10% increased damage · 8% increased critical strike chance
accessories.desc: The Destroyer Emblem is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory that gives the player 10% increased damage and 8% increased critical strike chance.

accessories.name: Eye of the Golem
accessories.effect: 10% increased critical strike chance
accessories.desc: The Eye of the Golem is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory that grants +10% critical strike chance. It has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being dropped by Golem.

accessories.name: Hive Pack
accessories.source: Dropped by the Queen Bee's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode
accessories.effect: Increases the strength of friendly bees
accessories.desc: The Hive Pack is a pre-Hardmode accessory that is always dropped from the Queen Bee 's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode. While equipped, it grants a 1/2 (50%) chance of replacing friendly Bee projectiles with stronger Giant Bees. [ 1 ]

accessories.name: The Swarmer
accessories.effect: Fires a swarm of bees and wasps
accessories.desc: The Swarmer is a Hardmode magic gun and the direct upgrade to the Bee Gun and Wasp Gun. When used, it rapidly fires 2 homing bees and wasps per shot that dissipate upon contact with enemies or tiles.

accessories.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
accessories.effect: Increases armor penetration by 10 · 10% increased damage
accessories.desc: The Sand Shark Tooth Necklace is a Hardmode accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

accessories.name: Sigil of Calamitas
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Increases maximum mana by 60 · 15% increased magic damage · Increases pickup range for mana stars
accessories.desc: The Sigil of Calamitas is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Celestial Emblem. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
accessories.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled
accessories.desc: The Ambrosial Ampoule is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Living Dew and Radiant Ooze. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Blood Pact
accessories.effect: Increases max HP by 25% · Healing Potions are 33% more effective · Grants immunity to Bleeding , Burning Blood and Heavy Bleeding
accessories.desc: The Blood Pact is an Expert Mode -exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by the Ravager. When equipped, it increases the player's maximum health by 25%, grants immunity to the Bleeding, Burning Blood & Heavy Bleeding debuffs, and increases the amount of health restored from drinking healing potions by 33%.

accessories.name: Bloom Stone
accessories.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'
accessories.desc: The Bloom Stone is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Plantera. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Deific Amulet

accessories.desc: The Deific Amulet is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star Veil. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.desc: The Frozen Shield is a Hardmode, post- Plantera shield that combines the functionalities of the Paladin's Shield and the Frozen Turtle Shell. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

accessories.desc: The Infected Jewel is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade of the Crown Jewel. It grants the following effects while equipped:

buffs.name: Super Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Super Healing Potion is a recovery potion that heals 200 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 60 seconds when used. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Super Mana Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Super Mana Potion is a recovery potion that restores 300 mana and inflicts the Mana Sickness debuff upon use. It is the most potent of all mana restoration items.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.desc: The Seafood Dinner is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: The extra survivability helps offset how punishing late-Hardmode mistakes can be for mage.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Mage has less room for mistakes, so the bonus defense matters a lot.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Lifeforce Potion is a buff potion that grants the Lifeforce buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Crystal Ball
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Wizard
buffs.why: Free Clairvoyance remains a baseline endgame mage habit before any serious fight.
buffs.desc: The Crystal Ball is a Hardmode furniture item which functions as a crafting station. It is purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC. Pressing ⚷ Open / Activate on a placed Crystal Ball grants the Clairvoyance buff and opens its crafting menu.

buffs.name: Magic Power Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Magic Power Potion is a buff potion which grants the Magic Power buff when consumed. The buff increases magic damage by 20%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Speeds up mana regeneration, so you stop to drink fewer mana potions.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Mana Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Mana Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff increases the rate at which the player's mana regenerates. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Soaring Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

weapons.name: Fuel Cell Bundle
weapons.source: Dropped by The Plaguebringer Goliath
weapons.effect: Releases a small, special variant of the plaguebringers
weapons.desc: The Fuel Cell Bundle is a Hardmode summon weapon that is dropped by The Plaguebringer Goliath. When used, it throws a small gravity-affected flask that deals no damage but summons a small and armed miniature Plaguebringer minion upon tile contact. The mini Plaguebringer stays at a certain distance from enemies to fire explosive plague missiles and occasionally a homing plague missile.

weapons.name: Stardust Cell Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at Ancient Manipulator
weapons.why: Summons Stardust Cell minions that fire homing projectiles and apply a stacking debuff.
weapons.effect: Summons a stardust cell to fight for you · 'Cultivate the most beautiful cellular infection'
weapons.desc: The Stardust Cell Staff is a Hardmode, post- Lunatic Cultist summon weapon that summons a Stardust Cell minion. It hovers near enemies, firing a homing mini-cell that attaches itself to the target, inflicting the Celled debuff to deal 20 damage per second for 5 seconds. [ 1 ] A maximum of 10 mini-cells can be attached to one target at a time, for a total of 200 damage per second. The Stardust Cell will teleport to enemies out of range.

weapons.name: Wither Blossoms Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons four decaying Plague flowers over your head
weapons.desc: The Wither Blossoms Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that is an upgrade to the Tundra Flame Blossoms Staff. When used, it summons up to four dark-colored flowers that orbit around the player, and fire homing bolts at nearby targets. The bolts travel through terrain, disappearing shortly after hitting an enemy and inflicting the Plague debuff.

weapons.name: Spikecrag Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by the Ravager
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons a bed of stalagmites to spray spikes at your enemies
weapons.desc: The Spikecrag Staff is a Hardmode sentry that is dropped by the Ravager. When used, it summons a Spikecrag sentry that attacks enemies by firing an intense upward spray of gravity-affected spikes; a total of 1 to 2 spikes are fired every 1/6th of a second.

weapons.name: Kaleidoscope
weapons.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light (summoned after Plantera)
weapons.why: Empress of Light drop giving one of the largest summon tag damage bonuses.
weapons.effect: 20 summon tag damage · 10% summon tag critical strike chance · Your summons will focus struck enemies
weapons.desc: The Kaleidoscope is a Hardmode, post- Plantera whip that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by the Empress of Light. It has a 20% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:

weapons.name: Betsy's Wrath
weapons.source: Dropped by Betsy (Old One's Army Tier 3, post-Golem)
weapons.effect: Splashes defense reducing miasma!
weapons.desc: Betsy's Wrath is a Hardmode, post- Golem wand that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by Betsy during Tier 3 of the Old One's Army event. When used, it fires three fireballs that travel in arcs. The fireballs explode upon impact with an enemy or a block and inflict the Betsy's Curse debuff, which adds 40 armor penetration against affected entities for 10 seconds.

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Eye of Magnus is a Hardmode classless weapon that is an upgraded version of the Lunic Eye. When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
weapons.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

armor.effect: Inferno effect when below 50% life · You emit a blazing explosion when you are hit · Helm: Enemies are more likely to target you · Melee attacks and projectiles cause chaos flames to erupt on enemy hits · Headgear: You fire a homing chaos flare when using ranged weapons every 0.33 seconds · Mask: Magic attacks summon damaging and healing flare orbs on hit · Helmet: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · 25% increased summon damage · Summons a hydrothermic vent to protect you · Hood: +110 maximum stealth · Rogue weapons unleash a volley of homing chaos flames around the player every 2 seconds
armor.desc: Hydrothermic armor is a Hardmode armor set.

armor.effect: Grants a plague dash which can slam through enemies without taking damage · Summons a lil' plaguebringer which swarms your foes with little bees · Friendly bees inflict Plague
armor.desc: Plaguebringer armor is a Hardmode armor set and an upgrade to the Bee armor set. While wearing the Plaguebringer Carapace, the player has a tank equipped behind them. While wearing all three set pieces, a motion blur afterimage is displayed while the player is walking, paired with additional trails of green dust while sprinting.

armor.name: Astral armor
armor.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 3 · 10% increased damage and critical strike chance · Whenever you crit an enemy, a barrage of stars will rain down · This effect has a 1 second cooldown before it can trigger again
armor.desc: Astral armor is a Hardmode armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits an afterimage effect.

armor.name: Reaver armor
armor.effect: Helm: Enemies are more likely to target you · Reduces the life regen lost from damage over time debuffs by 20% · 30% decreased movement speed and flight time · Grants Reaver Rage for 5 seconds after taking damage · Visage: Grants immunity to fall damage and allows constant jumping · 10% increased flight time and horizontal wing speed · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 50% faster · Reduces the cooldown of dashes by 33% · Headgear: Emits light and shows the location of treasure and ore · Enemies are less likely to target you and grants underwater breathing · Greatly enhances visibility in the abyss · Increased block placement & tool range by 7 · Increases pickup range for items
armor.desc: Reaver armor is a Hardmode armor set.

accessories.name: Betsy's Wings
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Angel Treads
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 12% increased movement speed and 10% increased flight time · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava · 'Extreme speed!'
accessories.desc: The Angel Treads are a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Terraspark Boots and Harpy Ring. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Empress Wings
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Fishron Wings
accessories.why: Flight, and faster movement in rain and water.
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Celestial Shell
accessories.why: All-round stats, plus werewolf at night and merfolk in water.
accessories.effect: Turns the holder into a werewolf at night · Turns the holder into a merfolk when entering water · Minor increase to damage, melee speed, · critical strike chance, life regeneration, · defense, mining speed, and minion knockback
accessories.desc: The Celestial Shell is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory that combines the stat-boosting powers of the Celestial Stone with the transformation powers of the Moon Shell, allowing both of their effects to happen simultaneously while taking only one accessory slot.

accessories.name: Heart of the Elements
accessories.effect: Summons all elementals to protect you · 'The heart of the world'
accessories.desc: The Heart of the Elements is a Hardmode accessory. It will summon all of the Elementals to assist the player and attack enemies.

accessories.name: Heartreach Potion
accessories.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
accessories.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
accessories.effect: Increases pickup range for life hearts
accessories.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

accessories.name: The Absorber
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing
accessories.desc: The Absorber is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Grand Gelatin, Baroclaw, and Giant Tortoise Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Asgard's Valor
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage
accessories.desc: The Asgard's Valor is a Hardmode shield accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Master Ninja Gear
accessories.why: Dash, wall climbing, and a 10% chance to dodge an attack.
accessories.effect: Allows the ability to climb walls and dash · Gives a chance to dodge attacks
accessories.desc: The Master Ninja Gear is a Hardmode, post- Plantera accessory that combines the abilities of the Black Belt, the Tabi, and the Tiger Climbing Gear. It allows the player to cling to and slide down vertical walls, quickly dash short distances by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right key, and offers a 1/10 (10%) chance to automatically dodge enemy attacks. There is a one-second cooldown period between dashes.

accessories.name: Shield of the High Ruler
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: +10 max life · Grants immunity to knockback and most debuffs · Grants an improved Shield of Cthulhu dash · Bonking an enemy halves dash cooldown time · Facing a projectile when it hits you reduces its damage by 15% · 'For the fate of the kingdom'
accessories.desc: The Shield of the High Ruler is a Hardmode shield accessory and the direct upgrade to the Shield of Cthulhu. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Interstellar Stompers
accessories.effect: 6% increased movement speed, 20% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Hold ▼ Down to increase your maximum fall speed · Pressing Interstellar Stompers Hotkey while midair charges up a superspeed slam over 0.33 seconds · While falling, you ram through enemies and don't take contact damage · Once you hit the ground, you create an explosion at your feet · The explosion scales in both damage and size the longer you slam for · Temporary 40% increased jump speed after slamming into the ground
accessories.desc: The Interstellar Stompers are an Expert Mode -exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Astrum Aureus. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Soaring Insignia
accessories.source: Dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess
accessories.effect: Grants infinite wing and rocket boot flight · Increases flight and jump mobility
accessories.desc: The Soaring Insignia is a Hardmode, post- Plantera accessory that boosts the player's flight and movement abilities. It has the following effects:

accessories.name: Papyrus Scarab
accessories.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Increases your summon damage by 15% and the knockback of your minions
accessories.desc: The Papyrus Scarab is a Hardmode, post- Plantera accessory that combines the bonuses of the Necromantic Scroll and the Hercules Beetle. When equipped, it increases the damage of summon weapons by 15%, increases their knockback by 2, and increases the player's maximum number of minions by one.

accessories.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
accessories.effect: Increases armor penetration by 10 · 10% increased damage
accessories.desc: The Sand Shark Tooth Necklace is a Hardmode accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

accessories.name: Star-Tainted Generator
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 2, and summon damage by 7% · Minion attacks spawn astral explosions and inflict several debuffs · Grants immunity to Irradiated · Does not stack with downgrades
accessories.desc: The Star-Tainted Generator is a Hardmode accessory that combines the effects of the Jelly-Charged Battery, Nuclear Fuel Rod, and Starbuster Core. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Statis' Curse
accessories.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 3, and summon damage by 12% · Increased minion knockback · Minion attacks inflict Shadowflame , and grants immunity to Shadowflame · Does not stack with downgrades
accessories.desc: The Statis' Curse is a Hardmode accessory and an upgrade to the Statis' Blessing and The First Shadowflame. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
accessories.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled
accessories.desc: The Ambrosial Ampoule is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Living Dew and Radiant Ooze. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Blood Pact
accessories.effect: Increases max HP by 25% · Healing Potions are 33% more effective · Grants immunity to Bleeding , Burning Blood and Heavy Bleeding
accessories.desc: The Blood Pact is an Expert Mode -exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by the Ravager. When equipped, it increases the player's maximum health by 25%, grants immunity to the Bleeding, Burning Blood & Heavy Bleeding debuffs, and increases the amount of health restored from drinking healing potions by 33%.

accessories.name: Bloom Stone
accessories.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'
accessories.desc: The Bloom Stone is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Plantera. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Deific Amulet
accessories.effect: Releases a burst of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect
accessories.desc: The Deific Amulet is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star Veil. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Frozen Shield
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Puts a shell around the owner when below 50% life that reduces damage by 25% · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when above 25% life
accessories.desc: The Frozen Shield is a Hardmode, post- Plantera shield that combines the functionalities of the Paladin's Shield and the Frozen Turtle Shell. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

accessories.name: Infected Jewel
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: +1 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 4 HP/s · Jump-starts regeneration after a damaging debuff ends · 'A beautiful gemstone tarnished by spaceborne rot'
accessories.desc: The Infected Jewel is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade of the Crown Jewel. It grants the following effects while equipped:

buffs.name: Super Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Super Healing Potion is a recovery potion that heals 200 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 60 seconds when used. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.desc: The Seafood Dinner is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: The damage reduction is especially welcome in a phase full of punishing optional content.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heart of the Elements
buffs.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
buffs.station: Ancient Manipulator
buffs.desc: The Heart of the Elements is a Hardmode accessory. It will summon all of the Elementals to assist the player and attack enemies.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: You are still fragile even with summons doing the work, so extra defense is welcome.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Lifeforce Potion is a buff potion that grants the Lifeforce buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Bewitching Table
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Dungeon
buffs.why: A free extra minion remains part of every serious endgame summoner setup.
buffs.desc: The Bewitching Table is a furniture item found naturally placed in the Dungeon and can be obtained by fishing in the Dungeon. In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Witch Doctor for 10 GC if the Wizard is present. It emits light when placed.

buffs.name: Flask of Brimstone
buffs.source: Crafted at an Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.desc: The Flask of Brimstone is a Hardmode flask. Upon consumption, it grants the Weapon Imbue: Brimstone buff, which causes melee, whip, and rogue weapons to inflict the Brimstone Flames debuff.

buffs.name: Flask of Venom
buffs.source: Brewed at Imbuing Station
buffs.why: Coats melee hits with Acid Venom.
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.desc: The Flask of Venom is a Hardmode, post- Plantera flask that causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Acid Venom debuff on hit for 5–9 seconds, which deals 30 damage per second to enemies and prevents health regeneration. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.name: Summoning Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: The extra minion slot is too valuable to skip, even in the earliest summoner boss prep.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Summoning Potion is a buff potion which grants the Summoning buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum number of minions by 1. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: War Table
buffs.source: Dropped by the Dark Mage and Ogre during the Old One's Army
buffs.why: Table buff that boosts minion damage.
buffs.desc: The War Table is an animated furniture item which fulfills a house's table requirement that is dropped by the Dark Mage and the Ogre during the Old One's Army event, with a 1/2 (50%) / 1/1 (100%) chance during Tier 1, and a 1/8 (12.5%) / 1/4 (25%) chance during Tier 3.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Soaring Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Releases a swarm of angry Plague bees · Stealth strikes spawn more bees and generate a larger explosion
weapons.desc: The Plaguenade is a Hardmode bomb. It is an explosive projectile that release 20 plague-infected bees upon explosion. Both the explosion and the bees inflict the Plague debuff on contact.
