weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Throws daggers that explode and split after a while and spread the Astral Infection · Stealth strike splits more with a devastating explosion that sucks enemies in
weapons.desc: The Radiant Star is a Hardmode dagger that is a direct upgrade to the Prismalline. When used, it throws an astral dagger that is not affected by gravity and pierces 3 times. Shortly after it is thrown, it causes a lingering explosion and splits into 3 copies of itself that home in on the closest enemy and deal half of the weapon's damage.

weapons.name: Regulus Riot
weapons.source: Dropped by Astrum Deus
weapons.why: high sustained thrown DPS; powerful stealth-strike option
weapons.effect: Fires a swift homing disk that inflicts Astral Infection · Stealth strikes explode into energy stars
weapons.desc: The Regulus Riot is a Hardmode rogue weapon that is dropped by Astrum Deus. When used, it fires a spinning disk towards the cursor's position, traveling a moderate distance before dissipating. If there are enemies nearby, the disk will charge towards the nearest enemy and hit up to 3 times.

weapons.name: Shard of Antumbra
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.why: homing shadow shards, strong single-target; homing shards on stealth strike
weapons.effect: Throws a cosmic javelin that sticks into enemies and tiles, creating a small rift nearby on enemy hits · After hitting a target, it will charge with energy and teleport to the rift, aiming itself at the nearest target · Stealth strikes create a multitude of rifts to spawn additional javelins upon teleporting
weapons.desc: The Shard of Antumbra is a Hardmode rogue javelin. It pierces infinitely and travels significant distances before being affected by gravity. Its damage is decreased by 10% every time it pierces an enemy.

weapons.name: Star of Destruction
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.why: explosive burst damage, and a heavy stealth-strike burst
weapons.effect: Throws a fan of cosmic bolts that meld together into a star of destruction · The explosive star will slowly follow your cursor until it expires or hits an enemy · Upon running out of time, the star will burst into a huge explosion that deals increased damage · Stealth strikes throw additional bolts that converge into a faster star that can pierce, exploding on every hit
weapons.desc: The Star of Destruction is a Hardmode bomb. On use, it throws a large spread of cosmic bolts which converge into a bomb. The bomb weakly follows the cursor, exploding when it hits an enemy or after 5 seconds.

weapons.name: Duke's Decapitator
weapons.source: Dropped by Duke Fishron
weapons.effect: Throws a hydro axe which shreds enemies when it comes into contact with them · The faster the axe is spinning, the more times it hits before disappearing · Stealth strikes emit short-ranged bubbles
weapons.desc: Duke's Decapitator is a Hardmode rogue weapon that is dropped by Duke Fishron. When used, it throws a fast-spinning axe that slowly decelerates to a stop and breaks shortly after. It will stick onto an enemy upon contact, dealing damage.

weapons.name: Leviathan Teeth
weapons.source: Dropped by Leviathan and Anahita
weapons.effect: Rapidly throws a spread of teeth that stick to enemies · After sticking to an enemy, the teeth will gouge through them and shoot out the other side · Stealth strikes create a clamping jaw of teeth to maul your foes
weapons.desc: The Leviathan Teeth are a Hardmode dagger that is dropped by Leviathan and Anahita. When used, they rapidly throw an inaccurate tight spread of 2 gravity-affected teeth that inflict the Heavy Bleeding debuff on contact with enemies and stick to them. After sticking for 2 seconds, teeth will launch out the other side of the enemy, dealing an additional burst of damage.

weapons.name: Betsy's Wrath
weapons.source: Dropped by Betsy (Old One's Army Tier 3, post-Golem)
weapons.effect: Splashes defense reducing miasma!
weapons.desc: Betsy's Wrath is a Hardmode, post- Golem wand that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by Betsy during Tier 3 of the Old One's Army event. When used, it fires three fireballs that travel in arcs. The fireballs explode upon impact with an enemy or a block and inflict the Betsy's Curse debuff, which adds 40 armor penetration against affected entities for 10 seconds.

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Eye of Magnus is a Hardmode classless weapon that is an upgraded version of the Lunic Eye. When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
weapons.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

armor.name: Hydrothermic armor
armor.why: melee set with brimstone offensive bonuses
armor.effect: Inferno effect when below 50% life · You emit a blazing explosion when you are hit · Helm: Enemies are more likely to target you · Melee attacks and projectiles cause chaos flames to erupt on enemy hits · Headgear: You fire a homing chaos flare when using ranged weapons every 0.33 seconds · Mask: Magic attacks summon damaging and healing flare orbs on hit · Helmet: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · 25% increased summon damage · Summons a hydrothermic vent to protect you · Hood: +110 maximum stealth · Rogue weapons unleash a volley of homing chaos flames around the player every 2 seconds
armor.desc: Hydrothermic armor is a Hardmode armor set.

armor.name: Astral armor
armor.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 3 · 10% increased damage and critical strike chance · Whenever you crit an enemy, a barrage of stars will rain down · This effect has a 1 second cooldown before it can trigger again
armor.desc: Astral armor is a Hardmode armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits an afterimage effect.

armor.name: Reaver armor
armor.effect: Helm: Enemies are more likely to target you · Reduces the life regen lost from damage over time debuffs by 20% · 30% decreased movement speed and flight time · Grants Reaver Rage for 5 seconds after taking damage · Visage: Grants immunity to fall damage and allows constant jumping · 10% increased flight time and horizontal wing speed · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 50% faster · Reduces the cooldown of dashes by 33% · Headgear: Emits light and shows the location of treasure and ore · Enemies are less likely to target you and grants underwater breathing · Greatly enhances visibility in the abyss · Increased block placement & tool range by 7 · Increases pickup range for items
armor.desc: Reaver armor is a Hardmode armor set.

accessories.name: Betsy's Wings
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Angel Treads
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 12% increased movement speed and 10% increased flight time · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava · 'Extreme speed!'
accessories.desc: The Angel Treads are a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Terraspark Boots and Harpy Ring. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Empress Wings
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Fishron Wings
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Celestial Shell
accessories.effect: Turns the holder into a werewolf at night · Turns the holder into a merfolk when entering water · Minor increase to damage, melee speed, · critical strike chance, life regeneration, · defense, mining speed, and minion knockback
accessories.desc: The Celestial Shell is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory that combines the stat-boosting powers of the Celestial Stone with the transformation powers of the Moon Shell, allowing both of their effects to happen simultaneously while taking only one accessory slot.

accessories.name: The Absorber
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing
accessories.desc: The Absorber is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Grand Gelatin, Baroclaw, and Giant Tortoise Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Asgard's Valor
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage
accessories.desc: The Asgard's Valor is a Hardmode shield accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Master Ninja Gear
accessories.effect: Allows the ability to climb walls and dash · Gives a chance to dodge attacks
accessories.desc: The Master Ninja Gear is a Hardmode, post- Plantera accessory that combines the abilities of the Black Belt, the Tabi, and the Tiger Climbing Gear. It allows the player to cling to and slide down vertical walls, quickly dash short distances by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right key, and offers a 1/10 (10%) chance to automatically dodge enemy attacks. There is a one-second cooldown period between dashes.

accessories.name: Shield of the High Ruler
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: +10 max life · Grants immunity to knockback and most debuffs · Grants an improved Shield of Cthulhu dash · Bonking an enemy halves dash cooldown time · Facing a projectile when it hits you reduces its damage by 15% · 'For the fate of the kingdom'
accessories.desc: The Shield of the High Ruler is a Hardmode shield accessory and the direct upgrade to the Shield of Cthulhu. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Interstellar Stompers
accessories.effect: 6% increased movement speed, 20% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Hold ▼ Down to increase your maximum fall speed · Pressing Interstellar Stompers Hotkey while midair charges up a superspeed slam over 0.33 seconds · While falling, you ram through enemies and don't take contact damage · Once you hit the ground, you create an explosion at your feet · The explosion scales in both damage and size the longer you slam for · Temporary 40% increased jump speed after slamming into the ground
accessories.desc: The Interstellar Stompers are an Expert Mode -exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Astrum Aureus. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Soaring Insignia
accessories.source: Dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess
accessories.effect: Grants infinite wing and rocket boot flight · Increases flight and jump mobility
accessories.desc: The Soaring Insignia is a Hardmode, post- Plantera accessory that boosts the player's flight and movement abilities. It has the following effects:

accessories.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
accessories.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled
accessories.desc: The Ambrosial Ampoule is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Living Dew and Radiant Ooze. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Blood Pact
accessories.effect: Increases max HP by 25% · Healing Potions are 33% more effective · Grants immunity to Bleeding , Burning Blood and Heavy Bleeding
accessories.desc: The Blood Pact is an Expert Mode -exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by the Ravager. When equipped, it increases the player's maximum health by 25%, grants immunity to the Bleeding, Burning Blood & Heavy Bleeding debuffs, and increases the amount of health restored from drinking healing potions by 33%.

accessories.name: Bloom Stone
accessories.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'
accessories.desc: The Bloom Stone is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Plantera. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Deific Amulet
accessories.why: stacks several defensive effects in one slot
accessories.effect: Releases a burst of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect
accessories.desc: The Deific Amulet is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star Veil. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Frozen Shield
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Puts a shell around the owner when below 50% life that reduces damage by 25% · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when above 25% life
accessories.desc: The Frozen Shield is a Hardmode, post- Plantera shield that combines the functionalities of the Paladin's Shield and the Frozen Turtle Shell. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

accessories.name: Infected Jewel
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: +1 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 4 HP/s · Jump-starts regeneration after a damaging debuff ends · 'A beautiful gemstone tarnished by spaceborne rot'
accessories.desc: The Infected Jewel is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade of the Crown Jewel. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Apollyon
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Critical strikes curse enemies with Bane that greatly scales off of your critical strike chance · When critically hit, enemies spread all debuffs they are afflicted with that are weaker than your Bane to nearby enemies · Critical strikes deal an additional 3% damage per debuff on the enemy · Current Bane damage: [DAMAGE] DPS
accessories.desc: Apollyon is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Abaddon. When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff. Additionally, critical strikes spread all debuffs inflicted on the hit enemy that are weaker than Bane to up to 10 enemies within an 87.5-tile range, and critical strikes deal 3% increased damage for every debuff inflicted on the enemy.

accessories.name: Dark Matter Sheath
accessories.effect: +10 maximum stealth · Stealth generation is boosted while moving if not attacking · Stealth strikes only expend 50% of your max stealth · 6% increased rogue damage and rogue crit chance
accessories.desc: The Dark Matter Sheath is a Hardmode rogue accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Destroyer Emblem
accessories.effect: 10% increased damage · 8% increased critical strike chance
accessories.desc: The Destroyer Emblem is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory that gives the player 10% increased damage and 8% increased critical strike chance.

accessories.name: Eye of the Golem
accessories.effect: 10% increased critical strike chance
accessories.desc: The Eye of the Golem is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory that grants +10% critical strike chance. It has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being dropped by Golem.

accessories.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
accessories.effect: Increases armor penetration by 10 · 10% increased damage
accessories.desc: The Sand Shark Tooth Necklace is a Hardmode accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

accessories.name: Abyssal Mirror
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Enemies are less likely to target you, even in the abyss · Generate stealth 25% faster when standing still and 12% faster while moving · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Dodging an attack restores stealth and releases a cloud that damages and stuns nearby enemies · 'Light does not reach the depths of the ocean'
accessories.desc: The Abyssal Mirror is a Hardmode rogue accessory and the direct upgrade to the Mirage Mirror. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Glove of Precision
accessories.source: Purchased from Bandit for 48 after Plantera has been defeated
accessories.effect: Decreases rogue attack speed by 15% · Increases rogue damage and critical strike chance by 10%, and velocity by 15%
accessories.desc: The Glove of Precision is a Hardmode rogue accessory that is sold by the Bandit for 48 after Plantera has been defeated. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

accessories.name: Vampiric Talisman
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Rogue critical strikes steal enemy life · Stealth strikes grant 15% critical strike chance and increased lifesteal to non-stealth strikes for 10 seconds · Stealth strikes inflict Heavy Bleeding and Armor Crunch , and deal 8% more damage · 'Possessing the talisman makes you yearn for blood'
accessories.desc: The Vampiric Talisman is a Hardmode rogue accessory. When equipped, it causes rogue critical hits to steal 1.5% of their damage (rounded down) in health. Additionally, it increases stealth strike damage by 8% and causes all stealth strikes to inflict Armor Crunch for 2.5 seconds and Heavy Bleeding for 5 seconds.

buffs.name: Super Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Super Healing Potion is a recovery potion that heals 200 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 60 seconds when used. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Candles
buffs.desc: Candles are furniture items that emit light. The Calamity Mod currently adds twenty-five types of candles to the game, with nineteen corresponding to specific sets of furniture, two acting as upgrades to the Water Candle and Peace Candle, and the remaining four being purchasable from the Wizard.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.desc: The Seafood Dinner is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Lifeforce Potion is a buff potion that grants the Lifeforce buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Flask of Brimstone
buffs.source: Crafted at an Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.desc: The Flask of Brimstone is a Hardmode flask. Upon consumption, it grants the Weapon Imbue: Brimstone buff, which causes melee, whip, and rogue weapons to inflict the Brimstone Flames debuff.

buffs.name: Flask of Venom
buffs.source: Brewed at Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.desc: The Flask of Venom is a Hardmode, post- Plantera flask that causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Acid Venom debuff on hit for 5–9 seconds, which deals 30 damage per second to enemies and prevents health regeneration. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Shadow Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Shadow Potion is a Pre-Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Shadow buff, which provides the following effects:

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Soaring Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.effect: Releases a burst of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect
items.desc: The Deific Amulet is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star Veil. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Frozen Shield
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Puts a shell around the owner when below 50% life that reduces damage by 25% · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when above 25% life
items.desc: The Frozen Shield is a Hardmode, post- Plantera shield that combines the functionalities of the Paladin's Shield and the Frozen Turtle Shell. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

items.name: Infected Jewel
items.why: Use on Astrum Deus.
items.effect: +1 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 4 HP/s · Jump-starts regeneration after a damaging debuff ends · 'A beautiful gemstone tarnished by spaceborne rot'
items.desc: The Infected Jewel is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade of the Crown Jewel. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Celestial Shell
items.effect: Turns the holder into a werewolf at night · Turns the holder into a merfolk when entering water · Minor increase to damage, melee speed, · critical strike chance, life regeneration, · defense, mining speed, and minion knockback
items.desc: The Celestial Shell is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory that combines the stat-boosting powers of the Celestial Stone with the transformation powers of the Moon Shell, allowing both of their effects to happen simultaneously while taking only one accessory slot.

items.name: The Absorber
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing
items.desc: The Absorber is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Grand Gelatin, Baroclaw, and Giant Tortoise Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Apollyon
items.effect: Critical strikes curse enemies with Bane that greatly scales off of your critical strike chance · When critically hit, enemies spread all debuffs they are afflicted with that are weaker than your Bane to nearby enemies · Critical strikes deal an additional 3% damage per debuff on the enemy · Current Bane damage: [DAMAGE] DPS
items.desc: Apollyon is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Abaddon. When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff. Additionally, critical strikes spread all debuffs inflicted on the hit enemy that are weaker than Bane to up to 10 enemies within an 87.5-tile range, and critical strikes deal 3% increased damage for every debuff inflicted on the enemy.

items.name: Dark Matter Sheath
items.effect: +10 maximum stealth · Stealth generation is boosted while moving if not attacking · Stealth strikes only expend 50% of your max stealth · 6% increased rogue damage and rogue crit chance
items.desc: The Dark Matter Sheath is a Hardmode rogue accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Destroyer Emblem
items.effect: 10% increased damage · 8% increased critical strike chance
items.desc: The Destroyer Emblem is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory that gives the player 10% increased damage and 8% increased critical strike chance.

items.name: Eye of the Golem
items.why: This grants critical strike damage.
items.effect: 10% increased critical strike chance
items.desc: The Eye of the Golem is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory that grants +10% critical strike chance. It has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being dropped by Golem.

items.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
items.effect: Increases armor penetration by 10 · 10% increased damage
items.desc: The Sand Shark Tooth Necklace is a Hardmode accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

items.name: Abyssal Mirror
items.effect: Enemies are less likely to target you, even in the abyss · Generate stealth 25% faster when standing still and 12% faster while moving · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Dodging an attack restores stealth and releases a cloud that damages and stuns nearby enemies · 'Light does not reach the depths of the ocean'
items.desc: The Abyssal Mirror is a Hardmode rogue accessory and the direct upgrade to the Mirage Mirror. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Glove of Precision
items.effect: Decreases rogue attack speed by 15% · Increases rogue damage and critical strike chance by 10%, and velocity by 15%
items.desc: The Glove of Precision is a Hardmode rogue accessory that is sold by the Bandit for 48 after Plantera has been defeated. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

items.name: Vampiric Talisman
items.effect: Rogue critical strikes steal enemy life · Stealth strikes grant 15% critical strike chance and increased lifesteal to non-stealth strikes for 10 seconds · Stealth strikes inflict Heavy Bleeding and Armor Crunch , and deal 8% more damage · 'Possessing the talisman makes you yearn for blood'
items.desc: The Vampiric Talisman is a Hardmode rogue accessory. When equipped, it causes rogue critical hits to steal 1.5% of their damage (rounded down) in health. Additionally, it increases stealth strike damage by 8% and causes all stealth strikes to inflict Armor Crunch for 2.5 seconds and Heavy Bleeding for 5 seconds.

weapons.name: Ark of the Elements
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: primary melee weapon with high true-melee DPS
weapons.effect: ⚒ Use / Attack to perform a 5-swing combo that ends by throwing the blade · Releasing while the blade is out will deal extra damage · ⚷ Open / Activate to snip out the scissor blades in front of you · Hitting an enemy with it will parry them, granting you brief invulnerability · You can parry projectiles to make them deal 60 less damage for a short period · Parrying will empower the next 10 swings of the sword, letting you use both blades at once · A heavenly pair of blades infused with the essence of Terraria, powerful enough to cut through the fabric of reality
weapons.desc: The Ark of the Elements is a post- Moon Lord melee weapon that is the penultimate upgrade to the Fractured Ark. Holding ⚒ Use / Attack (default: Left Click) performs a five-swing combo of an upwards slash followed by a downwards one that shoots a fast solar needle alongside an arc of four homing elemental glass stars, repeating the last two swings once, and then following it up with a medium-ranged throw, where the ark will be sent out spinning in the direction of the player's mouse, before coming back to them.

weapons.name: Greatsword of Judgement
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires a piercing energy wave that releases homing stars as it flies · Hits with the blade summon two stronger stars from behind you
weapons.desc: The Greatsword of Judgement is a post- Moon Lord broadsword with a custom swing animation. When swung, it fires a large energy wave that slows down as it travels and pierces infinitely, but loses 12% damage per hit. The wave spawns 2 homing stars that deal 35% base damage and pierce once.

weapons.name: Lightspeed
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Unleash a flurry of stabs which build Elemental Mastery on hit · Elemental Mastery is lost over time if it has not been gained for a few seconds · Press ⚷ Open / Activate with maximum Elemental Mastery to dash toward your cursor · Hitting an enemy during the dash refunds some Elemental Mastery
weapons.desc: The Lightspeed is a post- Moon Lord shortsword that autoswings. When used, it rapidly thrusts in a flurry of stabs straight ahead, piercing infinitely. Hitting enemies with stabs builds up Elemental Mastery, a resource that dissipates slowly over time, but briefly stops anytime it is gained.

weapons.name: Meowmere
weapons.source: Dropped by Moon Lord
weapons.why: Fires bouncing wall-piercing cat-head projectiles on swing.
weapons.desc: The Meowmere is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord. When swung, it fires a cat head projectile with a visual rainbow trail every 0.23 seconds. The cat head deals 125% of the weapon's damage (250 base damage), is affected by gravity, and can pierce enemies or bounce off blocks up to four times.

weapons.name: Stellar Contempt
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Throws a heavy, gravity-affected hammer that will return to you after striking an enemy · Consecutive hits call down more and more lunar flares from the sky · After hitting five times, the hammer supercharges with lunar energy to pulverize your target
weapons.desc: The Stellar Contempt is a post- Moon Lord melee weapon and the direct upgrade to the Fallen Paladin's Hammer. When used, it throws a fast gravity-affected hammer that passes through tiles. Upon hitting an enemy, it slows down and starts returning to the player.

armor.name: Solar Flare armor
armor.why: 12% less damage taken, plus charges that let you dash through enemies.
armor.effect: Reduces damage taken by 12% · Solar shields charge over time to protect you & let you dash · A charge is used to damage enemies you touch · Consumed charges explode & damage enemies
armor.desc: Solar Flare armor is a Hardmode, post- Moon Lord melee armor set consisting of the Solar Flare Helmet, Solar Flare Breastplate, and Solar Flare Leggings.

armor.name: Astral armor
armor.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 3 · 10% increased damage and critical strike chance · Whenever you crit an enemy, a barrage of stars will rain down · This effect has a 1 second cooldown before it can trigger again
armor.desc: Astral armor is a Hardmode armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits an afterimage effect.

accessories.name: Eye of Magnus
accessories.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
accessories.desc: The Eye of Magnus is a Hardmode classless weapon that is an upgraded version of the Lunic Eye. When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

accessories.name: Relic of Deliverance
accessories.effect: Using ⚒ Use / Attack mounts you on the spear; holding ⚒ Use / Attack revvs the spear, slowing you down · Release to launch yourself at high speeds, halved while a boss is alive · Losing too much speed while charging will bust the charge, resetting your speed · The dash allows you to ram through enemies and travel through tiles · Being inside tiles for too long will warp you back to where you entered · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to dismount · Holding out the spear heavily reduces the damage of all summons · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats · Vengeance fueled me, I had no thought other than exactment. · The dragon took everything from me, leaving my broken pieces strewn on the ground. · But when I danced by Her side, I knew there was something still worth fighting for.
accessories.desc: The Relic of Deliverance is a post- Moon Lord classless weapon that is dropped by the Guardian Commander. When used, it mounts the player on the spear, which can be freely turned. Right-clicking dismounts the spear.

accessories.name: Rod of Discord
accessories.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
accessories.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

accessories.name: Celestial Starboard
accessories.why: The fastest wings in the game, with the longest flight time.
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Press Down to toggle hover · Press Up to deactivate hover · Hold Up to boost faster! · 'The more you know'
accessories.desc: The Celestial Starboard is a Hardmode, post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory. In addition to granting remarkable flight capabilities, it has both hover and upwards boost capability. At its top speed, it travels at 82 mph horizontal, 115 mph vertical, and 51 mph while falling.

accessories.name: Moon Walkers
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 2.67 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Great · Max vertical speed: Great · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Good · 24% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Hee hee!'
accessories.desc: Moon Walkers are a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Angel Treads. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Solar Wings
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Celestial Shell
accessories.why: All-round stats, plus werewolf at night and merfolk in water.
accessories.effect: Turns the holder into a werewolf at night · Turns the holder into a merfolk when entering water · Minor increase to damage, melee speed, · critical strike chance, life regeneration, · defense, mining speed, and minion knockback
accessories.desc: The Celestial Shell is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory that combines the stat-boosting powers of the Celestial Stone with the transformation powers of the Moon Shell, allowing both of their effects to happen simultaneously while taking only one accessory slot.

accessories.name: The Absorber
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing
accessories.desc: The Absorber is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Grand Gelatin, Baroclaw, and Giant Tortoise Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: The Community
accessories.effect: 'The heart of (most of) the Terraria community' · Thank you to all of our supporters who made this mod a reality!
accessories.desc: The Community is an accessory that is dropped by Leviathan and Anahita. When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

accessories.name: Asgard's Valor
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage
accessories.desc: The Asgard's Valor is a Hardmode shield accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Statis' Ninja Belt
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 10% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.6x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws
accessories.desc: The Statis' Ninja Belt is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Master Ninja Gear and Frog Gear. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.effect: +10 max life · Grants immunity to knockback and most debuffs · Grants an improved Shield of Cthulhu dash · Bonking an enemy halves dash cooldown time · Facing a projectile when it hits you reduces its damage by 15% · 'For the fate of the kingdom'
accessories.desc: The Shield of the High Ruler is a Hardmode shield accessory and the direct upgrade to the Shield of Cthulhu. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Soaring Insignia
accessories.source: Dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess
accessories.effect: Grants infinite wing and rocket boot flight · Increases flight and jump mobility
accessories.desc: The Soaring Insignia is a Hardmode, post- Plantera accessory that boosts the player's flight and movement abilities. It has the following effects:

accessories.name: Fire Gauntlet
accessories.why: Melee damage, speed and knockback, and sets enemies on fire. Upgrades from Mechanical Glove.
accessories.effect: Increases melee knockback and melee attacks inflict fire damage · 12% increased melee damage and speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons · Increases the size of melee weapons
accessories.desc: The Fire Gauntlet is a Hardmode, post- mechanical bosses accessory. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

accessories.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
accessories.effect: Increases armor penetration by 10 · 10% increased damage
accessories.desc: The Sand Shark Tooth Necklace is a Hardmode accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

accessories.name: Warbanner of the Righteous
accessories.effect: Multiplies all damage based on how close you are to enemies · Maximum damage boost is 15%, minimum damage boost is -15% · Emit a blazing aura that burns and repels nearby enemies with Holy Flames · Enemies take increasing damage the closer they are to you and the longer they are near you · Effects are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled
accessories.desc: The Warbanner of the Righteous is an Expert Mode -exclusive post- Moon Lord accessory dropped by the Profaned Guardians. While equipped, it increases all damage depending on how close the player is to an enemy. The boost scales from -15% to +15%.

accessories.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
accessories.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled
accessories.desc: The Ambrosial Ampoule is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Living Dew and Radiant Ooze. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Bloom Stone
accessories.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'
accessories.desc: The Bloom Stone is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Plantera. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.desc: The Deific Amulet is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star Veil. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.desc: The Frozen Shield is a Hardmode, post- Plantera shield that combines the functionalities of the Paladin's Shield and the Frozen Turtle Shell. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

buffs.name: Plenty Satisfied
buffs.desc: Well Fed, Plenty Satisfied, and Exquisitely Stuffed are buffs granted to the player when they consume food, which provide general stat bonuses that vary in potency and duration depending on the food item consumed. In Expert Mode, health regeneration will only be fully effective while the player is under the effects of one of these buffs. While one of these buffs is active in a The Constant or Zenith special world seed, the player will also be temporarily immune to hunger for the buff's duration.

weapons.name: Barracuda Gun
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: primary ranged recommendation at this tier
weapons.effect: Fires four barracudas that latch onto enemies and shred them
weapons.desc: The Barracuda Gun is a post- Moon Lord ranged weapon that is an upgraded version of the Piranha Gun. Holding left-click will fire four barracudas that latch on to enemies and deal continuous damage as long as left-click is held down. After an enemy dies, the barracudas will automatically latch onto other enemies in range.

weapons.name: Clockwork Bow
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Hold ⚒ Use / Attack to load up to six precision bolts · The more precision bolts are loaded, the harder they hit
weapons.desc: The Clockwork Bow is a post- Moon Lord bow. When used, it slowly loads up to 6 precision bolts. Each bolt loaded reduces the time taken to load the next bolt by 5%.

weapons.name: Planetary Annihilation
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a storm of 7 arrows from the sky · Wooden arrows are converted into homing energy bolts
weapons.desc: The Planetary Annihilation is a post- Moon Lord bow that rains arrows from the sky in groups of seven. It converts Wooden Arrows into rainbow blasts that home in on enemies. Each set of bolts consists of a Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Indigo, and Violet bolt which all act identically to each other and are fired in a random order from the sky.

weapons.name: Prideful Hunter's Planar Ripper
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Every fourth shot deals 135% damage · Converts musket balls into Electrified lightning bolts · Lightning bolts travel extremely fast and explode on enemy kills · Lightning bolt crits grant a stacking speed boost to the player · This stacks up to 20 percent bonus movement speed and acceleration · The boost will reset if the player holds a different item · 50% chance to save ammo
weapons.desc: The Prideful Hunter's Planar Ripper is a post- Moon Lord gun. When used, it rapidly fires bullets. Musket balls turn into fast lightning bolts which do not pierce enemies or tiles, inflict the Electrified debuff, and explode when enemies are killed.

weapons.name: Superradiant Slaughterer
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Hold ⚒ Use / Attack to rev up an elemental buzzsaw that deals close-range damage · Release ⚒ Use / Attack to fire the buzzsaw which bounces off tiles, releasing homing bolts when returning depending on hits · Revving up the saw increases its damage and allows it to pierce more enemies · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to eject a lingering buzzsaw towards the cursor on a 6 second cooldown · Double ⚷ Open / Activate to rapidly propel yourself in the direction you are moving · During the cooldown, buzzsaws home to the cursor and constantly release homing bolts while returning · 'No one knows how it turns blood into rainbows...'
weapons.desc: The Superradiant Slaughterer is a post- Moon Lord ranged weapon. When held, it charges up a handheld buzzsaw which deals 150% damage on contact. As continuously held, the buzzsaw grows to a medium size after 0.5 seconds and full size after 2 seconds, as well as linearly scaling from 100% to 500% damage and 1 to 6 pierce over 2 seconds.

weapons.name: Endless Musket Pouch
weapons.source: Crafted at Crystal Ball
weapons.why: An infinite stack of Musket Balls, so ammo never runs out.
weapons.desc: The Endless Musket Pouch is a Hardmode ammunition item. While in the inventory, it acts as an infinite source of Musket Balls.

weapons.name: Venom Arrows
weapons.source: Crafted

weapons.name: Wooden Arrows
weapons.source: Crafted

armor.name: Lunic Corps armor
armor.effect: 20% increased jump speed · MJOLNIR Shield - Projects a bubble shield that absorbs up to 50 damage · Halves Adrenaline lost on hit if the shield fully absorbs the hit · The shield starts recharging 5 seconds after being hit · Recharging from zero to full charge takes 2 seconds · Being hit again while recharging restarts the charge timer · 'Finish the fight'
armor.desc: Lunic Corps armor is a Hardmode ranger armor set.

armor.name: Vortex armor
armor.why: Toggle stealth to raise ranged damage and make enemies less likely to target you.
armor.effect: Double tap ▼ Down to toggle stealth, · increasing ranged ability and reducing chance for enemies to target you but slowing movement speed
armor.desc: Vortex armor is a Hardmode, post- Moon Lord ranged armor set consisting of the Vortex Helmet, Vortex Breastplate, and Vortex Leggings.

armor.name: Astral armor
armor.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 3 · 10% increased damage and critical strike chance · Whenever you crit an enemy, a barrage of stars will rain down · This effect has a 1 second cooldown before it can trigger again
armor.desc: Astral armor is a Hardmode armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits an afterimage effect.

accessories.name: Eye of Magnus
accessories.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
accessories.desc: The Eye of Magnus is a Hardmode classless weapon that is an upgraded version of the Lunic Eye. When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

accessories.name: Relic of Deliverance
accessories.effect: Using ⚒ Use / Attack mounts you on the spear; holding ⚒ Use / Attack revvs the spear, slowing you down · Release to launch yourself at high speeds, halved while a boss is alive · Losing too much speed while charging will bust the charge, resetting your speed · The dash allows you to ram through enemies and travel through tiles · Being inside tiles for too long will warp you back to where you entered · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to dismount · Holding out the spear heavily reduces the damage of all summons · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats · Vengeance fueled me, I had no thought other than exactment. · The dragon took everything from me, leaving my broken pieces strewn on the ground. · But when I danced by Her side, I knew there was something still worth fighting for.
accessories.desc: The Relic of Deliverance is a post- Moon Lord classless weapon that is dropped by the Guardian Commander. When used, it mounts the player on the spear, which can be freely turned. Right-clicking dismounts the spear.

accessories.name: Rod of Discord
accessories.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
accessories.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

accessories.name: Normality Relocator
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Press Normality Relocator to teleport to the position of the mouse · Fall speed is doubled for 0.5 seconds after teleporting · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Works while in the inventory · 'I'll be there in the blink of an eye'
accessories.desc: Normality Relocator is a post- Moon Lord tool. While it is in the player's inventory, they may press the Normality Relocator key to instantly warp to the position of the cursor. Unlike the Rod of Discord, the Relocator cannot be used normally like other tools via selecting it in the hotbar and pressing the ⚒ Use / Attack key.

accessories.name: Celestial Starboard
accessories.why: The fastest wings in the game, with the longest flight time.
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Press Down to toggle hover · Press Up to deactivate hover · Hold Up to boost faster! · 'The more you know'
accessories.desc: The Celestial Starboard is a Hardmode, post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory. In addition to granting remarkable flight capabilities, it has both hover and upwards boost capability. At its top speed, it travels at 82 mph horizontal, 115 mph vertical, and 51 mph while falling.

accessories.name: Moon Walkers
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 2.67 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Great · Max vertical speed: Great · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Good · 24% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Hee hee!'
accessories.desc: Moon Walkers are a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Angel Treads. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Vortex Booster
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: The Absorber
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing
accessories.desc: The Absorber is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Grand Gelatin, Baroclaw, and Giant Tortoise Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: The Community
accessories.effect: 'The heart of (most of) the Terraria community' · Thank you to all of our supporters who made this mod a reality!
accessories.desc: The Community is an accessory that is dropped by Leviathan and Anahita. When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

accessories.name: Asgard's Valor
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage
accessories.desc: The Asgard's Valor is a Hardmode shield accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Statis' Ninja Belt
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 10% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.6x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws
accessories.desc: The Statis' Ninja Belt is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Master Ninja Gear and Frog Gear. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Shield of the High Ruler
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: +10 max life · Grants immunity to knockback and most debuffs · Grants an improved Shield of Cthulhu dash · Bonking an enemy halves dash cooldown time · Facing a projectile when it hits you reduces its damage by 15% · 'For the fate of the kingdom'
accessories.desc: The Shield of the High Ruler is a Hardmode shield accessory and the direct upgrade to the Shield of Cthulhu. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Soaring Insignia
accessories.source: Dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess
accessories.effect: Grants infinite wing and rocket boot flight · Increases flight and jump mobility
accessories.desc: The Soaring Insignia is a Hardmode, post- Plantera accessory that boosts the player's flight and movement abilities. It has the following effects:

accessories.name: Daawnlight Spirit Origin
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: All ranged weapons can supercrit when critical strike chance is over 100% · Marks enemies and bosses with bullseyes which boost critical strike chance when hit · Extra critical strike chance quickly fades over time · Summons a heroic spirit from another world if visibility is on or in vanity slots · 'A strand of a lost cosmos remains, waiting for its master'
accessories.desc: The Daawnlight Spirit Origin is a post- Moon Lord accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Dynamo Stem Cells
accessories.effect: 10% increased ranged damage and movement speed · Ranged weapons fire a powerful mini swarmer every 3 seconds · Reduces damage taken from Dragonfire
accessories.desc: The Dynamo Stem Cells are an Expert Mode -exclusive post- Moon Lord accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by the Dragonfolly. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Recon Scope
accessories.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance · Enemies are less likely to target you · 'Enemy spotted'
accessories.desc: The Recon Scope is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
accessories.effect: Increases armor penetration by 10 · 10% increased damage
accessories.desc: The Sand Shark Tooth Necklace is a Hardmode accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

accessories.name: Sniper Scope
accessories.why: 10% ranged damage and crit, and zooms out when you right-click with a gun.
accessories.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance
accessories.desc: The Sniper Scope is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Warbanner of the Righteous
accessories.effect: Multiplies all damage based on how close you are to enemies · Maximum damage boost is 15%, minimum damage boost is -15% · Emit a blazing aura that burns and repels nearby enemies with Holy Flames · Enemies take increasing damage the closer they are to you and the longer they are near you · Effects are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled
accessories.desc: The Warbanner of the Righteous is an Expert Mode -exclusive post- Moon Lord accessory dropped by the Profaned Guardians. While equipped, it increases all damage depending on how close the player is to an enemy. The boost scales from -15% to +15%.

accessories.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
accessories.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled
accessories.desc: The Ambrosial Ampoule is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Living Dew and Radiant Ooze. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Bloom Stone
accessories.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'
accessories.desc: The Bloom Stone is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Plantera. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Deific Amulet
accessories.effect: Releases a burst of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect
accessories.desc: The Deific Amulet is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star Veil. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Frozen Shield
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Puts a shell around the owner when below 50% life that reduces damage by 25% · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when above 25% life
accessories.desc: The Frozen Shield is a Hardmode, post- Plantera shield that combines the functionalities of the Paladin's Shield and the Frozen Turtle Shell. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

buffs.name: Plenty Satisfied
buffs.desc: Well Fed, Plenty Satisfied, and Exquisitely Stuffed are buffs granted to the player when they consume food, which provide general stat bonuses that vary in potency and duration depending on the food item consumed. In Expert Mode, health regeneration will only be fully effective while the player is under the effects of one of these buffs. While one of these buffs is active in a The Constant or Zenith special world seed, the player will also be temporarily immune to hunger for the buff's duration.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Survival matters a lot once the phase is dominated by hard optional content and fast fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Even ranged classes need extra defense when bosses or cave enemies close the gap.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Lifeforce Potion is a buff potion that grants the Lifeforce buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Photosynthesis Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Photosynthesis Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ammo Box
buffs.source: Placed station buff
buffs.why: Endgame ranger still wants free ammo efficiency before every serious fight.
buffs.desc: The Ammo Box is a furniture item. It can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for 10 GC in Hardmode.

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Ammo consumption adds up quickly, so this makes a stack last longer.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ammo Reservation Potion is a buff potion which grants the Ammo Reservation buff when consumed. The buff reduces the chance of consuming any ammunition by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Archery Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Raises arrow damage by 10% and arrow speed by 20%. Bows only.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Archery Potion is a buff potion which grants the Archery buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage of arrow -firing weapons by 10%, as well as the velocity of arrows by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Soaring Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().
