items.name: Warbanner of the Righteous
items.why: This requires being close to the boss to perform well.
items.effect: Multiplies all damage based on how close you are to enemies · Maximum damage boost is 15%, minimum damage boost is -15% · Emit a blazing aura that burns and repels nearby enemies with Holy Flames · Enemies take increasing damage the closer they are to you and the longer they are near you · Effects are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled
items.desc: The Warbanner of the Righteous is an Expert Mode -exclusive post- Moon Lord accessory dropped by the Profaned Guardians. While equipped, it increases all damage depending on how close the player is to an enemy. The boost scales from -15% to +15%.

weapons.name: Chronomancer's Scythe
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: primary recommended magic weapon, high homing DPS
weapons.effect: Rapidly fires icicles that cause Time Distortion on enemies · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to swing the scythe around you, creating a clock pattern of homing icicles · Direct hits with the scythe have a chance to spawn clocks · Collecting the clocks increases movement speed and acceleration by 5% for each clock collected · This stacks up to 3 times and each level wears off after 5 seconds
weapons.desc: The Chronomancer's Scythe is a post- Moon Lord magic weapon. When used with its primary fire (left-click), the player will swing a scythe towards the cursor rapidly with a tiny range, similarly to the Terragrim. Every 0.083 seconds, a small icicle is inaccurately fired with 120% damage.

weapons.name: Genesis
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fire an array of lasers that decreases in spread for each shot · Every sixth shot fires a splitting Genesis Beam and resets the spread of the weapon · Hitting an enemy before the Genesis Beam splits deals increased damage
weapons.desc: The Genesis is a post- Moon Lord magic gun. When used, it fires an array of eight lasers that pierce once and decrease in their spread on successive shots. Every 6th shot, the weapon instead fires a powerful splitting beam in a Y-shape, which deals 900% damage and resets the laser spread for the following set of shots.

weapons.name: Nuclear Fury
weapons.source: Crafted at a Bookcase
weapons.effect: Casts a torrent of cosmic typhoons
weapons.desc: The Nuclear Fury is a post- Moon Lord spell tome that is a direct upgrade to the Razorblade Typhoon. When used, it fires 8 cosmic typhoons evenly distributed in a circle around the player. The typhoons home in on nearby enemies, pass through tiles and pierce twice.

weapons.name: Nucleosynthesis
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Casts four celestial beams near the player · Solar beams explode into fire on enemy hits · Nebula beams sweep a little bit over time · Vortex beams act like fast lightning and electrify enemies on hit · Stardust beams release small stars that home on enemy hits
weapons.desc: The Nucleosynthesis is a post- Moon Lord wand that is a direct upgrade to the Photosynthesis. It fires four unique beams behind the player, all aiming towards the mouse cursor, each of which behave differently:

weapons.name: Rouge Slash
weapons.source: Dropped by Dragonfolly
weapons.effect: Fires a wave of 3 rouge air slashes
weapons.desc: The Rouge Slash is a post- Moon Lord spell tome that is dropped by Dragonfolly. When used, it fires three curved waves out from the player, which each vary in their size and speed and pass through tiles. The waves each pierce twice and disappear upon contact with a third.

armor.name: Nebula armor
armor.why: Magic damage can drop boosters that stack damage, life and mana buffs when picked up. The buffs fall off if you cannot collect them.
armor.effect: Magic damage has a chance to spawn buff boosters · Pick boosters up to get stacking buffs
armor.desc: Nebula armor is a Hardmode, post- Moon Lord mage armor set consisting of the Nebula Helmet, Nebula Breastplate, and Nebula Leggings.

armor.name: Astral armor
armor.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 3 · 10% increased damage and critical strike chance · Whenever you crit an enemy, a barrage of stars will rain down · This effect has a 1 second cooldown before it can trigger again
armor.desc: Astral armor is a Hardmode armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits an afterimage effect.

accessories.name: Eye of Magnus
accessories.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
accessories.desc: The Eye of Magnus is a Hardmode classless weapon that is an upgraded version of the Lunic Eye. When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

accessories.name: Relic of Deliverance
accessories.effect: Using ⚒ Use / Attack mounts you on the spear; holding ⚒ Use / Attack revvs the spear, slowing you down · Release to launch yourself at high speeds, halved while a boss is alive · Losing too much speed while charging will bust the charge, resetting your speed · The dash allows you to ram through enemies and travel through tiles · Being inside tiles for too long will warp you back to where you entered · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to dismount · Holding out the spear heavily reduces the damage of all summons · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats · Vengeance fueled me, I had no thought other than exactment. · The dragon took everything from me, leaving my broken pieces strewn on the ground. · But when I danced by Her side, I knew there was something still worth fighting for.
accessories.desc: The Relic of Deliverance is a post- Moon Lord classless weapon that is dropped by the Guardian Commander. When used, it mounts the player on the spear, which can be freely turned. Right-clicking dismounts the spear.

accessories.name: Rod of Discord
accessories.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
accessories.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

accessories.name: Celestial Starboard
accessories.why: The fastest wings in the game, with the longest flight time.
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Press Down to toggle hover · Press Up to deactivate hover · Hold Up to boost faster! · 'The more you know'
accessories.desc: The Celestial Starboard is a Hardmode, post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory. In addition to granting remarkable flight capabilities, it has both hover and upwards boost capability. At its top speed, it travels at 82 mph horizontal, 115 mph vertical, and 51 mph while falling.

accessories.name: Moon Walkers
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 2.67 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Great · Max vertical speed: Great · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Good · 24% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Hee hee!'
accessories.desc: Moon Walkers are a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Angel Treads. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Nebula Mantle
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: The Absorber
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing
accessories.desc: The Absorber is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Grand Gelatin, Baroclaw, and Giant Tortoise Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: The Community
accessories.effect: 'The heart of (most of) the Terraria community' · Thank you to all of our supporters who made this mod a reality!
accessories.desc: The Community is an accessory that is dropped by Leviathan and Anahita. When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

accessories.name: Asgard's Valor
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage
accessories.desc: The Asgard's Valor is a Hardmode shield accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Statis' Ninja Belt
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 10% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.6x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws
accessories.desc: The Statis' Ninja Belt is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Master Ninja Gear and Frog Gear. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Shield of the High Ruler
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: +10 max life · Grants immunity to knockback and most debuffs · Grants an improved Shield of Cthulhu dash · Bonking an enemy halves dash cooldown time · Facing a projectile when it hits you reduces its damage by 15% · 'For the fate of the kingdom'
accessories.desc: The Shield of the High Ruler is a Hardmode shield accessory and the direct upgrade to the Shield of Cthulhu. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Soaring Insignia
accessories.source: Dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess
accessories.effect: Grants infinite wing and rocket boot flight · Increases flight and jump mobility
accessories.desc: The Soaring Insignia is a Hardmode, post- Plantera accessory that boosts the player's flight and movement abilities. It has the following effects:

accessories.name: Arcane Flower
accessories.effect: 8% reduced mana cost · Automatically use mana potions when needed · Enemies are less likely to target you
accessories.desc: The Arcane Flower is a Hardmode accessory which combines the functionality of the Mana Flower and the aggro -reducing effect of the Putrid Scent.

accessories.name: Destroyer Emblem
accessories.effect: 10% increased damage · 8% increased critical strike chance
accessories.desc: The Destroyer Emblem is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory that gives the player 10% increased damage and 8% increased critical strike chance.

accessories.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
accessories.effect: Increases armor penetration by 10 · 10% increased damage
accessories.desc: The Sand Shark Tooth Necklace is a Hardmode accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

accessories.name: Sigil of Calamitas
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Increases maximum mana by 60 · 15% increased magic damage · Increases pickup range for mana stars
accessories.desc: The Sigil of Calamitas is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Celestial Emblem. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Warbanner of the Righteous
accessories.effect: Multiplies all damage based on how close you are to enemies · Maximum damage boost is 15%, minimum damage boost is -15% · Emit a blazing aura that burns and repels nearby enemies with Holy Flames · Enemies take increasing damage the closer they are to you and the longer they are near you · Effects are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled
accessories.desc: The Warbanner of the Righteous is an Expert Mode -exclusive post- Moon Lord accessory dropped by the Profaned Guardians. While equipped, it increases all damage depending on how close the player is to an enemy. The boost scales from -15% to +15%.

accessories.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
accessories.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled
accessories.desc: The Ambrosial Ampoule is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Living Dew and Radiant Ooze. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Bloom Stone
accessories.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'
accessories.desc: The Bloom Stone is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Plantera. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Deific Amulet
accessories.effect: Releases a burst of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect
accessories.desc: The Deific Amulet is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star Veil. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Frozen Shield
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Puts a shell around the owner when below 50% life that reduces damage by 25% · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when above 25% life
accessories.desc: The Frozen Shield is a Hardmode, post- Plantera shield that combines the functionalities of the Paladin's Shield and the Frozen Turtle Shell. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

accessories.name: Supreme Mana Potions
accessories.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table

buffs.name: Plenty Satisfied
buffs.desc: Well Fed, Plenty Satisfied, and Exquisitely Stuffed are buffs granted to the player when they consume food, which provide general stat bonuses that vary in potency and duration depending on the food item consumed. In Expert Mode, health regeneration will only be fully effective while the player is under the effects of one of these buffs. While one of these buffs is active in a The Constant or Zenith special world seed, the player will also be temporarily immune to hunger for the buff's duration.

buffs.name: Clairvoyance
buffs.source: Crafted
buffs.desc: The Crystal Ball is a Hardmode furniture item which functions as a crafting station. It is purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC. Pressing ⚷ Open / Activate on a placed Crystal Ball grants the Clairvoyance buff and opens its crafting menu.

weapons.name: Legion of Celestia
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons a possessed, celestial axe to fight for you
weapons.desc: The Legion of Celestia is a post- Moon Lord summon weapon. When used, it summons a Celestial Axe minion that floats around the player and attacks nearby enemies by aggressively dashing through them to deal damage and inflict the Elemental Mix debuff. The Celestial Axe minions constantly rotate through various colors.

weapons.name: Flowers of Mortality
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons five rainbow flowers over your head
weapons.desc: The Flowers of Mortality is a post- Moon Lord summon weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Wither Blossoms Staff and the final upgrade to the Frost Blossom Staff. When used, it summons up to 5 rainbow flowers that orbit around the player. The flowers attack nearby enemies by firing homing swirling rainbow bolts that occasionally burst into shrapnel on enemy hits.

weapons.name: Tactical Plague Engine
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons a Plague jet to pummel your enemies into submission · Jets will fire bullets from your inventory · Sometimes shoots a missile instead of a bullet · 50% chance to save ammo · Missiles do not consume ammo
weapons.desc: The Tactical Plague Engine is a post- Moon Lord summon weapon. When used, it summons a Plague Jet minion that fires and consumes bullets. It will attempt to fire from above, and will occasionally fire homing missiles instead of bullets, which inflict the Plague debuff and deal 150% of the weapon's base damage.

weapons.name: Lunar Portal Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by the Moon Lord
weapons.why: Post-Moon Lord sentry summoning a floating portal that fires sweeping piercing beams.
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons a lunar portal to shoot lasers at your enemies
weapons.desc: The Lunar Portal Staff is a Hardmode, post- Moon Lord summon weapon that summons a Lunar Portal sentry. It continuously fires beams that sweep across enemies, which pierce infinite enemies but cannot pass through blocks. Unlike most sentries, the Lunar Portal floats midair.

weapons.name: Rainbow Crystal Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by the Moon Lord
weapons.why: Post-Moon Lord sentry summoning a floating crystal that fires exploding light beams.
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons a radiant crystal that banishes your enemies · 'The colors, Duke, the colors!'
weapons.desc: The Rainbow Crystal Staff is a Hardmode, post- Moon Lord summon weapon that summons a Rainbow Crystal sentry. It fires spreads of three multicolored light beams towards enemies, but cannot target through blocks. Each beam releases a star that explodes shortly after.

weapons.name: Sanctified Spark
weapons.source: Dropped by Impious Immolators
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons a friendly immolator that will float towards you · Immolators rapidly fire homing flares of Holy Flames at nearby enemies, before continuing to float near you again · After firing, Immolators will fire one healing bolt at you for every 4 summon slots you have · 'They might be a bit clingy, but at least they're warm'
weapons.desc: The Sanctified Spark is a post- Moon Lord sentry that is dropped by Impious Immolators. When used, it summons an Impious Immolator sentry that slowly follows the player and rapidly fires flame bursts at the nearest enemy which inflicts the Holy Flames debuff. It will briefly pause between attacks, during which it will fire one healing orb that heals 5 health each for every 4 minion slots the player has.

weapons.why: Empress of Light drop giving one of the largest summon tag damage bonuses.
weapons.effect: 20 summon tag damage · 10% summon tag critical strike chance · Your summons will focus struck enemies
weapons.desc: The Kaleidoscope is a Hardmode, post- Plantera whip that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by the Empress of Light. It has a 20% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:

buffs.name: Plenty Satisfied

In Expert Mode, health regeneration will only be fully effective while the player is under the effects of one of these buffs. While one of these buffs is active in a The Constant or Zenith special world seed, the player will also be temporarily immune to hunger for the buff's duration.

weapons.name: Celestial Reaper
weapons.source: Purchased from Bandit for 3 after the Moon Lord has been defeated
weapons.effect: Throws a fast homing scythe · The scythe will bounce after hitting an enemy up to six times · Stealth strikes create damaging afterimages
weapons.desc: The Celestial Reaper is a post- Moon Lord rogue weapon that is sold by the Bandit for 3 after the Moon Lord has been defeated. When thrown, it will home in on an enemy and will bounce back from the enemy when it hits, allowing it to redirect itself to hit and bounce off of a different enemy, or simply turn around and hit the same enemy again. It will do this up to six times or 10 seconds, slowing down after each hit.

weapons.name: Lunar Kunai
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Throws out a set of three kunai that ignore gravity and slightly home in on enemies · After traveling enough distance, the kunai supercharge with lunar energy, homing in far more aggressively and exploding on impact · Stealth strikes instantly throw ten supercharged Kunai
weapons.desc: The Lunar Kunai is a post- Moon Lord dagger. When used, it throws 3 gravity-ignoring lunar kunai that slightly home in on enemies and do not pierce. After being in the air for roughly 1 second, the kunai will supercharge, causing them to speed up, changing their color from brown to teal, start emitting dust, and home in far more aggressively.

weapons.name: Profaned Partisan
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws a profaned spear that splits into miniature spears upon hitting an enemy · Stealth strikes remain impaled in an enemy for 10 seconds · While an enemy is impaled, all spears that strike them instead shatter into exploding stars
weapons.desc: The Profaned Partisan is a post- Moon Lord javelin that is an upgrade to the Spear of Paleolith. On use, it throws a javelin that splits into holy spears on hit. Holy spears have oscillating velocity and can pierce through enemies.

weapons.name: Rebounding Rainbow
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws a disk that has a chance to generate several disks if enemies are near it · Stealth strikes fly slower but travel farther, pierce through enemies, and spawn extra disks more frequently
weapons.desc: The Rebounding Rainbow is a post- Moon Lord rogue boomerang. When used, it rapidly throws a disk that has a chance of splitting into 8 more disks when near an enemy. The split disks move outward from the point they split from before returning in the player's direction and they last for a shorter duration before dissipating.

weapons.name: Utensil Poker
weapons.source: Dropped by the Moon Lord
weapons.effect: Fires utensils in bursts of three · Stealth strikes replace any utensil with a powerful butcher knife · 'Space chickens, that is all'
weapons.desc: The Utensil Poker is a post- Moon Lord dagger that is dropped by the Moon Lord. When used, it fires a set of three random utensils.

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Eye of Magnus is a Hardmode classless weapon that is an upgraded version of the Lunic Eye. When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

weapons.name: Relic of Deliverance
weapons.source: Dropped by the Guardian Commander
weapons.effect: Using ⚒ Use / Attack mounts you on the spear; holding ⚒ Use / Attack revvs the spear, slowing you down · Release to launch yourself at high speeds, halved while a boss is alive · Losing too much speed while charging will bust the charge, resetting your speed · The dash allows you to ram through enemies and travel through tiles · Being inside tiles for too long will warp you back to where you entered · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to dismount · Holding out the spear heavily reduces the damage of all summons · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats · Vengeance fueled me, I had no thought other than exactment. · The dragon took everything from me, leaving my broken pieces strewn on the ground. · But when I danced by Her side, I knew there was something still worth fighting for.
weapons.desc: The Relic of Deliverance is a post- Moon Lord classless weapon that is dropped by the Guardian Commander. When used, it mounts the player on the spear, which can be freely turned. Right-clicking dismounts the spear.

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
weapons.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Normality Relocator
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Press Normality Relocator to teleport to the position of the mouse · Fall speed is doubled for 0.5 seconds after teleporting · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Works while in the inventory · 'I'll be there in the blink of an eye'
weapons.desc: Normality Relocator is a post- Moon Lord tool. While it is in the player's inventory, they may press the Normality Relocator key to instantly warp to the position of the cursor. Unlike the Rod of Discord, the Relocator cannot be used normally like other tools via selecting it in the hotbar and pressing the ⚒ Use / Attack key.

armor.name: Empyrean armor
armor.effect: +115 maximum stealth · Rogue projectiles have special effects on enemy hits · Imbued with Empyrean Wrath when you are damaged or while below 50% life
armor.desc: Empyrean armor is a post- Moon Lord rogue armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a pulsing aura and afterimages. Additionally, the armor's movement and item swinging animations will change to be more unique than each individual piece's animation.

armor.desc: Astral armor is a Hardmode armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits an afterimage effect.

accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Enemies are less likely to target you, even in the abyss · Generate stealth 25% faster when standing still and 12% faster while moving · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Dodging an attack restores stealth and releases a cloud that damages and stuns nearby enemies · 'Light does not reach the depths of the ocean'
accessories.desc: The Abyssal Mirror is a Hardmode rogue accessory and the direct upgrade to the Mirage Mirror. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Glove of Precision
accessories.source: Purchased from Bandit for 48 after Plantera has been defeated
accessories.effect: Decreases rogue attack speed by 15% · Increases rogue damage and critical strike chance by 10%, and velocity by 15%
accessories.desc: The Glove of Precision is a Hardmode rogue accessory that is sold by the Bandit for 48 after Plantera has been defeated. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

accessories.name: Vampiric Talisman
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Rogue critical strikes steal enemy life · Stealth strikes grant 15% critical strike chance and increased lifesteal to non-stealth strikes for 10 seconds · Stealth strikes inflict Heavy Bleeding and Armor Crunch , and deal 8% more damage · 'Possessing the talisman makes you yearn for blood'
accessories.desc: The Vampiric Talisman is a Hardmode rogue accessory. When equipped, it causes rogue critical hits to steal 1.5% of their damage (rounded down) in health. Additionally, it increases stealth strike damage by 8% and causes all stealth strikes to inflict Armor Crunch for 2.5 seconds and Heavy Bleeding for 5 seconds.

buffs.name: Super Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Super Healing Potion is a recovery potion that heals 200 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 60 seconds when used. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.desc: The Seafood Dinner is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Lifeforce Potion is a buff potion that grants the Lifeforce buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Photosynthesis Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Photosynthesis Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Flask of Crumbling
buffs.source: Crafted at an Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.desc: The Flask of Crumbling is a Hardmode flask. Upon consumption, it grants the Weapon Imbue: Crumbling buff, which causes all melee, whip, and rogue attacks to inflict the Crumbling debuff.

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Shadow Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Shadow Potion is a Pre-Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Shadow buff, which provides the following effects:

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Soaring Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Celestial Starboard
items.why: This has powerful hover and boost abilities.
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Press Down to toggle hover · Press Up to deactivate hover · Hold Up to boost faster! · 'The more you know'
items.desc: The Celestial Starboard is a Hardmode, post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory. In addition to granting remarkable flight capabilities, it has both hover and upwards boost capability. At its top speed, it travels at 82 mph horizontal, 115 mph vertical, and 51 mph while falling.

items.name: Exodus Wings
items.why: This should be used with Empyrean armor
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 3 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Great · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Great · Vertical acceleration: Great · Grants permanent Empyrean Wrath while wearing the Empyrean armor · Pulsing with an alien heartbeat
items.desc: Exodus Wings are a post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory. While equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide. If they are equipped along with Empyrean armor, they grant permanent Empyrean Wrath buff.

items.name: Empyrean armor
items.why: This should be used with Empyrean armor
items.desc: Empyrean armor is a post- Moon Lord rogue armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a pulsing aura and afterimages. Additionally, the armor's movement and item swinging animations will change to be more unique than each individual piece's animation.

items.desc: The Bloom Stone is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Plantera. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.desc: The Deific Amulet is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star Veil. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.desc: The Frozen Shield is a Hardmode, post- Plantera shield that combines the functionalities of the Paladin's Shield and the Frozen Turtle Shell. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

items.desc: The Absorber is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Grand Gelatin, Baroclaw, and Giant Tortoise Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.desc: The Blunder Booster is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Plagued Fuel Pack. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.effect: +10 maximum stealth · Stealth generation is boosted while moving if not attacking · Stealth strikes only expend 50% of your max stealth · 6% increased rogue damage and rogue crit chance
items.desc: The Dark Matter Sheath is a Hardmode rogue accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Destroyer Emblem
items.effect: 10% increased damage · 8% increased critical strike chance
items.desc: The Destroyer Emblem is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory that gives the player 10% increased damage and 8% increased critical strike chance.

items.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
items.effect: Increases armor penetration by 10 · 10% increased damage
items.desc: The Sand Shark Tooth Necklace is a Hardmode accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

items.name: Warbanner of the Righteous
items.why: This requires being close to the boss to perform well.

weapons.name: Empyrean Knives
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws a flurry of homing knives that bounce off of tiles and heal the user
weapons.desc: The Empyrean Knives are a post- Moon Lord melee weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Vampire Knives. When used, they throw a spread of 4 to 8 homing knives, each dealing damage and healing the player for 1.5% of the damage dealt. The knives bounce off of tiles twice and travel much farther than the Vampire Knives before spinning and fading away.

weapons.name: Holy Collider
weapons.source: Dropped by Providence
weapons.effect: Swings a holy greatsword that can be charged for higher damage · Charged swings create four lingering flares that float around the point of impact · Striking a flare with an uncharged swing will push it around and extend its lifetime · Charged swings can empower flares, turning them into massive fireballs on hit and launching them to your cursor
weapons.desc: The Holy Collider is a post- Moon Lord special sword that is dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. Pressing ⚒ Use / Attack (default: Left Click) swings the sword back and forth, dealing 20% base damage and creating 6 short-lived flares on hit that deal 1% base damage. Holding ⚒ Use / Attack will instead charge up the sword for a powerful swing when the button is released, dealing full damage on hit.

weapons.name: Meowmere
weapons.source: Dropped by Moon Lord
weapons.why: Fires bouncing wall-piercing cat-head projectiles on swing.
weapons.desc: The Meowmere is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord. When swung, it fires a cat head projectile with a visual rainbow trail every 0.23 seconds. The cat head deals 125% of the weapon's damage (250 base damage), is affected by gravity, and can pierce enemies or bounce off blocks up to four times.

weapons.name: Pulse Dragon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws two mechanical dragon heads that emit damaging electrical fields · 'Yharim specifically requested this weapon to be modelled after the Dragons of old. · How trite.'
weapons.desc: The Pulse Dragon is a post- Moon Lord flail. When used, the player swings two glowing electric dragon heads which move in a whip-like manner. As they converge, up to eight short-lasting electrosphere projectiles are spawned per flail.

weapons.name: Stellar Contempt
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Throws a heavy, gravity-affected hammer that will return to you after striking an enemy · Consecutive hits call down more and more lunar flares from the sky · After hitting five times, the hammer supercharges with lunar energy to pulverize your target
weapons.desc: The Stellar Contempt is a post- Moon Lord melee weapon and the direct upgrade to the Fallen Paladin's Hammer. When used, it throws a fast gravity-affected hammer that passes through tiles. Upon hitting an enemy, it slows down and starts returning to the player.

weapons.name: Terratomere
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Heals the player on true melee hits · Fires several piercing energy bolts that rapidly seek targets · On hit, explodes and repeatedly slashes the target · 'Linked to the essence of Terraria'
weapons.desc: The Terratomere is a post- Moon Lord broadsword that autoswings. When used, it fires 4 homing energy bolts that cause an explosion which deals 50% of the weapon's damage and also fires a short-range slash projectile after every swing. Both the blade and energy bolts create 3 light beam slashes that deal 40% of the weapon's damage on hit.

weapons.name: Claret Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a hypercondensed claret round · The round explodes upon striking an enemy and releases blood orbs · The explosion shreds enemies, dramatically reducing their defense · Picking up the blood orbs will reduce Potion Sickness when possible · If you do not have Potion Sickness , your natural regeneration will be enhanced · Can only fire once every 10 seconds · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Claret Cannon is a post- Moon Lord classless weapon. It fires a small claret round that explodes into 20 small floating blood orbs upon hitting an enemy. When collected by the player, each orb reduces the duration of the Potion Sickness debuff by 0.33 seconds.

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Eye of Magnus is a Hardmode classless weapon that is an upgraded version of the Lunic Eye. When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

weapons.name: Relic of Deliverance
weapons.source: Dropped by the Guardian Commander
weapons.effect: Using ⚒ Use / Attack mounts you on the spear; holding ⚒ Use / Attack revvs the spear, slowing you down · Release to launch yourself at high speeds, halved while a boss is alive · Losing too much speed while charging will bust the charge, resetting your speed · The dash allows you to ram through enemies and travel through tiles · Being inside tiles for too long will warp you back to where you entered · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to dismount · Holding out the spear heavily reduces the damage of all summons · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats · Vengeance fueled me, I had no thought other than exactment. · The dragon took everything from me, leaving my broken pieces strewn on the ground. · But when I danced by Her side, I knew there was something still worth fighting for.
weapons.desc: The Relic of Deliverance is a post- Moon Lord classless weapon that is dropped by the Guardian Commander. When used, it mounts the player on the spear, which can be freely turned. Right-clicking dismounts the spear.

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
weapons.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Normality Relocator
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Press Normality Relocator to teleport to the position of the mouse · Fall speed is doubled for 0.5 seconds after teleporting · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Works while in the inventory · 'I'll be there in the blink of an eye'
weapons.desc: Normality Relocator is a post- Moon Lord tool. While it is in the player's inventory, they may press the Normality Relocator key to instantly warp to the position of the cursor. Unlike the Rod of Discord, the Relocator cannot be used normally like other tools via selecting it in the hotbar and pressing the ⚒ Use / Attack key.

accessories.name: Badge of Bravery
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Increases melee damage and critical strike chance by 10% · Increases melee armor penetration by 5
accessories.desc: The Badge of Bravery is a post- Moon Lord accessory. When equipped, it increases melee damage and critical strike chance by 10%, and armor penetration by 5.

accessories.name: Fire Gauntlet
accessories.why: Melee damage, speed and knockback, and sets enemies on fire. Upgrades from Mechanical Glove.
accessories.effect: Increases melee knockback and melee attacks inflict fire damage · 12% increased melee damage and speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons · Increases the size of melee weapons
accessories.desc: The Fire Gauntlet is a Hardmode, post- mechanical bosses accessory. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

accessories.name: Warbanner of the Righteous
accessories.effect: Multiplies all damage based on how close you are to enemies · Maximum damage boost is 15%, minimum damage boost is -15% · Emit a blazing aura that burns and repels nearby enemies with Holy Flames · Enemies take increasing damage the closer they are to you and the longer they are near you · Effects are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled
accessories.desc: The Warbanner of the Righteous is an Expert Mode -exclusive post- Moon Lord accessory dropped by the Profaned Guardians. While equipped, it increases all damage depending on how close the player is to an enemy. The boost scales from -15% to +15%.

accessories.desc: The Ambrosial Ampoule is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Living Dew and Radiant Ooze. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Deific Amulet

accessories.desc: The Deific Amulet is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star Veil. It grants the following effects while equipped:

buffs.name: Bloodfin
buffs.desc: The Bloodfin is a post- Moon Lord healing potion -type fish that can be caught in the Brimstone Crag with a 10% chance after Providence, the Profaned Goddess has been defeated.

buffs.name: Supreme Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Supreme Healing Potion is a post- Moon Lord potion that heals the player for 250 health, and inflicts the Potion Sickness debuff upon use. It is also dropped from Providence, the Profaned Goddess, Ceaseless Void, Storm Weaver, Signus, Polterghast, and The Old Duke.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.desc: The Seafood Dinner is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Lifeforce Potion is a buff potion that grants the Lifeforce buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Flask of Ichor
buffs.source: Crafted at Imbuing Station
buffs.why: The defense reduction still adds meaningful value even when your raw damage is already enormous.
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.desc: The Flask of Ichor is a Hardmode flask that causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Ichor debuff for 10–19 seconds on enemies hit. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Sharpening Station
buffs.source: Found in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle
buffs.why: Grants armor penetration to melee weapons while standing near it.
buffs.desc: The Sharpening Station is a furniture item found naturally generated in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle. In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Merchant for 10 GC.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Soaring Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

weapons.name: Angelic Shotgun
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Each shot casts a radiant beam of Holy Flames from the sky · Musket balls convert into hallow-point rounds which also empower the beam · 'Fighting 'til the war's won'
weapons.desc: The Angelic Shotgun is a post- Moon Lord gun. Each time the weapon is fired, it shoots 5-6 bullets and summons a radiant beam from the sky towards the cursor. The beam deals 200% of the weapon's damage, pierces infinitely and passes through tiles.

weapons.name: Blood Boiler
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires twin streams of bloodfire that returns to you · Returning bloodfire reduces Potion Sickness if it struck an enemy · Uses your health as ammo · 20% chance to save health
weapons.desc: The Blood Boiler is a post- Moon Lord flamethrower. It uses health for ammunition, with a 20% chance to not consume ammo. When used, it fires two long and continuous streams of bloodfire.

weapons.name: Ontological Despoiler
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Condenses chargeable pockets of concentrated unreality. ⚷ Open / Activate to swap modes only after firing a charged shot · Unstable condensate shots trifurcate and pierce enemies · Null condensate shots fire rapidly and home in on enemies · At 50% charge or higher, rate of fire significantly increases · Fully charged unstable condensate lobs a homing disruption sphere · Fully charge null condensate emits a hitscan null-annihilation beam that always crits · Each mode charges slower when used repeatedly and resets to full speed when swapped · 'Rob them of continuity and the laws of physics they hold so dear.'
weapons.desc: The Ontological Despoiler is a post- Moon Lord ranged weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Nullification Pistol. It does not consume any ammo.

weapons.name: Spyker
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Converts musket balls into Acid Venom infused spikes that stick to enemies, tiles and explode into shrapnel
weapons.desc: The Spyker is a post- Moon Lord gun that is a direct upgrade to the Needler. When used with Musket Balls, bullets are converted into spikes which stick to enemies and tiles and explode into more spikes, which also have a delayed explosion and inflict the Acid Venom debuff.

weapons.name: Telluric Glare
weapons.source: Dropped by Providence
weapons.effect: Rapidly fires volleys of arrows · Every other arrow is converted into radiant greatarrows which pierce but quicky disappear after striking · Wooden arrows are converted into more powerful greatarrows that deal increased damage
weapons.desc: The Telluric Glare is a post- Moon Lord bow that is dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. When used, it rapidly fires volleys of arrows and radiant arrows in a sequential stream, with slight variation in their position of origin. Wooden Arrows are all converted into radiant greatarrows that deal 120% base damage.

weapons.name: Claret Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a hypercondensed claret round · The round explodes upon striking an enemy and releases blood orbs · The explosion shreds enemies, dramatically reducing their defense · Picking up the blood orbs will reduce Potion Sickness when possible · If you do not have Potion Sickness , your natural regeneration will be enhanced · Can only fire once every 10 seconds · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Claret Cannon is a post- Moon Lord classless weapon. It fires a small claret round that explodes into 20 small floating blood orbs upon hitting an enemy. When collected by the player, each orb reduces the duration of the Potion Sickness debuff by 0.33 seconds.

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Eye of Magnus is a Hardmode classless weapon that is an upgraded version of the Lunic Eye. When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

weapons.name: Relic of Deliverance
weapons.source: Dropped by the Guardian Commander
weapons.effect: Using ⚒ Use / Attack mounts you on the spear; holding ⚒ Use / Attack revvs the spear, slowing you down · Release to launch yourself at high speeds, halved while a boss is alive · Losing too much speed while charging will bust the charge, resetting your speed · The dash allows you to ram through enemies and travel through tiles · Being inside tiles for too long will warp you back to where you entered · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to dismount · Holding out the spear heavily reduces the damage of all summons · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats · Vengeance fueled me, I had no thought other than exactment. · The dragon took everything from me, leaving my broken pieces strewn on the ground. · But when I danced by Her side, I knew there was something still worth fighting for.
weapons.desc: The Relic of Deliverance is a post- Moon Lord classless weapon that is dropped by the Guardian Commander. When used, it mounts the player on the spear, which can be freely turned. Right-clicking dismounts the spear.

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
weapons.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Normality Relocator
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Press Normality Relocator to teleport to the position of the mouse · Fall speed is doubled for 0.5 seconds after teleporting · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Works while in the inventory · 'I'll be there in the blink of an eye'
weapons.desc: Normality Relocator is a post- Moon Lord tool. While it is in the player's inventory, they may press the Normality Relocator key to instantly warp to the position of the cursor. Unlike the Rod of Discord, the Relocator cannot be used normally like other tools via selecting it in the hotbar and pressing the ⚒ Use / Attack key.

armor.desc: Tarragon armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit faint pulses.

accessories.desc: The Recon Scope is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Sniper Scope
accessories.why: 10% ranged damage and crit, and zooms out when you right-click with a gun.
accessories.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance
accessories.desc: The Sniper Scope is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
accessories.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled
accessories.desc: The Ambrosial Ampoule is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Living Dew and Radiant Ooze. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Deific Amulet
accessories.effect: Releases a burst of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect
accessories.desc: The Deific Amulet is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star Veil. It grants the following effects while equipped:

buffs.name: Bloodfin
buffs.desc: The Bloodfin is a post- Moon Lord healing potion -type fish that can be caught in the Brimstone Crag with a 10% chance after Providence, the Profaned Goddess has been defeated.

buffs.name: Supreme Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Supreme Healing Potion is a post- Moon Lord potion that heals the player for 250 health, and inflicts the Potion Sickness debuff upon use. It is also dropped from Providence, the Profaned Goddess, Ceaseless Void, Storm Weaver, Signus, Polterghast, and The Old Duke.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.desc: The Seafood Dinner is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Survival matters a lot once the phase is dominated by hard optional content and fast fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Even ranged classes need extra defense when bosses or cave enemies close the gap.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Lifeforce Potion is a buff potion that grants the Lifeforce buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ammo Box
buffs.source: Placed station buff
buffs.why: Endgame ranger still wants free ammo efficiency before every serious fight.
buffs.desc: The Ammo Box is a furniture item. It can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for 10 GC in Hardmode.

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Ammo consumption adds up quickly, so this makes a stack last longer.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ammo Reservation Potion is a buff potion which grants the Ammo Reservation buff when consumed. The buff reduces the chance of consuming any ammunition by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Archery Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Raises arrow damage by 10% and arrow speed by 20%. Bows only.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Archery Potion is a buff potion which grants the Archery buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage of arrow -firing weapons by 10%, as well as the velocity of arrows by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Soaring Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endless Musket Pouch
buffs.source: Crafted at Crystal Ball
buffs.why: An infinite stack of Musket Balls, so ammo never runs out.
buffs.station: Crystal Ball
buffs.desc: The Endless Musket Pouch is a Hardmode ammunition item. While in the inventory, it acts as an infinite source of Musket Balls.

ammo.name: Bloodfire Arrow
ammo.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
ammo.desc: Bloodfire Arrows are post- Moon Lord arrows. They drain 1 HP from the player when fired, travel at a noticeably higher speed than most arrows, and are not affected by gravity. When hitting an enemy, they deal 1.3x damage and will increase the player's health regeneration and heal the player for 1-4 HP depending on their missing health.

ammo.name: Luminite Arrow
ammo.desc: The Luminite Arrow is a Hardmode, post- Moon Lord arrow. When a Luminite Arrow dissipates, a Luminite Arrow Trail projectile will be fired after a short delay which copies the arrow's flying trail and deals the same base damage as the arrow. The Luminite Arrow and its trail can pierce 3 enemies, and their damage decreases by 4% per enemy pierced. [ 1 ] Both the arrow and its trail also dissipate upon contact with blocks or after 0.75 seconds.

items.name: Elysian Wings
items.why: This is faster than the other wings.
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · Blessed by the Profaned Flame
items.desc: Elysian Wings are a post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory that are dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

items.name: Moon Walkers
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 2.67 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Great · Max vertical speed: Great · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Good · 24% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Hee hee!'
items.desc: Moon Walkers are a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Angel Treads. They grant the following effects while equipped:

items.desc: Tarragon Wings are a post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory. While equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

items.desc: The Ascendant Insignia is a post- Moon Lord accessory and an upgrade to the Soaring Insignia. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.desc: The Elysian Aegis is a post- Moon Lord shield accessory that is dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.desc: The Statis' Ninja Belt is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Master Ninja Gear and Frog Gear. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.desc: The Absorber is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Grand Gelatin, Baroclaw, and Giant Tortoise Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: The Community
items.effect: 'The heart of (most of) the Terraria community' · Thank you to all of our supporters who made this mod a reality!
items.desc: The Community is an accessory that is dropped by Leviathan and Anahita. When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

items.name: The Evolution
items.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%
items.desc: The Evolution is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Ceaseless Void. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Arc Flash Ring
items.effect: Attacks have a 5% chance to call down a lightning bolt for 3x damage · The chance is reduced for each enemy an attack hits · The bolt's damage is based on non-crit damage, but can itself crit · Bolts are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled
items.desc: The Arc Flash Ring is an Expert Mode post- Moon Lord accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Storm Weaver. While equipped, it grants the player's attacks a 5% chance to fire down an arc flash that deals 3x the weapon's base damage and inflicts the Electrified debuff for 3 seconds.

items.name: Daawnlight Spirit Origin
items.effect: All ranged weapons can supercrit when critical strike chance is over 100% · Marks enemies and bosses with bullseyes which boost critical strike chance when hit · Extra critical strike chance quickly fades over time · Summons a heroic spirit from another world if visibility is on or in vanity slots · 'A strand of a lost cosmos remains, waiting for its master'
items.desc: The Daawnlight Spirit Origin is a post- Moon Lord accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Dynamo Stem Cells
items.effect: 10% increased ranged damage and movement speed · Ranged weapons fire a powerful mini swarmer every 3 seconds · Reduces damage taken from Dragonfire
items.desc: The Dynamo Stem Cells are an Expert Mode -exclusive post- Moon Lord accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by the Dragonfolly. They grant the following effects while equipped:
