accessories.name: Affliction
accessories.source: Dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode
accessories.effect: Gives all teammates +0.5 HP/s life regen, +10% max life, 7% damage reduction, 9 defense and 10% increased damage
accessories.desc: Affliction is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode. While equipped, all the player's teammates in the same team are granted the Afflicted buff, which provides all the bonuses that the accessory itself provides.

accessories.name: The Absorber
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing
accessories.desc: The Absorber is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Grand Gelatin, Baroclaw, and Giant Tortoise Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: The Community
accessories.effect: 'The heart of (most of) the Terraria community' · Thank you to all of our supporters who made this mod a reality!
accessories.desc: The Community is an accessory that is dropped by Leviathan and Anahita. When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

accessories.name: The Evolution
accessories.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%
accessories.desc: The Evolution is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Ceaseless Void. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Ascendant Insignia
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Increases wing flight time by 50%, movement and jump speed by 15%, and acceleration by 1.5x · Pressing Ascendant Insignia Hotkey grants you the power of ascension, providing infinite flight time for 4 seconds · Ascension has a 40 second cooldown
accessories.desc: The Ascendant Insignia is a post- Moon Lord accessory and an upgrade to the Soaring Insignia. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Elysian Aegis
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to dash, empowered by holy fire · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage · 'Blessed by the Profaned Flame'
accessories.desc: The Elysian Aegis is a post- Moon Lord shield accessory that is dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Statis' Ninja Belt
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 10% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.6x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws
accessories.desc: The Statis' Ninja Belt is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Master Ninja Gear and Frog Gear. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Leviathan Ambergris
accessories.source: Dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita
accessories.effect: 100% increased initial dash velocity, 33% faster dash cooldown, and greatly increased dash deceleration · Your dashes are empowered by water, knocking back and damaging enemies with vicious currents · Visual effects are reduced if visibility is disabled
accessories.desc: The Leviathan Ambergris is an Expert Mode -exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Arc Flash Ring
accessories.effect: Attacks have a 5% chance to call down a lightning bolt for 3x damage · The chance is reduced for each enemy an attack hits · The bolt's damage is based on non-crit damage, but can itself crit · Bolts are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled
accessories.desc: The Arc Flash Ring is an Expert Mode post- Moon Lord accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Storm Weaver. While equipped, it grants the player's attacks a 5% chance to fire down an arc flash that deals 3x the weapon's base damage and inflicts the Electrified debuff for 3 seconds.

accessories.name: Badge of Bravery
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Increases melee damage and critical strike chance by 10% · Increases melee armor penetration by 5
accessories.desc: The Badge of Bravery is a post- Moon Lord accessory. When equipped, it increases melee damage and critical strike chance by 10%, and armor penetration by 5.

accessories.name: Fire Gauntlet
accessories.why: Melee damage, speed and knockback, and sets enemies on fire. Upgrades from Mechanical Glove.
accessories.effect: Increases melee knockback and melee attacks inflict fire damage · 12% increased melee damage and speed · Enables auto swing for melee weapons · Increases the size of melee weapons
accessories.desc: The Fire Gauntlet is a Hardmode, post- mechanical bosses accessory. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

accessories.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
accessories.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'
accessories.desc: The Reaper Tooth Necklace is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Sand Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

accessories.name: Warbanner of the Righteous
accessories.effect: Multiplies all damage based on how close you are to enemies · Maximum damage boost is 15%, minimum damage boost is -15% · Emit a blazing aura that burns and repels nearby enemies with Holy Flames · Enemies take increasing damage the closer they are to you and the longer they are near you · Effects are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled
accessories.desc: The Warbanner of the Righteous is an Expert Mode -exclusive post- Moon Lord accessory dropped by the Profaned Guardians. While equipped, it increases all damage depending on how close the player is to an enemy. The boost scales from -15% to +15%.

accessories.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
accessories.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled
accessories.desc: The Ambrosial Ampoule is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Living Dew and Radiant Ooze. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Deific Amulet
accessories.effect: Releases a burst of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect
accessories.desc: The Deific Amulet is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star Veil. It grants the following effects while equipped:

buffs.name: Bloodfin
buffs.desc: The Bloodfin is a post- Moon Lord healing potion -type fish that can be caught in the Brimstone Crag with a 10% chance after Providence, the Profaned Goddess has been defeated.

buffs.name: Supreme Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Supreme Healing Potion is a post- Moon Lord potion that heals the player for 250 health, and inflicts the Potion Sickness debuff upon use. It is also dropped from Providence, the Profaned Goddess, Ceaseless Void, Storm Weaver, Signus, Polterghast, and The Old Duke.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.desc: The Seafood Dinner is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Photosynthesis Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Photosynthesis Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

buffs.name: Bloodflare armor
buffs.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
buffs.station: Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
buffs.desc: Bloodflare armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit faint pulses.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Lifeforce Potion is a buff potion that grants the Lifeforce buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Flask of Crumbling
buffs.source: Crafted at an Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.desc: The Flask of Crumbling is a Hardmode flask. Upon consumption, it grants the Weapon Imbue: Crumbling buff, which causes all melee, whip, and rogue attacks to inflict the Crumbling debuff.

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Sharpening Station
buffs.source: Found in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle
buffs.why: Grants armor penetration to melee weapons while standing near it.
buffs.desc: The Sharpening Station is a furniture item found naturally generated in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle. In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Merchant for 10 GC.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Soaring Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Elysian Wings
items.why: This is faster than the other wings.
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · Blessed by the Profaned Flame
items.desc: Elysian Wings are a post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory that are dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

items.name: Tarragon Wings
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4.5 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Great · Vertical acceleration: Great · 'Born of the jungle'
items.desc: Tarragon Wings are a post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory. While equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

items.name: Void Striders
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 3.33 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 36% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Ludicrous speed!'
items.desc: Void Striders are a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Moon Walkers. They grant the following effects while equipped:

items.desc: The Warbanner of the Righteous is an Expert Mode -exclusive post- Moon Lord accessory dropped by the Profaned Guardians. While equipped, it increases all damage depending on how close the player is to an enemy. The boost scales from -15% to +15%.

weapons.name: Fetid Emesis
weapons.source: Dropped by The Old Duke
weapons.effect: Fires an accelerating stream of bullets until the barrel overheats · When the barrel overheats, a spread of fetid chunks is vomited out · After firing, the gun must cool back down before it can be used again · 66% chance to save ammo
weapons.desc: The Fetid Emesis is a post- Moon Lord gun that is dropped by The Old Duke. It fires bullets at a gradually increasing rate, up to a maximum of 20 bullets per second after 5 seconds. After 7 seconds, the gun fires a massive spread of 11 rotten chunks outwards which deal 250% base damage and inflict the Sulphuric Poisoning debuff.

weapons.name: Halley's Inferno
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a burst of intensely concentrated lunar fire jets · ⚷ Open / Activate to rapid-fire Starbursts that inflict Voidfrost · Generates Starbursts when hitting enemies, depending on your accuracy · Uses gel for ammo · 50% chance to save ammo · 'Halley arrived sooner than expected'
weapons.desc: Halley's Inferno is a post- Moon Lord flamethrower. It uses Gel for ammunition, with a 50% chance to not consume ammo. When used with its primary fire (⚒ Use / Attack), it fires a rapid burst of five blue comets that pierce four times.

weapons.name: Monsoon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a spread of 5 arrows · Wooden arrows are converted into typhoon arrows and sharks
weapons.desc: The Monsoon is a post- Moon Lord bow that auto-fires five arrows at once. When firing Wooden Arrows, four of the five arrows are converted into sharks, and the fifth, middle arrow is converted into a Typhoon Arrow. Typhoon Arrows erupt into a swirling typhoon on contact with enemies or tiles, dealing damage over time in a wide area.

weapons.name: Quiver of Nihility
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: 5% increased ranged critical strike chance · Summons a ring of four void fields to orbit you · Arrows that pass through these fields gain a 75% damage boost and double speed · 'Filled with a substance darker than the night sky'
weapons.desc: The Quiver of Nihility is a post- Moon Lord accessory. While equipped, it grants +5% ranged critical strike chance. It also summons four void fields that orbit around the player.

weapons.name: Sulphuric Acid Cannon
weapons.source: Dropped by the Mauler miniboss in the Tier 3 Acid Rain
weapons.effect: Fires homing Acid Rockets · Acid Rockets stick to enemies and explode into toxic mist after a short delay
weapons.desc: The Sulphuric Acid Cannon is a post- Moon Lord launcher that is dropped by the Mauler miniboss in the Tier 3 Acid Rain. When used, it slowly fires acid rockets which home in on enemies and stick to them. After being stuck to an enemy for 3.33 seconds, the acid rocket creates a large sulphuric mist explosion, dealing 200% base damage and inflicting the Sulphuric Poisoning debuff.

weapons.name: Tau Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: A bulky assault rifle with three charge levels that fires astral energy · Charge level one fires a burst of bolts · Charge level two fires a beam of energy that quickly fizzles out · Charge level three fires a massive laser and creates astral portals around you · 'This weapon is very ethically questionable'
weapons.desc: The Tau Cannon is a post- Moon Lord ranged weapon that does not consume ammo. It is one of the final upgrades to the Magna Cannon and Opal Striker, alongside the Ontological Despoiler. While holding, the player channels a glowing blue orb at the tip of the cannon which increases in charge level every second, as indicated by a pulse.

weapons.name: Claret Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a hypercondensed claret round · The round explodes upon striking an enemy and releases blood orbs · The explosion shreds enemies, dramatically reducing their defense · Picking up the blood orbs will reduce Potion Sickness when possible · If you do not have Potion Sickness , your natural regeneration will be enhanced · Can only fire once every 10 seconds · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Claret Cannon is a post- Moon Lord classless weapon. It fires a small claret round that explodes into 20 small floating blood orbs upon hitting an enemy. When collected by the player, each orb reduces the duration of the Potion Sickness debuff by 0.33 seconds.

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Eye of Magnus is a Hardmode classless weapon that is an upgraded version of the Lunic Eye. When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
weapons.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Normality Relocator
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Press Normality Relocator to teleport to the position of the mouse · Fall speed is doubled for 0.5 seconds after teleporting · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Works while in the inventory · 'I'll be there in the blink of an eye'
weapons.desc: Normality Relocator is a post- Moon Lord tool. While it is in the player's inventory, they may press the Normality Relocator key to instantly warp to the position of the cursor. Unlike the Rod of Discord, the Relocator cannot be used normally like other tools via selecting it in the hotbar and pressing the ⚒ Use / Attack key.

weapons.name: Stratus Sphere
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Launches a singularity which exerts influence on all entities in a large area around it · Influenced players gain Starbursts over time and will consume Starbursts to fly when out of flight time · ⚷ Open / Activate to cause Starbursts to form a barrier, causing you to lose Starbursts instead of health · Launching the singularity deactivates the barrier, and creating the barrier deactivates the singularity · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats · 'Channeling souls into stars, an inane concept'
weapons.desc: The Stratus Sphere is a post- Moon Lord classless weapon. When used, it fires a massive planetary stratus orb that can pass through tiles.

armor.name: Bloodflare armor
armor.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
armor.effect: Enemies below 50% life drop a heart when struck · This effect has a 5 second cooldown · Ram Mask: Enemies are more likely to target you · After striking an enemy 15 times with true melee you will enter a blood frenzy for 5 seconds · During this you will gain 25% increased melee damage, critical strike chance, and 50% reduced contact damage · This effect has a 30 second cooldown · Demon Helm: Armor Set Bonus to unleash the lost souls of polterghast[ sic ] to destroy your enemies · This effect has a 30 second cooldown · Ranged weapons fire bloodsplosion orbs every 2.5 seconds · Hydra Hood: Magic weapons fire ghostly bolts every 1.67 seconds · Magic critical strikes cause blood explosions every 2 seconds · Wyvern Helm: Increases your max number of minions by 2 · 30% increased summon damage · Summons polterghast mines to circle you · Grants 20 defense when below 50% life · Imp Mask: +120 maximum stealth · Grants 30 defense when above 80% life
armor.desc: Bloodflare armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit faint pulses.

armor.name: Omega Blue armor
armor.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 2 · Short-ranged tentacles heal you by sucking enemy life · Abyssal Madness - Armor Set Bonus to go berserk for 5 seconds · While active, tentacles attack with greater range and aggression, and always critically strike · This also grants 10% increased damage and critical strike chance · This effect has a 25 second cooldown
armor.desc: Omega Blue armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit a pulsating aura around them.

accessories.name: Heartreach Potion
accessories.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
accessories.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
accessories.effect: Increases pickup range for life hearts
accessories.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

accessories.name: Photosynthesis Potion
accessories.effect: Dropped hearts heal 5 more HP
accessories.desc: The Photosynthesis Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

accessories.name: Elysian Wings
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · Blessed by the Profaned Flame
accessories.desc: Elysian Wings are a post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory that are dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

accessories.name: Tarragon Wings
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4.5 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Great · Vertical acceleration: Great · 'Born of the jungle'
accessories.desc: Tarragon Wings are a post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory. While equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

accessories.name: Void Striders
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 3.33 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 36% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Ludicrous speed!'
accessories.desc: Void Striders are a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Moon Walkers. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Affliction
accessories.source: Dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode
accessories.effect: Gives all teammates +0.5 HP/s life regen, +10% max life, 7% damage reduction, 9 defense and 10% increased damage
accessories.desc: Affliction is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode. While equipped, all the player's teammates in the same team are granted the Afflicted buff, which provides all the bonuses that the accessory itself provides.

accessories.name: The Absorber
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing
accessories.desc: The Absorber is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Grand Gelatin, Baroclaw, and Giant Tortoise Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: The Community
accessories.effect: 'The heart of (most of) the Terraria community' · Thank you to all of our supporters who made this mod a reality!
accessories.desc: The Community is an accessory that is dropped by Leviathan and Anahita. When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

accessories.name: The Evolution
accessories.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%
accessories.desc: The Evolution is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Ceaseless Void. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Ascendant Insignia
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Increases wing flight time by 50%, movement and jump speed by 15%, and acceleration by 1.5x · Pressing Ascendant Insignia Hotkey grants you the power of ascension, providing infinite flight time for 4 seconds · Ascension has a 40 second cooldown
accessories.desc: The Ascendant Insignia is a post- Moon Lord accessory and an upgrade to the Soaring Insignia. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Elysian Aegis
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to dash, empowered by holy fire · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage · 'Blessed by the Profaned Flame'
accessories.desc: The Elysian Aegis is a post- Moon Lord shield accessory that is dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Statis' Ninja Belt
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 10% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.6x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws
accessories.desc: The Statis' Ninja Belt is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Master Ninja Gear and Frog Gear. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Leviathan Ambergris
accessories.source: Dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita
accessories.effect: 100% increased initial dash velocity, 33% faster dash cooldown, and greatly increased dash deceleration · Your dashes are empowered by water, knocking back and damaging enemies with vicious currents · Visual effects are reduced if visibility is disabled
accessories.desc: The Leviathan Ambergris is an Expert Mode -exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Arc Flash Ring
accessories.effect: Attacks have a 5% chance to call down a lightning bolt for 3x damage · The chance is reduced for each enemy an attack hits · The bolt's damage is based on non-crit damage, but can itself crit · Bolts are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled
accessories.desc: The Arc Flash Ring is an Expert Mode post- Moon Lord accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Storm Weaver. While equipped, it grants the player's attacks a 5% chance to fire down an arc flash that deals 3x the weapon's base damage and inflicts the Electrified debuff for 3 seconds.

accessories.name: Daawnlight Spirit Origin
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: All ranged weapons can supercrit when critical strike chance is over 100% · Marks enemies and bosses with bullseyes which boost critical strike chance when hit · Extra critical strike chance quickly fades over time · Summons a heroic spirit from another world if visibility is on or in vanity slots · 'A strand of a lost cosmos remains, waiting for its master'
accessories.desc: The Daawnlight Spirit Origin is a post- Moon Lord accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Quiver of Nihility
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: 5% increased ranged critical strike chance · Summons a ring of four void fields to orbit you · Arrows that pass through these fields gain a 75% damage boost and double speed · 'Filled with a substance darker than the night sky'
accessories.desc: The Quiver of Nihility is a post- Moon Lord accessory. While equipped, it grants +5% ranged critical strike chance. It also summons four void fields that orbit around the player.

accessories.name: Monsoon
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Fires a spread of 5 arrows · Wooden arrows are converted into typhoon arrows and sharks
accessories.desc: The Monsoon is a post- Moon Lord bow that auto-fires five arrows at once. When firing Wooden Arrows, four of the five arrows are converted into sharks, and the fifth, middle arrow is converted into a Typhoon Arrow. Typhoon Arrows erupt into a swirling typhoon on contact with enemies or tiles, dealing damage over time in a wide area.

accessories.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
accessories.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'
accessories.desc: The Reaper Tooth Necklace is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Sand Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

accessories.name: Recon Scope
accessories.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance · Enemies are less likely to target you · 'Enemy spotted'
accessories.desc: The Recon Scope is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Sniper Scope
accessories.why: 10% ranged damage and crit, and zooms out when you right-click with a gun.
accessories.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance
accessories.desc: The Sniper Scope is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
accessories.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled
accessories.desc: The Ambrosial Ampoule is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Living Dew and Radiant Ooze. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Deific Amulet
accessories.effect: Releases a burst of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect
accessories.desc: The Deific Amulet is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star Veil. It grants the following effects while equipped:

buffs.name: Bloodfin
buffs.desc: The Bloodfin is a post- Moon Lord healing potion -type fish that can be caught in the Brimstone Crag with a 10% chance after Providence, the Profaned Goddess has been defeated.

buffs.name: Supreme Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Supreme Healing Potion is a post- Moon Lord potion that heals the player for 250 health, and inflicts the Potion Sickness debuff upon use. It is also dropped from Providence, the Profaned Goddess, Ceaseless Void, Storm Weaver, Signus, Polterghast, and The Old Duke.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.desc: The Seafood Dinner is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Survival matters a lot once the phase is dominated by hard optional content and fast fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Photosynthesis Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Photosynthesis Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

buffs.name: Bloodflare armor
buffs.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
buffs.station: Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
buffs.desc: Bloodflare armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit faint pulses.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Even ranged classes need extra defense when bosses or cave enemies close the gap.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Lifeforce Potion is a buff potion that grants the Lifeforce buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ammo Box
buffs.source: Placed station buff
buffs.why: Endgame ranger still wants free ammo efficiency before every serious fight.
buffs.desc: The Ammo Box is a furniture item. It can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for 10 GC in Hardmode.

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Ammo consumption adds up quickly, so this makes a stack last longer.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ammo Reservation Potion is a buff potion which grants the Ammo Reservation buff when consumed. The buff reduces the chance of consuming any ammunition by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Archery Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Raises arrow damage by 10% and arrow speed by 20%. Bows only.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Archery Potion is a buff potion which grants the Archery buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage of arrow -firing weapons by 10%, as well as the velocity of arrows by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Soaring Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Mini Nuke I
buffs.source: Crafted at an Autohammer
buffs.station: Autohammer
buffs.desc: The Mini Nuke I is a type of rocket ammunition. Unlike the Mini Nuke II, it does not destroy tiles. It is a direct upgrade to the Rocket III, dealing more damage over a larger blast radius, but with lower knockback.

ammo.name: Bloodfire Bullet
ammo.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
ammo.desc: Bloodfire Bullets are post- Moon Lord bullets. They can pass through tiles and accelerate the player's natural life regeneration rate by 3 on enemy hits. Additionally, their damage is increased by the player's current life regeneration, which calculates when the enemy gets hit up to a maximum of 1.1x increased flat damage.

ammo.name: Holy Fire Bullet
ammo.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
ammo.desc: Holy Fire Bullets are post- Moon Lord bullets. They deal up to 15% increased damage based on how close it is to the player, as well as explode upon collision with any enemy or tile, creating explosions which deal 33% of the bullet's damage and inflicting the Holy Flames debuff. Explosions shrink the longer the bullet has remained in the air, reducing down to half size after 0.27 seconds, and cannot hit enemies the bullet has hit.

ammo.name: Luminite Bullet
ammo.why: The highest base damage of any bullet.
ammo.desc: The Luminite Bullet is a Hardmode, post- Moon Lord bullet. The Luminite Bullet can hit an infinite number of targets. The damage of the Luminite Bullet decreases by 4% each time it hits a target.

ammo.name: Wooden Arrow
ammo.source: Sold by the Merchant, or dropped by Skeletons and Zombies
ammo.desc: The Wooden Arrow is a pre-Hardmode arrow. It has no special properties and is used for crafting a variety of more advanced ammunition. When fired with certain bows, Wooden Arrows will be converted into a special projectile (e.g. the Molten Fury converting them into Flaming Arrows).

items.desc: The Reaper Tooth Necklace is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Sand Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

items.name: Recon Scope
items.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance · Enemies are less likely to target you · 'Enemy spotted'
items.desc: The Recon Scope is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Sniper Scope
items.why: This grants critical strike damage.
items.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance
items.desc: The Sniper Scope is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

weapons.name: Dark Spark
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: 'And everything under the sun is in tune, · But the sun is eclipsed by the moon.'
weapons.desc: Dark Spark is a post- Moon Lord magic weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Last Prism. When used, it initially fires a single black beam of light that splits into six different beams as it charges. Over 6 seconds, these beams will change to white and, after another 4 seconds, various colors.

weapons.name: Phantasmal Fury
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Casts a vortex of homing souls around you that repels enemies and will fly towards your cursor after a few seconds
weapons.desc: The Phantasmal Fury is a post- Moon Lord wand that is a direct upgrade to the Spectre Staff. When used, it fires a swirling vortex of souls around the player. While swirling around the player, souls deal 30% base damage but have twice as much knockback.

weapons.name: Shadowbolt Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a shadow beam that creates a platform to redirect itself back at enemies for increased damage
weapons.desc: The Shadowbolt Staff is a post- Moon Lord wand that is a direct upgrade to the Shadowbeam Staff. When used, it fires a shadowbolt that can pass through tiles. After traveling far enough or hitting an enemy, the shadowbolt creates a platform that it rebounds off of after a delay.

weapons.name: Venusian Trident
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Casts an infernal trident that erupts into a gigantic explosion of fire and magma shards · Always critically strikes, with critical strike chance increasing critical strike damage
weapons.desc: The Venusian Trident is a post- Moon Lord wand and the direct upgrade to the Inferno Fork. When used, it fires an infernal trident that causes a very large explosion upon hitting a tile or an enemy, releasing four to nine flaming shards that fall to the floor and deal 2% of the weapon's damage. The tridents, explosions, and flaming shards inflict the Daybroken debuff, and always critically strike.

weapons.name: Vitriolic Viper
weapons.source: Dropped by The Old Duke
weapons.effect: Charges up and fires a slithering beam of radiation · If fully charged, instead fires a huge spread of short range fangs
weapons.desc: The Vitriolic Viper is a post- Moon Lord wand that is dropped by The Old Duke. When used, it charges up to fire a spread of radioactive beams that inflict the Irradiated debuff, whose spread gets tighter the longer it is charged. After 1 second to fully charge, it instead fires a large spread of 33 short-range fangs that inflict the Sulphuric Poisoning debuff.

weapons.name: Claret Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a hypercondensed claret round · The round explodes upon striking an enemy and releases blood orbs · The explosion shreds enemies, dramatically reducing their defense · Picking up the blood orbs will reduce Potion Sickness when possible · If you do not have Potion Sickness , your natural regeneration will be enhanced · Can only fire once every 10 seconds · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Claret Cannon is a post- Moon Lord classless weapon. It fires a small claret round that explodes into 20 small floating blood orbs upon hitting an enemy. When collected by the player, each orb reduces the duration of the Potion Sickness debuff by 0.33 seconds.

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Eye of Magnus is a Hardmode classless weapon that is an upgraded version of the Lunic Eye. When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
weapons.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Normality Relocator
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Press Normality Relocator to teleport to the position of the mouse · Fall speed is doubled for 0.5 seconds after teleporting · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Works while in the inventory · 'I'll be there in the blink of an eye'
weapons.desc: Normality Relocator is a post- Moon Lord tool. While it is in the player's inventory, they may press the Normality Relocator key to instantly warp to the position of the cursor. Unlike the Rod of Discord, the Relocator cannot be used normally like other tools via selecting it in the hotbar and pressing the ⚒ Use / Attack key.

weapons.name: Stratus Sphere
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Launches a singularity which exerts influence on all entities in a large area around it · Influenced players gain Starbursts over time and will consume Starbursts to fly when out of flight time · ⚷ Open / Activate to cause Starbursts to form a barrier, causing you to lose Starbursts instead of health · Launching the singularity deactivates the barrier, and creating the barrier deactivates the singularity · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats · 'Channeling souls into stars, an inane concept'
weapons.desc: The Stratus Sphere is a post- Moon Lord classless weapon. When used, it fires a massive planetary stratus orb that can pass through tiles.

armor.name: Bloodflare armor
armor.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
armor.effect: Enemies below 50% life drop a heart when struck · This effect has a 5 second cooldown · Ram Mask: Enemies are more likely to target you · After striking an enemy 15 times with true melee you will enter a blood frenzy for 5 seconds · During this you will gain 25% increased melee damage, critical strike chance, and 50% reduced contact damage · This effect has a 30 second cooldown · Demon Helm: Armor Set Bonus to unleash the lost souls of polterghast[ sic ] to destroy your enemies · This effect has a 30 second cooldown · Ranged weapons fire bloodsplosion orbs every 2.5 seconds · Hydra Hood: Magic weapons fire ghostly bolts every 1.67 seconds · Magic critical strikes cause blood explosions every 2 seconds · Wyvern Helm: Increases your max number of minions by 2 · 30% increased summon damage · Summons polterghast mines to circle you · Grants 20 defense when below 50% life · Imp Mask: +120 maximum stealth · Grants 30 defense when above 80% life
armor.desc: Bloodflare armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit faint pulses.

armor.name: Prismatic armor
armor.effect: Increased mana regeneration rate · Prismatic Barrage - Armor Set Bonus to unleash a laser barrage at the cursor for 5 seconds · This has a 30 second cooldown
armor.desc: Prismatic armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a faint pulsing aura.

armor.name: Omega Blue armor
armor.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 2 · Short-ranged tentacles heal you by sucking enemy life · Abyssal Madness - Armor Set Bonus to go berserk for 5 seconds · While active, tentacles attack with greater range and aggression, and always critically strike · This also grants 10% increased damage and critical strike chance · This effect has a 25 second cooldown
armor.desc: Omega Blue armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit a pulsating aura around them.

accessories.name: Heartreach Potion
accessories.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
accessories.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
accessories.effect: Increases pickup range for life hearts
accessories.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

accessories.name: Photosynthesis Potion
accessories.effect: Dropped hearts heal 5 more HP
accessories.desc: The Photosynthesis Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

accessories.name: Elysian Wings
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · Blessed by the Profaned Flame
accessories.desc: Elysian Wings are a post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory that are dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

accessories.name: Tarragon Wings
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4.5 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Great · Vertical acceleration: Great · 'Born of the jungle'
accessories.desc: Tarragon Wings are a post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory. While equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

accessories.name: Void Striders
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 3.33 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 36% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Ludicrous speed!'
accessories.desc: Void Striders are a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Moon Walkers. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Affliction
accessories.source: Dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode
accessories.effect: Gives all teammates +0.5 HP/s life regen, +10% max life, 7% damage reduction, 9 defense and 10% increased damage
accessories.desc: Affliction is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode. While equipped, all the player's teammates in the same team are granted the Afflicted buff, which provides all the bonuses that the accessory itself provides.

accessories.name: The Absorber
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing
accessories.desc: The Absorber is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Grand Gelatin, Baroclaw, and Giant Tortoise Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: The Community
accessories.effect: 'The heart of (most of) the Terraria community' · Thank you to all of our supporters who made this mod a reality!
accessories.desc: The Community is an accessory that is dropped by Leviathan and Anahita. When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

accessories.name: The Evolution
accessories.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%
accessories.desc: The Evolution is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Ceaseless Void. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Ascendant Insignia
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Increases wing flight time by 50%, movement and jump speed by 15%, and acceleration by 1.5x · Pressing Ascendant Insignia Hotkey grants you the power of ascension, providing infinite flight time for 4 seconds · Ascension has a 40 second cooldown
accessories.desc: The Ascendant Insignia is a post- Moon Lord accessory and an upgrade to the Soaring Insignia. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Elysian Aegis
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to dash, empowered by holy fire · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage · 'Blessed by the Profaned Flame'
accessories.desc: The Elysian Aegis is a post- Moon Lord shield accessory that is dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Statis' Ninja Belt
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 10% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.6x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws
accessories.desc: The Statis' Ninja Belt is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Master Ninja Gear and Frog Gear. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Leviathan Ambergris
accessories.source: Dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita
accessories.effect: 100% increased initial dash velocity, 33% faster dash cooldown, and greatly increased dash deceleration · Your dashes are empowered by water, knocking back and damaging enemies with vicious currents · Visual effects are reduced if visibility is disabled
accessories.desc: The Leviathan Ambergris is an Expert Mode -exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Arc Flash Ring
accessories.effect: Attacks have a 5% chance to call down a lightning bolt for 3x damage · The chance is reduced for each enemy an attack hits · The bolt's damage is based on non-crit damage, but can itself crit · Bolts are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled
accessories.desc: The Arc Flash Ring is an Expert Mode post- Moon Lord accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Storm Weaver. While equipped, it grants the player's attacks a 5% chance to fire down an arc flash that deals 3x the weapon's base damage and inflicts the Electrified debuff for 3 seconds.

accessories.name: Arcane Flower
accessories.effect: 8% reduced mana cost · Automatically use mana potions when needed · Enemies are less likely to target you
accessories.desc: The Arcane Flower is a Hardmode accessory which combines the functionality of the Mana Flower and the aggro -reducing effect of the Putrid Scent.

accessories.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
accessories.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'
accessories.desc: The Reaper Tooth Necklace is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Sand Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

accessories.name: Sigil of Calamitas
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Increases maximum mana by 60 · 15% increased magic damage · Increases pickup range for mana stars
accessories.desc: The Sigil of Calamitas is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Celestial Emblem. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
accessories.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled
accessories.desc: The Ambrosial Ampoule is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Living Dew and Radiant Ooze. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Deific Amulet
accessories.effect: Releases a burst of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect
accessories.desc: The Deific Amulet is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star Veil. It grants the following effects while equipped:

buffs.name: Bloodfin
buffs.desc: The Bloodfin is a post- Moon Lord healing potion -type fish that can be caught in the Brimstone Crag with a 10% chance after Providence, the Profaned Goddess has been defeated.

buffs.name: Supreme Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Supreme Healing Potion is a post- Moon Lord potion that heals the player for 250 health, and inflicts the Potion Sickness debuff upon use. It is also dropped from Providence, the Profaned Goddess, Ceaseless Void, Storm Weaver, Signus, Polterghast, and The Old Duke.

buffs.name: Supreme Mana Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Supreme Mana Potion is a post- Moon Lord potion. Upon consumption, it restores 400 mana and inflicts the Mana Sickness debuff.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.desc: The Seafood Dinner is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: The extra survivability helps offset how punishing late-Hardmode mistakes can be for mage.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Photosynthesis Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Photosynthesis Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

buffs.name: Bloodflare armor
buffs.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
buffs.station: Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
buffs.desc: Bloodflare armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit faint pulses.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Mage has less room for mistakes, so the bonus defense matters a lot.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Lifeforce Potion is a buff potion that grants the Lifeforce buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Crystal Ball
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Wizard
buffs.why: Free Clairvoyance remains a baseline endgame mage habit before any serious fight.
buffs.desc: The Crystal Ball is a Hardmode furniture item which functions as a crafting station. It is purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC. Pressing ⚷ Open / Activate on a placed Crystal Ball grants the Clairvoyance buff and opens its crafting menu.

buffs.name: Magic Power Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Magic Power Potion is a buff potion which grants the Magic Power buff when consumed. The buff increases magic damage by 20%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Speeds up mana regeneration, so you stop to drink fewer mana potions.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Mana Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Mana Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff increases the rate at which the player's mana regenerates. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Soaring Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.why: This is faster than the other wings.
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · Blessed by the Profaned Flame
items.desc: Elysian Wings are a post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory that are dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.
