items.desc: The Deific Amulet is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star Veil. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Affliction
items.effect: Gives all teammates +0.5 HP/s life regen, +10% max life, 7% damage reduction, 9 defense and 10% increased damage
items.desc: Affliction is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode. While equipped, all the player's teammates in the same team are granted the Afflicted buff, which provides all the bonuses that the accessory itself provides.

items.name: The Absorber
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing
items.desc: The Absorber is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Grand Gelatin, Baroclaw, and Giant Tortoise Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: The Community
items.effect: 'The heart of (most of) the Terraria community' · Thank you to all of our supporters who made this mod a reality!
items.desc: The Community is an accessory that is dropped by Leviathan and Anahita. When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

items.name: The Evolution
items.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%
items.desc: The Evolution is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Ceaseless Void. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Arc Flash Ring
items.effect: Attacks have a 5% chance to call down a lightning bolt for 3x damage · The chance is reduced for each enemy an attack hits · The bolt's damage is based on non-crit damage, but can itself crit · Bolts are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled
items.desc: The Arc Flash Ring is an Expert Mode post- Moon Lord accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Storm Weaver. While equipped, it grants the player's attacks a 5% chance to fire down an arc flash that deals 3x the weapon's base damage and inflicts the Electrified debuff for 3 seconds.

items.name: Arcane Flower
items.effect: 8% reduced mana cost · Automatically use mana potions when needed · Enemies are less likely to target you
items.desc: The Arcane Flower is a Hardmode accessory which combines the functionality of the Mana Flower and the aggro -reducing effect of the Putrid Scent.

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'
items.desc: The Reaper Tooth Necklace is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Sand Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

items.name: Sigil of Calamitas
items.effect: Increases maximum mana by 60 · 15% increased magic damage · Increases pickup range for mana stars
items.desc: The Sigil of Calamitas is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Celestial Emblem. It grants the following effects while equipped:

weapons.name: Dragonblood Disgorger
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons a skeletal dragon and her two children · Baby spits burst into blood orbs upon hitting an enemy · Picking up these blood orbs reduces the duration of Potion Sickness · There can only be one family at a time
weapons.desc: The Dragonblood Disgorger is a post- Moon Lord summon weapon. When used, it summons a large skeleton dragon minion accompanied by her two children. The main dragon wanders around and breathes bloodfire at nearby enemies which inflict the Burning Blood debuff on enemy hits, while the children violently charge at enemies and spit blood shots that spawn blood orbs which reduce the Potion Sickness cooldown by 0.2 seconds.

weapons.name: Ethereal Subjugator
weapons.source: Dropped by Polterghast
weapons.effect: Summons a phantom to protect you
weapons.desc: The Ethereal Subjugator is a post- Moon Lord summon weapon that is dropped by Polterghast. When used, it summons a Phantom minion that follows the player and attacks enemies by releasing 3 ghastly particles that home in on the closest enemy after a short time.

weapons.name: King of Constellations, Tenryū
weapons.source: Crafted at a Bookcase
weapons.effect: Summons a pair of celestial dragons to fight for you · There can only be one pair of dragons at a time · 'The ones who will devour the Unmoving Star'
weapons.desc: The King of Constellations, Tenryū is a post- Moon Lord summon weapon. It consumes four minion slots to summon two Celestial Dragons which follow the player. Each dragon contains 22 segments with 20 body segments.

weapons.name: Mutated Truffle
weapons.source: Dropped by The Old Duke
weapons.effect: Summons a younger fishron to irradiate your foes · The fishron will cycle between charging, projectiles, and a typhoon · There can only be one minion
weapons.desc: The Mutated Truffle is a post- Moon Lord summon weapon that is dropped by The Old Duke. It summons a Baby Boomer minion that cycles between through three attacks, starting out by charging rapidly at enemies, shooting tooth balls which explode into homing teeth projectiles after 2 seconds, and then spinning around while summoning a large vortex that slowly chase enemies to deal damage. The minion deals 125% base damage while charging at enemies.

weapons.name: Virid Vanguard
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Alternates between summoning axes and swords, both laced with a powerful poison · Axes orbit the player, dealing high damage at a close range · Swords chase down enemies with extreme precision, tearing them to shreds · All weapons inflict Sage Poison , which becomes more powerful the more weapons are summoned · When all minion slots are full, ⚒ Use / Attack again to spin up a flurry of slashes aimed at your cursor · This ability has a five-second cooldown that requires holding this item · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to change the rotation direction
weapons.desc: The Virid Vanguard is a post- Moon Lord summon weapon. When used, it alternates between summoning giant axes and blades that orbit around the player, inflicting Sage Poison which deals 50 damage per second, per summoned Virid Vanguard. Using it again with full minion slots can activate a special attack.

weapons.name: Cadaverous Carrion
weapons.source: Dropped by The Old Duke
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons a gross, shark-puking Old Duke head on the ground
weapons.desc: The Cadaverous Carrion is a post- Moon Lord sentry that is dropped by The Old Duke. When used, it summons a grounded Old Duke head sentry that rapidly fires homing sulphurous sharks at nearby enemies which inflicts the Sulphuric Poisoning debuff.

weapons.name: Lunar Portal Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by the Moon Lord
weapons.why: Post-Moon Lord sentry summoning a floating portal that fires sweeping piercing beams.
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons a lunar portal to shoot lasers at your enemies
weapons.desc: The Lunar Portal Staff is a Hardmode, post- Moon Lord summon weapon that summons a Lunar Portal sentry. It continuously fires beams that sweep across enemies, which pierce infinite enemies but cannot pass through blocks. Unlike most sentries, the Lunar Portal floats midair.

weapons.name: Sanctified Spark
weapons.source: Dropped by Impious Immolators
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons a friendly immolator that will float towards you · Immolators rapidly fire homing flares of Holy Flames at nearby enemies, before continuing to float near you again · After firing, Immolators will fire one healing bolt at you for every 4 summon slots you have · 'They might be a bit clingy, but at least they're warm'
weapons.desc: The Sanctified Spark is a post- Moon Lord sentry that is dropped by Impious Immolators. When used, it summons an Impious Immolator sentry that slowly follows the player and rapidly fires flame bursts at the nearest enemy which inflicts the Holy Flames debuff. It will briefly pause between attacks, during which it will fire one healing orb that heals 5 health each for every 4 minion slots the player has.

weapons.name: Kaleidoscope
weapons.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light (summoned after Plantera)
weapons.why: Empress of Light drop giving one of the largest summon tag damage bonuses.
weapons.effect: 20 summon tag damage · 10% summon tag critical strike chance · Your summons will focus struck enemies
weapons.desc: The Kaleidoscope is a Hardmode, post- Plantera whip that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by the Empress of Light. It has a 20% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:

weapons.name: Claret Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a hypercondensed claret round · The round explodes upon striking an enemy and releases blood orbs · The explosion shreds enemies, dramatically reducing their defense · Picking up the blood orbs will reduce Potion Sickness when possible · If you do not have Potion Sickness , your natural regeneration will be enhanced · Can only fire once every 10 seconds · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Claret Cannon is a post- Moon Lord classless weapon. It fires a small claret round that explodes into 20 small floating blood orbs upon hitting an enemy. When collected by the player, each orb reduces the duration of the Potion Sickness debuff by 0.33 seconds.

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Eye of Magnus is a Hardmode classless weapon that is an upgraded version of the Lunic Eye. When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
weapons.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Normality Relocator
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Press Normality Relocator to teleport to the position of the mouse · Fall speed is doubled for 0.5 seconds after teleporting · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Works while in the inventory · 'I'll be there in the blink of an eye'
weapons.desc: Normality Relocator is a post- Moon Lord tool. While it is in the player's inventory, they may press the Normality Relocator key to instantly warp to the position of the cursor. Unlike the Rod of Discord, the Relocator cannot be used normally like other tools via selecting it in the hotbar and pressing the ⚒ Use / Attack key.

weapons.name: Stratus Sphere
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Launches a singularity which exerts influence on all entities in a large area around it · Influenced players gain Starbursts over time and will consume Starbursts to fly when out of flight time · ⚷ Open / Activate to cause Starbursts to form a barrier, causing you to lose Starbursts instead of health · Launching the singularity deactivates the barrier, and creating the barrier deactivates the singularity · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats · 'Channeling souls into stars, an inane concept'
weapons.desc: The Stratus Sphere is a post- Moon Lord classless weapon. When used, it fires a massive planetary stratus orb that can pass through tiles.

armor.name: Bloodflare armor
armor.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
armor.effect: Enemies below 50% life drop a heart when struck · This effect has a 5 second cooldown · Ram Mask: Enemies are more likely to target you · After striking an enemy 15 times with true melee you will enter a blood frenzy for 5 seconds · During this you will gain 25% increased melee damage, critical strike chance, and 50% reduced contact damage · This effect has a 30 second cooldown · Demon Helm: Armor Set Bonus to unleash the lost souls of polterghast[ sic ] to destroy your enemies · This effect has a 30 second cooldown · Ranged weapons fire bloodsplosion orbs every 2.5 seconds · Hydra Hood: Magic weapons fire ghostly bolts every 1.67 seconds · Magic critical strikes cause blood explosions every 2 seconds · Wyvern Helm: Increases your max number of minions by 2 · 30% increased summon damage · Summons polterghast mines to circle you · Grants 20 defense when below 50% life · Imp Mask: +120 maximum stealth · Grants 30 defense when above 80% life
armor.desc: Bloodflare armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit faint pulses.

armor.name: Stardust armor
armor.why: A stardust guardian follows you and attacks nearby enemies.
armor.effect: A stardust guardian will protect you from nearby enemies
armor.desc: Stardust armor is a Hardmode, post- Moon Lord armor set consisting of the Stardust Helmet, Stardust Plate, and Stardust Leggings.

armor.name: Omega Blue armor
armor.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 2 · Short-ranged tentacles heal you by sucking enemy life · Abyssal Madness - Armor Set Bonus to go berserk for 5 seconds · While active, tentacles attack with greater range and aggression, and always critically strike · This also grants 10% increased damage and critical strike chance · This effect has a 25 second cooldown
armor.desc: Omega Blue armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit a pulsating aura around them.

accessories.name: Heartreach Potion
accessories.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
accessories.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
accessories.effect: Increases pickup range for life hearts
accessories.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

accessories.name: Photosynthesis Potion
accessories.effect: Dropped hearts heal 5 more HP
accessories.desc: The Photosynthesis Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

accessories.name: Stardust Wings
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
accessories.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

accessories.name: Elysian Wings
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · Blessed by the Profaned Flame
accessories.desc: Elysian Wings are a post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory that are dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

accessories.name: Tarragon Wings
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4.5 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Great · Vertical acceleration: Great · 'Born of the jungle'
accessories.desc: Tarragon Wings are a post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory. While equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

accessories.name: Void Striders
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 3.33 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 36% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Ludicrous speed!'
accessories.desc: Void Striders are a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Moon Walkers. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Affliction
accessories.source: Dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode
accessories.effect: Gives all teammates +0.5 HP/s life regen, +10% max life, 7% damage reduction, 9 defense and 10% increased damage
accessories.desc: Affliction is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode. While equipped, all the player's teammates in the same team are granted the Afflicted buff, which provides all the bonuses that the accessory itself provides.

accessories.name: Profaned Soul Artifact
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Summons your own personal Guardians to fight alongside you · The offensive guardian grants an additional minion slot and fires a ring of spears while attacking · The defensive guardian creates a weak barrier of profaned rock · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · Once depleted, the rocks are flung outward and will regenerate 5 seconds after being hit · Taking damage resets the timer · The healer guardian restores 10 health every few seconds · Purity
accessories.desc: The Profaned Soul Artifact is a post- Moon Lord accessory. It summons all three miniature Profaned Guardians to assist the player.

accessories.name: The Absorber
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing
accessories.desc: The Absorber is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Grand Gelatin, Baroclaw, and Giant Tortoise Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: The Evolution
accessories.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%
accessories.desc: The Evolution is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Ceaseless Void. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Ascendant Insignia
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Increases wing flight time by 50%, movement and jump speed by 15%, and acceleration by 1.5x · Pressing Ascendant Insignia Hotkey grants you the power of ascension, providing infinite flight time for 4 seconds · Ascension has a 40 second cooldown
accessories.desc: The Ascendant Insignia is a post- Moon Lord accessory and an upgrade to the Soaring Insignia. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Elysian Aegis
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to dash, empowered by holy fire · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage · 'Blessed by the Profaned Flame'
accessories.desc: The Elysian Aegis is a post- Moon Lord shield accessory that is dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Statis' Ninja Belt
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 10% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.6x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws
accessories.desc: The Statis' Ninja Belt is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Master Ninja Gear and Frog Gear. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Leviathan Ambergris
accessories.source: Dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita
accessories.effect: 100% increased initial dash velocity, 33% faster dash cooldown, and greatly increased dash deceleration · Your dashes are empowered by water, knocking back and damaging enemies with vicious currents · Visual effects are reduced if visibility is disabled
accessories.desc: The Leviathan Ambergris is an Expert Mode -exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
accessories.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'
accessories.desc: The Reaper Tooth Necklace is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Sand Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

accessories.name: Star-Tainted Generator
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 2, and summon damage by 7% · Minion attacks spawn astral explosions and inflict several debuffs · Grants immunity to Irradiated · Does not stack with downgrades
accessories.desc: The Star-Tainted Generator is a Hardmode accessory that combines the effects of the Jelly-Charged Battery, Nuclear Fuel Rod, and Starbuster Core. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Statis' Curse
accessories.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 3, and summon damage by 12% · Increased minion knockback · Minion attacks inflict Shadowflame , and grants immunity to Shadowflame · Does not stack with downgrades
accessories.desc: The Statis' Curse is a Hardmode accessory and an upgrade to the Statis' Blessing and The First Shadowflame. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
accessories.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled
accessories.desc: The Ambrosial Ampoule is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Living Dew and Radiant Ooze. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Deific Amulet
accessories.effect: Releases a burst of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect
accessories.desc: The Deific Amulet is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star Veil. It grants the following effects while equipped:

buffs.name: Bloodfin
buffs.desc: The Bloodfin is a post- Moon Lord healing potion -type fish that can be caught in the Brimstone Crag with a 10% chance after Providence, the Profaned Goddess has been defeated.

buffs.name: Supreme Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Supreme Healing Potion is a post- Moon Lord potion that heals the player for 250 health, and inflicts the Potion Sickness debuff upon use. It is also dropped from Providence, the Profaned Goddess, Ceaseless Void, Storm Weaver, Signus, Polterghast, and The Old Duke.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.desc: The Seafood Dinner is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: The damage reduction is especially welcome in a phase full of punishing optional content.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Photosynthesis Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Photosynthesis Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

buffs.name: Bloodflare armor
buffs.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
buffs.station: Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
buffs.desc: Bloodflare armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit faint pulses.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: You are still fragile even with summons doing the work, so extra defense is welcome.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Lifeforce Potion is a buff potion that grants the Lifeforce buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Bewitching Table
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Dungeon
buffs.why: A free extra minion remains part of every serious endgame summoner setup.
buffs.desc: The Bewitching Table is a furniture item found naturally placed in the Dungeon and can be obtained by fishing in the Dungeon. In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Witch Doctor for 10 GC if the Wizard is present. It emits light when placed.

buffs.name: Flask of Crumbling
buffs.source: Crafted at an Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.desc: The Flask of Crumbling is a Hardmode flask. Upon consumption, it grants the Weapon Imbue: Crumbling buff, which causes all melee, whip, and rogue attacks to inflict the Crumbling debuff.

buffs.name: Summoning Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: The extra minion slot is too valuable to skip, even in the earliest summoner boss prep.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Summoning Potion is a buff potion which grants the Summoning buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum number of minions by 1. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: War Table
buffs.source: Dropped by the Dark Mage and Ogre during the Old One's Army
buffs.why: Table buff that boosts minion damage.
buffs.desc: The War Table is an animated furniture item which fulfills a house's table requirement that is dropped by the Dark Mage and the Ogre during the Old One's Army event, with a 1/2 (50%) / 1/1 (100%) chance during Tier 1, and a 1/8 (12.5%) / 1/4 (25%) chance during Tier 3.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Soaring Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Elysian Wings
items.why: This is faster than the other wings.
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · Blessed by the Profaned Flame
items.desc: Elysian Wings are a post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory that are dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

items.name: Stardust Wings
items.why: This should be used with Stardust armor
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall
items.desc: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Stardust armor
items.why: This should be used with Stardust armor
items.desc: Stardust armor is a Hardmode, post- Moon Lord armor set consisting of the Stardust Helmet, Stardust Plate, and Stardust Leggings.

items.name: Tarragon Wings
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4.5 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Great · Vertical acceleration: Great · 'Born of the jungle'
items.desc: Tarragon Wings are a post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory. While equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

items.name: Void Striders
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 3.33 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 36% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Ludicrous speed!'
items.desc: Void Striders are a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Moon Walkers. They grant the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Ascendant Insignia
items.effect: Increases wing flight time by 50%, movement and jump speed by 15%, and acceleration by 1.5x · Pressing Ascendant Insignia Hotkey grants you the power of ascension, providing infinite flight time for 4 seconds · Ascension has a 40 second cooldown
items.desc: The Ascendant Insignia is a post- Moon Lord accessory and an upgrade to the Soaring Insignia. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Elysian Aegis
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to dash, empowered by holy fire · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage · 'Blessed by the Profaned Flame'
items.desc: The Elysian Aegis is a post- Moon Lord shield accessory that is dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Statis' Ninja Belt
items.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 10% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.6x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws
items.desc: The Statis' Ninja Belt is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Master Ninja Gear and Frog Gear. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Leviathan Ambergris
items.effect: 100% increased initial dash velocity, 33% faster dash cooldown, and greatly increased dash deceleration · Your dashes are empowered by water, knocking back and damaging enemies with vicious currents · Visual effects are reduced if visibility is disabled
items.desc: The Leviathan Ambergris is an Expert Mode -exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
items.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled
items.desc: The Ambrosial Ampoule is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Living Dew and Radiant Ooze. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Deific Amulet
items.effect: Releases a burst of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect
items.desc: The Deific Amulet is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star Veil. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Affliction
items.effect: Gives all teammates +0.5 HP/s life regen, +10% max life, 7% damage reduction, 9 defense and 10% increased damage
items.desc: Affliction is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode. While equipped, all the player's teammates in the same team are granted the Afflicted buff, which provides all the bonuses that the accessory itself provides.

items.name: Profaned Soul Artifact
items.effect: Summons your own personal Guardians to fight alongside you · The offensive guardian grants an additional minion slot and fires a ring of spears while attacking · The defensive guardian creates a weak barrier of profaned rock · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · Once depleted, the rocks are flung outward and will regenerate 5 seconds after being hit · Taking damage resets the timer · The healer guardian restores 10 health every few seconds · Purity
items.desc: The Profaned Soul Artifact is a post- Moon Lord accessory. It summons all three miniature Profaned Guardians to assist the player.

items.name: The Absorber
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing
items.desc: The Absorber is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Grand Gelatin, Baroclaw, and Giant Tortoise Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: The Evolution
items.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%
items.desc: The Evolution is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Ceaseless Void. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'
items.desc: The Reaper Tooth Necklace is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Sand Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

items.name: Star-Tainted Generator
items.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 2, and summon damage by 7% · Minion attacks spawn astral explosions and inflict several debuffs · Grants immunity to Irradiated · Does not stack with downgrades
items.desc: The Star-Tainted Generator is a Hardmode accessory that combines the effects of the Jelly-Charged Battery, Nuclear Fuel Rod, and Starbuster Core. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Statis' Curse
items.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 3, and summon damage by 12% · Increased minion knockback · Minion attacks inflict Shadowflame , and grants immunity to Shadowflame · Does not stack with downgrades
items.desc: The Statis' Curse is a Hardmode accessory and an upgrade to the Statis' Blessing and The First Shadowflame. It grants the following effects while equipped:

weapons.name: Deep Sea Dumbbell
weapons.source: Dropped by Reaper Sharks after Polterghast has been defeated
weapons.effect: Throws a dumbbell that bounces and flings weights with each bounce · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to flex, increasing the damage of your next attack up to 5 times damage · Flexes can hit enemies directly
weapons.desc: The Deep Sea Dumbbell is a post- Moon Lord rogue weapon that is dropped by Reaper Sharks after Polterghast has been defeated. When used, it throws a dark blue dumbbell that is not affected by gravity and bounces twice off of tiles or enemies, breaking on the third impact. Every time it bounces, it releases 2 smaller gravity-affected blue weights which fly out in random directions and velocities.

weapons.name: Jaws of Oblivion
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws a tight spread of six reaper teeth with Acid Venom that stick in enemies · The Acid Venom can stack when more teeth are stuck in an enemy · Stealth strikes cause the teeth to emit a crushing shockwave on impact · 'You're gonna need a bigger boat'
weapons.desc: The Jaws of Oblivion are a post- Moon Lord dagger that is a direct upgrade to the Leviathan Teeth. When used, they rapidly throw a tight spread of 6 gravity-ignoring reaper teeth that stick to enemies and inflict the Acid Venom and Armor Crunch debuffs. Like its predecessor, the damage from the Acid Venom debuff can stack.

weapons.name: Sealed Singularity
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Disables normal stealth generation · Throws a contained singularity bomb that slows down and creates a damaging field after a short fuse · Hold ⚒ Use / Attack to generate stealth, but burn through the bomb's fuse · After the field collapses, the singularity seeks out the strongest target that it hit and explodes · Stealth strikes increase the size and duration of the damaging field · Will explode in your hand if you hold the fuse too long
weapons.desc: The Sealed Singularity is a post- Moon Lord bomb. When used, it throws a circular, void-containing flask that stops moving after a short time, shattering if enough time has passed or upon any collision with solid tiles or enemies. Once shattered, a black hole is formed at the center of the impact, along with 3 gravity-affected shards which each deal 25% damage.

weapons.name: The Old Reaper
weapons.source: Dropped by The Old Duke
weapons.effect: Throws a scythe that cuts through enemies · Deposits unstable isotopes on hit, which create delayed nuclear explosions when they decay · Stealth strikes are thrown into the sky and fall upon enemies and few seconds later · On hit, stealth strikes create a focused deluge of acid rain
weapons.desc: The Old Reaper is a post- Moon Lord rogue weapon that drops from The Old Duke. When fired, it throws a scythe which spawns unstable isotope projectiles on enemy hits that explode after a brief delay.

weapons.name: Toxicant Twister
weapons.source: Dropped by The Old Duke
weapons.effect: Throws a fan of four spinning disks that swirl around your cursor · Stealth strikes swirl in a wider range and create a vortex of raindrops that home in on enemies
weapons.desc: The Toxicant Twister is a post- Moon Lord rogue boomerang that is dropped by The Old Duke. When used, it throws a fan of 4 boomerangs that spin and cluster around the cursor.

weapons.name: Vega
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws a spear that shatters into star fragments on impact and generates Starbursts · Stealth strike conjure an image of Lyra to deal immense damage in an area · ⚷ Open / Activate to consume 20 Starbursts and immediately perform a stealth strike, regardless of your current stealth · This strike calls all star fragments to attack the damaged foe and inflicts Voidfrost · Consuming Starbursts with Vega allows using stealth for 10 seconds, even without rogue armor · 'The final song of a misunderstood genius... or just a madman'
weapons.desc: The Vega is a post- Moon Lord javelin. It throws a rapid stratus spear that breaks upon hitting a tile and explodes upon striking an enemy, releasing 4 stratus stars that inflict Nightwither. These stars can pierce for a short amount of time and the explosion from the spear will not be triggered if the spear doesn't strike an enemy.

weapons.name: Molten Amputator
weapons.source: Dropped by Providence
weapons.effect: Throws a spinning scythe that lingers at your cursor · ⚷ Open / Activate to recall all existing scythes · Recalling a scythe while it's on an enemy rends them for massive damage · ⚷ Open / Activate with sufficient stealth to empower the next 30 scythes and greatly increase attack speed · You cannot recall scythes thrown while empowered
weapons.desc: The Molten Amputator is a post- Moon Lord rogue boomerang that is dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. When used, it throws a rapidly spinning scythe which lingers at the position of the cursor when it was fired before returning. Right-clicking recalls all existing scythes; recalling a scythe that is on top of an enemy rends them, dealing 700% base damage.

weapons.name: Twisting Thunder
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a lightning bolt to electrocute enemies · The lightning bolt travels faster while it is raining · Summons lightning from the sky on impact · Stealth strikes summon more lightning and travel faster
weapons.desc: The Twisting Thunder is a post- Moon Lord dagger that is an upgrade to the Stormfront Razor and the final upgrade of the Cinquedea. It automatically throws a gravity-defying lightning bolt that does not pierce and travels faster while raining. When it hits an enemy, lightning strikes vertically from the sky which pierces indefinitely and can pass through tiles.

weapons.name: Claret Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a hypercondensed claret round · The round explodes upon striking an enemy and releases blood orbs · The explosion shreds enemies, dramatically reducing their defense · Picking up the blood orbs will reduce Potion Sickness when possible · If you do not have Potion Sickness , your natural regeneration will be enhanced · Can only fire once every 10 seconds · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Claret Cannon is a post- Moon Lord classless weapon. It fires a small claret round that explodes into 20 small floating blood orbs upon hitting an enemy. When collected by the player, each orb reduces the duration of the Potion Sickness debuff by 0.33 seconds.

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Eye of Magnus is a Hardmode classless weapon that is an upgraded version of the Lunic Eye. When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
weapons.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Normality Relocator
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Press Normality Relocator to teleport to the position of the mouse · Fall speed is doubled for 0.5 seconds after teleporting · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Works while in the inventory · 'I'll be there in the blink of an eye'
weapons.desc: Normality Relocator is a post- Moon Lord tool. While it is in the player's inventory, they may press the Normality Relocator key to instantly warp to the position of the cursor. Unlike the Rod of Discord, the Relocator cannot be used normally like other tools via selecting it in the hotbar and pressing the ⚒ Use / Attack key.

weapons.name: Stratus Sphere
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Launches a singularity which exerts influence on all entities in a large area around it · Influenced players gain Starbursts over time and will consume Starbursts to fly when out of flight time · ⚷ Open / Activate to cause Starbursts to form a barrier, causing you to lose Starbursts instead of health · Launching the singularity deactivates the barrier, and creating the barrier deactivates the singularity · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats · 'Channeling souls into stars, an inane concept'
weapons.desc: The Stratus Sphere is a post- Moon Lord classless weapon. When used, it fires a massive planetary stratus orb that can pass through tiles.

armor.name: Bloodflare armor
armor.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
armor.effect: Enemies below 50% life drop a heart when struck · This effect has a 5 second cooldown · Ram Mask: Enemies are more likely to target you · After striking an enemy 15 times with true melee you will enter a blood frenzy for 5 seconds · During this you will gain 25% increased melee damage, critical strike chance, and 50% reduced contact damage · This effect has a 30 second cooldown · Demon Helm: Armor Set Bonus to unleash the lost souls of polterghast[ sic ] to destroy your enemies · This effect has a 30 second cooldown · Ranged weapons fire bloodsplosion orbs every 2.5 seconds · Hydra Hood: Magic weapons fire ghostly bolts every 1.67 seconds · Magic critical strikes cause blood explosions every 2 seconds · Wyvern Helm: Increases your max number of minions by 2 · 30% increased summon damage · Summons polterghast mines to circle you · Grants 20 defense when below 50% life · Imp Mask: +120 maximum stealth · Grants 30 defense when above 80% life
armor.desc: Bloodflare armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit faint pulses.

armor.name: Tarragon armor
armor.effect: Increased heart pickup range · Enemies have a chance to drop extra hearts on death · Helm: Enemies are more likely to target you · Taking damage gives Tarra Life, which grants +1.5 HP/s life regen · Armor Set Bonus to cloak yourself in life energy that heavily reduces contact damage for 10 seconds · This has a 30 second cooldown · Visage: Ranged projectiles spawn homing life energy and leaves on enemy hits · Mask: On every 5th critical strike you will fire a leaf storm · Horned Helm: Increases your max number of minions by 2 · 30% increased summon damage · Summons a life aura around you that damages nearby enemies · Helmet: +115 maximum stealth · After every 50 rogue critical hits you will gain 2.5 seconds of damage immunity · This effect has a cooldown of 25 seconds · While under effects of a debuff you gain 10% increased rogue damage
armor.desc: Tarragon armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit faint pulses.

armor.name: Omega Blue armor
armor.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 2 · Short-ranged tentacles heal you by sucking enemy life · Abyssal Madness - Armor Set Bonus to go berserk for 5 seconds · While active, tentacles attack with greater range and aggression, and always critically strike · This also grants 10% increased damage and critical strike chance · This effect has a 25 second cooldown
armor.desc: Omega Blue armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit a pulsating aura around them.

accessories.name: Heartreach Potion
accessories.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
accessories.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
accessories.effect: Increases pickup range for life hearts
accessories.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

accessories.name: Photosynthesis Potion
accessories.effect: Dropped hearts heal 5 more HP
accessories.desc: The Photosynthesis Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

accessories.desc: The Arc Flash Ring is an Expert Mode post- Moon Lord accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Storm Weaver. accessories.name: Blunder Booster
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: 12% increased rogue damage and 15% increased rogue projectile velocity · Stealth generates 10% faster · Summons a red lightning aura around the player that electrifies nearby enemies with Vermillion Flux · The aura has reduced opacity if visibility is disabled · Press Booster Dash to consume 25% of your maximum stealth to perform a swift upwards diagonal dash · This dash leaves a trail of red lightning bolts · This effect has a 1 second cooldown before it can be used again
accessories.desc: The Blunder Booster is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Plagued Fuel Pack. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Dark Matter Sheath
accessories.effect: +10 maximum stealth · Stealth generation is boosted while moving if not attacking · Stealth strikes only expend 50% of your max stealth · 6% increased rogue damage and rogue crit chance
accessories.desc: The Dark Matter Sheath is a Hardmode rogue accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'

accessories.name: Abyssal Mirror
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Enemies are less likely to target you, even in the abyss · Generate stealth 25% faster when standing still and 12% faster while moving · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Dodging an attack restores stealth and releases a cloud that damages and stuns nearby enemies · 'Light does not reach the depths of the ocean'
accessories.desc: The Abyssal Mirror is a Hardmode rogue accessory and the direct upgrade to the Mirage Mirror. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Glove of Precision
accessories.source: Purchased from Bandit for 48 after Plantera has been defeated
accessories.effect: Decreases rogue attack speed by 15% · Increases rogue damage and critical strike chance by 10%, and velocity by 15%
accessories.desc: The Glove of Precision is a Hardmode rogue accessory that is sold by the Bandit for 48 after Plantera has been defeated. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

accessories.name: Spectral Veil
accessories.effect: Pressing Spectral Veil Teleport consumes 25% of your maximum stealth to teleport, rendering you invulnerable · If you dodge something while invulnerable, you instantly gain full stealth · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Stealth generates 15% faster · 'The inside of the cloak is full of teeth...'
accessories.desc: The Spectral Veil is an Expert Mode -exclusive post- Moon Lord rogue accessory that is obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Signus. While equipped, it makes stealth generate 15% faster.

accessories.name: Vampiric Talisman
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Rogue critical strikes steal enemy life · Stealth strikes grant 15% critical strike chance and increased lifesteal to non-stealth strikes for 10 seconds · Stealth strikes inflict Heavy Bleeding and Armor Crunch , and deal 8% more damage · 'Possessing the talisman makes you yearn for blood'
accessories.desc: The Vampiric Talisman is a Hardmode rogue accessory. When equipped, it causes rogue critical hits to steal 1.5% of their damage (rounded down) in health. Additionally, it increases stealth strike damage by 8% and causes all stealth strikes to inflict Armor Crunch for 2.5 seconds and Heavy Bleeding for 5 seconds.

buffs.name: Bloodfin
buffs.desc: The Bloodfin is a post- Moon Lord healing potion -type fish that can be caught in the Brimstone Crag with a 10% chance after Providence, the Profaned Goddess has been defeated.

buffs.name: Supreme Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Supreme Healing Potion is a post- Moon Lord potion that heals the player for 250 health, and inflicts the Potion Sickness debuff upon use. It is also dropped from Providence, the Profaned Goddess, Ceaseless Void, Storm Weaver, Signus, Polterghast, and The Old Duke.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.desc: The Seafood Dinner is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Heartreach Potion is a buff potion which grants the Heartreach buff when consumed. The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Photosynthesis Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Photosynthesis Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Photosynthesis buff, which causes Heart pickups to heal an additional 5 health.

buffs.name: Bloodflare armor
buffs.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
buffs.station: Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
buffs.desc: Bloodflare armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit faint pulses.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Lifeforce Potion is a buff potion that grants the Lifeforce buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Flask of Crumbling
buffs.source: Crafted at an Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.desc: The Flask of Crumbling is a Hardmode flask. Upon consumption, it grants the Weapon Imbue: Crumbling buff, which causes all melee, whip, and rogue attacks to inflict the Crumbling debuff.

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Shadow Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Shadow Potion is a Pre-Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Shadow buff, which provides the following effects:

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Soaring Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Elysian Wings
items.why: This is faster than the other wings.
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · Blessed by the Profaned Flame
items.desc: Elysian Wings are a post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory that are dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

items.name: Tarragon Wings
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4.5 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Great · Vertical acceleration: Great · 'Born of the jungle'
items.desc: Tarragon Wings are a post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory. While equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

items.name: Void Striders
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 3.33 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 36% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Ludicrous speed!'
items.desc: Void Striders are a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Moon Walkers. They grant the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Ascendant Insignia
items.effect: Increases wing flight time by 50%, movement and jump speed by 15%, and acceleration by 1.5x · Pressing Ascendant Insignia Hotkey grants you the power of ascension, providing infinite flight time for 4 seconds · Ascension has a 40 second cooldown
items.desc: The Ascendant Insignia is a post- Moon Lord accessory and an upgrade to the Soaring Insignia. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Elysian Aegis
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to dash, empowered by holy fire · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage · 'Blessed by the Profaned Flame'
items.desc: The Elysian Aegis is a post- Moon Lord shield accessory that is dropped by Providence, the Profaned Goddess. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Statis' Ninja Belt

items.desc: The Statis' Ninja Belt is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Master Ninja Gear and Frog Gear. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.desc: The Leviathan Ambergris is an Expert Mode -exclusive Hardmode accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled
items.desc: The Ambrosial Ampoule is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Living Dew and Radiant Ooze. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Deific Amulet

items.desc: The Deific Amulet is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star Veil. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Affliction

items.desc: Affliction is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode. While equipped, all the player's teammates in the same team are granted the Afflicted buff, which provides all the bonuses that the accessory itself provides.

items.name: The Absorber

items.desc: The Absorber is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Grand Gelatin, Baroclaw, and Giant Tortoise Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: The Community
items.effect: 'The heart of (most of) the Terraria community' · Thank you to all of our supporters who made this mod a reality!
items.desc: The Community is an accessory that is dropped by Leviathan and Anahita. When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

items.name: The Evolution
items.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%
items.desc: The Evolution is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Ceaseless Void. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Arc Flash Ring
items.effect: Attacks have a 5% chance to call down a lightning bolt for 3x damage · The chance is reduced for each enemy an attack hits · The bolt's damage is based on non-crit damage, but can itself crit · Bolts are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled
items.desc: The Arc Flash Ring is an Expert Mode post- Moon Lord accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Storm Weaver. While equipped, it grants the player's attacks a 5% chance to fire down an arc flash that deals 3x the weapon's base damage and inflicts the Electrified debuff for 3 seconds.

items.name: Blunder Booster
items.effect: 12% increased rogue damage and 15% increased rogue projectile velocity · Stealth generates 10% faster · Summons a red lightning aura around the player that electrifies nearby enemies with Vermillion Flux · The aura has reduced opacity if visibility is disabled · Press Booster Dash to consume 25% of your maximum stealth to perform a swift upwards diagonal dash · This dash leaves a trail of red lightning bolts · This effect has a 1 second cooldown before it can be used again
items.desc: The Blunder Booster is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Plagued Fuel Pack. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Dark Matter Sheath
items.effect: +10 maximum stealth · Stealth generation is boosted while moving if not attacking · Stealth strikes only expend 50% of your max stealth · 6% increased rogue damage and rogue crit chance
items.desc: The Dark Matter Sheath is a Hardmode rogue accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'
items.desc: The Reaper Tooth Necklace is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Sand Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

items.name: Abyssal Mirror

items.desc: The Abyssal Mirror is a Hardmode rogue accessory and the direct upgrade to the Mirage Mirror. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.desc: The Glove of Precision is a Hardmode rogue accessory that is sold by the Bandit for 48 after Plantera has been defeated. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

items.name: Spectral Veil
items.why: This is difficult and risky to use.
items.effect: Pressing Spectral Veil Teleport consumes 25% of your maximum stealth to teleport, rendering you invulnerable · If you dodge something while invulnerable, you instantly gain full stealth · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Stealth generates 15% faster · 'The inside of the cloak is full of teeth...'
