items.effect: 15% increased ranged damage, 7% increased ranged critical strike chance and 20% reduced ammo usage · Grants a 20% chance to not consume arrows · Pressing Ammo Cycle Hotkey will automatically swap the ammos in your ammo slots · The ammo type swapped depends on the ammo of the weapon you are holding
items.desc: The Planebreaker's Pouch is a post- Moon Lord accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'
items.desc: The Reaper Tooth Necklace is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Sand Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

items.name: Sniper Scope
items.why: This grants critical strike damage.
items.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance
items.desc: The Sniper Scope is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

weapons.name: Hyperdeath Rift Scepter
weapons.source: Dropped by The Devourer of Gods
weapons.effect: Tears space in two with Hyperdeath Rift Ripper
weapons.desc: The Hyperdeath Rift Scepter is a post- Moon Lord wand that is dropped by The Devourer of Gods. It fires down a large beam at the cursor's position to disintegrate nearly anything it is aimed at. The laser can pierce infinitely, losing small chunks of damage for every few enemies it pierces, and will phase through blocks.

weapons.name: Omicron
weapons.source: Crafted at a Cosmic Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a continuous array of lasers and spawns two Wingmen which orbit you and fire lasers at your cursor · Press ⚷ Open / Activate when firing to shoot an Omicron Beam that splits upon hitting an enemy · After firing an Omicron Beam your Wingmen will launch a pair of grenades · Hitting an enemy with an Omicron Beam right as it is fired will increase the damage done substantially and stop it from splitting
weapons.desc: The Omicron is a post- Moon Lord magic gun that is the final upgrade to the Wingman and Genesis. When used with its primary fire (left-click), it fires an array of 10 lasers that pierce once and decrease in their spread on following shots before resetting back to original spread after every 5 shots. In addition, two Wingmen are summoned to the sides of the player perpendicular to the direction of the cursor, that each switch sides and fire 3 lasers towards the cursor that also pierce once.

weapons.name: Primordial Ancient
weapons.source: Crafted at a Bookcase
weapons.effect: Casts five primordial sand blasts that converge at your cursor after a moment and create a giant explosion · Casting this spell at max mana while without mana sickness will cause it to give you and any player it hits the Aeolian Earth buff
weapons.desc: The Primordial Ancient is a post- Moon Lord spell tome that is a direct upgrade to the Primordial Earth. When used, it fires 5 dust blows that pass through tiles and converge at the cursor into an explosion of dust that inflicts the Armor Crunch debuff. Using it at full health and with no Mana Sickness gives the player, and any player that touches the dust particles, the Aeolian Earth buff which increases damage reduction by 8%, damage by 15%, and mana regeneration.

weapons.name: Tesla Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Cosmic Anvil
weapons.effect: A lightweight energy cannon that blasts an intense electrical beam that explodes · The beam can arc to nearby targets
weapons.desc: The Tesla Cannon is a post- Moon Lord magic gun. When used, it fires a large blue beam that creates a large dust explosion upon contact with a block or enemy. The beam will arc towards other nearby enemies on enemy hits.

weapons.name: Voltaic Climax
weapons.source: Crafted at a Cosmic Anvil
weapons.effect: Conjures a ring of supercharged magnet spheres around the cursor
weapons.desc: The Voltaic Climax is a post- Moon Lord wand. When used, it summons a circular spread of 9 tile-ignoring magnetic orbs around the cursor that spread out before stopping. Each orb fires one electric beam consecutively that pierces infinitely when dealing more than 1 damage, and inflicts the Electrified debuff.

weapons.name: Claret Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a hypercondensed claret round · The round explodes upon striking an enemy and releases blood orbs · The explosion shreds enemies, dramatically reducing their defense · Picking up the blood orbs will reduce Potion Sickness when possible · If you do not have Potion Sickness , your natural regeneration will be enhanced · Can only fire once every 10 seconds · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Claret Cannon is a post- Moon Lord classless weapon. It fires a small claret round that explodes into 20 small floating blood orbs upon hitting an enemy. When collected by the player, each orb reduces the duration of the Potion Sickness debuff by 0.33 seconds.

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Eye of Magnus is a Hardmode classless weapon that is an upgraded version of the Lunic Eye. When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
weapons.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Normality Relocator
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Press Normality Relocator to teleport to the position of the mouse · Fall speed is doubled for 0.5 seconds after teleporting · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Works while in the inventory · 'I'll be there in the blink of an eye'
weapons.desc: Normality Relocator is a post- Moon Lord tool. While it is in the player's inventory, they may press the Normality Relocator key to instantly warp to the position of the cursor. Unlike the Rod of Discord, the Relocator cannot be used normally like other tools via selecting it in the hotbar and pressing the ⚒ Use / Attack key.

weapons.name: Stratus Sphere
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Launches a singularity which exerts influence on all entities in a large area around it · Influenced players gain Starbursts over time and will consume Starbursts to fly when out of flight time · ⚷ Open / Activate to cause Starbursts to form a barrier, causing you to lose Starbursts instead of health · Launching the singularity deactivates the barrier, and creating the barrier deactivates the singularity · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats · 'Channeling souls into stars, an inane concept'
weapons.desc: The Stratus Sphere is a post- Moon Lord classless weapon. When used, it fires a massive planetary stratus orb that can pass through tiles.

armor.name: Silva armor
armor.effect: +3 HP/s life regen · 5% increased max run speed and acceleration · Taking fatal damage will revive you and make you invulnerable to all damage for 5 seconds · This effect has a 5 minute cooldown, which does not decrement if any bosses or events are active · Masked Cap: Magic projectiles which cannot pierce will occasionally set off potent blasts of nature energy · Horned Hood: Increases your max number of minions by 3 · 40% increased summon damage · Summons an ancient leaf prism to blast your enemies with life energy
armor.desc: The Silva armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. It is the mage/summoner counterpart to God Slayer armor. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit afterimages.

accessories.name: Silva Wings
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4.5 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 'The purest of nature'
accessories.desc: Silva Wings are a post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory. While equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

accessories.name: Void Striders
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 3.33 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 36% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Ludicrous speed!'
accessories.desc: Void Striders are a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Moon Walkers. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Affliction
accessories.source: Dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode
accessories.effect: Gives all teammates +0.5 HP/s life regen, +10% max life, 7% damage reduction, 9 defense and 10% increased damage
accessories.desc: Affliction is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode. While equipped, all the player's teammates in the same team are granted the Afflicted buff, which provides all the bonuses that the accessory itself provides.

accessories.name: Dark Sun Ring
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased damage · +0.5 HP/s life regen and +2 max minions · Increased minion knockback · Grants various buffs as the day goes on · 'Contains the power of the dark sun'
accessories.desc: The Dark Sun Ring is a post- Moon Lord accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: The Absorber
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing
accessories.desc: The Absorber is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Grand Gelatin, Baroclaw, and Giant Tortoise Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: The Amalgam
accessories.effect: All attacks inflict a variety of debuffs, 200% increased elemental debuff damage · Most buffs last twice as long, and persist after dying · Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10% · 'You have no idea how it's staying together' · Expert
accessories.desc: The Amalgam is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Amalgamated Brain. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: The Community
accessories.effect: 'The heart of (most of) the Terraria community' · Thank you to all of our supporters who made this mod a reality!
accessories.desc: The Community is an accessory that is dropped by Leviathan and Anahita. When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

accessories.name: The Evolution
accessories.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%
accessories.desc: The Evolution is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Ceaseless Void. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Ascendant Insignia
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Increases wing flight time by 50%, movement and jump speed by 15%, and acceleration by 1.5x · Pressing Ascendant Insignia Hotkey grants you the power of ascension, providing infinite flight time for 4 seconds · Ascension has a 40 second cooldown
accessories.desc: The Ascendant Insignia is a post- Moon Lord accessory and an upgrade to the Soaring Insignia. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Asgardian Aegis
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash, empowered by a cosmic inferno · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage
accessories.desc: The Asgardian Aegis is a post- Moon Lord shield accessory and the direct upgrade to the Asgard's Valor and Elysian Aegis. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Statis' Void Sash
accessories.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 20% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.85x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws
accessories.desc: The Statis' Void Sash is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Statis' Ninja Belt. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Arc Flash Ring
accessories.effect: Attacks have a 5% chance to call down a lightning bolt for 3x damage · The chance is reduced for each enemy an attack hits · The bolt's damage is based on non-crit damage, but can itself crit · Bolts are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled
accessories.desc: The Arc Flash Ring is an Expert Mode post- Moon Lord accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Storm Weaver. While equipped, it grants the player's attacks a 5% chance to fire down an arc flash that deals 3x the weapon's base damage and inflicts the Electrified debuff for 3 seconds.

accessories.name: Ethereal Talisman
accessories.effect: Increases maximum mana by 60 and 8% reduced mana cost · 15% increased magic damage and 5% increased magic critical strike chance · Increases pickup range for mana stars · You automatically use mana potions when needed · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate in your inventory to toggle Mana Flower's effect
accessories.desc: The Ethereal Talisman is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Sigil of Calamitas. It is also the final upgrade to the Celestial Emblem. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
accessories.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'
accessories.desc: The Reaper Tooth Necklace is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Sand Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

accessories.name: Sigil of Calamitas
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Increases maximum mana by 60 · 15% increased magic damage · Increases pickup range for mana stars
accessories.desc: The Sigil of Calamitas is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Celestial Emblem. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
accessories.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled
accessories.desc: The Ambrosial Ampoule is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Living Dew and Radiant Ooze. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Bloom Stone
accessories.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'
accessories.desc: The Bloom Stone is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Plantera. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Chalice of the Blood God
accessories.effect: Increases max HP by 25% · +2 HP/s life regen and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25% · Taking more than 5 damage converts the hit into a damage over time bleed effect · This bleeding does not interfere with life regeneration · Drinking a healing potion removes some of the remaining bleed, up to 50% of its heal value · Unequipping this accessory while bleeding inflicts the remaining damage instantly · Grants immunity to Bleeding , Burning Blood , Heavy Bleeding and Laceration · 'All that for a drop of blood...'
accessories.desc: The Chalice of the Blood God is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is a combination of the Blood Pact and Charm of Myths. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Deific Amulet
accessories.effect: Releases a burst of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect
accessories.desc: The Deific Amulet is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star Veil. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: The Sponge
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Gain a barrier with 120 health · The barrier grants 10% damage reduction while active · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · The barrier will regenerate 8 seconds after being hit, taking 10 seconds to completely regenerate · Getting hit resets the timer
accessories.desc: The Sponge is a post- Moon Lord accessory which is the direct upgrade of the Rover Drive. After eight seconds of equipping the item without taking damage, a barrier covers its user, which grants 10% damage reduction. As the barrier is formed, it builds up to 120 shield durability at a rate of 12 durability per second.

buffs.name: Omega Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Omega Healing Potion is a post- Moon Lord potion that heals the player for 300 health, and inflicts the Potion Sickness debuff upon use. It is also dropped from the Primordial Wyrm, The Devourer of Gods, each individual Exo Mech, Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth and Supreme Witch, Calamitas.

buffs.name: Supreme Mana Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Supreme Mana Potion is a post- Moon Lord potion. Upon consumption, it restores 400 mana and inflicts the Mana Sickness debuff.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.desc: The Seafood Dinner is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: The extra survivability helps offset how punishing late-Hardmode mistakes can be for mage.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Mage has less room for mistakes, so the bonus defense matters a lot.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Lifeforce Potion is a buff potion that grants the Lifeforce buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Crystal Ball
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Wizard
buffs.why: Free Clairvoyance remains a baseline endgame mage habit before any serious fight.
buffs.desc: The Crystal Ball is a Hardmode furniture item which functions as a crafting station. It is purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC. Pressing ⚷ Open / Activate on a placed Crystal Ball grants the Clairvoyance buff and opens its crafting menu.

buffs.name: Magic Power Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Magic Power Potion is a buff potion which grants the Magic Power buff when consumed. The buff increases magic damage by 20%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Speeds up mana regeneration, so you stop to drink fewer mana potions.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Mana Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Mana Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff increases the rate at which the player's mana regenerates. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Soaring Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Affliction
items.effect: Gives all teammates +0.5 HP/s life regen, +10% max life, 7% damage reduction, 9 defense and 10% increased damage
items.desc: Affliction is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode. While equipped, all the player's teammates in the same team are granted the Afflicted buff, which provides all the bonuses that the accessory itself provides.

items.name: Dark Sun Ring
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased damage · +0.5 HP/s life regen and +2 max minions · Increased minion knockback · Grants various buffs as the day goes on · 'Contains the power of the dark sun'
items.desc: The Dark Sun Ring is a post- Moon Lord accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: The Absorber
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing
items.desc: The Absorber is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Grand Gelatin, Baroclaw, and Giant Tortoise Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: The Amalgam
items.effect: All attacks inflict a variety of debuffs, 200% increased elemental debuff damage · Most buffs last twice as long, and persist after dying · Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10% · 'You have no idea how it's staying together' · Expert
items.desc: The Amalgam is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Amalgamated Brain. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: The Community
items.effect: 'The heart of (most of) the Terraria community' · Thank you to all of our supporters who made this mod a reality!
items.desc: The Community is an accessory that is dropped by Leviathan and Anahita. When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

items.name: The Evolution
items.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%
items.desc: The Evolution is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Ceaseless Void. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Arc Flash Ring
items.effect: Attacks have a 5% chance to call down a lightning bolt for 3x damage · The chance is reduced for each enemy an attack hits · The bolt's damage is based on non-crit damage, but can itself crit · Bolts are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled
items.desc: The Arc Flash Ring is an Expert Mode post- Moon Lord accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Storm Weaver. While equipped, it grants the player's attacks a 5% chance to fire down an arc flash that deals 3x the weapon's base damage and inflicts the Electrified debuff for 3 seconds.

items.name: Ethereal Talisman
items.effect: Increases maximum mana by 60 and 8% reduced mana cost · 15% increased magic damage and 5% increased magic critical strike chance · Increases pickup range for mana stars · You automatically use mana potions when needed · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate in your inventory to toggle Mana Flower's effect
items.desc: The Ethereal Talisman is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Sigil of Calamitas. It is also the final upgrade to the Celestial Emblem. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'
items.desc: The Reaper Tooth Necklace is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Sand Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

items.name: Sigil of Calamitas
items.effect: Increases maximum mana by 60 · 15% increased magic damage · Increases pickup range for mana stars
items.desc: The Sigil of Calamitas is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Celestial Emblem. It grants the following effects while equipped:

weapons.name: Corvid Harbinger Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at a Cosmic Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons a powerful raven which teleports and dashes · 'Nevermore'
weapons.desc: The Corvid Harbinger Staff is a post- Moon Lord summon weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Raven Staff. When used, it summons a dark raven minion that flies around and rapidly charges towards enemies, occasionally teleporting near them and leaving a ring of dust before continuing its charge.

weapons.name: Ethereal Subjugator
weapons.source: Dropped by Polterghast
weapons.effect: Summons a phantom to protect you
weapons.desc: The Ethereal Subjugator is a post- Moon Lord summon weapon that is dropped by Polterghast. When used, it summons a Phantom minion that follows the player and attacks enemies by releasing 3 ghastly particles that home in on the closest enemy after a short time.

weapons.name: Mirror of Kalandra
weapons.source: Crafted at a Shimmer
weapons.effect: Summons five ancient weapons to annihilate your enemies · There can only be one of each individual weapon · Atziri's Disfavor brutally cleaves through enemies · Starforge rips through foes and occasionally induces cosmic explosions · Paradoxica teleports to enemies and blitzes through them at high speed · Wind Ripper unleashes a single high-speed, powerful arrow at enemies · Hope Shredder shoots arrows that split into three and pierce enemies twice · 'Ultimate, Immeasurable, Indescribable'
weapons.desc: The Mirror of Kalandra is a post- Moon Lord summon weapon. When used, it summons the following weapons respectively: Atziri's Disfavor, Starforge, Paradoxica, Wind Ripper, and Hope Shredder. Only 1 of each weapon can be summoned at a time, each taking up 1 minion slot.

weapons.name: Sirius
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons the brightest star in the sky, Sirius, to protect you · Continue summoning to complete Canis Major · Repeated summons increase its power greatly, even after the constellation is complete · Sirius passively generates Starbursts when targeting enemies · When Starbursts are full, Sirius consumes them to launch a powerful piercing quasar that inflicts Voidfrost · 'A guide to a dream never realized'
weapons.desc: Sirius is a post- Moon Lord summon weapon that is a direct upgrade to the Vengeful Sun Staff. When used, it summons a star which hovers over the player and fires homing fireballs at enemies.

weapons.name: Void Eater Marionette
weapons.source: Dropped by The Devourer of Gods
weapons.effect: Contains the power to control a mini Devourer · Repeated summons increase the length and power of the Devourer · The Devourer attacks with Divinity Devourer, Faith Incinerator, and Ultracosmic Maelstrom · Can play fetch with dropped items · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory when the Devourer has been spawned to prioritize fetching
weapons.desc: The Void Eater Marionette is a post- Moon Lord summon weapon that is dropped by The Devourer of Gods. Upon use, it summons a flying mechanical worm that charges, fires lasers, teleports onto enemies to inflict them with the God Slayer Inferno debuff and ignores immunity frames. The mechworm is in constant flight and can travel through tiles.

weapons.name: Cadaverous Carrion
weapons.source: Dropped by The Old Duke
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons a gross, shark-puking Old Duke head on the ground
weapons.desc: The Cadaverous Carrion is a post- Moon Lord sentry that is dropped by The Old Duke. When used, it summons a grounded Old Duke head sentry that rapidly fires homing sulphurous sharks at nearby enemies which inflicts the Sulphuric Poisoning debuff.

weapons.name: Sanctified Spark
weapons.source: Dropped by Impious Immolators
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons a friendly immolator that will float towards you · Immolators rapidly fire homing flares of Holy Flames at nearby enemies, before continuing to float near you again · After firing, Immolators will fire one healing bolt at you for every 4 summon slots you have · 'They might be a bit clingy, but at least they're warm'
weapons.desc: The Sanctified Spark is a post- Moon Lord sentry that is dropped by Impious Immolators. When used, it summons an Impious Immolator sentry that slowly follows the player and rapidly fires flame bursts at the nearest enemy which inflicts the Holy Flames debuff. It will briefly pause between attacks, during which it will fire one healing orb that heals 5 health each for every 4 minion slots the player has.

weapons.name: Kaleidoscope
weapons.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light (summoned after Plantera)
weapons.why: Empress of Light drop giving one of the largest summon tag damage bonuses.
weapons.effect: 20 summon tag damage · 10% summon tag critical strike chance · Your summons will focus struck enemies
weapons.desc: The Kaleidoscope is a Hardmode, post- Plantera whip that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by the Empress of Light. It has a 20% multihit penalty and performs the following effects on hit:

weapons.name: Claret Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a hypercondensed claret round · The round explodes upon striking an enemy and releases blood orbs · The explosion shreds enemies, dramatically reducing their defense · Picking up the blood orbs will reduce Potion Sickness when possible · If you do not have Potion Sickness , your natural regeneration will be enhanced · Can only fire once every 10 seconds · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Claret Cannon is a post- Moon Lord classless weapon. It fires a small claret round that explodes into 20 small floating blood orbs upon hitting an enemy. When collected by the player, each orb reduces the duration of the Potion Sickness debuff by 0.33 seconds.

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Eye of Magnus is a Hardmode classless weapon that is an upgraded version of the Lunic Eye. When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
weapons.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Normality Relocator
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Press Normality Relocator to teleport to the position of the mouse · Fall speed is doubled for 0.5 seconds after teleporting · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Works while in the inventory · 'I'll be there in the blink of an eye'
weapons.desc: Normality Relocator is a post- Moon Lord tool. While it is in the player's inventory, they may press the Normality Relocator key to instantly warp to the position of the cursor. Unlike the Rod of Discord, the Relocator cannot be used normally like other tools via selecting it in the hotbar and pressing the ⚒ Use / Attack key.

weapons.name: Stratus Sphere
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Launches a singularity which exerts influence on all entities in a large area around it · Influenced players gain Starbursts over time and will consume Starbursts to fly when out of flight time · ⚷ Open / Activate to cause Starbursts to form a barrier, causing you to lose Starbursts instead of health · Launching the singularity deactivates the barrier, and creating the barrier deactivates the singularity · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats · 'Channeling souls into stars, an inane concept'
weapons.desc: The Stratus Sphere is a post- Moon Lord classless weapon. When used, it fires a massive planetary stratus orb that can pass through tiles.

armor.name: Fearmonger armor
armor.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 2 · Minions no longer deal less damage while wielding non-summoner weapons · Immunity to all but the strongest forms of frost and flame · Minion attacks grant +2.5 HP/s life regen and massively accelerate life regen
armor.desc: Fearmonger armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set and the direct upgrade to the Spooky armor. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a faint pulsing aura and a motion blur afterimage while moving.

armor.name: Silva armor
armor.effect: +3 HP/s life regen · 5% increased max run speed and acceleration · Taking fatal damage will revive you and make you invulnerable to all damage for 5 seconds · This effect has a 5 minute cooldown, which does not decrement if any bosses or events are active · Masked Cap: Magic projectiles which cannot pierce will occasionally set off potent blasts of nature energy · Horned Hood: Increases your max number of minions by 3 · 40% increased summon damage · Summons an ancient leaf prism to blast your enemies with life energy
armor.desc: The Silva armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. It is the mage/summoner counterpart to God Slayer armor. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit afterimages.

accessories.name: Silva Wings
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4.5 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 'The purest of nature'
accessories.desc: Silva Wings are a post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory. While equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

accessories.name: Void Striders
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 3.33 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 36% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Ludicrous speed!'
accessories.desc: Void Striders are a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Moon Walkers. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Affliction
accessories.source: Dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode
accessories.effect: Gives all teammates +0.5 HP/s life regen, +10% max life, 7% damage reduction, 9 defense and 10% increased damage
accessories.desc: Affliction is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode. While equipped, all the player's teammates in the same team are granted the Afflicted buff, which provides all the bonuses that the accessory itself provides.

accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased damage · +0.5 HP/s life regen and +2 max minions · Increased minion knockback · Grants various buffs as the day goes on · 'Contains the power of the dark sun'
accessories.desc: The Dark Sun Ring is a post- Moon Lord accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Profaned Soul Artifact
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Summons your own personal Guardians to fight alongside you · The offensive guardian grants an additional minion slot and fires a ring of spears while attacking · The defensive guardian creates a weak barrier of profaned rock · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · Once depleted, the rocks are flung outward and will regenerate 5 seconds after being hit · Taking damage resets the timer · The healer guardian restores 10 health every few seconds · Purity
accessories.desc: The Profaned Soul Artifact is a post- Moon Lord accessory. It summons all three miniature Profaned Guardians to assist the player.

accessories.name: The Absorber
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing
accessories.desc: The Absorber is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Grand Gelatin, Baroclaw, and Giant Tortoise Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: The Amalgam
accessories.effect: All attacks inflict a variety of debuffs, 200% increased elemental debuff damage · Most buffs last twice as long, and persist after dying · Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10% · 'You have no idea how it's staying together' · Expert
accessories.desc: The Amalgam is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Amalgamated Brain. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: The Evolution
accessories.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%
accessories.desc: The Evolution is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Ceaseless Void. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Ascendant Insignia
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Increases wing flight time by 50%, movement and jump speed by 15%, and acceleration by 1.5x · Pressing Ascendant Insignia Hotkey grants you the power of ascension, providing infinite flight time for 4 seconds · Ascension has a 40 second cooldown
accessories.desc: The Ascendant Insignia is a post- Moon Lord accessory and an upgrade to the Soaring Insignia. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Asgardian Aegis
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash, empowered by a cosmic inferno · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage
accessories.desc: The Asgardian Aegis is a post- Moon Lord shield accessory and the direct upgrade to the Asgard's Valor and Elysian Aegis. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Statis' Void Sash
accessories.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 20% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.85x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws
accessories.desc: The Statis' Void Sash is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Statis' Ninja Belt. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Nucleogenesis
accessories.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 4 · Grants immunity to Shadowflame and Irradiated · 15% increased summon damage, and increased minion knockback · Minions inflict a variety of debuffs · Minions spawn damaging sparks on enemy hits · Does not stack with downgrades
accessories.desc: Nucleogenesis is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star-Tainted Generator and Statis' Curse. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
accessories.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'
accessories.desc: The Reaper Tooth Necklace is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Sand Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

accessories.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
accessories.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled
accessories.desc: The Ambrosial Ampoule is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Living Dew and Radiant Ooze. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Bloom Stone
accessories.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'
accessories.desc: The Bloom Stone is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Plantera. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Chalice of the Blood God
accessories.effect: Increases max HP by 25% · +2 HP/s life regen and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25% · Taking more than 5 damage converts the hit into a damage over time bleed effect · This bleeding does not interfere with life regeneration · Drinking a healing potion removes some of the remaining bleed, up to 50% of its heal value · Unequipping this accessory while bleeding inflicts the remaining damage instantly · Grants immunity to Bleeding , Burning Blood , Heavy Bleeding and Laceration · 'All that for a drop of blood...'
accessories.desc: The Chalice of the Blood God is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is a combination of the Blood Pact and Charm of Myths. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Deific Amulet
accessories.effect: Releases a burst of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect
accessories.desc: The Deific Amulet is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star Veil. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: The Sponge
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Gain a barrier with 120 health · The barrier grants 10% damage reduction while active · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · The barrier will regenerate 8 seconds after being hit, taking 10 seconds to completely regenerate · Getting hit resets the timer
accessories.desc: The Sponge is a post- Moon Lord accessory which is the direct upgrade of the Rover Drive. After eight seconds of equipping the item without taking damage, a barrier covers its user, which grants 10% damage reduction. As the barrier is formed, it builds up to 120 shield durability at a rate of 12 durability per second.

buffs.name: Omega Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Omega Healing Potion is a post- Moon Lord potion that heals the player for 300 health, and inflicts the Potion Sickness debuff upon use. It is also dropped from the Primordial Wyrm, The Devourer of Gods, each individual Exo Mech, Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth and Supreme Witch, Calamitas.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.desc: The Seafood Dinner is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: The damage reduction is especially welcome in a phase full of punishing optional content.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: You are still fragile even with summons doing the work, so extra defense is welcome.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Lifeforce Potion is a buff potion that grants the Lifeforce buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Bewitching Table
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Dungeon
buffs.why: A free extra minion remains part of every serious endgame summoner setup.
buffs.desc: The Bewitching Table is a furniture item found naturally placed in the Dungeon and can be obtained by fishing in the Dungeon. In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Witch Doctor for 10 GC if the Wizard is present. It emits light when placed.

buffs.name: Flask of Ichor
buffs.source: Crafted at Imbuing Station
buffs.why: Reduces enemy defense, which applies to every melee hit for the duration.
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.desc: The Flask of Ichor is a Hardmode flask that causes melee weapons and whips (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Ichor debuff for 10–19 seconds on enemies hit. Melee weapons that fire projectiles will also inflict the debuff on enemies hit by the projectiles.

buffs.name: Summoning Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: The extra minion slot is too valuable to skip, even in the earliest summoner boss prep.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Summoning Potion is a buff potion which grants the Summoning buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum number of minions by 1. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: War Table
buffs.source: Dropped by the Dark Mage and Ogre during the Old One's Army
buffs.why: Table buff that boosts minion damage.
buffs.desc: The War Table is an animated furniture item which fulfills a house's table requirement that is dropped by the Dark Mage and the Ogre during the Old One's Army event, with a 1/2 (50%) / 1/1 (100%) chance during Tier 1, and a 1/8 (12.5%) / 1/4 (25%) chance during Tier 3.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Soaring Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Silva Wings
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4.5 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 'The purest of nature'
items.desc: Silva Wings are a post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory. While equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

items.name: Void Striders

items.desc: The Ascendant Insignia is a post- Moon Lord accessory and an upgrade to the Soaring Insignia. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Asgardian Aegis
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash, empowered by a cosmic inferno · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage
items.desc: The Asgardian Aegis is a post- Moon Lord shield accessory and the direct upgrade to the Asgard's Valor and Elysian Aegis. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Statis' Void Sash

items.desc: The Statis' Void Sash is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Statis' Ninja Belt. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.desc: The Ambrosial Ampoule is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Living Dew and Radiant Ooze. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.desc: The Bloom Stone is a Hardmode accessory that is dropped by Plantera. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Chalice of the Blood God
items.why: This should be used with Chalice of the Blood God
items.effect: Increases max HP by 25% · +2 HP/s life regen and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25% · Taking more than 5 damage converts the hit into a damage over time bleed effect · This bleeding does not interfere with life regeneration · Drinking a healing potion removes some of the remaining bleed, up to 50% of its heal value · Unequipping this accessory while bleeding inflicts the remaining damage instantly · Grants immunity to Bleeding , Burning Blood , Heavy Bleeding and Laceration · 'All that for a drop of blood...'
items.desc: The Chalice of the Blood God is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is a combination of the Blood Pact and Charm of Myths. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.desc: The Deific Amulet is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star Veil. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: The Sponge
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Gain a barrier with 120 health · The barrier grants 10% damage reduction while active · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · The barrier will regenerate 8 seconds after being hit, taking 10 seconds to completely regenerate · Getting hit resets the timer
items.desc: The Sponge is a post- Moon Lord accessory which is the direct upgrade of the Rover Drive. After eight seconds of equipping the item without taking damage, a barrier covers its user, which grants 10% damage reduction. As the barrier is formed, it builds up to 120 shield durability at a rate of 12 durability per second.

items.name: Affliction
items.effect: Gives all teammates +0.5 HP/s life regen, +10% max life, 7% damage reduction, 9 defense and 10% increased damage
items.desc: Affliction is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode. While equipped, all the player's teammates in the same team are granted the Afflicted buff, which provides all the bonuses that the accessory itself provides.

items.name: Dark Sun Ring
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased damage · +0.5 HP/s life regen and +2 max minions · Increased minion knockback · Grants various buffs as the day goes on · 'Contains the power of the dark sun'
items.desc: The Dark Sun Ring is a post- Moon Lord accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Profaned Soul Artifact
items.effect: Summons your own personal Guardians to fight alongside you · The offensive guardian grants an additional minion slot and fires a ring of spears while attacking · The defensive guardian creates a weak barrier of profaned rock · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · Once depleted, the rocks are flung outward and will regenerate 5 seconds after being hit · Taking damage resets the timer · The healer guardian restores 10 health every few seconds · Purity
items.desc: The Profaned Soul Artifact is a post- Moon Lord accessory. It summons all three miniature Profaned Guardians to assist the player.

items.name: The Absorber
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing
items.desc: The Absorber is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Grand Gelatin, Baroclaw, and Giant Tortoise Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: The Amalgam
items.effect: All attacks inflict a variety of debuffs, 200% increased elemental debuff damage · Most buffs last twice as long, and persist after dying · Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10% · 'You have no idea how it's staying together' · Expert
items.desc: The Amalgam is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Amalgamated Brain. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: The Evolution
items.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%
items.desc: The Evolution is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Ceaseless Void. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Nucleogenesis
items.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 4 · Grants immunity to Shadowflame and Irradiated · 15% increased summon damage, and increased minion knockback · Minions inflict a variety of debuffs · Minions spawn damaging sparks on enemy hits · Does not stack with downgrades
items.desc: Nucleogenesis is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Star-Tainted Generator and Statis' Curse. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'
items.desc: The Reaper Tooth Necklace is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Sand Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

weapons.name: Dimension-Tearing Disk
weapons.source: Dropped by The Devourer of Gods
weapons.effect: Throws a disk that tears space in the direction of the nearest enemy · Stealth strikes stick to enemies and unleash God's Bane Doombeam Array
weapons.desc: The Dimension-Tearing Disk is a post- Moon Lord rogue boomerang that is dropped by The Devourer of Gods. When used, it throws a disk that passes through tiles and returns to the player after traveling a moderate distance. When thrown at nearby enemies, it will fire a nebula laser beam that deal 70% of the weapon's damage.

weapons.name: Executioner's Blade
weapons.source: Crafted at a Cosmic Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws a stream of homing blades · Stealth strikes summon a guillotine of blades on hit
weapons.desc: The Executioner's Blade is a post- Moon Lord rogue weapon. When used, it rapidly auto-fires a continuous stream of purple blades that home on nearby enemies and explode on impact. The blades pass through tiles and travel for a moderate distance before being affected by gravity.

weapons.name: Plasma Grenade
weapons.source: Crafted at a Cosmic Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws a grenade that explodes into plasma on collision · Stealth strikes explode violently on collision into a vaporizing blast · 'Each grenade contains a heavily condensed and heated unit of plasma. Use with extreme caution.'
weapons.desc: The Plasma Grenade is a post- Moon Lord bomb. When used, the bomb is affected by gravity after a short time. When it collides with a surface or enemy, it explodes, dealing damage within the area.

weapons.name: The Old Reaper
weapons.source: Dropped by The Old Duke
weapons.effect: Throws a scythe that cuts through enemies · Deposits unstable isotopes on hit, which create delayed nuclear explosions when they decay · Stealth strikes are thrown into the sky and fall upon enemies and few seconds later · On hit, stealth strikes create a focused deluge of acid rain
weapons.desc: The Old Reaper is a post- Moon Lord rogue weapon that drops from The Old Duke. When fired, it throws a scythe which spawns unstable isotope projectiles on enemy hits that explode after a brief delay.

weapons.name: Toxicant Twister
weapons.source: Dropped by The Old Duke
weapons.effect: Throws a fan of four spinning disks that swirl around your cursor · Stealth strikes swirl in a wider range and create a vortex of raindrops that home in on enemies
weapons.desc: The Toxicant Twister is a post- Moon Lord rogue boomerang that is dropped by The Old Duke. When used, it throws a fan of 4 boomerangs that spin and cluster around the cursor.

weapons.name: Claret Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a hypercondensed claret round · The round explodes upon striking an enemy and releases blood orbs · The explosion shreds enemies, dramatically reducing their defense · Picking up the blood orbs will reduce Potion Sickness when possible · If you do not have Potion Sickness , your natural regeneration will be enhanced · Can only fire once every 10 seconds · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Claret Cannon is a post- Moon Lord classless weapon. It fires a small claret round that explodes into 20 small floating blood orbs upon hitting an enemy. When collected by the player, each orb reduces the duration of the Potion Sickness debuff by 0.33 seconds.

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Eye of Magnus is a Hardmode classless weapon that is an upgraded version of the Lunic Eye. When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )
weapons.desc: The Rod of Discord is a Hardmode tool that has a 1/500 (0.2%) / 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by Chaos Elementals. When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Normality Relocator
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Press Normality Relocator to teleport to the position of the mouse · Fall speed is doubled for 0.5 seconds after teleporting · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Works while in the inventory · 'I'll be there in the blink of an eye'
weapons.desc: Normality Relocator is a post- Moon Lord tool. While it is in the player's inventory, they may press the Normality Relocator key to instantly warp to the position of the cursor. Unlike the Rod of Discord, the Relocator cannot be used normally like other tools via selecting it in the hotbar and pressing the ⚒ Use / Attack key.

weapons.name: Stratus Sphere
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Launches a singularity which exerts influence on all entities in a large area around it · Influenced players gain Starbursts over time and will consume Starbursts to fly when out of flight time · ⚷ Open / Activate to cause Starbursts to form a barrier, causing you to lose Starbursts instead of health · Launching the singularity deactivates the barrier, and creating the barrier deactivates the singularity · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats · 'Channeling souls into stars, an inane concept'
weapons.desc: The Stratus Sphere is a post- Moon Lord classless weapon. When used, it fires a massive planetary stratus orb that can pass through tiles.

armor.name: God Slayer armor
armor.effect: Press Dimensional Drive to Dimensional Drive towards your cursor for 1.25 seconds · Enemies you dash through take massive damage · During Dimensional Drive you are immune to damage and most debuffs · Dimensional Drive has a 45 second cooldown · Horned Greathelm: Enemies are more likely to target you · Releases a swarm of god killer darts when taking over 80 damage in one hit · Helmet: Ranged weapons fire a god killer shrapnel round every 2.5 seconds · Mask: +120 maximum stealth · 10% increased rogue damage, critical strike chance, and velocity when at full health · Increased length of invincibility when taking over 80 damage in one hit
armor.desc: God Slayer armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player will emit afterimages.
