items.desc: The Amalgam is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Amalgamated Brain. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: The Community
items.effect: 'The heart of (most of) the Terraria community' · Thank you to all of our supporters who made this mod a reality!
items.desc: The Community is an accessory that is dropped by Leviathan and Anahita. When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

items.name: The Evolution
items.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%
items.desc: The Evolution is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Ceaseless Void. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Arc Flash Ring
items.effect: Attacks have a 5% chance to call down a lightning bolt for 3x damage · The chance is reduced for each enemy an attack hits · The bolt's damage is based on non-crit damage, but can itself crit · Bolts are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled
items.desc: The Arc Flash Ring is an Expert Mode post- Moon Lord accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Storm Weaver. While equipped, it grants the player's attacks a 5% chance to fire down an arc flash that deals 3x the weapon's base damage and inflicts the Electrified debuff for 3 seconds.

items.name: Eclipse Mirror
items.effect: +10 maximum stealth · 6% increased rogue damage and rogue crit chance · Enemies are less likely to target you, even in the abyss · Stealth generates 25% faster when standing still and is boosted while moving if not attacking · Stealth strikes only expend 50% of your max stealth · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Dodging an attack restores stealth and releases a burst of highly damaging darksun light · 'Its reflection shows naught but darkness'
items.desc: The Eclipse Mirror is a post- Moon Lord rogue accessory and the direct upgrade to the Abyssal Mirror and Dark Matter Sheath. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Nanotech
items.effect: Rogue projectiles create nanoblades as they travel · Stealth strikes summon nanobeams and sparks on enemy hits · Stealth strikes have lifesteal, +15 armor penetration, deal 5% more damage · 15% increased rogue damage and 15% increased rogue velocity · Stealth strikes grant lifesteal and 10% critical strike chance to non-stealth strikes for 10 seconds
items.desc: The Nanotech is a post- Moon Lord rogue accessory that is a combination of the Rogue Emblem, Raider's Talisman, Vampiric Talisman, and Electrician's Glove. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'
items.desc: The Reaper Tooth Necklace is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Sand Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

items.name: Glove of Precision
items.effect: Decreases rogue attack speed by 15% · Increases rogue damage and critical strike chance by 10%, and velocity by 15%
items.desc: The Glove of Precision is a Hardmode rogue accessory that is sold by the Bandit for 48 after Plantera has been defeated. While equipped, it grants the following effects:

items.name: Spectral Veil
items.why: This is difficult and risky to use.
items.effect: Pressing Spectral Veil Teleport consumes 25% of your maximum stealth to teleport, rendering you invulnerable · If you dodge something while invulnerable, you instantly gain full stealth · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Stealth generates 15% faster · 'The inside of the cloak is full of teeth...'
items.desc: The Spectral Veil is an Expert Mode -exclusive post- Moon Lord rogue accessory that is obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Signus. While equipped, it makes stealth generate 15% faster.

weapons.name: Draconic Destruction
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: Fires a draconic sword beam that explodes into additional beams · Additional beams fly up and down to shred enemies
weapons.desc: The Draconic Destruction is a post- Moon Lord developer broadsword that autoswings. When swung, it fires a high-velocity sword beam that pierces infinitely, passes through tiles, and splits into 8 more sword beams in a circular formation on enemy hits. The split beams move out for a quick moment before erratically flying up and down constantly while spacing away from each other as they travel before dissipating.

weapons.name: Earth
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: A beautiful prismatic blade with unrivaled close combat proficiency · Heals you greatly on hit · Every other swing will summon three Gaia meteors to annihilate nearby enemies · 'All Its spawn shall know the beauty and wrath of their creator'
weapons.desc: Earth is a post- Moon Lord developer special sword. When used, the sword is rapidly swung in a circular motion around the player, leaving behind a rainbow trail, before swinging towards the cursor with a larger slash. The larger slash spawns 3 rainbow gaia meteors from the sky that deal 120% base damage and explode on hit, dealing an additional 75% base damage.

weapons.name: Illustrious Knives
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: Throws a barrage of fast-moving homing knives that heal the user
weapons.desc: The Illustrious Knives are a post- Moon Lord developer melee weapon. When used, the weapon launches a spread of 4-8 slow moving green knives, similar to the Vampire Knives. The knives are destroyed upon contact with tiles but will rapidly accelerate and home in on nearby enemies.

weapons.name: Ozzathoth
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: Reach: 55 tiles · Speed: 60 · Infinite throw duration · Fires cosmic orbs that blast nearby enemies with lasers · 'Destroy the universe in the blink of an eye'
weapons.desc: Ozzathoth is a post- Moon Lord developer yoyo. While deployed, it constantly fires roughly-stationary cosmic orbs. The cosmic orbs do not pass through tiles, and they deal 40% of the weapon's damage and have an innate 100 armor penetration.

weapons.name: Red Sun
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: Drops a barrage of solar flares from the sky · 'Over paradise'
weapons.desc: The Red Sun is a post- Moon Lord developer broadsword. When it is swung, a large number of solar flares fall from the sky at varying speeds and angles. The flares explode after some time or upon hitting an enemy, releasing multiple homing fragments when they do.

weapons.name: Triactis' True Paladinian Mage-Hammer of Might
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: Throws a heavy, gravity-affected hammer that will return to you after striking an enemy · Enemy hits release prismatic light flares which orbit around the struck foe · Instead of returning, the fourth hit transforms flares into hardlight hammers · These hammers converge and form a universe-collapsing explosion that always critically strikes
weapons.desc: Triactis' True Paladinian Mage-Hammer of Might is a post- Moon Lord developer thrown melee weapon. When used, it throws a heavy, gravity-affected hammer that will return to the player after striking an enemy. Every hit of the hammer spawns a prismatic light flare which orbits around the struck enemy.

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Eye of Magnus is a Hardmode classless weapon that is an upgraded version of the Lunic Eye. When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

weapons.name: Rod of Harmony
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor
weapons.desc: The Rod of Harmony is a Hardmode, post- Moon Lord tool. It is the direct upgrade to the Rod of Discord, instantly teleporting the player to the location of the cursor when used, but without inflicting the Chaos State debuff.

armor.desc: The Auric Tesla armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is equipped, the player will emit afterimages and release a trail of golden sparkles while moving.

armor.name: Gem Tech armor
armor.effect: Power Gems - Six gem fragments idly orbit you; one for each class, and a base gem · Each active gem provides a bonus for its respective class, while the defensive gem grants defensive boosts · Powerful enemy hits will dislodge gems, launching them into the nearest enemy for huge damage · Losts gems regenerate after a while · The lost gem is the same class as the weapon you are using, so better prepare for some weapon switching action! · Hold Shift to see an expanded description A gem is lost when you take more than 100 damage in a single hit · The type of game lost is the same as the class of the most recently used weapon · If said gem has already been lost, the base gem is lost instead · When a gem is lost, it breaks off and homes towards the nearest enemy or boss, dealing a base of 40000 damage · Gems have a 30 second delay before they appear again · The red gem grants 130 maximum stealth, increased rogue stats, and makes stealth only consumable by rogue weapons · The yellow gem provides increased melee stats and makes melee attacks release shards on hit with a cooldown. armor.desc: Gem Tech armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set.

accessories.effect: Lights your cursor ablaze with the Witch's flames, engulfing it in a blazing aura · Enemies touching the blaze take immense damage and are inflicted with Vulnerability Hex · Focusing an enemy for 2.5 seconds curses them, ascending Vulnerability Hex to its True form · Foes afflicted with True Vulnerability Hex take 1.15x damage from all sources · This effect is increased to 2.5x for the blazing cursor itself · Equip in a vanity slot to change the cursor without dealing damage · These changes work in conjunction with the Rainbow Cursor
accessories.desc: Calamity is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas. When equipped, a flaming aura spawns at the player's cursor. accessories.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
accessories.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'
accessories.desc: The Reaper Tooth Necklace is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Sand Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

accessories.name: Chalice of the Blood God
accessories.effect: Increases max HP by 25% · +2 HP/s life regen and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25% · Taking more than 5 damage converts the hit into a damage over time bleed effect · This bleeding does not interfere with life regeneration · Drinking a healing potion removes some of the remaining bleed, up to 50% of its heal value · Unequipping this accessory while bleeding inflicts the remaining damage instantly · Grants immunity to Bleeding , Burning Blood , Heavy Bleeding and Laceration · 'All that for a drop of blood...'
accessories.desc: The Chalice of the Blood God is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is a combination of the Blood Pact and Charm of Myths. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Draedon's Heart
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 15% reduced contact damage from enemies · Replaces Adrenaline with the Nanomachines meter · Unlike Adrenaline, you lose no Nanomachines when you take damage, but they stop accumulating for 1 second · With full Nanomachines, press Adrenaline Mode to heal 180 health over 2 seconds · While healing you take [DR]% less damage · 'Nanomachines, son'
accessories.desc: Draedon's Heart is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by the Exo Mechs. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Radiance
accessories.effect: +1 to +4 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Reduces damage over time taken by 10 HP/s and jump-starts regeneration after a damaging debuff ends · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit shining blue light if visibility is enabled · 'A once putrid crystal, now glimmering with immaculate purity'
accessories.desc: The Radiance is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Ambrosial Ampoule and Infected Jewel. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Rampart of Deities
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Releases a blast of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health or taking high damage attacks · Reduces damage taken by 25% when below 50% life · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when you are above 25% life · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect
accessories.desc: The Rampart of Deities is a post- Moon Lord shield accessory and the direct upgrade to the Frozen Shield and Deific Amulet. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: The Sponge
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Gain a barrier with 120 health · The barrier grants 10% damage reduction while active · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · The barrier will regenerate 8 seconds after being hit, taking 10 seconds to completely regenerate · Getting hit resets the timer
accessories.desc: The Sponge is a post- Moon Lord accessory which is the direct upgrade of the Rover Drive. After eight seconds of equipping the item without taking damage, a barrier covers its user, which grants 10% damage reduction. As the barrier is formed, it builds up to 120 shield durability at a rate of 12 durability per second.

buffs.name: Omega Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Omega Healing Potion is a post- Moon Lord potion that heals the player for 300 health, and inflicts the Potion Sickness debuff upon use. It is also dropped from the Primordial Wyrm, The Devourer of Gods, each individual Exo Mech, Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth and Supreme Witch, Calamitas.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.desc: The Seafood Dinner is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: This is the default early combat potion because the defense increase matters in every fight.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Lifeforce Potion is a buff potion that grants the Lifeforce buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: It gives a steady survivability bump through long exploration trips and drawn-out boss fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Flask of Crumbling
buffs.source: Crafted at an Imbuing Station
buffs.station: Imbuing Station
buffs.desc: The Flask of Crumbling is a Hardmode flask. Upon consumption, it grants the Weapon Imbue: Crumbling buff, which causes all melee, whip, and rogue attacks to inflict the Crumbling debuff.

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Sharpening Station
buffs.source: Found in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle
buffs.why: Grants armor penetration to melee weapons while standing near it.
buffs.desc: The Sharpening Station is a furniture item found naturally generated in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle. In Hardmode, it is also sold by the Merchant for 10 GC.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Soaring Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

items.name: Seraph Tracers
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4.17 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 50% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava and damaging tiles, including Auric Ore · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Taking speed EVEN FURTHER BEYOND!'
items.desc: The Seraph Tracers are a post- Moon Lord accessory. They are the direct upgrade to the Void Striders and final upgrade to the Hermes Boots. They grant the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Wings of Rebirth
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 6 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 'Resplendent to the very end'
items.desc: The Wings of Rebirth are a post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory that are dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth. When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

items.name: Ascendant Insignia
items.effect: Increases wing flight time by 50%, movement and jump speed by 15%, and acceleration by 1.5x · Pressing Ascendant Insignia Hotkey grants you the power of ascension, providing infinite flight time for 4 seconds · Ascension has a 40 second cooldown
items.desc: The Ascendant Insignia is a post- Moon Lord accessory and an upgrade to the Soaring Insignia. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Asgardian Aegis
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash, empowered by a cosmic inferno · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage
items.desc: The Asgardian Aegis is a post- Moon Lord shield accessory and the direct upgrade to the Asgard's Valor and Elysian Aegis. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Statis' Void Sash
items.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 20% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.85x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws
items.desc: The Statis' Void Sash is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Statis' Ninja Belt. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.desc: The Rampart of Deities is a post- Moon Lord shield accessory and the direct upgrade to the Frozen Shield and Deific Amulet. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Gain a barrier with 120 health · The barrier grants 10% damage reduction while active · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · The barrier will regenerate 8 seconds after being hit, taking 10 seconds to completely regenerate · Getting hit resets the timer
items.desc: The Sponge is a post- Moon Lord accessory which is the direct upgrade of the Rover Drive. After eight seconds of equipping the item without taking damage, a barrier covers its user, which grants 10% damage reduction. As the barrier is formed, it builds up to 120 shield durability at a rate of 12 durability per second.

items.name: Affliction
items.effect: Gives all teammates +0.5 HP/s life regen, +10% max life, 7% damage reduction, 9 defense and 10% increased damage
items.desc: Affliction is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode. While equipped, all the player's teammates in the same team are granted the Afflicted buff, which provides all the bonuses that the accessory itself provides.

items.name: Dark Sun Ring
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased damage · +0.5 HP/s life regen and +2 max minions · Increased minion knockback · Grants various buffs as the day goes on · 'Contains the power of the dark sun'
items.desc: The Dark Sun Ring is a post- Moon Lord accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Shattered Community
items.effect: 'Ruined by unknowable hatred, it still contains (most of) the power of The Community...' · Increases damage, max health, and movement speed by 10% · Increases defense by 10, and life regen by 1 HP/s · Increases critical strike chance and damage reduction by 5%, and flight time by 20% · You generate rage over time and rage does not fade out of combat · Gain rage after taking damage regardless of defensive stats · While Rage Mode is active, taking damage gives only half as much rage · Deal damage with Rage Mode to further empower your wrath · Current level: [LEVEL] (+[BOOST]% Rage Mode damage) · Progress to next level: [PROGRESS RATIO]% · Total Rage Mode damage: [CUMULATIVE DAMAGE DEALT]
items.desc: The Shattered Community is a post- Moon Lord developer accessory. It is the exhumed form of The Community. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: The Absorber
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing
items.desc: The Absorber is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Grand Gelatin, Baroclaw, and Giant Tortoise Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: The Amalgam
items.effect: All attacks inflict a variety of debuffs, 200% increased elemental debuff damage · Most buffs last twice as long, and persist after dying · Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10% · 'You have no idea how it's staying together' · Expert
items.desc: The Amalgam is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Amalgamated Brain. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: The Evolution
items.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%
items.desc: The Evolution is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Ceaseless Void. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Arc Flash Ring
items.effect: Attacks have a 5% chance to call down a lightning bolt for 3x damage · The chance is reduced for each enemy an attack hits · The bolt's damage is based on non-crit damage, but can itself crit · Bolts are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled
items.desc: The Arc Flash Ring is an Expert Mode post- Moon Lord accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Storm Weaver. While equipped, it grants the player's attacks a 5% chance to fire down an arc flash that deals 3x the weapon's base damage and inflicts the Electrified debuff for 3 seconds.

items.name: Badge of Bravery
items.effect: Increases melee damage and critical strike chance by 10% · Increases melee armor penetration by 5
items.desc: The Badge of Bravery is a post- Moon Lord accessory. When equipped, it increases melee damage and critical strike chance by 10%, and armor penetration by 5.

items.name: Calamity
items.effect: Lights your cursor ablaze with the Witch's flames, engulfing it in a blazing aura · Enemies touching the blaze take immense damage and are inflicted with Vulnerability Hex · Focusing an enemy for 2.5 seconds curses them, ascending Vulnerability Hex to its True form · Foes afflicted with True Vulnerability Hex take 1.15x damage from all sources · This effect is increased to 2.5x for the blazing cursor itself · Equip in a vanity slot to change the cursor without dealing damage · These changes work in conjunction with the Rainbow Cursor
items.desc: Calamity is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas. When equipped, a flaming aura spawns at the player's cursor. While an enemy is within range, the aura glows and continuously deals 320 damage at a rate of 12 hits per second, inflicting the Vulnerability Hex debuff.

items.name: Elemental Gauntlet
items.effect: Melee attacks and projectiles inflict Elemental Mix · 15% increased melee damage and melee speed · 5% increased melee critical strike chance · 20% increased true melee damage and increased melee knockback · Enables auto swing for melee weapons and increases their size · Does not stack with downgrades
items.desc: The Elemental Gauntlet is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the final upgrade to the Titan Glove and Feral Claws. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'
items.desc: The Reaper Tooth Necklace is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Sand Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

weapons.name: Contagion
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: Fires contagion arrows that leave exploding orbs behind as they travel
weapons.desc: The Contagion is a post- Moon Lord developer bow. It fires arrows that leave behind a trail of orbs, exploding after a short delay. Holding left-click will cause the bow to "spin-up", increasing the fire rate appreciably.

weapons.name: Halibut Cannon
weapons.source: Dropped by the Primordial Wyrm
weapons.effect: 'Yes, it's still overpowered'
weapons.desc: The Halibut Cannon is a gun that is dropped by the Primordial Wyrm. When used, it fires out between 25 and 35 bullets per shot that slowly spread out, while only consuming one unit of ammo.

weapons.name: Soma Prime
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: This weapon can supercrit if its crit chance is over 100% · All bullets fired have a 5% chance to inflict Shred , a stacking bleed debuff · Critical strikes deal 3x damage instead of 2x by default and have a 30% chance to inflict Shred · Shred deals 600 DPS per stack and scales with your ranged stats · Damage ticks of Shred can critically strike for 3x damage and can supercrit · Replaces musket balls with enhanced High Velocity Bullets · 80% chance to save ammo
weapons.desc: The Soma Prime is a post- Moon Lord developer gun. When used, it very rapidly fires bullets in a small spread. It also converts Musket Balls into high-damage High Velocity Bullets which have 4 additional base damage.

weapons.name: Svantechnical
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: Fires a trinity of energy bolts that split into beams that track your cursor · Ignores 200 points of enemy Defense · 80% chance to save ammo · 'The age old balance of trading damage for frames'
weapons.desc: The Svantechnical is a post- Moon Lord developer gun. When used, it fires three streams of charged energy bolts in a sine-wave pattern. Each bolt splits off into 2 small bolts in a wide backwards spread upon hitting an enemy or tile, before turning around after travelling a small distance.

weapons.name: Voidragon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: Loads a 50 round magazine of alternating bullets and concentrated void blasts · When all bullets are fired, the gun unleashes an enormous jet of abyssal fire · The power of the abyssal fire scales with the amount of shots hit · 66% chance to save ammo · 'Fade to black'
weapons.desc: The Voidragon is a post- Moon Lord developer gun which is the upgraded version of Seadragon and the final upgrade to the Minishark. When used, it loads a magazine of 50 shots, then alternates between firing bullets and concentrated void blasts that inflict the Whispering Death debuff. After exhausting the entire magazine, the gun charges up before unleashing a massive abyssal fire beam for 8.33 seconds that inflicts Whispering Death and Demonic Flames before having to reload again, repeating the process.

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Eye of Magnus is a Hardmode classless weapon that is an upgraded version of the Lunic Eye. When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

weapons.name: Rod of Harmony
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor
weapons.desc: The Rod of Harmony is a Hardmode, post- Moon Lord tool. It is the direct upgrade to the Rod of Discord, instantly teleporting the player to the location of the cursor when used, but without inflicting the Chaos State debuff.

armor.desc: The Auric Tesla armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is equipped, the player will emit afterimages and release a trail of golden sparkles while moving.

armor.name: Gem Tech armor
armor.effect: Power Gems - Six gem fragments idly orbit you; one for each class, and a base gem · Each active gem provides a bonus for its respective class, while the defensive gem grants defensive boosts · Powerful enemy hits will dislodge gems, launching them into the nearest enemy for huge damage · Losts gems regenerate after a while · The lost gem is the same class as the weapon you are using, so better prepare for some weapon switching action! · Hold Shift to see an expanded description A gem is lost when you take more than 100 damage in a single hit · The type of game lost is the same as the class of the most recently used weapon · If said gem has already been lost, the base gem is lost instead · When a gem is lost, it breaks off and homes towards the nearest enemy or boss, dealing a base of 40000 damage · Gems have a 30 second delay before they appear again · The red gem grants 130 maximum stealth, increased rogue stats, and makes stealth only consumable by rogue weapons · The yellow gem provides increased melee stats and makes melee attacks release shards on hit with a cooldown. This cooldown is shorter for true melee attacks · The green gem provides increased ranged stats and causes flechettes to fly swiftly towards targets when they are damaged by a ranged projectile · The blue gem grants 4 maximum minions, increased summon damage, and negates the summon damage penalty while wielding non-summoner weapons · The violet gem grants 100 maximum mana, increased magic stats, and makes mana rapidly regenerate when holding a non-magic weapon · The pink base gem grants 75 defense, increased damage reduction, movement speed, jump speed, and +1 HP/s life regen · When all gems exist simultaneously, hitting a target with any weapon grants you +1 HP/s life regen for 8 seconds · This is increased to +1.5 HP/s life regen if a weapon of another class is used during that 8 second period for 2.5 seconds
armor.desc: Gem Tech armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set.

accessories.name: Seraph Tracers
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4.17 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 50% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava and damaging tiles, including Auric Ore · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Taking speed EVEN FURTHER BEYOND!'
accessories.desc: The Seraph Tracers are a post- Moon Lord accessory. They are the direct upgrade to the Void Striders and final upgrade to the Hermes Boots. They grant the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Wings of Rebirth
accessories.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 6 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 'Resplendent to the very end'
accessories.desc: The Wings of Rebirth are a post- Moon Lord wing -type accessory that are dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth. When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

accessories.name: Affliction
accessories.source: Dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode
accessories.effect: Gives all teammates +0.5 HP/s life regen, +10% max life, 7% damage reduction, 9 defense and 10% increased damage
accessories.desc: Affliction is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode. While equipped, all the player's teammates in the same team are granted the Afflicted buff, which provides all the bonuses that the accessory itself provides.

accessories.name: Dark Sun Ring
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased damage · +0.5 HP/s life regen and +2 max minions · Increased minion knockback · Grants various buffs as the day goes on · 'Contains the power of the dark sun'
accessories.desc: The Dark Sun Ring is a post- Moon Lord accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Shattered Community
accessories.effect: 'Ruined by unknowable hatred, it still contains (most of) the power of The Community...' · Increases damage, max health, and movement speed by 10% · Increases defense by 10, and life regen by 1 HP/s · Increases critical strike chance and damage reduction by 5%, and flight time by 20% · You generate rage over time and rage does not fade out of combat · Gain rage after taking damage regardless of defensive stats · While Rage Mode is active, taking damage gives only half as much rage · Deal damage with Rage Mode to further empower your wrath · Current level: [LEVEL] (+[BOOST]% Rage Mode damage) · Progress to next level: [PROGRESS RATIO]% · Total Rage Mode damage: [CUMULATIVE DAMAGE DEALT]
accessories.desc: The Shattered Community is a post- Moon Lord developer accessory. It is the exhumed form of The Community. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: The Absorber
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing
accessories.desc: The Absorber is a Hardmode accessory and the direct upgrade to the Grand Gelatin, Baroclaw, and Giant Tortoise Shell. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: The Amalgam
accessories.effect: All attacks inflict a variety of debuffs, 200% increased elemental debuff damage · Most buffs last twice as long, and persist after dying · Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10% · 'You have no idea how it's staying together' · Expert
accessories.desc: The Amalgam is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Amalgamated Brain. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: The Evolution
accessories.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%
accessories.desc: The Evolution is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Ceaseless Void. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Ascendant Insignia
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Increases wing flight time by 50%, movement and jump speed by 15%, and acceleration by 1.5x · Pressing Ascendant Insignia Hotkey grants you the power of ascension, providing infinite flight time for 4 seconds · Ascension has a 40 second cooldown
accessories.desc: The Ascendant Insignia is a post- Moon Lord accessory and an upgrade to the Soaring Insignia. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Asgardian Aegis
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash, empowered by a cosmic inferno · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage
accessories.desc: The Asgardian Aegis is a post- Moon Lord shield accessory and the direct upgrade to the Asgard's Valor and Elysian Aegis. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Statis' Void Sash
accessories.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 20% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.85x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws
accessories.desc: The Statis' Void Sash is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Statis' Ninja Belt. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Arc Flash Ring
accessories.effect: Attacks have a 5% chance to call down a lightning bolt for 3x damage · The chance is reduced for each enemy an attack hits · The bolt's damage is based on non-crit damage, but can itself crit · Bolts are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled
accessories.desc: The Arc Flash Ring is an Expert Mode post- Moon Lord accessory obtained from the Treasure Bag dropped by Storm Weaver. While equipped, it grants the player's attacks a 5% chance to fire down an arc flash that deals 3x the weapon's base damage and inflicts the Electrified debuff for 3 seconds.

accessories.name: Calamity
accessories.effect: Lights your cursor ablaze with the Witch's flames, engulfing it in a blazing aura · Enemies touching the blaze take immense damage and are inflicted with Vulnerability Hex · Focusing an enemy for 2.5 seconds curses them, ascending Vulnerability Hex to its True form · Foes afflicted with True Vulnerability Hex take 1.15x damage from all sources · This effect is increased to 2.5x for the blazing cursor itself · Equip in a vanity slot to change the cursor without dealing damage · These changes work in conjunction with the Rainbow Cursor
accessories.desc: Calamity is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by Supreme Witch, Calamitas. When equipped, a flaming aura spawns at the player's cursor. While an enemy is within range, the aura glows and continuously deals 320 damage at a rate of 12 hits per second, inflicting the Vulnerability Hex debuff.

accessories.name: Daawnlight Spirit Origin
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: All ranged weapons can supercrit when critical strike chance is over 100% · Marks enemies and bosses with bullseyes which boost critical strike chance when hit · Extra critical strike chance quickly fades over time · Summons a heroic spirit from another world if visibility is on or in vanity slots · 'A strand of a lost cosmos remains, waiting for its master'
accessories.desc: The Daawnlight Spirit Origin is a post- Moon Lord accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Planebreaker's Pouch
accessories.effect: 15% increased ranged damage, 7% increased ranged critical strike chance and 20% reduced ammo usage · Grants a 20% chance to not consume arrows · Pressing Ammo Cycle Hotkey will automatically swap the ammos in your ammo slots · The ammo type swapped depends on the ammo of the weapon you are holding
accessories.desc: The Planebreaker's Pouch is a post- Moon Lord accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
accessories.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'
accessories.desc: The Reaper Tooth Necklace is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Sand Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

accessories.name: Sniper Scope
accessories.why: 10% ranged damage and crit, and zooms out when you right-click with a gun.
accessories.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance
accessories.desc: The Sniper Scope is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Chalice of the Blood God
accessories.effect: Increases max HP by 25% · +2 HP/s life regen and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25% · Taking more than 5 damage converts the hit into a damage over time bleed effect · This bleeding does not interfere with life regeneration · Drinking a healing potion removes some of the remaining bleed, up to 50% of its heal value · Unequipping this accessory while bleeding inflicts the remaining damage instantly · Grants immunity to Bleeding , Burning Blood , Heavy Bleeding and Laceration · 'All that for a drop of blood...'
accessories.desc: The Chalice of the Blood God is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is a combination of the Blood Pact and Charm of Myths. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Draedon's Heart
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 15% reduced contact damage from enemies · Replaces Adrenaline with the Nanomachines meter · Unlike Adrenaline, you lose no Nanomachines when you take damage, but they stop accumulating for 1 second · With full Nanomachines, press Adrenaline Mode to heal 180 health over 2 seconds · While healing you take [DR]% less damage · 'Nanomachines, son'
accessories.desc: Draedon's Heart is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is dropped by the Exo Mechs. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Radiance
accessories.effect: +1 to +4 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Reduces damage over time taken by 10 HP/s and jump-starts regeneration after a damaging debuff ends · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit shining blue light if visibility is enabled · 'A once putrid crystal, now glimmering with immaculate purity'
accessories.desc: The Radiance is a post- Moon Lord accessory and the direct upgrade to the Ambrosial Ampoule and Infected Jewel. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: Rampart of Deities
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Releases a blast of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health or taking high damage attacks · Reduces damage taken by 25% when below 50% life · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when you are above 25% life · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect
accessories.desc: The Rampart of Deities is a post- Moon Lord shield accessory and the direct upgrade to the Frozen Shield and Deific Amulet. It grants the following effects while equipped:

accessories.name: The Sponge
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Gain a barrier with 120 health · The barrier grants 10% damage reduction while active · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · The barrier will regenerate 8 seconds after being hit, taking 10 seconds to completely regenerate · Getting hit resets the timer
accessories.desc: The Sponge is a post- Moon Lord accessory which is the direct upgrade of the Rover Drive. After eight seconds of equipping the item without taking damage, a barrier covers its user, which grants 10% damage reduction. As the barrier is formed, it builds up to 120 shield durability at a rate of 12 durability per second.

buffs.name: Omega Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Omega Healing Potion is a post- Moon Lord potion that heals the player for 300 health, and inflicts the Potion Sickness debuff upon use. It is also dropped from the Primordial Wyrm, The Devourer of Gods, each individual Exo Mech, Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth and Supreme Witch, Calamitas.

buffs.name: Seafood Dinner
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.desc: The Seafood Dinner is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. This lasts for 14 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Survival matters a lot once the phase is dominated by hard optional content and fast fights.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Endurance Potion is a buff potion that grants the Endurance buff when consumed, which provides +10% damage reduction. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Even ranged classes need extra defense when bosses or cave enemies close the gap.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ironskin Potion is a buff potion that grants the Ironskin buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's defense by 8, thus reducing damage by 4 / 6 / 8. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Lifeforce Potion is a buff potion that grants the Lifeforce buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's health capacity by up to 20% (see below for details). This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Regeneration Potion is a buff potion which grants the Regeneration buff when consumed. The buff provides health regeneration by restoring an additional 2 health per second, for a total of 960 health. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ammo Box
buffs.source: Placed station buff
buffs.why: Endgame ranger still wants free ammo efficiency before every serious fight.
buffs.desc: The Ammo Box is a furniture item. It can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for 10 GC in Hardmode.

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Ammo consumption adds up quickly, so this makes a stack last longer.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Ammo Reservation Potion is a buff potion which grants the Ammo Reservation buff when consumed. The buff reduces the chance of consuming any ammunition by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Archery Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Raises arrow damage by 10% and arrow speed by 20%. Bows only.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Archery Potion is a buff potion which grants the Archery buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage of arrow -firing weapons by 10%, as well as the velocity of arrows by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Rage Potion is a buff potion which grants the Rage buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's critical strike chance by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Wrath Potion is a buff potion which grants the Wrath buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage dealt by melee, ranged, magic, and summon weapons by 10%. This lasts for 4 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Soaring Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at an Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Alchemy Table
buffs.desc: The Soaring Potion is a Hardmode buff potion. Upon consumption, it grants the Soaring buff, which increases wing flight time and horizontal flight speed by 10%.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Extra movement speed compounds with your mobility accessories and makes dodging much more forgiving.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.desc: The Swiftness Potion is a buff potion which grants the Swiftness buff when consumed. The buff increases the player's maximum movement speed by 25%, but does not stack with sprinting accessories (such as Hermes Boots), nor does it affect the speed of mounts. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: God Slayer Slug
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cosmic Anvil
buffs.station: Cosmic Anvil
buffs.desc: God Slayer Slugs are post- Moon Lord bullets. They initially behave similarly to Luminite Bullets, piercing infinitely and moving at a high velocity. Upon contact with an enemy, their lifespan will be limited and they will gain the ability to warp after despawning.

ammo.name: Vanquisher Arrow
ammo.desc: Vanquisher Arrows are post- Moon Lord arrows. They appear as pink or magenta colors, can pass through tiles and aggressively seek the closest target within 4 tiles of range, inflicting the God Slayer Inferno debuff. They can pierce once, dealing 40% on the initial hit and full damage on the second hit.

items.effect: 15% increased ranged damage, 7% increased ranged critical strike chance and 20% reduced ammo usage · Grants a 20% chance to not consume arrows · Pressing Ammo Cycle Hotkey will automatically swap the ammos in your ammo slots · The ammo type swapped depends on the ammo of the weapon you are holding
items.desc: The Planebreaker's Pouch is a post- Moon Lord accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'
items.desc: The Reaper Tooth Necklace is a post- Moon Lord accessory that is a direct upgrade to the Sand Shark Tooth Necklace. When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

items.name: Sniper Scope
items.why: This grants critical strike damage.
items.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance
items.desc: The Sniper Scope is a Hardmode, post- Golem accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:

weapons.name: Apotheosis
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: Unleashes interdimensional projection magic · Eat worms
weapons.desc: Apotheosis is a post- Moon Lord developer spell tome. When used, it summons a cosmic portal that releases a mini Devourer of Gods that swarms enemies and fires lasers at them, before disappearing 5 seconds later. The mini-Devourer of Gods inflicts God Slayer Inferno and Whispering Death.

weapons.name: Eternity
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: Hexes a possible nearby enemy, trapping them in a brilliant display of destruction · 'There's pictures of ponies in the book'
weapons.desc: Eternity is a post- Moon Lord developer spell tome. When used, it will create a large circle, which inside will have five crystals, a beam, and a group of projectiles that create a flower shape while traveling, all of which will be centered around a nearby enemy. The beam will travel in an infinity shape.

weapons.name: Rainbow Party Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: 'Let the rainbow remind you that together we will always shine...'
weapons.desc: The Rainbow Party Cannon is a post- Moon Lord developer magic gun. When used, a cannon appears locked to the player's location, pointing either left or right towards the direction of the cursor. It is unable to change direction until released.

weapons.name: Staff of Blushie
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: Hold your mouse, wait, wait, wait, and put your trust in the power of blue magic
weapons.desc: The Staff of Blushie is a post- Moon Lord developer wand. Upon holding the ⚒ Use / Attack button with the weapon in hand, five blue gears will appear on the screen which are connected by a series of chains, and a row of blue fire appears some distance below. These effects are purely aesthetic, and will follow the player as they move.

weapons.name: Sylvestaff
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: Casts a bouncing beam that splits when enemies are near it · 'Also known as the Karma Staff!'
weapons.desc: The Sylvestaff is a post- Moon Lord developer wand. When used, it fires a beam with a pink, white, and blue trail that bounces off tiles in quick succession and pierces infinitely. When enemies are nearby, the beam will emit small splitting beams that are aimed towards the nearest enemy and do not bounce on tiles.

weapons.name: The Dance of Light
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: Barrages enemies with a hailstorm of Light Blades · 'And in a flash of light, nothing remains'
weapons.desc: The Dance of Light is a post- Moon Lord developer spell tome. When used, it rapidly summons four pairs of fast inaccurate light blades from a cone around the player towards the cursor's direction. Each pair of light blades will curve, converge, and home with each other and they pierce once and go through tiles.

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats
weapons.desc: The Eye of Magnus is a Hardmode classless weapon that is an upgraded version of the Lunic Eye. When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

weapons.name: Rod of Harmony
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor
weapons.desc: The Rod of Harmony is a Hardmode, post- Moon Lord tool. It is the direct upgrade to the Rod of Discord, instantly teleporting the player to the location of the cursor when used, but without inflicting the Chaos State debuff.

armor.name: Auric Tesla armor
armor.effect: Inherited Universal Set Bonuses: Inherited Tarragon Set Bonus: · Increased heart pickup range · Enemies have a chance to drop extra hearts on death · Inherited Bloodflare Set Bonus: · Enemies below 50% life drop a heart when struck · This effect has a 5 second cooldown · Inherited God Slayer Set Bonus (if applicable): · Press Dimensional Drive to Dimensional Drive towards your cursor for 1.25 seconds · Enemies you dash through take massive damage · During Dimensional Drive you are immune to damage and most debuff · Dimensional Drive has a 45 second cooldown · Inherited Silva Set Bonus (if applicable): · +3 HP/s life regen · 5% increased max run speed and acceleration · Taking fatal damage will revive you and make you invulnerable to all damage for 5 seconds · This effect has a 5 minute cooldown, which does not decrement if any bosses or events are active · Royal Helm: Enemies are more likely to target you · Melee Tarragon, Bloodflare and God Slayer effects · Bonus to cloak yourself in life energy that heavily reduces enemy contact damage for 10 seconds · This has a 30 second cooldown · Inherited Bloodflare Set Bonus: · After striking an enemy 15 times with true melee you will enter a blood frenzy for 5 seconds · During this you will gain 25% increased melee damage, critical strike chance, and 50% reduced contact damage · This effect has a 30 second cooldown · Inherited God Slayer Set Bonus: · Releases a swarm of god killer darts when taking over 80 damage in one hit · Hooded Facemask: Ranged Tarragon, Bloodflare and God Slayer armor effects · Hold Shift to view these set bonus details and press Shift repeatedly to cycle through them Inherited Tarragon Set Bonus: · Ranged projectiles spawn homing life energy and leaves on enemy hits · Inherited Bloodflare Set Bonus: · Armor Set Bonus to unleash the lost souls of polterghast to destroy your enemies · This effect has a 30 second cooldown · Ranged weapons fire bloodsplosion orbs every 2.5 seconds · Inherited God Slayer Set Bonus: · Ranged weapons fire a god killer shrapnel round every 2.5 seconds · Wire-Hemmed Visage: Magic Tarragon, Bloodflare and Silva armor effects · Hold Shift to view these set bonus details and press Shift repeatedly to cycle through them Inherited Tarragon Set Bonus: · On every 5th critical strike you will fire a leaf storm · Inherited Bloodflare Set Bonus: · Magic weapons fire ghostly bolts every 1.67 seconds · Magic critical strikes cause blood explosions every 2 seconds · Inherited Silva Set Bonus: · Magic projectiles which cannot pierce will occasionally set off potent blasts of nature energy · Space Helmet: Increases your max number of minions by 4 · 55% increased summon damage · Summoner Tarragon, Bloodflare and Silva armor effects · Hold Shift to view these set bonus details and press Shift repeatedly to cycle through them Inherited Tarragon Set Bonus: · Summons a life aura around you that damages nearby enemies · Inherited Bloodflare Set Bonus: · Summons polterghast mines to circle you · Grants 20 defense when below 50% life · Inherited Silva Set Bonus: · Summons an ancient leaf prism to blast your enemies with life Inherited Tarragon Set Bonus: · After every 50 rogue critical hits you will gain 2.5 seconds of damage immunity · This effect has a cooldown of 25 seconds · While under the effects of a debuff you
